reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nature’s Masterpiece on the Ionian Sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach is one of Kefalonia’s most iconic destinations, famous for its turquoise waters and striking white pebble shore. The surrounding cliffs create a dramatic and breathtaking setting. When the wind picks up, waves can be strong, adding excitement for those who enjoy a bit of adventure in the water. During the high season, the beach can get crowded, but visiting later in the afternoon provides a more peaceful experience and the chance to enjoy unforgettable sunsets. Easily accessible and full of natural beauty

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wild wonder not suitable for certain tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, beautiful setting still wild. The choice of the few umbrellas, at a super honest price something forgotten now in Italy, and the absence of the bar are a plus, those who complain about it went somewhere else. Greece has something for everyone. I hope that it will remain so forever with a nature-friendly tourism.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtakingly beautiful from the top, gut wrenching disappointing at the bottom
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited in mid October - I’d hate to be here mid summer when I suspect it would be rammed. The beach is made of white pebbles - uncomfortable unless you bring sea shoes and chairs with you. Toilets and changing facilities aside (all clean!), that was where the facilities stopped - was it due to being mid October? Surprised to be honest, given this is one of the top spots to visit. Sea was just as crystal clear as it looks from the top - bit rough and shelved sharply. There’s natural shade depending on which end you sit on, but otherwise a suntrap and you needn’t take your own parasol. Road down was winding and parking good - again, I’d hate to see what it’s like in the summer. Glad we’ve been, may well go back before we go home, but to be honest, given the spectacular view from the top, the reality of it down below couldn’t be more different and we were desperately disappointed….

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful to look at…
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We’ve visited here a number if times over the years. Never loses its beauty but we tend to not stay long - not the safest of beaches for swimming especially for children. And why is there no taverna or cafe anymore?! So, in summary, take pics, admire but then move on!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach with stunning views from the top so make sure you stop to get the best photos of this lovely place. The sand is very fine but you might need beach shoes and it's gravel like in places .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrthos Beach, fantastically beautiful and highly recommended (possibly period dependent)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach – fantastically beautiful and highly recommended!The approach leads over a winding but well-developed road – completely problem-free and at the same time a small highlight, as the view from above of the beach is simply gigantic. We were there in the postseason and found enough, even infinite parking spaces.The beach itself is impressive: crystal-clear, turquoise waters that delight from afar. We could easily lie in front of the beach and enjoy the atmosphere. Our five-year-old daughter had great fun – she could run into the water, swim a bit and jump in the waves.Important to know: Directly on the beach there is no kiosk or snack bar. If you want to eat or drink, simply drive 1–2 kilometers up the mountain (about three minutes by car). There you will find a small collection of restaurants and supermarkets, perfect for a break or to stock up on everything you need.Alles in allem: An unforgettable beach, dreamlike scenery, crystal clear water and well organized, even if there is no food downstairs. Absolutely worth a visit!⸻Would you like me to give you the review in a shorter, crisper version that you could post directly on Google Maps?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top beach! But without the bar:(
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, easy to reach, some hairpin bends, there are several places to park. Lots of gravel, I highly recommend the shoes because it hurts. At the bottom there is also a natural cave, great for taking nice pictures. There are showers (4), the only flaw that there is no bar. So bring your own food and drink! Ps. There is a guy who distributes home made sugar doughnuts (cash only).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Charming island. After 10 years you haven't aged at all
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you go early before it fills up it is the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia. Beautiful water. I came back after 10 years and I liked it even more

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking beach. We drove the narrow roads in the mountains  to get to it. The sea really was electric blue and sand was white. We didn’t swim as we’d heard that it’s not a safe shallow beach but still beautiful to see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To see at least for a few hours ..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach mixed sand and white stone, personally I did not find it up to the reviews but probably due to the cloudy and windy day that made the sea rough and difficult to enjoy both for snorkeling and for a swim. In September we parked practically on the beach without problems.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The absolute beauty in every moment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've always been going for 50 years and it's the most beautiful place on the planet. Especially this year without the over-organization, without a pitch bar. Whether in the morning or at noon or at sunset, wave or calm, Myrtos is unique. I am sorry that so many people who want to see him are finally burdening him and some who have only one day to visit him can not understand his beauty with this move.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So-so
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The road to get there is ugly full of curves, arrived there the paid sunbeds are few and do not even give you wi fi, all crowded, full street parking, there is not even a bar to take a bottle of water.  Never again,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wonderful beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful beach, with small white pebbles, easily accessible by car. I recommend arriving early, by 10:00, to be able to park without problems. Take water and food with you, as it is not served by bars and restaurants. There is a beach equipped for umbrellas and sun loungers and a bathroom and changing facilities.In the afternoon the water could get dirty because of the "uncivilized" on board the boats at the bottom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Iconic and scenic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most photographed in the area: from above it really leaves you breathless! Despite being very touristy and crowded, thanks to its size you can still enjoy it without feeling too "tight".How to get thereThe road is quite easy and on arrival there is free parking. It should be noted, however, that with the passing of the hours many cars begin to park along the road and the road becomes more complicated.Sea and beachThe seabed is composed of white stones (shoes recommended), with a spectacular blue sea but immediately deep and often rough: it is therefore not ideal for children or for those who can not swim well.ServicesAvailable some showers near the beach umbrellas.ConclusionA place that is definitely worth a visit for its beauty, but personally I would not choose it to return several times.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best viewed from above. Not worth the risk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kefalonia is beautiful and has so many gorgeous beaches. But this is not one of them. The pebbly beach is so overrated. It is dangerous due to a treacherous access road, strong currents, and past fatalities. Since the cafe closed the beach is full of litter, making it hugely overrated compared to most other beaches on Kefalonia. Myrtos is best viewed as a photo opportunity from above - that's all -  just like the postcard.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mare turchese
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice and large beach with a turquoise sea. Sunbeds and umbrellas are free, but there are about thirty, so I recommend arriving very early to occupy one. There are toilets, but no kind of bar, so arrive provided with food and water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: If heaven exists it must be so
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach and bay of indescribable beauty. We arrived at the beach early in the morning, when the sun had not yet reached the beach and we found paradise. Deep blue sea due to the crumbling of white rock, white pebble beach and white sheer cliff. Pristine beach (and we hope it will remain so for a long time) of breathtaking beauty to behold. The beach is absolutely not equipped. There are only about twenty umbrellas in the central part of the beach without any kind of Service (and I personally would not put these either). The road to the beach is very fraught and not absolutely safe. We only stopped for a swim and a walk on the beach and, in our opinion, it was absolutely worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pebbles, limited parking, crowded and deep water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pebble beach, no bars, some umbrellas, limited parking and deep water. Not everyone’s cup of tea. The water is indeed beautiful, but deep. Not for children or those who cannot swim in deep waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The wrong day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were in Myrthos on Tuesday. Arrived at 9.20, umbrellas and sunbeds sold out. Very rough sea, so no "quiet" baths. At about 11.00 a parasol was released and we gained the shade but we paid 15 euros since "free", as written on the sign of umbrellas, it seems that in Greece means "available" (?!) not free....If you add to that a white foam along a good part of the coast, we did bingo.No, not yet! We decide to leave the beach and discover that smartly the buses arrive until the end of the road, not exactly linear. So to get back inside the bus, we put a lot of patience and some swear words, ours and the drivers who had to reverse on the hairpin bends....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best and most beautiful beaches i have visited
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best and most beautiful beaches i have visited, bring everything with you to enjoy a perfect day in heaven. We created a Kefalonia 7-Day Travel Planner that really helped us enjoy every day of our trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: spectacular scenery!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you arrive on the ridge, the view from above of Mirthos Bay is spectacular😍! The rock that descends to the sea and mixes with the turquoise colors of the sea is one of the most beautiful landscapes we have seen! Wild nature🌴 surrounds the bay and there are no bars and some umbrellas⛱️. BRING ROCK SHOES!! After lunch the water gets a little cloudy...  But the sea still remains beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely unbelievable!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went on day trip with KCG travel, and this was a bus tour, which dropped us off at the very top of this magnificent beach. This was a photo shoot opportunity from its viewpoint, and it’s breathtaking! If we are ever in Kefa again. We will definitely hire car to spend day at this beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: OVERRATED! ABSOLUTELY NOT!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Panic road without guardrail overhanging. To get to a beach equipped only x 10 sunbeds occupied already at 9.30 am without bar even to buy water. The murky and rough sea is absolutely not worth it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All shades of blue!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is really beautiful, with beautiful white round pebbles, but they release a little dust, so even the sea is not very clear. But clean and with wonderful colors, you find all shades of blue! The parking is located and is convenient, if you do not arrive very late (we arrived around ten and there were still several places near the beach). Definitely a beach to see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: EXPECTATIONS MET!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach that respects expectations. From above the view is sensational, but even when you get to the beach, the latter does not disappoint. Clear water, pebble beach (shoes recommended) and ample space for those who choose the free beach. There is also a space for the beach equipped with sun loungers and umbrellas (I do not know the price).Recommended to arrive early because otherwise you find yourself having to park quite far from the beach on hairpin bends. Always check the wind, otherwise you risk a big disappointment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The awesome beach of Myrtos with the wonderful blue waters. Very difficult parking, has showers, boat rescue and a place is organized with sun loungers.Always with plenty of people so the sooner you visit the better. It has pebble and no sand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful colors, the sea no big deal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach not equipped, sunbeds are only a dozen. There is not even a bar and a shred of shade. The sea has beautiful colors but unfortunately being to the west is often rough and you can not enjoy a nice swim. In summary a passage stage but maximum for 2/3 hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Probably bad experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to the beach 19/8 had a wave and the waters were very blurred. Enough trouble until someone arrives and finding parking requires great luck! I don't think I'll visit this beach again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated beach.  Maybe it was the day but the water was opaque and not clear, indeed there were traces of gasoline.  Parking impossible.  The beach is great but really uncomfortable to reach.  After our experience we recommend using the bus to reach this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: CONFUSION AND MURKY WATER
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach to reach with hairpin bends with several cars parked along the road that make it difficult to transit. Small and always sold out parking, pebble beach, beautiful water seen from above, when you dive you can not see the bottom. No bar or restaurant, not equipped, you have to arrive very early with umbrella and food. Not recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed on the beach after we saw it from the mountain. Beautiful from up. Arrived on the beach was a disappointment. There are much nicer beaches on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clear blue water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach! Beautiful landscape! A huge place that you can very easily find to sit but with a little difficulty in parking. It has a beach bar!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A dream sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: August 15th. White sandy beach and small pebbles; beautiful imare, a swimming pool. Free parking; arrived around 12.00 we parked immediately about 5 minutes from the beach. Free umbrellas and sunbeds... but of course all occupied given the time. Free bathrooms, changing cabin and showers. No refreshment points, no taverns, no bars.... present only a street vendor with a fridge bag in tow... 1 beer 3 euros, 1 small mineral water 1 euro. Rescue Service present. Boats approaching the shore were promptly turned away. Bring your food! Happy holidays everyone!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Famous for great reasons
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Iconic beach with sea in unreal colors: it is mandatory to stop and take some photos from above! Parking is quite large but it fills up early, so better to go there in the morning. Even with the crowds the beach is still great and there is room for everyone, there is a central area with umbrellas and the rest is free. Watch out that if there is wind the sea can be quite dangerous. As services there is only the toilet, no bars or restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated and over flowing with rubbish
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived early to find overflowing rubbish and dirty toilets. Unfortunately this beach has been ruined by overpopulation and lack of sanitation. We even saw a Durex packet in amongst the pebbles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Myrtos!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place and sea! Blue water and white pebble! That would mean Ionium ❤Heaven!!! It also has organized beach plenty of place for parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach has breathtaking turquoise waters. The waves can sometimes be very high and dangerous, but that doesn’t take away from its beauty. There is always an alert lifeguard on duty. The beach is partly organized, so it’s a good idea to bring your own items (such as umbrellas) before you go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach is worth visiting, but not in August when it is lost.I went in June 2010.I would like to go again.....I look forward to seeing you again Oh this wonderful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach and sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach crystal clear sea better visit it in the afternoon for parking. The road to get there is a bit steep overlooking the sea but worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A passing day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach.I recommend getting there early in the morning for parking (which is free) and to avoid crowding the parking lot (at about 12 it was very messy with cars and people). The road to reach it includes a narrow final piece of road and downhill hairpin bends, regularly alternated by the passage of buses and shuttles for transport. Comfortable beach and easily accessible from the parking lot, it is equipped with bathrooms, bars and some umbrellas.I recommend choosing a day not very windy and quiet because the sea can be shaken, with many waves that annoy the entrance into the sea.Overall it is a great beach, quiet and pleasant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise on Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have never swum in a completely blue water not transparent but blue... really never seen something like this...If you want to have sunbeds (free) you have to arrive by 9 am are few... then the beach will fill up... there are also toilets and showers... super recommended you have to see Myrtos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not worth the hype
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really not worth the hype. Stunning to look at from above but when you get down there the parking is hectic and there are no facilities whatsoever. The toilets are typical beach ones so not great but there are no bars or restaurants for food or drink so youMust either bring a picnic or go back the very steep hill/mountain to one of the bars there. There are far far better beaches in Kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach of the impossible blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably one of the most famous postcards on the island! Beautiful...Beach of white basins, very wide, not making yourself feel crowds of people. It has lifeboat swimmer and beach supports, a small area for rent of umbrellas / loungers (although it's not difficult to fix your own umbrellas), but I'm not sure there is a support bar.Accessible by a zigzagging mountain road, with some viewpoints for panoramic photos. Free parking, and when full, it is always possible to park on the road, provided there is a skill for such...Attention! The currents that form the blue tones of the sea and the waves can make dives something dangerous, but it is always possible to check the conditions for swimming a few days in advance on the Greek weather website.Water shoes make walking on the beach more comfortable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Must see beach with the most beautiful range of blue waters. Natural and untouched beauty. The waves do get big though and the road there is steep!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magic sunset.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very wide beach that offers a truly magical sunset, in fact I think it is the ideal time to visit this place to take some photos both from above and once you get to the beach.Few sunbeds so equip yourself, but complete with bathrooms, showers and changing rooms.In the hottest hours a real kettle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach not to be missed.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Iconic beach.  Do beautiful whilst on it or from the view point.  The sea feels a bit unsafe to swim in but that is widely shared.  Don’t miss if you visit Kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is Wonderful, although with pebble or just because of that the water is turquoise blue, One has enough space. The journey is a bit long but worthwhile. Just a pity there is no beach bar etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: New, but bad.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place from above is wonderful, but once you get down it will be a disappointment (obviously it is all subjective) what no one writes above is that from this year the beach is free, so you can use the sunbeds with the umbrella comfortably without spending anything but you have to arrive early to find one because there are 30 of them in number. We arrived at 9am and fortunately we found a place, the beach is nothing much better, the bathrooms are three for each sex and are always very clean and provided with paper , but the absence of the bar is felt , plus once it is late cars and people continue to arrive who camp in front of the former lido and it becomes an impossible thing even to swim, we left out of desperation 🤦🏻‍♂️ clicks the comparison with Patani, Agia Kyriaki who are clearly more beautiful with picturesque landscapes and Aqua much cleaner and clearer because there is management and maintenance ... I would never go back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view is amazing. Myrtos is fantastic and myrtoscottages@gmail.com is very easy to use. Lydia is very helpful and a warm lerson as well.The rooms were lovely and so was the garden .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large crowded sandy beach, a galley to park past 10am.Take a picture from the top and go to another beach...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrthos beach delusione
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking panoramic view... but when you arrive in my opinion it is not as beautiful as they describe it... there are no facilities or restaurants... there are 30 sunbeds that if you arrive after 8:00 are all occupied... bring the umbrella and the fridge bag to survive... rude lifeguards especially with Italians... and also the water is not crystal clear as in the rest of the island .. there are better beaches like petani beach..antisamos beach..skala...lourdata etc.... we were disappointed... great only x panoramic photos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but don't arrive too late
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, as from the photos and videos seen online, definitely deserves.Usually there are a few waves and the water is immediately deep.Unfortunately there is no bar, only showers and toilets. There are some umbrellas and sunbeds (mid-July 2025), but very few, you have to be there very early to pick them up, we arrived at 10am and they were already all busy.Also the parking is not very large (when we were there it was free), there is to be there MAXIMUM at 10.30/11 because then it is up to park on the road and it is quite dangerous, then there is a whole piece of walking to do and considering that you arrive via a mountain road, I do not recommend it.If you don’t have a parasol with you, I suggest you stay maximum until lunchtime. Bring your shoes because there are stones!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful mediocre beach just for photos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach more instagrammable than anything else, overall one of the ugliest we visited. The water has fabulous colors given by white stones that make it this blue color, beautiful from above but murky up close. It is worth just taking a picture while going to other beaches.The umbrellas when we went were free but you have to arrive early both to get one and to be able to park in the parking lot instead of on the street. Stoney beach and all exposed to the sun, so very hot.In our experience it was not helpful that the sea was very rough, so it was difficult to get in and especially out.There are free toilets and showers.It is very busy so there are a lot of people (who also arrive by bus).It wasn't worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived early-ish on the 4th of July and we genuinely thought we had driven to the wrong beach. The neon blue water videos and photos must be photoshopped, we was so underwhelmed. Arrived at 10:30am and it was relatively full. There is only roughly 20-30 free sunbeds on this beach so IF you choose to go you need to be there before 10am or you’ll be laying on pebbles. The beach was genuinely dirty and derlict. Understandably, people like a quiet authentic Greek beach but this beach is absolutely massive at the bottom of a cliff with nothing, just a port-a-loo. There was a menstrual pad in the sea with us, seaweed, rubble & plastic waste. We thought that there was a sewage pump that goes into the sea of this beach. The town around Myrtos is cute though and worth a visit but the beach was such a let down.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has warm water. The shore drops off quickly into deep water. There is free parking. High rocks surround the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pearl Of the Ionian sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can only give this beach less than the highest rating if you come unprepared.This beach is truly a gem of the Ionian Sea and was rightfully chosen as the filming location for the Hollywood movie Captain Corelli’s Mandolin.What does that mean? It means, first of all, that the beach is not accessible via highway, but rather by a road that climbs up the mountain and then descends through narrow paths to reach the beach, which lies at the foot of massive cliffs towering above it.The beach is not commercialized, so aside from restrooms, there are no other facilities. If you don’t manage to grab one of the few available sunbeds, you’ll need to bring your own umbrellas and chairs/sun loungers. Facing the sea, the right side of the beach has fine white pebbles/sand, while the left side is more gravelly and close to the cliffs, with clear warning signs about possible rockfalls. I will never understand why people still place their towels and umbrellas directly beneath those cliffs.The water is turquoise blue, azure, and crystal clear. It truly is a breathtaking experience. There is a parking area near the beach, but if you arrive later in the day, you might have trouble finding a free spot. A lifeguard is also present on the beach, which adds a sense of security for visitors.On the right side of the beach, there is also a tunnel – a passage beneath the rock – which is also marked with a warning about possible rockfall. But to be honest, I couldn’t resist the thrill and quickly passed through the tunnel, which is only about 10 meters long and connects the beach to the open sea.Be sure to bring your own drinks and snacks, as there are absolutely no food or beverage vendors on the beach, apart from a hardworking donut seller who occasionally passes by offering homemade donuts at €3 apiece.Enjoy the natural beauty of Myrtos Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The iconic Myrtos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, about 1 hour and 10 min from Katelios. The beach is equipped with bathrooms and showers but without a bar. It is a perfect destination for families and for snorkeling, I recommend arriving before noon because after it gets crowded and it becomes difficult to find parking.P.S best beach I've seen in Kefalonia (in my opinion)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful wild beach. Very ventilated there is no possibility to buy anything all nature great parking. Sea top cold turquoise to say fantastic is little

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.  Could not find area to change into bathing suite  Well worth stopping to see this area. Take a lot of pictures

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top colours
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Milto bella, gorgeous colors. You wore the umbrella because there is absolutely no service.The rocks do not make me crazy even for a queerion of comfort ', but 'a beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view indeed from above was fantastic the experience down on the beach was less, boulders everywhere and also far into the water, so going with t in you had less trouble but getting out was difficult. It disappointed me but from above beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Impressive panoramic point
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely worth visiting but without much expectation.Striking panoramic point both during the day and at sunset.You can arrive by car near the beach and there is free parking. Very clean, transparent water, simple beach and not even equipped with a refreshment point (June).We went for a swim at Myrthos beach in the afternoon and it was not crowded, overall pleasant but not the best for us.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but no bar
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach to see!  Immersed in the rocks of the mountain, really a beautiful view. Clear water and pebble beach. There are toilets and showers but no bars or shops. Equip yourself with water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beauty with a Bit of Bite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach delivers that turquoise tease and towering cliffs drama—but don’t expect a gentle dip. The sea’s got some muscle, and the waves come in swinging. Still, it’s a stunner from every angle, and the beach itself holds up well. It’s not just a photo op—it’s an experience. Just hold onto your towel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bring umbrella!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: At the beginning of June the equipped beach I saw in the photos was not there (I do not know if they put umbrellas) and I went back up to the village to get one. Very nice, with very special colors, pebbles, clear water. There is a large parking lot that fills up at peak times but at the beginning of the day there was space.I paraglided and landed here: beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view of the beach from above is exceptional, deserves a photo, but the beach I do not consider the most beautiful, is devoid of umbrellas and bars, has only a parking, the water is beautiful as in all Kefalonia, but in my opinion there are other much more beautiful coves, such as emblisi beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Kefalonia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place, lots of car parks spaces available.Brilliant water colours! Clean area! There are 3 view points on the way down so make sure to stop and make your picttures. On the beach I highly recommend spot by grotto as there is a shadow available.Minus- no toilets available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great views but not the best facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing views. Turquoise water. Toilets closed . No sunbeds. Not as good as antisamos beach. Disappointed as expected more

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise views. Large beach with crystal clear waters and nice temperature. I leave you in this comment the following suggestions or tips:1) To access this beach if or if you need car. In the main viewpoint there is a kind of mini parking to park some cars. If you continue to get down by car you access the beach and the closest it leaves you is approximately 50 meters from the sand, not the sea.2) Wear shoes to enter the sea, what you see from the photos is not sand, it is stone.3) If it is not high season, there is no beach service, no open bar. We went in late June and there was no service.4) The ideal time for your best photos is at noon, the sun illuminates in all its splendor that beautiful sea providing the best colors that you can admire from the viewpoint, stop obligatory to get the best memories.5) The water is crystal clear and with pleasant temperature.Visually it is a beautiful beach, it has often been chosen as one of the most beautiful beaches. If you are in Cephalonia, you can not stop going!!!! Worth it!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too bad for nothing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beaches for photos! Very photogenic but wild. It is not for bathing. Huge waves and sharp pebble. The dining room is also expensive and the portions are half. Disappointment!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unique beach in the world.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the experience of discovering one of the most beautiful beaches in the world was a unique experience.  It is worth staying at least a week to interact with the local population and enjoy the healthy and genuine foods of the surrounding nature.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Admire from a distance, don't get close
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Read in TA's Travellers’ Choice Awards 'Best of the Best Beaches' that "It rarely gets crowded". RUBBISH! If you want to go in the summer season you do indeed need to go very early if you need a parking space (& watch the road down, too many hire cars totally unused to narrow Greek roads.....) or to get your spot on the beach - then wait while it gets very, very busy.The other thing to note - & this is of VITAL importance if you have children or unless you are VERY strong swimmers, the waves are extremely strong & the undertow is nasty. There have been serious accidents at this beach (talk to locals, not tour operators). Yes, it's very beautiful; so is a tiger or some snakes but I wouldn't play with them. Look & admire from the top of the cliff road at the viewpoint, take your pictures - then go swim somewhere else.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach, worth any drive!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach, this and the one in Sami, Antisamos beach, are in our opinion, the greatest two beaches in Kefalonia, and well worth the drives from Argostoli or the south coast. Gorgeous views all the way down and then stunning when you are there. Lovely beach beds - think they were about a tenner each, and super safe beach… you can leave all your keys, phones, bags etc and go swimming together and everything was fine. Gorgeous clear water and lovely and warm- beach / rocks shoes would be a bonus! The parking is tight in peak times so set off early. There are two brilliant restaurants either side of the last junction before you head down to the beach too! It really is as good as it looks in the pictures!! 🥰

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scenic Myrtos is deadly on feet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Iconic Myrtos beach is stunning to look at but not the most enjoyable swimming experience. As others have noted it is a pebble beach.  With the strong undertow, it took all my strength to drag myself out of the water. I literally had to crawl out on my belly and it was painful to walk on the pebbles in bare feet.  I would not recommend this beach for families with young children. If you do go, bring water shoes!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful crystal clean water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow ! Incredible crystal clear water ! One of the most beautiful beach we could visit in Kefalonia. Worth to visit. A bot hard with parking, watch out for large rocks in the parking lot, tight spaces and cars that don't look where they park, during our stay someone scratched our car, we also saw that several cars had trouble leaving the parking lot, very steep parking spaces, tight spaces and small parking lot as a big minus of this place but the water and beach make up for all the rest. Very friendly little bar that serves great iced coffee, beautiful beach, the day we were there it was a bit windy so the waves were also very visible, for people who like this vibe  it gives a lot of fun, for people who prefer calm water it would be a great place to sunbathe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Yet another wonderful beach in Kefalonia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had read that we should not go to Myrtos in case of wind because of currents and waves. We were lucky, there was no breath of air. The view from above is incredible with its different shades of blue. But swimming is just as amazing. As we move forward the water changes color. It was very hot about 28.30 due to the heatwave. The road to get off there turns but is not narrow so it’s going well. A must on this beautiful island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach.  Picture perfect.  Just somewhat off the beaten path.  We were there off season so it was just the scenery.  No services available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos beach is incredibly beautiful. Looked at from the cliff top it is stunning and the water is turquoise and warm. But it is incredibly dangerous. On the day we were there a man drowned despite there being a lifeguard there. Its remote location meant it took 30 mins for an ambulance to arrive. So worth a visit but stay out of the water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning postcard beach but otherwise I was disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach but not the best in Kefalonia. Perfect 5*postcard beach but not the best to relax there. Beach wide and long, with rather bigger pebbles, the same the entrance to the water which starts to be qucikly deap, can be difficult  to get off when big waves. No lifeguards on duty. Water crystal clear. Absolutely no shade at all, so take plenty of sun loution , umbrela as there are not many beds with umbrela to rent. Event the tavern was in the middle of September closed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bloody scary
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Mytos beach is stunning, however, the sea is treacherous. The waves are enormous and crash on the land with so much power that they bring large stones with them. The beach quickly dips to  very deep water, which means when you are trying to get out, you are quickly swept back and fall under the waves, tumbling as if you were in a washing machine.This felt like a near death experience, and if two men's hadn't pulled me out, I don't think I would have made it. In October, there were no life guards and no red flags to say how dangerous it could be. There should be massive warnings about the danger lurking in the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don’t miss this!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After seeing pictures of Myrtos beach on previous reviews we really wanted to visit, we were not disappointed. Mid September visit and the water was so warm still. An absolutely stunning natural arena shaped beach. Stayed for several hours, swimming, watching and just enjoying the sheer beauty of the place. Do not visit Kefalonia without a visit here, simply a must!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Breathtaking Viewpoint
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Mytros Beach is nothing short of a paradise, offering a breathtaking viewpoint that captures the essence of coastal beauty. The crystal-clear waters shimmer in mesmerizing shades of blue and green, inviting you to take a refreshing dip. Soft, powdery sand stretches along the shore, perfect for lounging under the sun or building sandcastles.As you gaze out at the horizon, the stunning cliffs surrounding the beach create a dramatic backdrop, making every moment feel like a postcard. Whether you’re relaxing with a book or enjoying a swim, Mytros Beach is a serene escape that leaves a lasting impression.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach💙🩵
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful!!The fact that from September there are no more sunbeds, etc., makes it even more beautiful for us. Also the drive to the beach, along the cliffs, is spectacular.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful - september 2024
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful big beach with clear water, in september there was not owercrowded. Parking free. Nice view from road, must - have picture here!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not all that - road situation spoils it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely views and breathtaking given the surrounding mountains.Water was nice and clear.Beach is pebbly so beach shoes recommended.We found the road up and down really scary and steep, must be a nightmare in height of summer.I wouldn't recommend as there are other nice beaches to visit without the road issue.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A truly breath taking beach, the view point up top gives a gorgeous view of the clear water colours. They have plenty of parking and close to the beach so accessible for all, they have a little hidden cave on the left side of the beach which is a true hidden beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mah!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A day of strong wind was enough to make "the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia", in an expanse of milky, murky and dirty water, not at all inviting to swim.In my opinion, very much overrated, I could provide a list of at least 20 most beautiful beaches in Kefalonia alone.Oh, I forgot, plant closed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Small great place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place with nice streets and surprising shops. Nice boulevard with good restaurants. Beautiful ride through the mountains

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place was green with wonderful smells. The friendly people are ready to serve you and the beaches are beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach to visit, go early for parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Finally got to the beach on the 2nd attempt, 1st time we arrived mid afternoon after visit the caves and it was far to busy, we're people parked at the top and walked down, so we came back 2 days later, arrived approx 11am, weather wasn't the best but we preserved, then it got better and we spent good 4 hours here, beautiful. No sunbeds or umbrellas or bar though, all closed, it was a Sunday of that makes a difference. We drove from Lassi, nice drive approx 45 mins.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but dangerous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is no doubt a beautiful beach a mixture of sand and pebbles. However the surf is deadly. Sadly the day we visited a man drowned while we were there. Beware of the warning flags. The water is a gorgeous blue so my advice is to look and enjoy but don’t swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We didn’t go down to the beach but took pics from the view point. Our tour guide told us it was a white pebble beach with some sand, that’s what gives the water the changing turquoise colour. It was very beautiful. Wise we had more time to go down.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beauty but a bit too busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach for sure, and the usual steep drive down with steep drops below. We came from Divarata direction. We got down there and it was rammed. The car park and all the approach road were full. We found a space but frustrated drivers were coming in after us. We found the cafe closed and therefore no sun loungers available to hire. Disappointing as we’d had no food, so we left. It was busy, quite a commercial set up and having seen it on our very short visit, we probably won’t return. Not that it wasn’t nice, but there are plenty of smaller and equally beautiful beaches around. Nice photo opps from the road if you dare, and are allowed to stop. Divarata is a nice village so stock up there before you head down to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cefalonia, Greece
reviewsWithKeywords.text: one of the best islands in Greece. Little widespread and hidden by the clamor fashion of Mikonos and Santorini. But it was the most beautiful one we know. the beach of Myrtos is as or more beautiful as Zakintos (kkkkkk) the blue of the water is constant!! TEm beaches of more amazing blue, it is rustic and natural, has warm water beaches and other emerald greens. An Incredible Place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view of the beach from the viewpoint from the road towards Assos is really amazing. We were at this beach in mid-afternoon at the end of August and there were lots of parking spaces available. The beach is composed of small pebbles and were not too crowded. At the level of furnishings, you can find a snack, showers and even deckchairs for those who wish (fairly far from the water). The turquoise water does not lend itself to snorkeling, but the situation seen from below is also very pretty (the sun sets in addition facing the beach). For us essential beach to do during a visit of Kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Myrtos Beach in September @ 3pm in the afternoon.No problem parking & beach was not overcrowded. Didn’t bother with sun loungers as spent time in the seaI was a little bit concerned about the road to the beach & the waves after reading some previous reviews on here.I didn’t think the road was dangerous & the waves when I visited certainly weren’t dangerous either. Although I would agree it’s not ideal for little children as it gets deep quickly.As always in life - it’s good to do your research beforehand but don’t let that put you off experiencing something firsthand for yourself.I agree with its rating as one of the best beaches in the world - and the drive to the beach is absolutely breathtaking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, but it gets better...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Undoubtedly a beautiful beach to see.There is an equipped part and a free part for those who are equipped with everything necessary.You have to arrive early, by 9 or shortly after because the parking lots are few and not all are comfortable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: a beautiful blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: one of the two most beautiful beaches of Kefalonia..view from the top panoramic beautiful with evil color of a blue introvabile..beach equipped with sunbeds and umbrellas at 15 euros in August, convenient parking better arrive a little early because very crowded...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: When you say aquamarine color
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Certainly among the most beautiful to visit. It deserves 5 stars for the ridiculously beautiful color of the water. You know the aquamrine? There, exactly that. The beach is equipped, 15 euro two sunbeds and thatched umbrella. There are showers, toilets and a small bar with croissants in the morning and pizza for lunch. All pebbles even in the water, shoes are indispensable. The water rises immediately, children always need an adult, especially if small.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hard for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is dangerous for families because of the waves and steep depths..leave the stones difficult to please the children.On the other hand it is difficult and parking unless you go in the morning before 10..But from above it looks magnificent..The landscape as a landscape either above or below is very nice..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We will go back!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful sea. Amazing view from above. You have to go when it has no waves, to let you swim in its waters of all shades of blue. The sooner the better for a parking spot. There is an organized section with sunbeds, canteens, dressing rooms and showers and free space for nature lovers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing picture
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing beach like a picture One of the best beaches in the world If you are lucky to find the water calm then you are the luckiest person on earth The colours are fantastic the water is crystal and the waves amazing Totally worth it ! Be careful due to deep waters and huge waves Is not a joke especially for young children Enjoy with awareness and have many pics!You can’t see that everyday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful colors and panorama
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely one of the most beautiful beaches. The view coming from above and the color from the water are unbelievable. We rented an umbrella (15 euros with 2 sunbeds). Just arrive, find a free umbrella and they will come to you to charge you. The beach has free showers and a bar. We took a day of rough seas (fun but dangerous). We stayed until evening to watch the sunset.NB: do not be frightened by reviews that say that the street is horrendous and that there is no parking: surely arriving early you will find the best parking lots. But the road moderating speed is absolutely feasible

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go when there's no wave
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The famous beach, which is worth seeing. On the road there is a stop to see the bay of Myrtos from above, amazing view. The route to the last section makes it difficult and especially the parking that wants luck. Later at noon we found it. We reached a calm sea, it was not the cleanest though and deepens sharply. Beautiful colors, beautiful environment with white pebble, sunbeds 15 euro per set.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrthos beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A white beach surrounded by high hills, beautiful blue sea.Umbrella service with sun loungers, bar available

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turquoise water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well what about, the photos speak for themselves is a fantastic place with a beautiful sea even if a little rough, bring your shoes from stones and an umbrella and two sunbeds cost 15 €. There is a bar that makes sandwiches, toilets and even disabled toilets. Beware of parking, after 10:30/11 it is overflowing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too silly for nothing! We went, we got the credit for parking, we didn't go into the sea because of huge waves and we left! Before he goes, he's checking if he has northerns. Not recommended for kids!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More beautiful from far than near
reviewsWithKeywords.text: More beautiful from a distance than close, but it is still among the top of Kefalonia. Convenient parking and there is also a bar that offers little stuff to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but not the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you arrive in the morning around 9am you have all umbrellas free and you can choose the place. The morning is all shade but around 10 the sun comes and the water turns a beautiful blue color. Too bad that today there were waves and so we could not fully enjoy the sea. Parking just behind the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist trap...avoid!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Completely overrated beach. Can't actually see the beach because of the number of sunloungers and umbrellas (all of which were fully booked anyway). Parking is the stuff of nightmares (we arrived at 11am and had to park at the top of the hill on a verge. The pollution must be horrendous due to the amount of cars. I'm sure at one point this was a stunning place to visit but not now. I personally wouldn't recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view and the sea are wonderful. The sea is somewhat dangerous for children because it deepens sharply. Set of sunbeds 15€, coffee ok.Narrow road

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Patience and strong nerves to have
reviewsWithKeywords.text: View great.... access better to have made life insurance and mixed car...water overestimating for them....the bar that operates there needs patience in the queue and when it comes your turn to have a kidney about for what you get... you mean that the coffee is miserable as in all places in Kefalonia...the sunbeds at 15 euros.....but you will definitely need an orthopedist after you leave...good courage....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arrived early, breath taking views on the way down. We got there before 10  and there was parking space and sunbeds.  Bus trips arrived and car parking soon became tricky.  The beach is beautiful as is the water, however big waves meant that it was tricky to get in and out and our teenage daughters got taken under a few times and this wasn’t going to be an all day beach trip due to not being able to 100% enjoy the sea. We stayed for a drink in the small cafe.  Beautiful but perhaps not a beach for young children. We then moved on to Assos and Fiscardo, this was a great day exploring that part of the Island before returning to our base nr Skala.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More beautiful from above than from below
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Forget the snorkel mask, its turquoise color is due to a whitish color (limestone) and the visibility is complicated. Pretty cave. Showers, toilet block. Snack is expensive. Small round pebbles. It was very hot, no wind, the fact that it is collected must play according to the direction of the wind... Huge parking at the very bottom, places available until around 10am/10.30am the day we went there (mid August).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful colors but uncomfortable beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pebble beach a little uncomfortable, Recommendation to go early in the morning to be able to find parking nearby.Beautiful colors but, in my opinion, it is not the best in Kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but very dangerous road!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches seen so far here in Kefalonia, crystal clear water with rocky bottom (we recommend rock shoes).Beach equipped with umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and bars.The cost of an umbrella and two sunbeds amounts to 15 euros.Do not underestimate the very dangerous stretch of road to get to the beach.The end of the road is not safe, as there are no protective barriers. Also, the road is two-way and the high height does not give you security, just for this reason I would not go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hard to access , pollution seems . I would choose some other beach to swim .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Difficult access. Unfortunately the waters are full of bubbles, pollution seems. I would choose some other beach for bathing. Only photos from above...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More pain than pleasure.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view from above is really incredible! Beautiful colors, everything you need to take amazing photos!We had to park quite far, about 17 minutes walk to the beach and unfortunately we were not compensated for the inconvenience. The waters were incredibly dirty the day we went there, they didn't invite you to swim, we all stayed 2 meters from the coast.Although there was a lot of people, the beach was clean.For children it is inappropriate, deepens very quickly, needs attention and supervision.The canteen has the necessary, at priced prices.On the positive, the saviors and the toilets that, despite the world, are kept quite clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but it gets better!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but too crowded. Beautiful sea but it gets better.The only bar available is really very expensive. Unsurpassed sunset! You have to go there early in the morning otherwise you will not find parking easily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Braving the wind and the big horses...🌊⛱️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful pebble beach, clear water.We caught a windy day and high horses ;we stayed in the area of free umbrellas, and we enjoyed braving the waves, sometimes so high that they were scary!we took advantage of the beer of the small gazebo at the entrance of the beach and the fried doughnuts with sugar of a street vendor that were not bad (a doughnut 2 euros, chocolate maybe a little more).The equipped beach had several rows of umbrellas, free showers and bathrooms .parking behind the beach or along the road that goes down to the beach in curva.arrive early:although large is a crowded beach!remember the rock shoes

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unique beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Special beauty.We came in time for parking and sunbeds.Friendly prices It's a shame that the nice canteen has nothing but standard frozen.If I knew it I would have been supplied by oven & ananas coming.We'll probably come back while we're on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It must be visited!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Recommendation to arrive in the morning by 9.30am to find a place for the beachfront car and to consult wave forecasts.In the morning spectacular sea, at about 11.30 the beach fills up to the unlikely and the water gets dirty thanks to the yachts that park in front of it.But a visit is worth it .. maybe not all day a bath and go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: not to be missed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not surprisingly considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, a must-see in Kefalonia. Recommendation to arrive early to enjoy it in peace, find free umbrellas (if you are interested - 15 euros umbrella and two sunbeds) and find convenient parking, after arriving is a delirium. There is a bar that sells snacks and also makes reasonably priced sandwiches. Sea with really beautiful colors but not really suitable for children because immediately deep.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach acropolis?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, impressive, the spectacle and its colors have no rival. But the hassle of getting there, and especially where to park, is such that you don't know if it's worth it. Unfortunately, the sea was not clean, it had enough waste, probably from the 6-7 boats that were stretched deeper inside. The people on the beach, although quite, kept the rules of cleaning. In plus, the 3 rescuers and the beach bar with facilities for the necessary.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Accessible only when there is no air..It is dangerous sea but worth a visit.. Great view before you come down! The road is normal in general until there. It is only difficult for 2-3 minutes to download because they park on the mountain side due to lack of space!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolute bliss
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely amazing beach, the colour of the water is stunning all day long. 2 sun-beds with an umbrella for €15 for the day but they are not padded.  There is no waiter service. The roads are steep and narrow with hairpin bends. Do not attempt if you are scared of heights 😂 You must go early, by 11 there were no car parking spaces left so people just parked on the road making the trip down the hairpin road even more perilous.  It is stoney so bring beach shoes.There are toilet facilities, showers and a small cafe shop which is reasonably priced. Enjoy your day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Number 1 beach of Kefalonia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing waters! If you go by 10:30, you'll find it convenient to park. The cost of the set umbrella sunbeds is very reasonable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, worth a visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great classic of Kefalonia. Although it is one of the most famous beaches, it still remains very simple, with only one bar and long rows of umbrellas.The beach is pebbles mixed sand and the sea is a clear blue.The cost of an umbrella and two sunbeds is 15€.Parking near the bar but only if you arrive early (around 9/9:30), otherwise you have to park along the hairpin bends. Large area of free beach You can order at the bar directly from the guy on the beach who brings you what you order at the umbrella

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is spectacular. There are no words to describe this place. The viewpoint, the way there. The white stones, the cave on the left side, the sea of neon color, translucent, amazing. And because there are no bus and bars the place is even more perfect. The road there is quiet. There are argostoli buses I think from 2h/2h I WANT TO COME

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Third fourth beach...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It had a fine air and the sea was dirty!! I have no reason to lie floated garbage and a dead fish, the landscape very beautiful for it 2 stars otherwise neither one

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, white beach with pebbles, recommended!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful views on the way there, but you really should drive there too. Is a pebble beach though. I lost my prescription sunglasses there due to the intensity of the sea / waves. So pay attention with caps, glasses ... from Lassi region it is a good 45' drive. Mss the most beautiful of the island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrto beach a must go to beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Recent trip to Kefalonia; beaches were beautiful but Myrto beach stood out ; bring your own umbrella and get there early if you plan on parking as you may have a wait to find a spot

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but be careful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is breathtakingly beautiful. In the end of July there were sunbeds and umbrellas to rent (€15 total for the whole day), a bar and free showers, toilets and changing rooms. I would recommend but be careful: if there are strong waves you could slip on the pebbles or be submerged even in the shallow. The water also goes deep in a few meters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Iconic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos beach is one of the most iconic and photographed in Greece, characterized by white sand and pebbles and turquoise waters.Despite its popularity, Myrtos maintains a quiet and pristine atmosphere. Perfect for swimming and relaxing, it offers an unforgettable bathing experience in one of Kefalonia's most fascinating landscapes.There is the possibility to park near the famous beach, there are beaches and places to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach, the most popular beach on the island, certainly lives up to its reputation. The striking blue water and iconic cliffs create a picturesque setting that attracts many visitors. However, the popularity does come with a downside: the beach can get quite crowded, and the water isn't as pristine as some of the island's lesser-known spots. Despite this, the vibrant blue hues of the sea remain stunning, and the small cave along the shore adds a charming touch to the experience. It's a beautiful spot, though for a more secluded experience, other beaches might be preferable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Beach Day in Kefalonia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and the sea was amazing! We easily found a sunbed and the cost was affordable when you compare with the other beaches in Kefalonia. The waves were so big and it was not easy to jump into the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful from above
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach from above, a beautiful color and great beach, but with only one beach, we could not find umbrella and sunbeds. Rough and dirty sea, you could not see the bottom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach absolutely worth visiting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Kefalonia.Completely blue water and really beautiful bay. It is a stony beach (special shoes are recommended to enjoy it to the fullest). There is ample availability of free beach, as well as sun loungers with umbrellas at average prices. The only real flaw parking: I recommend arriving early in the morning so as to find a place easily, otherwise you have to park along the road to go down to the beach which is not the best. There is also a fairly simple bar. Overall good experience and definitely worth visiting at least once.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning views to the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach from views up the top so we went down to watch the sunset one evening. Unlike the coves & other beaches we went to this wasn’t clear but the most gorgeous shade of turquoise.The waves are very strong & the bottom falls away quite quickly from the shoreline so not suitable for small children. It has white stones & pebbles so sea shoes are recommended but watching the sunset here was beautiful while we bounced in the waves. We got to the beach about 7.00 pm, parking was free & spaces after the hairpin road down ( its entry/exit different routes so not worrying about passing)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white stand with blue sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach now less crowded due to closure road from Lixouri. You have to drive all the way around. Nice clean beach with beautiful blue sea. 2 beds and parasol 15 euros. Can be high waves than less suitable for smaller children

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful, unique sea colors
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos must be seen with the calm sea, otherwise it loses its magic. So inquire before you go, no use pretending to see the best of Myrtos with waves of 0.3-0.4,0.5 m. We saw it in July and, unfortunately, from after 11 am until 5 pm on the shore it looked like a tent city with all the umbrellas planted by people. Bar good for breakfast not lunch.But this does not change my Rating on the view the beach and especially the water. Then obvious that beaches like this appreciate them at their best in May June September.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not to be there all day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unexplained positive reviews, rough and dirty sea. In high season to come at about 9 'already after 10 the parking lot's full. To arrive road full of hairpin bends and steep. In the end it's feasible just to organize but it's not worth paying for the beds and much less stay there all day. Recommendation to come early take a bath and two photos and come away. There are nicer beaches and the only bar there is not good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Much appearance and very little substance
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So beautiful from above, with beautiful colors and then, once down, it turns out to be a white stony (if you do not have the appropriate shoes to enter the water is a very painful undertaking). What from above look like cliffs overlooking the sea are just big landslides, there is only one establishment with no infamy and no praise but with a cost of renting deck chairs and umbrella that screams revenge compared to the average costs of the island. A little-stocked bar, scarce and hard-to-find parking spaces after 10 am, a flood of people who are even brought with tourist buses. Never again, there are dozens of much more beautiful beaches in Kefalonia!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mah
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I agree with the latest reviews ..dall'alto bella but then it is murky... immediately very deep... it is not sand but pebbles with a bit of sand... and the gentlemen of the place say that it is very rare to find there the calm sea... x me there are much more beautiful beaches ...However free parking ... establishment with umbrellas at about 15 euros ... and also free beach ..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing place !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Thougt it would be good to share a more recent review of this beautiful place. We visited  Myrtos beach in July ‘24 on a Monday in high season. It is indeed good to arrive before 10.30 to have a reasonable chance of parking your car at beachlevel and still have a choice for some sunbeds. After 11.00 all will be full and cars will be parking back up the road.The road itself is not too bad, albeit a bit narrow towards the end. For those who have been to Balos beach on Crete, this is easy !There’s a modest beachbar with a simple takeaway menu; hotdogs, sandwiches, pizza and the like. Lots of choices for drinks at tourist prices. They offer toilets and showers as well, that would be expected at such a destination.The sea is absolutely gorgeous ! Many shades of blue, but depth is increasing quickly and there’s some serious waves and currents, so beware. Mostly a white pebble beach, that enhances the sun power, so wear something on your feet and use lots of sunscreen.There’s a small cave on the left side, where you can swim outside to the sea; sort of a mini ‘Tunnel of Love’ for those that been to Corfu.Hope this helps, set your alarmclock and GO !Ps. You can do Parapente from the beach, where they drive you up and you’ll land back on the beach !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived at the beach around 10 am, there were still places for cars but few umbrellas and I must say we were lucky to find one of the very few in the front row. Sea of a beautiful turquoise color but unfortunately it was a bit rough so there was some dirt here and there floating. Recommendation shoes because the shore and the seabed are made of stones even quite large. Two sunbeds (uncomfortable) and an umbrella for 15€. Then there is a small kiosk where you can eat (sitting on benches because there are no tables). We arrived in the kiosk at 12.30 and already many sandwiches were finished and even salads. In conclusion it is a beautiful beach, certainly very characteristic, but there are more beautiful and better equipped.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Look at it from above
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It deserves a picture but panoramic from above, I found it very disappointing that you can not see your feet in 20cm of water... beautiful colors, for goodness sake to look like a pool, but getting closer it is white, peat, and from what I know it is always so...  He does not deserve the coat of arms if with a mask you can not see ten cm away! In Kefalonia there is much better!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches. Unique sea. Of course a lot of people and understandable. Prefer the afternoon to admire the sunset (it also has umbrellas, sunbeds but they respect the space and there is enough for anyone who does not want to pay)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but only for a passage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to lunch and found parking right on the beach. Very beautiful and the view from above is worth it. I was relieved to see cars parked 500 meters above... There's plenty of room for your umbrella, but... The beach is full of stones, crocades and feet hurt. We went to many other beaches in Kefalonia but here we suffered! Even the kids complained. Our little girl was yelling out trying to make her play. Needless to say, rubber shoes we didn't have. For us the worst beach of the island we have seen, the kids asked to leave almost immediately.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wild beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The environment of this beach gives it a great advantage over other similar ones. Endless cliffs, rocks imposing, wild, white to pebble pebbles inside and outside the water and waters with this incredible alcoholic - turquoise color make up the special beauty of Myrtos. Right and left there is plenty of free space for your umbrellas. If you want to use the umbrellas of Bitsomore you will pay 15€. It is important to know that on the right side of the beach the pebble is large, it is not easy to walk you will need the special plastic Shoes Sea. On the left however the pebble is very thin and you can more easily walk (the side of the cave)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Discovering myrtos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful from above and below, with some organizational flaws: storming, few umbrellas, little assistance, you could do more.The air spins little, a hot basin so equip yourself properly, anonymous kiosk, scorching heat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very good.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Congratulations to the Municipality of Pilaréon providing free umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and sanitary facilities (and for disabled people) on this beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spiaggia spettacolare!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful beach and convenient to reach since the parking lots are behind the beach. The sea is wonderful, Recommendation to everyone to go for a swim; not far from there, you can set on the navigator the View Point of Myrtos, you can see the beach from above, very suggestive!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Postcard of the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On this beach we have read a lot and I share many things.Before arriving early, 9.30, we could admire and photograph it from above and the view is spectacular, arriving early then you can park down close to it and we had brought everything you need, umbrella, shoes, ..The beach is white stones that with the sun reverberate a lot in a species of basin surrounded by high cliffs, be careful to go too close to them as there is danger of landslides, for this reason we positioned ourselves away from them.The sea when we were there was practically calm, what unusual it seems, the colors are beautiful with a beautiful range of blues the entrance into the water however is immediately high and you have to be careful.Its position means that around noon if there is no wind it creates a hood of heat so around that time we decided to go elsewhere.Refreshment kiosk, umbrellas and sunbeds and bathrooms available.With these precautions, arrive early and leave when it is too hot I must say that we enjoyed the time spent here perhaps also because the sea was calm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful for pictures
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself looks stunning. We visited in the begging of June and there was no umbrellas or what so ever on the beach, so if you haven't brought your own umbrella, you can not stay more than 30min. because of the heat. The beach is pebbly and preferably you need shoes. It is not suitable for children, as it is deepens quickly. The parking is an issue too, if you do not go early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Francesco
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were bitterly disappointed. Described as the most beautiful beach on the island when in fact there are better ones. The sea is a beautiful turquoise, but the pebbles prevent you from fully enjoying it. We recommend shoes and umbrella, also because those made available are insufficient for the large turnout. The kiosk is well stocked but do not expect gourmet dishes, you will also find benches and not tables to sit on. The only positive note is the beautiful sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rejected
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bocciatissima!  Road to get very dangerous. Beach WITHOUT services. If you go there bring everything, umbrella, chairs and especially eat. There's a bar with no tables and only benches to sit on. Absolutely insufficient for turnout. Pebble beach, bring shoes. Yesterday we were in Petani, something else entirely!!!!!! Equipped beach, excellent quality restaurants.Myrthos mi spiace ma non mi rivedi!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Twice we went to see if it improved and nothing. Water full of weeds bird feathers and more
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fine overrated dirty sea parking small to forget. Claim made when comparing other Greek islands

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A thousand shades of blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Exciting panorama. Beautiful colors. There is a lido and a kiosk. Arriving by 9:30-10:00 you will find the umbrella for 15 euros. Parking nearby. At the kiosk you can have a sweet breakfast with chocolate croissants, but also a quick lunch with many types of pie-rustici.Very clean bathrooms and presence of several showers. Definitely not to be missed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Important to know before you go!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water here is very beautiful and clear BUT the beach is pebbly/rocky.  You MUST have water shoes or it is painful and difficult to get in and out of the water.  The water was rough/waves when we went and no real shallow water for kids to play in.  You MUST have an umbrella or the sun is scorching mid day.  Umbrellas and chairs are available for rent but go quickly.  Cantina open for drinks and snacks, bathrooms and rinse showers available.  Parking is a little chaotic and a long windy hill to get to beach level. There is a cave at the end of the beach but can't swim in when water is rough.  We made the best of it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After reading about it being the most beautiful beach in Greece I was somewhat disappointed. Place packed with cars and yes water looked beautiful but nowhere to sit. Locals not so friendly

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Undoubtedly the sea, with its colors that fade from turquoise to dark blue represents a spectacle, but the beach itself is disappointing. Sand (little) and pebbles (many), you need rubber shoes, a backdrop of stones that descends quickly. Few straw umbrellas, aluminum sunbeds without mats, no coffee table. 15€ for umbrella and two sunbeds. We arrived at 9:15, at 10 am they were all busy, and the parking lot was also full. At the back of the beach there is a bar, higher than average prices, no beach service.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely to see but don’t go!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had visited the beach in 2011 and it was beautiful. We went back today. The colour of the water is amazing, as always. We arrived on the beach at 10am, which we considered reasonably early, to find almost all of the sun beds already occupied. No umbrellas available. The sea is really rough, definitely not for the faint hearted. The worst aspect though is the traffic/parking. No organisation, complete chaos, people parking wherever they want, sometimes blocking entry/exit down the scary, hairpin-filled road with sheer drops down the cliffs. Oh, and they throw in a few truly massive coaches every now and then. How they get up and down that road is beyond me. The place needs properly organising with parking restrictions. There needs to be a limit on the number of vehicles allowed down there and the big coaches should be banned. If nothing happens I am certain there will be a serious accident on that road one day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow WoW WoWThe most stunning water I’ve ever seen.Beautiful beach loads of space.We drove here in Citroen c1 and had no problem. Parking fine too.  We took a picnic cos wasn’t sure taverna would be open. It opened late afternoon! Enjoy hard not to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Deludente!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived at the beach in Myrtos Beach in the morning at 09:30 on 1 July 2024, we had read that the beach was equipped, instead when we arrived there were sunbeds and umbrellas all dismantled, we asked if there was the possibility of having a pair with umbrella and we were told that maybe they would mount them in the afternoon if not in the next few days!! I would say that in July we expected more organization!! So we changed the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The real beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the must visit place on the island.Combine it with a lunch in Divarata and drink in Asos!I wanted to visit this beach since I watched the movie Captain Corelli’s Mandolin.We were there at last day of June and still there was no sun-beds and canteen didn’t work. So, to be on the safe side, have your own umbrella, enough drinks and some flip flops. They told us canteen will be open early July.  The road is in a very good shape. If you are a good driver, it will not be a problem. I read some reviews telling that road is narrow, but there are more narrow roads on the island. It is a few minute drive from Divarata and you will enjoy the drive and views.Beach is really beautiful, clean, with white pebbles, fantastic colours, nature as it should be. You can sit on the shore and admire beauty around you. Enjoy!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Entertainment
