reviewsWithKeywords.text: Didn't actually go down to the beach as we were on a coach, but stopped at viewing point looking down, what a stunning view!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach but very busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we wanted to see this famous beach so popped over to it from assos one morning , the road down to it is very steep and winding and the carpark at the bottom was full so go early , parking is free there is a small taverna and toilets the beach does look amazing when you are there but we found it far too busy , we were told it is not very good for snorkelling  but there were plenty of sun loungers for hire

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were stunned to see this beach from the road above, it really is so bright, the water and the pebbles. The road down was pretty scary and the parking at the beach haphazard. We would have spent longer at the beach if we had been happier with where we had parked our hire car!Glad we went though, it is beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach you need a car and when we got there it was very busy one of the best beaches on the island well worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous crescent shaped beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Saturday 29th June 2019. Family of 4 (ages 21 to 64). It's a winding drive down to the two large parking areas. The beach is mainly pebbles, but fine to walk on. It's very large indeed, so although this was the weekend (we arrived at about 11am) it did not feel even remotely crowded. There is a snack shop and a large area given over to regimented rows of sun chairs and umbrellas which you can hire. We didn't as our visit was just to have a dip in the (quite cold!) sea and a walk along the shoreline. There are 2 watchtowers, but they were not manned when we were there so it would be wise to keep an eye on children at all times here. At one end there is a cool cave where people go to take photos inside the cave with the waves in the background. A couple was also sitting there...wouldn't be much room for many more people. In terms of shade, and if you're here for a while, then either bring a beach umbrella or hire one here because the sun is pretty intense. It was quite windy when we were here, and some umbrellas were getting blown away. It's a lovely beach and well worth a visit. It would probably be best to get here early - say around 9am when there is sufficient heat in the sun, but you are before the coaches (which do come here - but as I say it's a huge beach so I doubt you'd ever be pushed for space).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A fantastic beach with plenty of parking available. A bit boring for snorkelling as it’s just a sand bottom with a few rocks but the water is so clear! A lovely “secret” cave at the end of the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but full of Towie look a likes posing and pouting.  Beach cafe limited food so went to restaurant on the way back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a heavenly place ..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was on our bucket list after viewing the bay from above last year. We were travelling with Tui and our local rep was very negative when we enquired about visiting. “Almost impossible by public transport, no facilities or shade when you get there, no other tours available”We hired a car for the day, and found the complete opposite, beds and shade €10/day, small self service cafe, WCs and changing facilities! Interestingly, tour buses too. Seems there is a tour from Argostoli for €25 for a 2hr beach stop - geared up for the cruise ships which are now a feature in Argostoli. Parking is very limited and the road down winding, steep and narrow. We can see it’s a dilemma for the local tourist industry as the last thing you would want is to spoil such an idyllic spot, but we feel slightly frustrated at Tui’s spin on visiting. Well worth a visit though but get there early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is incredible, you will never see such clear blue water. the drive down to it is abit scary, but once your down there its amazing!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice view from afar
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped off at the viewing point to look at this beautiful beach and the view was glorious. However we didnt bother driving down to it given that it is unsafe for swimming due to strong currents. Think that was the best decision! We discovered Mounda Beach near Skala  which is very sandy and shallow so perfect for little ones if you're looking for a bathing beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful little beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a stunner of a beach. Beautiful clear water, beautiful pebble stones along with sand. Amazing views. It really is worth a visit. My only caution... the waves can get quite high and rough quite quick so if you’re with tiny ones just be careful. Also take your own sandwiches or have a late lunch, I really wouldn’t bother eating at the local taverna on the beach - the baguettes were awful - had barely any filling and no butter or mayo/ketchup inside so it was like trying to chew 15 dry crackers!?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches in the World and you can see why. Located in a cove surrounded by sheer cliffs it is one of the big attractions on Kefalonia. The view looking down to the beach is iconic.There is a large parking area at the side of the road which can get busy.To drive to the beach the road has a number of hairpin bends to negotiate.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: love this beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this is one of the must see beaches, really pretty turquoise water, white shingle beach.in my opinion you need water shoes on the shingle, and not suitable for young children as it gets deep very quickly.there are umbrellas and beds, and a caféfairly steep drive down, but room to park when you get there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stay at the top and look down at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went to Myrtos beach today for the third time as I wanted to see if it had changed from my other visits in 2012 and 2014. If you park at the top and look down this beach looks amazing, clear blue sea that meets a clear blue sky and green trees on the sides of the cliffs that surrounds the most loveliest looking white sand. But wait that’s not sand that’s stones  that range from large to small and hurt when walked on and I have never see the water calm as the stones slope steeply in the water sometimes making the waves knock you off your feet. Although today it was the calmest I have see it. I really don’t know how this could be considered one of the best beaches in Greece. The drive to the beach isn’t that bad it’s the drive up that’s worse and the parking is terrible for a beach that is one of Greece’s finest. But all in all you have to go and experience the beach yourself so you can say you have been there I would advise that you take a parasol, drinks and beach shoes so those stones don’t hurt.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but take a parasol
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the drive down is stunning and the beach and sea themselves are next to none. due to the mountains either side there is limited breeze so it gets extremely hot and we both burnt. definitely take a parasol!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great if you can cope with the drive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Challenging road down. Some toilets but not well maintained, Beach bar just setting up in early June. Shelving beach so care needed when swimming

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful view - worth climbing down to ??
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Myrtos and took some photos from the cliff above. It looks like beautiful sand, but actually shingle. And it has loads of wasps. Nice photo opp. But we didn’t bother staying.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: NO FACILITIES
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very difficult drive down a narrow track. Very poor toilets. No facilities. Take everything you'll need for the day. TIP: On arrival, do not follow the arrow to car parking - keep left instead.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not enough facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove down all the way to the beach with high expectations, supposedly the most beautiful beach of the island. Even in the pre season we found all facilities occupied although overall there were not even that many people. So we left and drove to another beach nearby with free beds and umbrella’s. The many small bays and beaches offer a much better alternative.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful hot beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the highlights of Kefalonia. Personally i prefer Petani Beach or the Sandy beaches around Argostoli. Quite hot here as there is almost no wind. Sea is not as clear and clean as other beaches in Kefalonia but still worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This little beach is truly stunning!!  The colours are just so.....blue, green, turquoise!! Amazing little place!! Yes, it is a pebbled beach, but you can walk on it easily.  There was a little cafe when we went end of May 2019. Take your own beach kit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lego Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice to look at but not so nice to walk on.... this beach is the equivalent to walking on Lego.......lots and lots of Lego

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach a real gem to the island of kefalonia, weather your on the beach or up on the mountain above the views are amazing a must go if on the island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This Beach is lovely very windy to get to and dont forget your sun cream as there are no shops, cafes down there, it is totally unspoilt. The colour of the sea is stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth a look
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have just returned from Kefalonia and one of my 'must see' visits was Myrtos Beach.I wasn't disappointed. lovely white beach made up mainly of pebbles and a very steep drive down to get to it. The cave at the end is worth a look also. Only downside was that the toilets were locked up presumably until the season begins and there was nowhere to buy a drink so if you want to spend some time there take your own drinks. The view from the top is to die for also and there is a 'pull in' observation point for cars and buses.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely breathtaking location and even better in May when almost deserted even on a sunny day - don't forget your camera

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth a selfie!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You could mistake for being in Thailand it's that stunning with the turquoise waters and islands beyond!Beach hut just being built ready for summer season so definitley worth a visit..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches I have come across in Greece and there are many!  Seen from the road above, the turquoise colour of the water is so stunningly vibrant that you realize right away you absolutely have to find your way to the white-pebble beach to experience it firsthand. Swimming or snorkeling in these crystal clear water is a treat you won’t want to miss.  If you can arrange to approach the beach by kayak, that is even better!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A steep windy road which opens into a stunning beach. Both times I’ve visited the beach has been relatively empty and it’s so wide you feel you have the place to yourself.We hired a car, apparently the coach trips stop at the top and ask if you want to walk down to the beach, walk down!Lovely cafe Alexander is a good spot to stop on the way back. Great cake and coffee and clean toilets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Deserted when we visited in May however I would imagine an absolute tourist overload in high season. Stunning bay no bars, untouched paradise. Stay away from rocks as rock falls from goats

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped here for a few hours whilst we had the hire car. The beach was quiet (very early morning) and the sea so inviting, had a lovely quiet time here. Such a beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MYRTOS BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A stunningly beautiful beach with a cave at the side. White Pebble beach with a multi coloured bay of sea. Crystal clear. Extremely dangerous under current so be careful if swimming there. Well worth a visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful locstion
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Secluded in early season. Worth the journey, fantastic view. Limited parking. 😉 Roads  /access a challenge, but the vista superb.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos beach is always stunning, even in the rain. This is a place we always visit when we come to Kefalonia. Please take a look for yourselves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, definitely a favourite of mine. Has a beautiful hidden gem of a little cave there too which is a must see. Has beautiful waters reminds me of the Caribbean. Definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice not nothing special
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely better seeing from above then actually being on the beach. Quite stoney and shingle. Lovely smooth white pebbles and waves. Obviously made famous by the film so guess must see

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From upstairs looks amazing.Sandy beach,turquoise water turning to purple blue 100 meters from the beach.But it’s very rare absolute clear waters because of the transported slopes of passing vessels.The dangerous waves sometimes makes difficult to swim out and tho local authorities don’t take any measures against.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Enjoy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a beautiful beach. Has a mix of larger and fine stone, the finer sand is so soft, not sticky and a beautiful white. Has an incredible back drop of the cliff front through the winding road to the hidden, perfectly clear blue sea. I think the clearest I’ve ever seen!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos Beach 2018
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a stunning beach ! The waters are crystal clear and the views from above are stunning ! It's well worth a visit as part of your Island discovery 😉

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ONE OF THE BEST BEACHES
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Myrtos Beach twice, 2014 and 2018.  1st visit in 2014, there was big waves and look extremely dangerous, so we only went in to our waist.  (i've heard that there has been many drownings here, so we were extra careful.  2nd trip in 2018, it was like magic, very, very mild waves (almost flat), we had the best swim of our trip, we went a couple hundred meters out (two children, two adults) and not a hint of danger at all.  We just happen to catch this beach on a good day on our second trip.  A big highlight of our trip.  While on Cephalonia, make sure you visit 'Makris Yialos' also a great beach with bar/food and plenty of hire umbrellas and banana chairs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better appreciated from above
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is no denying that Myrtos beach is beautiful the sea is so blue but it looks so much better looking down from above than when you are actually on the beach which is over crowded and difficult to park. It also has the worst toilet facilities I have ever been too. I have been to many places in the world and been to some pretty dubious toilets, I am not fussy at all I will go any where, but this place was covered floor to ceiling in poo which was a bit much even for me.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: So pretty it looks like candy from the cliff above!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The drive down to parking lot might be bit treacherous but once there you park right next to the beach.It has warm turquoise water and you can float/swim all day.When I was there there was no vending of any kind so bring your food and drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By far one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The only downside is that its a pebble beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: just falling in love with the views and colour of sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: what a stunning beach, the view from the top just not give Myrtos justice. As when swimming in the beautiful, blue waters of this beach:)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Everything and more
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Honestly the most beautiful beach I have ever been too. Difficult drive to get to it but well worth it. It's just like the pictures. Would be nice if there was shops / taverna nearby so that you could make a day of the beach, but that might spoil it's natural beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in KefaloniaWe had a very hairy drive to get here but it was worth itViews are incredible

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is absolutley stunning, plentyof room even in mis August.  Couple of negatives are that unless you get theer very early there aer no sunbeds so bring your own shad and something to lie on as the beach gets hot.  Also parking..... if you dont manage to get there early you could be parking over a kilometre away on the road.  which then makes it fun to try and leave as then the road down becomes a single road with minimal passing spaces.... took me and my daughter about 40 minutes to get to the main road at the top (should take about 5 minutes)  so if you dont like hill starts in your car dont do it! :-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous - came up to expectations
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited 3 times in our short stay on Kefalonia. The sea colour is absolutely wonderful  - just like the pictures but probably better. We were fortunate to experience one day with high wind and the waves  and spectacle were fantastic. A must see loaction

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach but hire a car
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great beach, probably the most beautiful one in kefalonia- but it can be difficult to get to. I would definitely recommend hiring a car as there is a very long, steep road down to the beach which would not be fun to walk back up in the heat. Great beach overall with toilets and ice cream shop 🏖

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great place to see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fiskardo a picturesque port lined with pastel coloured houses that rings the small harbor with heaps of relaxing cafés and shops to explore. This village is the only one on the whole island to emerge unscathed from the great quake in 1953. You could spend many hours here. Myrtos bay stunning waters with neon blue and the veiws are truely amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of our road trips while staying in Kefalonia.  The ride into Myrtos Beach was breathtaking! Truly a beautiful beach although youll need beach shoes cause this beach has tiny rocks.  Water was incredible and theres a cave to explore and take pictures!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favourite place by far.Amazing crystal clear waters that you refuse to stop swimming in .Must visit.Advise,have some shoes with you since the beach is full of stones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful places on this planet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was in Cephalonia just a few weeks ago, travelling in Greek sunshine and warmth. We pretty well covered the whole of Cephalonia during our all too short stay, the first time my wife and I had been there in some 27 years. The last time was the year before the demise of the drachma and the rise of the dreaded Euro. Needless to say, a stop at Myrtos is a must while on this beautiful island. If I could only convince my wife, I would sell up and move myself lock, stock and barrel to this heaven on earth. We travelled all over the island and I will write about different places we visited, but this is one incredibly gorgeous beach which deserves its own mention

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A must see when you are in kefalonia. A really beautiful beach. You will need beach shoes here,the water is crystal clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach - unfortunatelly neglected
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches in Greece - period!Every day 100s or maybe 1000s of tourists enjoy the cristal blue waters (watch out for strong flow of water - dangerous for small children). It seems that the municipality has other things to do than hiring a lifequard and so the beach lost it´s "blue flag". Aditionally there was no place where you could buy a bottle of water - that´s a shame. You should bring beach foot wear because of the stones and get there early on high season (until 10:00) or else you will have to park high up the cliff.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a view. We visited whilst on a day trip to Kefalonia and we are so glad we did. The beach is beautiful. If you have the opportunity then visit. You won’t be disappointed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Must Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you're on Kefalonia, you simply must visit Myrtos Beach. As soon as you come around the corner to see it for the first time it will simply take your breath away.One piece of advice though, bring beach shoes as, from a distance it may look like white sand, it is actually small pebbles, so a bit sore on bare feet. Snorkelling here is great as the visibility is unbelievable and there are plenty of fish to see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach - Worth a Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Myrtos Beach whilst travelling around the island.This beach is featured in the film 'Captain Corelli's Mandolin'.There is a very narrow windy lane down to the beach (not for the faint hearted) but worth it in the end.The water was crystal clear and the long white sandy beach was amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Drove here one of the most breathtaking views in Kefalonia.  If you hire a car you must go and visit this beach if only for the photo's.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beautiful location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beautiful location with quite a long twisting road down to beach.Best viewed from the high cliffs above- which are about 300 -400 foot  high at this point. This just emphasises the perfect golden crescent of sand and shingle set in an azure and light blue sea. There are some organised franchise sunbeds and umbrellas, but this is restricted to one small area only. Myrtos beach is the film location for the beach scenes including "exploding a naval mine" from "Captain Corolli's mandolin".Lovely places to visit - even if it is by the rather complicated bus schedules.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: best Beach in Kefalonia! The view from the top is just breathtaking! And the beach itself is beautiful. Amazing shades of blue! Perfect place for a sunset!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a sublime view.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This must be one of the most photographed beaches anywhere in Greece. It combination of white pebbles against an azure blue sea is truly a must-see, but take care if you bathe there, as the beach falls sharply as you enter the sea, and there are sharp undercurrents ready to rip you off your feet. You can see from the photo next to this review how long and tortuous the road twists and turns down off the main road. This photo was taken from a viewpoint further along the road to Assos and Fiscardo, which has ample safe parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Takes Your Breath Away
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a breathtaking beach.  The white beach and turquoise waters cannot be matched.Heads up, parking is minimal, beach has lots of round rocks and is hard on your bare feet.  So, get there early and wear water shoes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Greece, land of blue.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you have been descending the winding road down to the beach you will find a place for your car most of the times. Pebble beach with amazing blue water. The pebbles will hurt you feet. Use watershoes for comfort. The cave at the left is attractive, be ware of falling stones from the hill however. Great beach for a swim. We spotted a muray eal!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand and pebbles but very nice. Not so easy without a car though. Would be a nice place to drop anchor.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but be careful in the surf.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach is certainly beautiful. Get there early, there are many spots but they do fill up quickly. We had a great day but did notice many people having difficulty in the dumping waves. As an Australian who is used to changeable surf conditions, based on what I saw the day we were there, this beach is absolutely beautiful but not safe for unsupervised kids.Enjoy this beach but look out for each other. Stay safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beech with white sand and small pebbles. You'll need your sea shoes for this one. But wow! turquoise water, waves crashing onto the shore, sun loungers, parking on the beech front. The road down and up to the beech is typically Greece. Very scary and not for the faint hearted but it's well worth the visit so don't be put off.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ok but not all that
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went to Myrtos beach as a swim stop on way back from Fiscardo. Agreed it was empty and water was clear but the beach is only worth the 20 minutes we were there. In summary it’s ok as part of something else but not worth going as your only destination

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dramatic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Dramatic setting and you can park right at the beach . I prefer more rustic place with old fashioned tavernas with wilder beaches so this was not for me . However there is no denying its beauty , it’s very exposed with little shelter but great for swimming .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent Myrtos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The local tourist industry describe this as an organised beach, which means it has sun loungers for hire and has some services. It is possible to find spots for sunbathing without loungers. It is in a dramatic location with huge cliffs on three sides. There is a good road going down, with multiple hairpin bends, quite a number of road safety barriers but not everywhere so travel with the customary caution that Kefalonian roads demand. One of the spectacles of this location is the amazing colour of the sea with pools of turquoise and ultramarine alternating across the bay. Unmissable really.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing views on the way, basic beach, great for swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the view from above (on the way) is priceless, the beach itself has just basic amenities (sunbeds, simple kiosk), no real escape from the sun, but the water is amazingly clear and great for swimming. a must visit in Kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: a must see,we walked on the beach to the cave,but did not swim.The view from the top is amazing a beautiful spot

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A really superb spot. The drive down is a little steep (not shocking for Kef), but there are good amenities and a really special spot in general.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are many beaches to see in Kefalonia and this is one of the ones that is a must. Many go because of the link to the film and once you see it you understand why they chose this location. Stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breath taking views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Busy beach but worth the trip down the steep access road to car park!Park anywhere you can at the bottom.........

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning scenery but basic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach and setting but nowhere to escape from the sun.  There was only a kiosk selling drinks and one type of sandwich.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunningly beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach is idyllic ! From above the colour of the sea is true blue and the beach is a mix of shingle and sand. There are WCs and a bar serving drinks and snacks, However and a big warning there is a very strong undercurrent here and lots of people were getting pulled back in trying to get out of the sea. It’s a strong surf which can be deceiving until you go in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large beach in a dramatic setting. Gorgeous blue colours in the water. Quite famous and as a result, very popular. Parking can be a tad difficult, but the beach itself is big enough not to feel overcrowded. It does have facilities and a beach bar, but these are very basic. We were warned about strong under currents here, but thankfully on the day we visited it was calm and swimming was delightful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over-hyped and busy!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perhaps this place is just not for me.  I like quiet and secluded - pretty Greek beaches, surrounded by olive trees, and with perhaps an old Taverna at the back!Myrtos beach is none of those things, apart from having a Taverna - doing burgers and chips however!The beach is large.  It is barren and devoid of any character.  It gets very busy and so do not rely on being able to rent a bed and umbrella ... take your own.On a positive side - it is a nice place to swim ... however - if there is a wind from the west of more than 5 or 6 kmh ... you may want to avoid it.  This is a wide beach that gets very choppy when it is windy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not that special!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We didn’t quite understand the rave reviews about this beach! Admittedly the high cliffs around you were impressive but the big white rocks instead of lovely sand do not make the walk to the sea pleasant! Facilities poor! Beach bar just serves drinks from fridges & crisps that’s about it!  Experienced much nicer beach at Lassi where drinks served to you & lovely sun beds! Still worth A short visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the top beaches. Try to arrive early to avoid the crowds and find easy parking.Crystal clear waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this beach, the beach is ok with loungers and umbrellas, however the taverna at the beach is not very good, suggest if you do visit this beach you take food with you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow, just beautiful,  Crystal clear, turquoise water. Stunning location. Fantastic panoramic views. Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Didnt have time or patience to find a parking space and have a swim but this is certainly one popular beach, and for good reason.  Book ended by 2 headlands which provide for a protected beach, the water is a beautiful turquoise colour.  Umbrellas and sun beds can be purchased here.  Strongly suggest an early or late visit to beat the crowds.  Otherwise you will just have to satisfy yourself with brilliant views and photos of this iconic beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in Greece
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing colors but get here the right day. Some days the beach gets crowded with touristbus people. To swim in the blue gives another meaning here...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely - must see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We booked a tour which included a visit to the beach. We got to stay on the beach for an hour and it is so beautiful. You must visit this beach whilst staying in kefalonia!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is breathtaking. It's paradise and one of the most amazing beaches I have been to. Wonderful blue sea, white sands (with pebbles) and just a stunning surrounding.An absolute must if you are in Kefalonia

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach paradise...almost perfect
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I totally get why this beach gets listed among the top 10 in the world. The views as you descend the hills above are truly breathtaking. Very few locations can claim such picture postcard beauty. The clear turquoise water is typical of the Ionian Islands, especially those beaches which face west. The only beach that rivals this is Porto Katsiki in Lefkada, the next island up. The beach itself is a mix of white sand and pebbles. Getting in and out of the sea comfortably requires leaving your flipflops right at the edge. It is quite a steep shelf so not ideal for non swimmers. The beach bar serves drinks and ice creams but has a very limited food offer. Everything seems to be €3.00 for some reason. One exception: an umbrella with two sunbeds is €10.00 per day.  My advice: come in September. It's lovely and quiet, you get to park right on the edge of the beach and there's loads of space. I can't imagine it's this good in August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely stunning beach. White sand and crystal clear waters. Well worth a visit if you are in kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A brilliant beach with the bluest seas and lovely sand. Worth a trip to this beach. It's quite far from anything else though and quite a scary ride over the mountains to get there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Kefalonia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a must see beach, not just because of the film, the views down to it are stunning, the water is just amazing, the colours in the sea will mezmarize you. Beach is massively pebbly so you will need reef shoes and you will have no problem walking the beach and entering the sea, I hobbled about in flip flops and stubbed my toes going in the sea and quite frankly struggled getting out again lol, but wear wet suit or reef/gel shoes and you’re sorted, if you come to Kefalonia you MUST see this beach, a bus will take you there and it’s a 10 min walk down to it or you can hire a car or quad bike, we hired a car and parked on the beach, much easier. Enjoy 😊

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picturesque from above.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have visited this beach every year for the past 9 years and seen from above it is quite spectacular. This year it was even more  crowded than usual but an organised one way parking system was in force which made getting out from the parking area much easier. However i would advise going early to park by the beach.  With 2 sunbeds and an umbrella now costing 10 euros it wont be on my itinerary next year. The beach is very pebbly so fitted beach shoes are advisable especially when entering the sea which can be  rough. There are toilets and a cafe for snacks, drinks, ice creams etc. Watch out for the paragliders coming down from the cliffs behind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited the beach on a day trip the beach was outstandingly beautiful. We have seen many beaches over the years but this will take some beating

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, just too crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arrived about 11 and found parking easy (free) which was next to the beach.Two lounge chairs and umbrella for 10euros.Desk chairs are close to each other and the sun come from behind as the chairs are facing the sea.A pebbled beach which requires flip flops till the sea. Then you have to put up with 4-5 steps on the stone till you start swimming. There is a toilet which was reasonably clean and a cafe which had drinks, toasties and beers. They played loud music at times which spoilt the ambience, there were also some people playing their music and talking loudly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There isn’t much here, not even a cafe or toilets but the beach is so beautiful and quiet that it’s worth a visit. It’s pebbly so make sure you bring flip flops for going into the sea!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited Myrtos beach today, lovely crystal clear warm waters, white pebble beach, what a lovely place to visit *****

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Could Rival Any Caribbean Beach....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From the winding road coming down from Fiscardo this beach looks stunning so much so it could rival any carribean beach, there are viewpoints along the road and it does get fairly busy with people taking photographs hence why it is the most photographed beach in the whole of Greece.Also famous for its location for the film Captain Corelli's Mandolin used as the mine explosion episode, it has also been voted the best beach in Greece so really is a tourist spot and a photographers delight.Once down at the beach you can park right on it, it is a very winding drive down not for the faint hearted just like most of the roads in the North.A  pure white tiny stones beach leads to an unbelievable turquoise azure blue sea, there is quite a drop a little out and the wave energy here is very high, i certainly wouldn't leave children unattended, especially on a windy day as it was on our visit .An absolute must no matter which area you are staying in on Cephalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well worth the trip to Myrtos beach - it is absolutely incredible. Pictures don't do the sea colour justice! lots of room, and places to place a towel or you can also hire sun loungers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A white stone beach with the limestone eroding into the ocean makes the colours just amazing.It's one of the wavy beaches of Kefalonia and the feelings of being shaken by the waves follow you even after you left.Be mindful of bringing some sort of protection for your feet since the waves are powerful and the stones may be sharp.Little secret: on the east of that beach there's an amazing cave from where the ocean penetrates powerfully (be careful not to go on high tide as the waves can be a bit scary)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I cannot say enough wonderful things about Myrtos Beach. We stopped here for a short 45 minutes while on a tour to Messilani Lake, I wish we could have spent the entire day here. It’s is absolutely the most beautiful beach I have ever been to. The water is a color I didn’t know existed in real life, such a bright turquoise color that isn’t like anywhere else in the world. An absolute must if you are on Kefalonia Island. One thing I would suggest is make sure you have good sandals or water shoes. The beach is very rocky, not much sand so be prepared to walk on the rocks to get into the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful views -rough sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach- is pebbly but we prefer that and we buy the beach shoes with a tough flexible sole. The colour of the sea was a beautiful turquoise and there are sun beds.It was difficult to swim as the sea was very rough which is tough when it is boiling hot. Lovely view from the beach but the best view is from the very top before you go down the winding roads to get to it- it is so high and the scenery is magnificent.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous and breathtaking! The white marble stones and pebbles are beautiful, have not seen this before. The white stones pebbles against the lovely blue sea is beautiful. Sea a bit rough in the day we were there so we did not get a chance to snorkel. Beautiful beach to relax at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but the sea very rough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach and quite busy but hard to get into the sea as very wild and rough waves also take swim shoes to walk on pebbles

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely stunning beach! The contrast of colours here was beautiful, from white pebble stones (swim shoes could be handy), bright turquoise water. The best way to get here is by car! Would recommend making a day out of it and bringing some snack along for the ride!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome beach, huge stretch of small to medium sized pebble beach, with beautiful blue water and sheltered cove. There are sunbeds and umbrellas you can rent but we bought a cheap umbrella for 8 EUR in the supermarket and set up on a more secluded part of the beach. There's also a little bar where you can get drinks and a public restroom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovey beach, such blue water! Got to the beach around 11am and got two sun loungers for 10 euros, recommend you don’t get to the beach much later as they were all taken by midday. Managed to park all fine and our little hire car managed the track down just fine. Beach is pebbly but didn’t cause us any problems. Def recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This a stunning beach.  Pebbled so wear beach shoes.  There is a winding road down but passable for two cars.  The beach is large but car parking can be limited at peak times.  There is a small beach cafe, toilets & shower.  There is a great Cave to the left where you can swim in.  There are some beach umbrellas & sun-loungers for hire, but not loads.  Without a doubt go around 6pm when the crowds have gone & watch the sun set it is incredible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach if you get a calm day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were lucky the day we came it was very calm water and safe for swimming, but easy to see how it could be dangerous on a rough day. It’s worth exploring the cave down to the left of the beach, just make sure you wear shoes for the rocks!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: On the Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the tourist hot spots looks great from above and the drive down the very narrow steep road with large tourist couches coming the other way is very entertaining or scarey, parking at the bottom is a challenge unless you go early or late in the day.The beach is stoney and shelves away into the sea very quickly so not suitable for young children, the cave at the end of the beach is interesting and you can swim thru it . In summary difficult to get to its not suitable for kids but is dramatic location it’s worth the effort

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful from the top - not so good when you get to the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not too sure what is so good about this place - when we visited, parking was non-existent, so returned on another day - but later in the day - but were quite underwhelmed and wouldn't recommend a beach visit here.  The pebbles in places are quite large, so uncomfortable under foot - advisable to wear aqua shoes in all honesty - however the sea here can be a little formidable and wipe you out.There are nicer beaches to visit on the island - but for sheer beauty from the photographic point up on the mountain roadside - it is spectacular.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in Greece but no sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have had photographs at the top some 15 years ago and we finally revisited last week and again had photos but this time drove down to the beach. We had hired a jeep this time and was not part of a coach trip. From above its one of the most photographed beaches and the colours are as you see on the photos , no filters .We passed by early on route to Assos but returned in the afternoon. By the time t was in full swing and busy. The beach its self is actually white pebbles and not sand as it appears from above. The sea was warm with lots of waves and gets deep quickly. For not so strong swimmers it can be dangerous if it gets really choppy and it does pull you in. So for kids please ensure your watching them. I have heard that if its to bad they do actually stop you swimming.You do have a wc and a small beach bar for drinks and snacks. You also have sunbeds which can be rented and also have to advise not much shade so either take some or rent some as it gets hot down there. Its fantastic for phot opportunities and well worth a visit. But I would go early if you want to park  there as it does get very busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach,get there early
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning to look at, pebbly underfoot and make sure you get there early to hire an umbrella or take your own. It's very exposed and got very hot. Lovely waters which were calm when went and great for all the family to swim in. Basic snack bar which does ice creams and drinks. If you want more make sure you bring your own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach but no facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am rating the beach 5***** just because of its beauty. However, it is very difficult to access, even more difficult to find an unoccupied seat (we did not find any on our trip here), so bring your own umbrella if you can. Also no restaurant or bar here, just a tiny shop where you can buy drinks and ice-creams but the queue is huge, so not pleasant. However the beauty of the place still makes it worth visiting if only for a couple of hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Took a drive down here today, it was very busy. The sea is stunning. Lovely white stony beach, sharp underfoot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An amazing experience beach with round pebbles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved this beach, for the experience. What an amazing beach with perfectly rounded white pebbles. Definitely bring swim shoes as walking on these pebbles is not easy on the feet. It’s a beach like nothing you’ve seen before. The sea deepens quite quickly here. Wasn’t overly crowded which also made it super comfortable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but so busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No trip to Kefelonia is complete without a visit to this wonderful Beach, with the stunning views when approaching it, amazing views to look down on. When approaching Myrtos, there is a viewing point along the road side, worth a stop here for photo opportunity.We made the journey to visit here from our accommodation in Lourdas/ Vlachata on Sunday  26th August. We took the scenic route through Agrostoli past the Lagoon and along up the Bay. We drove through Farsa and across through Agon then on to Myrtos, much more scenic that taking the inland route.When we visited here it was so busy, the parking was absolutely chaotic and finding a place to park was difficult, eventually we parked up and headed for the beach.There were sunbeds and umbrellas available, they were a new addition this year. There was still room to spread out the beach mats and towels, not much avaiable when we visited. We stayed for a few hours and decided to head for Mounda Beach (reviewed separately) much quieter.The good news is there is a Taverna at Myrtos again, last year the authorities did not permit one. It is situated a bit off the beach and not on it like the old one.Would recommend possibly visiting here during the week and not at the weekend, might be slightly quieter, but don't it.Not sure, maybe my imagination but the beach seemed different this year, it appeared to have been flattened, maybe naturally or by machine, not sure, it felt a bit unreal if that makes sense.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was a little nervous of the road but it was fine. Full of bends but not too difficult. The views from the top are breathtaking. I have read a lot of negative reviews about the beach. It is mainly stones as are a lot of other beaches. The stones here however are brilliant white. Also there are stretches of white sand.The water was gorgeous. Loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning but strong “dumper” waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited twice during our holiday. Just simply stunning! Absolutely necessary to go early during the peak season as it gets busy quickly. We struggled to get in and out of the sea on our second visit due to the power of the waves, I wouldn’t recommend for children or weaker swimmers on windy days. The waves will pound you into the pebbles and it hurts! Beautiful to see and experience but beware of the strong tow. We didn’t use the facilities but there are sun beds/umbrellas and a small snack bar available in the peak season. Basic toilet and changing facilities available, parking on the beach if you arrive before 9:30am, slightly hairy drive down to the beach but worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but no amenities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is stunning. However the drive down is pretty hairy winding hairpin bends what seems to go on forever. You have to parallel park on these hairpin bends, which could prove difficult for some.There is nowhere to buy a drink so make sure that you bring enough water. Shaded places are limited- bear this in mind if you have small children. The beach is beautiful, though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view from above is perfect. The waters are clear and light blue. You have to visit the beach when there isn't any wind so there will be no waves. Must see.  Go early around 10 so you can find a parking slot and a nice seat on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scary trip down to the beach in a coach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited as part of a coach trip,how coaches get down that road safely.Beach is beautiful but mostly pebbles,very painful to walk on,so wear flip flops,the sea shelves off very quickly & strong currents,so can be quite dangerous,but still worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great afternoon in the surf
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a bit of a surprise given some mixed reviews. It is a pebble beach so not ideal for only sunbathing as it’s not that comfortable but the waves were fantastic. We all loved being in the breaking surf from 7 years old to 47. A really fun afternoon in the waves, some 6 feet or more high. A welcome contrast to the calmer beaches. Road down fine and in the mid afternoon finding a parking space was no problem. A holiday highlight for us!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Captain Corelli;)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Corelli .... who does not know. Not only because you should visit the Myrthos beach. The beach is beautiful not only from the top but also on the beach. Clean water, hot sand, what more could you want :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is well maintained and is easy to reach. It has guards who keep an eye on the people in the water, which is good because it can have some waves if the wind is right. This is a must visit beach on Kefalonia!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best of Kefalonia. The road is winding, but manageable, nothing too tricky. We got there by 11.30 and got the last parking spaces at the end of the alley. One Panda that tried to enter after us got stuck in the sand. White pebbles, shoes are a must. It is very large and very long, so it was not crowded. Few sunbeds, so best to have an umbrella, or else it gets too hot. Only one tavern/kiosk, didn’t ckeck it. So it was very peaceful, and quiet, and relaxing. The scenery is magnificent and indeed the colour of the water is unbeatable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This may be the best beach in cefalonia. You need to go early if you want to find a parking lot. There are some beds&umbrellas, but all of them were sold around 12.30. Its not possible to sit under the sun when its too hot. The sea is magnificent, the  color is amazing. For me much better than antisamos, i would prefer shooting the movie in this beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is one the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia perhaps it is the most famous. The sea and beach were beautiful. It was also nice to have a facility selling drinks on the beach and changing cabin. The prices were reasonable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach with views to die for!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful turquoise waters and slightly pebbly. Get there early to park on the beach, it's well worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As the photos show, this is an amazing place and one to tick off the bucket list.Bring a parasol if you don't want to pay to hire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a view!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A stunning view and a colour of sea that is beautiful. Pebbles, yes. Parking a real issue unless you get there early, yes. Quite a windy road down, yes. Not much shade, no. Loos “ok”. Cafe limited but perfectly ok. If you’re looking for the perfect beach with everything wonderful, it’s not it. But, for Kefalonia, it’s a fabulous beach on a fabulous island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a must see on Kefalonia. Unfortunately - No sand. But still - beautiful. The most amazing is the view from the viewpoint. Parking place - awful!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place to see the sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a car so went to this beach about 3 o'clock. We found plenty of car parking spaces as it was later on in the day and we wanted to watch the sunset. Very stoned beach and would advise to wear shoes into the sea. This beach is stunning and the sunseet didn't disappoint us at all. Lovely to see the paragliders landed on the beach. I would highly recommend this beach as it was clean but I should imagine the parking would be a little annoying in the busy season

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely to look at, pebbly beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove past on the way to and back from Fiscardo.  The views are fabulous.  We went to the beach mid afternoon and got parking easily, they have a good one way system.  There is very little natural shade on the beach and it's very pebbly so hard on the feet to get in and out.  Once in the waves are quite rough so it wasn't the calmest or most fun beach we have been on.  We left after 30 minutes.Beautiful to look at, not our sort of beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: excellent beach, awful parking place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is awesome, there is a lot of place where you can place your towel and umbrella, but the parking is extremely small. You can find a beach bar, showers and toilets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome views!!! Wow!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most amazing beach on the island and most of Greece for views. Its much more quiet than the commercialized beaches. Bring some kind of shoes to wear because its mostly a pebbles and rocks beach. It has some amenities but it does not have the most amenities. If you want the most amenities, go to Makris Gialos beach or Antisamos beach or Skala beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dissapointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been looking forward to visiting the beautiful beach featured in the film “Cpt Corelli‘s Mandolin” Very disappointed, as beach was very overcrowded, sun beds and umbrellas, and very congested with traffic trying to find parking spaces (which are very limited)Access is down a very steep and narrow hill. We arrived on an organised tour, which I would definitely recommend, as a parking space next to the beach was reserved for us .There is a small cafe on the beach and toilets, however we were warned by our tour guide not to use the toilets !!The beach has very sharp shingle/ pebbles, so beach shoes are a must! Also we were warned about the very strong currents and steep shelving beach, so be aware when swimming.Be very careful near the cliffs , especially near the cave, as there was a rock fall while we were there!!Best way to see this beach, is from the pull in view point on the road above the beach.Definitely recommend taking your photographs from here Beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach but
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches on the island of Kefalonia...It is a pebble beach so bring beach shoes or have a painful stay.The BUT....you Must get there 9:30 latest or the chances of parking your car are almost nil.Now look at Google earth...if you can not park there the walk up hill is horrendous.One taverna sells toasties and coffee €3 cold drinks and crisps.👍There are toilets.Its a great day out.Leave by 4pm before the exodus.Sprogg

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely big beach. White Pebbles so tricky getting in and out of the sea. Take swimming shoes. Parking and sunloungers not plentiful so go early on otherwise u have to park up the hill and do the steep walk up and down and wait for a longer to become free. Free parking and loungers not too costly . Showers at the back of the beach.Def worth a visit. View amazing from the road above.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Terrible Dangerous Road - Had to Turn Back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The road down to the beach was too dangerous to continue down to the beach.  Maybe outside of August there is less bedlam? My experience was that since there is little parking at the beach area - everyone was parking instead along the narrow road.  This is a treacherous winding road and the parked cars made the situation absolutely untenable.  A Serb chap parked to admire the view as I tried to do a 3 point turn on a bend to escape and laughed when I explained there were no barriers and the road was frightening - he told me this was 'Greek Land'!  Even if you reach the beach early in the day and manage to park at the bottom safely - you would still have the nightmare of leaving up a winding road, with no barriers and huge drops - with other reckless drivers.  Sadly I would give it a miss - since this road is an accident waiting to happen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach with rock jumping
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visit the south end of Myrtos beach which has won awards - rightly so. Small pebbles, some sand (but quick drop to depth - be careful if with young children). Our teenagers (13/15) enjoyed jumping from the rock near the small cave. Arrive before 10.30 to be able to park on or near beach. There is a refreshment stand and showers near the middle of the beach (chairs/umbrellas there too). There is a spectacular view of the beach at the lookout along the main road towards Assos. Tip: buy pies and fruits at the grocery up in the town next to the turning for the beach to enjoy them on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear waters, amazing view down on it! Pebbles but able to get comfortable! Suitable shoes useful due to pebbles that you can wear in sea. Limited parking so get there early. Very popular but enough room so didn’t feel crowded. Saw few fish when snorkelling. Will definitely revisit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a site!! Beautiful beach. Amazing sunsets. When someone visits Cephalonia it is a beach that he has to go!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best for a great photo
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is lovely and white as the photos suggest and not too stoney either. Parking can be tricky so either get there early or you will have to park up the hill. We stayed here for a couple of hours before moving on to see other beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely to drive to see but we didn't stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A good drive from where we were in Lourdas but worth it to see this famous beach. The congestion with vehicles trying to park was bonkers - it was just too popular! We parked and went for a walk on the beach but didn't stay. It is an unspoilt beach and, as such, has no cafe/bar/shop/toilet etc and only a small collection of sunbeds and shades. We didn't have our own shade and it was too hot to stay without even natural shade so we moved on but our photos are amazing! The drive on was also lovely. I suspect those in the know we're aware that it gets crazy busy and were there very early to secure a spot. It's worth a visit, absolutely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just gorgeousThere is a car park but when full people park along the long winding road which isn’t as scary as we were led to believe although the walk is challenging because of the heat and lengthBeach is shingle and there are toilets and refreshmentsThe sea a few steps in is deep but totally gorgeous

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picture perfect beach but nightmare road down.....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You have probably already seen images of the picture perfect Myrtos Beach without even realising it, as it's image is widely used to promote Greece as a whole. Be warned, if you are driving, the road down is extremely windey, and as parking at the beach itself fills up quickly, visitors start to fill up the roadside closest to the cliff wall. This makes the road only just wide enough for vehicles to pass. Bad enough on the way down in an unfamiliar hire car, but a nightmare on the way back when you will need to drive within feed of a sheer drop ! That said, it's worth a quick visit and park in some of the wider sections of road where you can take a picture looking down onto the beach...beautiful !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perhaps the most famous beach on Kefalonia so unsurprisingly full of tourists. If you want to park close by, get there early. If you prefer a quiet beach, don't go! But well worth a visit at off peak times...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth the effort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everyone says this beach looks best from the cliff tops. True, it’s a pebbly beach, but it is stunning in and out of the water. Get there early (9-10am) to get a parking space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach - top tips
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a God given gem. To fully enjoy it follow these simple tips.1. Leave a visit for the later part of holiday. The beach is white so you will be recieving sun rays from water and sand as well. Get some melanin on you.2. Bring your own sun umbrella and if you have folding chairs. 3. For more sensitive ones, bring rubber shoes 4. Go to the far left part so you will explore caves and rocks5. Come before 10am the car parking is crowdedHave a great fun day at the beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Roads are crazy on this island...  so many twists and turns and the drive down to this beach is nuts! To then discover no restaurants or snack bar!  Not sure why designated in top 30 beaches in the world ... yes fab but we were a little disappointed...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach is very warm. It is warmer than in other parts of Kefalonia even in May. I advise for a family holiday. Luckily there were no sunbeds on the beach. this creates the impression of a wild beach. people are relatively many. the water is blue and clean. but for diving with a mask does not fit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very crowded place in August
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As you probably discovered already this is one of this places that looks perfect in the pictures, or from above but it’s not a beach to spend your day on. It is so popular!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing road along the sea and mountains
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We did not visit the beach itself because it looked to crowded. We saw it from above while driving on one of the most beautiful roads I've ever seen. The views over the ocean and mountains are perfect, I would place it on the same spot as Chapman's Peak in Cape Town!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Words cannot describe the stunning beautiful features of Myrtos Beach. The view from the clifftop is amazing and once you get down there for a swim the crystal clear water is both invigorating and essential in peak of a Greek summer.Be early if you want an umbrella or bring your own as there are limited umbrellas

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful beach I have ever seen!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Took a car round the island today with the family. Stopped here twice. First we went to the photo point on the road where the view of the beach was so stunning and picturesque. I’ve never seen anything so beautiful. Later we went down to the beach for a dip and a sunbathe. Despite the beach being a bit rocky, the sea is so clear and blue and the pebbles are amazingly white. You can park along the road at the foot of the hill and I would definitely recommend this as one of the best places to visit if you are staying in Kefalonia. Simply blissful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was one of my highlights and i wish i had spent a full day there as the sunset would be awesome! The water and beach are SO clean! I spent my entire time in the water which is DEEP but safe. The clarity of the water is stunning. I just loved it! Note, shade is hard to come by so be warned. You can get a bit at the back of the beach but i am sure it would go later in the day so best to take your own. It does get busy but the beach is so huge it isn't really a problem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful place absolutely stunning, a real suntrap, a got to visit beach even as the sun goes down sunset stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everyone already said it all, its breathtaking! I was there for few hours only, but don't really get people who are unsatissfed with fascilites, have you seen other beaches how they look like with all the umbrellas and sunbeds? Can you see the beach out of them? This is exeptional natural beauty, enjoy it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were left dumbfounded when we came across the sight of Myrtos beach, it is simply breathtaking!! The beach itself has white sand and pebbles, take your beach shoes if you’re swimming. If you will be staying a while take a parasol as there are none for hire. There are a couple of loos. Worth not having facilities for the spectacle that is Myrtos beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The views are better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The views of Myrtos Beach are undeniably stunning and worth taking many photos of. However, although the beach itself is fine, it is not as relaxing as the smaller beaches in Kefalonia. It is big, so you should get space, but it is obviously more crowded and the toilets were vile! If you like a busier and more organised beach, this is fine and much nicer than Antisamos Beach. If you prefer quieter and smaller beaches, take your photos and drive on!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach, could be better
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos beach is the most famous beach on Kefalonia. Water is pretty clean and clear and has very nice coulour. However, there are some things that does not make it perfect. Aside from being too crowded, there is a serious problem with parking spaces, especially having in mind that there is a large part of the beach that is being underused and could be improved and turned into parking. The other problem is that there is very small number of sunbeds and umbrellas for visitors who do not bring their own. In the end, there is only one small coffee shop with very high prices. Therefore, you have to wait for someone to leave the beach and then race with other visitors for the spot. All in all, I have to say that although I prefer sandy beaches, this one is very good, apart of these few problems.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Got here late after travelling somewhere else first.Was too busy to park but looked really nice. Recommend arriving early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most wonderful sandy beach, not overpopulated so there is plenty of space. The view are spectacular and well worth the tricky route down. There is also a lovely taverna serving food and drinks. You won't want to leave

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful but very crowded beach. If you search a peaceful place is not the place to go! Not enough parking lots.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely gorgeous but very very busy. There are some of sunbeds and sun shades- 8€. A small cabin with a very limited choice of snacks- take your own lunch. There are toilets and a place to change. Limited parking unless you are early

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb stunning beach and definitely a must visit place when you go to Kefalonia. A place to go for a lovely relaxing chilling day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful day!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is undeniably beautiful. We came at around Midday during the week and it was very very busy so we decided to leave it for another day. Get there for 10.30am latest to park and access sun beds. We did this and spent the day here, it was amazing. The water is crystal clear and the most amazing shades of blue/turquoise, the surroundings are breathtaking. As others have said there are toilet facilities, however these get pretty grim (take tissue!), showers, and a small cafe selling drinks/snacks. There is a cave to explore, and the sea is just beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breath Taking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view from the top is out of this world and have never seen anything so beautiful like it.When we went down to the beach and parked up the sea waves where rough on this particular day but still managed to dip my feet in as I could not resist.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The journey is well worth it. The colour of the water is unbelievable and the cleanliness of the beach is superb

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice location pebble beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very spectacular view to get to the beach and the location is gorgeous. If you dont mind pebble beaches then this will be good beach. I personally liked kiriaki beach more which is close by. Parking is a bit tricky and gets really busy by 12 so get there before then

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is just the most amazing view from the road I’ve ever seen.  Absolutely stunning. A must stop for great photos when visiting the island.  Just beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s true what they say - one of the very best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The trip down to the beach is a typical nightmare but well worth it. Take your own food and drinks because you cannot get anything down there. There are good beds and umbrellas for hire for 7 or 8 Euros a set. The water is beyond description as is the view back up the mountains from the beach Swimmers will rejoice doing a lap or two across the bay in which the beach rests. For the brave or reckless you can do tandem hangliding from the top of the mountain landing on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow, about the most beautiful thing I've ever seen
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a must see when on the island.  I have never see so many shades of blue.   It is spectacular.  Pictures cannot capture how beautiful this is.I didn't go down to the beach, just saw it from the road half way up the mountain.There are pull outs on both sides of the beach.  It is good to check them both out.  Depending on the time of day, one might be better than the other.  We saw it at mid-day in the summer and it was fantastic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue Blue Blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is stunning. I have never seen anything like this. Me and my husband travel all the time and this beach took our breath away.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Natural beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Is the most beautiful and one of the most popular beaches. A natural beauty with an unbelievable view that will give you the opportunity to take great pictures. The negative is that most of the time there is waves and air. It has a beach bar that you can take snacks or coffee, but do not go to its toilets are unacceptable and very dirty !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue definitely is the colour
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach, when you see it from the vantage points up top, the colour is stunning and even better once you have made the journey down the winding road to it.  Yes it is pebble and large ones at that, so beach shoes required if you intend to swim.  The only reason I did not give it a 5 star rating is as previous reviewers have said, the lack of facilities.  There was nowhere to get a drink or food when we visited in July and the toilets could definitely do with an update.  For such an iconic tourist attraction as Myrtos, with all the visitors it gets each year, I am really surprised that the Council (or whoever is in charge of local government) does not employ someone to at least keep the toilets clean and empty the overflowing "paper" bins.  Also, there used to be a beach bar cafe, so not sure what happened to it but the beach is crying out for one.  If anyone from the council or tourist board has any info please could they let us know.  Beautiful beach but facilities need updating.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Out of this world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What can I say this place has to be seen to be believed.  Only downside there are no beach bars for you to buy a drink or get something to eat.  Get there early to get your self a brolly/beds or ensure you take your own

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but.........
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a great looking beach from the viewing  point and where all the publicity photos are taken. Once on the beach it is made up of various sized white pebbles. Beach shoes are recommended and be aware the beach shelves off very quickly so you are out of your depth in a few meters. No problem if you are a confident swimmer but those who aren't or child should be aware. The water is very clear and stunning. Having read some reviews they stated there were no amenities on the beach. On 31 July there was a shower point and toilet. We were informed   as of 1 August a small cafe will be opening to provide refreshments. If you want to go in the car then you need you need to  go early. Any later than 10.00hrs in the peak season and you have no chance. The beach is at the end of a narrow track  with hairpin bends. Parking gets crazy the later you leave it. There is no effective monitoring of the number of vehicles entering hence the potential for total grid lock. There is a small local bus which runs  from the small kiosk ( pictured)  down to the beach  regularly throughout the day.The toilets are a good addition although I warn you they require some refinement. The Gents toilet had a normal size dust bin with no lid. In Greece all paper is required to be put in the bin rather than flushed down the toilet. By 1000hrs this resembled  something  akin to an open sewer. This was not too dissimilar to the smell of open medieval sewers experienced when visiting the Jorvick Viking centre in York.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No food or beverages offered in the beach bar
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As others have already mentioned the beach is amazing and specious. However parking is not easy to find and the beach bar only offers coffee and water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is lovely, tidy, clean.There is a tiny cave.Nothing other than sun, pebbles and sand and obviously a clear blue sea.Surroundings are beautiful.Nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow what a Blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach looks amazing from above , stunning Blue and calm.We hired a car and went down onto the beach from above looks can be deceiving, the beach is pebbles and the current very strong so beware. Well worth a visit though you will not be disappointed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately it clouded over when we went to see the beach but it was still gorgeous and we had some lovely photos. Worth seeing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos Beach- Definitely One for the Bucket List
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Myrtos Beach is absolutely AMAZING!!! Viewing it from the road above is just spectacular! It is just breathtaking to look down at it in all its glorious grandeur -the incredibly blue water & the softest looking white sand!! You can make your down to the beach via a rather long, narrow one way path by car or by foot.  Parking is somewhat limited.  Once on the beach, there are facilities for changing and showering.  Additionally, there are a limited number of sun beds with umbrellas  available.  In any case, pack yourself a cooler with refreshments & snacks, a towel (and maybe your own chair & tube/raft), and for sure, don’t forget the sun block!!! Spend the day idly basking in the sun, splashing around in the aquamarine water while you soak up one of nature’s most magnificent creations!  Myrtos Beach- definitely one for the Bucket List!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach, well worth the drive!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited this beach twice in two weeks. The water can be a bit chilly at times for an Australian, but the view driving down is fantastic.  Tip: bring some decent footwear as the pebbles can be a bit annoying walking back and forth on the pebbles and sand. The cave down the far end is great to witness. One can easily swim in and out and around the cave. Be careful of the sharp rocks though, best the visit this place when it's a really hot day!Parking is a breeze, we never had trouble parking there both times so plenty of space is available.Nothing available in terms of food and drinks at the beach, so best to pack something before you leave. However, at the top of the hill, there are a few restaurants and places to buy drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning turquoise water, nice view from the view point. If you miss the bus, there is a long road to walk. Try to rent a car or hitchike.You should bring your own umbrella, because there is no shadow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We decided to drive early to Myrtos to beat the crowds and I’m so glad we did! Whilst the road was windy and steep, the views driving down were spectacular. The beach itself was a mix of sand and white pebble, and whilst there were umbrellas, it certainly wasn’t  organised like some. It was also large enough that even when busy, there still felt like space! I would fully recommend a day spent on Myrtos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best views are from the road above. Truly breathtaking. The beach itself is large white pebbles and it shelves away very quickly from waters edge and the current is quite strong. Wouldn’t recommend for young children or poor swimmers. That aside one of the nicest beaches I have ever been too and definitely worth a drive to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach with a few of cons
