Looks can and usually are deceiving! The water is an amazing color but I unfortunately didn't get a chance to go in do to the amazing lack of parking! This is a photographers friend but there are much better beaches to go to should you wish to enjoy your day and bath in the ocean.Worth a look for Instagram's sake but wouldn't spend the day. Best to do it when near to the area and combine this with other activities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach with the whitest pebbles and an amazing view from above
reviewsWithKeywords.text: First saw this heavenly place from the road above on our way to the hotel and decided to stop to take pictures which decision I'm very grateful for (photos attached). The view and the beach itself is very identical to the famous Navagio (Shipwreck) beach in Zakynthos. However we went there at around 5 in the afternoon and it was so wavy that I didn't even fully get in the water though it was a great picture material for the photography/Instagram lovers. I would recommend putting swimming shoes on as the beach is stony (the pebbles were so white and beautiful that I took some home to remind of that place) and you might hurt your feet. The beach is accessible by car, bus, bike, waking and I hear a public bus stops right there. Disadvantage is that I didn't see any bars, restaurants or bathrooms and I'm not a fan of peeing in the see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Impressive view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Impressive work of nature. The view from the main road is breath taking.The send is so fine, so soft, fondle the feet. The water is deep with waves usually so you cannot let you toddler or a small child to play in a shallow. My advice is to get up early if you want to enjoy this beach given the fact that you can find shade only in the morning hours and early after noon. There is limited number of sunbeds and umbrellas, also you can always carry on your own and enjoy all day in the beach. Also, there are no organised parking space so you have to park on the/next to the road and that can be very high and include a lot of walking. Beach offers a kite surfing.To be honest, I've enjoyed more in a view and scenery than in a swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good but not quite up to first impressions
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You first see the beach from the top of the cliffs and it looks stunning. After you drive down a slightly twisty but perfectly safe road you reach the beach. Parking is limited so get there early. One end has sun chairs and umbrellas. There is a kiosk. And the beach is white pebbles, although it's quite comfortable if you have a towel.  There is quite a steep drop off into sea and day we went sea was cloudy so couldn't see bottom.  Quite choppy so be carefully.  Worth a visit though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning scenery
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Parked up, walked down and the beach is every bit as stunning as the top but , be aware you do need sensible shoes to walk on this beach as it is very stoney, and the sea is no different. I do not swim and it was not pleasent to sit in as the waves crashing against you are also bringing in the stones.There are limited sun beds available at what cost I do not know. There is a kiosk to get snacks , drinks reasonably priced. There are toilets and changing facilities too. Best advice is get there early therefore no hiking back up hill to car.!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: THE place to go
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everyone says this is one of the most beautiful beaches in the Medditerranean, and with good reason. The view from the hilltop leaves you speechless! The color of the water is amazing, completely surreal!A recommendation to come early, or you will have to park all the way up the hill, and the climb is quite steep :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach but not much else there
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Warning to all who travel make sure you take food and drinks because although the beach does have a snack bar for some unknown reason it was closed and you could only order things you wanted and then you would have to wait one hour to get it. Crazy but true, so make sure you take provisions because it is well worth it. The beach has limited sun beds and umbrellas. On the day we went we were told that they were free for some unknown reason. The beach is absolutely spectacular in colour and you will have never seem the sea such a brilliant, almost unbelievable effervescent aqua blue. It is truly amazing and you must visit this beach. It has pebbles and waves so you need to be a good swimmer. Also water shoes are required if you have sensitive feet..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Speechless
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Maybe we was at the right time and season but the real colours of rhe water it s ten times more beautiful than the pictures..amazing beach!!Buy your beach shoes for stoney beach if you are foot sensitive😀The bar was close at the time we was there so bring your cooler with you!Sunbed was available but better on the towel...it s to beautiful to have ,,neighbours"

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited here many years ago, so didn't feel that we needed to venture down the winding road to the beach on this occasion. The spectacular colour of the beach and the sea is something to behold. So from the top or the bottom it is just glorious. A must see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos Beach, Kefalonia, Greece
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach, one of the prettiest I've seen. It is fabulous to see but is rocky and there is a dangerous undertow. For swimming there are other much more suitable (and beautiful) beaches in Kefalonia.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this one as it makes a change from the quiet little coves without waves (although we adore those too!!!) huge breakers to jump through and a tiny bit of sandy shingle rather than all pebbles. Get there early though as parking is limited! Clean, and unusually for kefalonia there was a couple of guys selling snacks from coolboxes. Not much shade so take a brolly 😊

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth the trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathe taking beach well worth the hairy trip up and down the windy hill. A must if you're on the island but dont go by coach.. :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very nice beach. Can be difficult to find parking in the summer months but if you manage to get there it's worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a very nice beach of course, but it also very busy in the high season. It is a must see beach, but other beaches are as beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice clean pebbly beach, best to get there pre 10am as it's a hike to get there and it does get fairly busy, €7 for 2 sun beds and an Umbrella, there is a small cafe service sarnies, drinks and ice Lollies etc, has toilets and a changing area that is fairly clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Actually visited the beach some time ago and only had a brief stopover at a viewing point this time round. If you can get down, it's worth noting that the beach is not what it seems and perhaps not the best place to bathe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: a stunning beech pebbles and sand their is a view point on the way down to the beech do stop and be thrilled with the view very narrow road down also steep. bendy. go early as it gets busy and i mean early on the beech are cold drinks snacks toilets .the toilets are very busy and in need of upgrading there is a life guard and if it is rough he will stop you swimming be aware it is a sun trap

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exquisite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a must if you are visiting Kefalonia. One of the top 10 most beautiful beaches in the world. The sea is a gorgeous turquoise and crystal clear. Its a stone beach so wear water shoes. There are beach beds and umbrellas to hire but go early to book one. Its a very steep decline to the beach with hairpin bends ..scary to navigate but worth the ride down. There is a beach taverna for drinks and snacks which is very handy because of the long trip back to shops. A nice add on to visiting this beach are the fresh water showers to rinse the salf off after a swim. Highly recommend a visit to Myrtos beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach with a view driving down to it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pebbley  beach with a drive down to it you will never forget famous for its clear water. But a pair of those rubber shoes a necessity to negotiate your way to the waters edge you need to spend at least half a day there to appreciate it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning views - not to be missed!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think the views are even better than what you can see on the pictures - just stunning! Pack food and get prepared to spend some time on a wonderful beach. Bring your shoes as it is rocky!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice looking beach from a distance but in reality nothing special.  No shade, no sunbeds for hire.  Busy when we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It is like a fairy tale
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is a must see in whole greece island series. Free areas for publicmto settle down with their own stuff, paid umbrella and sunbeds nearby, free shower and changing rooms. Amazing water color. Deep sea. Warning rapidly increasing depth. Beginner swimmers must be careful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Looks wonderful from a distance
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Looking at this beach from above it seems so idyllic but down there we found it to be potentially quite dangerous. Very stony so sea shoes are almost essential because trying to exit the rough breakers can be difficult. Water does get deep quickly and with the big waves I would not risk letting a child into the sea without some kind of safety device. Maybe it was a rough day but with no wind or significant waves anywhere else we visited on the day think this may be the norm. Nice for sunbathing though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Well worth the visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Recently toured around the island and were recommended this beach as a must see... after stopping off in Asos we made our way over to the famous kefalonia beach to spend the afternoon there. The parking was pretty easy as we managed to park up on the beach at around 1 pm no problem but we're lucky as someone was just leaving. The beach is shingle then pebbles and shelves quickly once you get into the sea but the sea is well worth it it's beautiful turquoise and warm and regardless of the red flag flying was safe enough to swim in on our visit... however there were no lifeguards present! The care was open fir drinks and icecreams and I think toastie sandwiches... maybe only in august? We had beach mats and sea shoes so we're well equipped . Unfortunately the weather clouded over and we even had a few drops of rain so after a stroll to the cave and a brief swim we left but felt our visit had been worthwhile.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Looks better from a distance
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful when viewed from above.  But it's just a beach.  Not great for kids - it shelves away quickly and is deep. Stony on the edge of the shore. 7 euros for a bed and a brolly. Recommend view from above and move on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The view from above is magnificent. If you are lucky you can also swim
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is the most famous of the island and for good reason. Amazing view and magnificent beach if you are lucky and it is not windy. Otherwise just play with the waves. The parking is problematic during rush hours so go there either early or late in the afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach and breathtaking.  Very easy to park, sea was rough when we visited, but great fun.  Would recommend a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I didn't like it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is, as many on here have said, very beautiful...but, this makes it difficult to get to as parking is restricted, crowded (I counted 12 people in a queue for the only one of three showers that was working) of expensive (4 euros for a bottle of water!!).  Go there, take pictures from up high on the mountains, and then go and find another beach to sit on, there are nicer ones!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Landmark
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well it probably should be a must-see. Staff were preventing any cars from parking anywhere on the beach on the Friday we visited, which was unlike previously. But the attraction is from above and clear turquoise waters give amazing photography.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to the view point for Myrtos beach on a day tour of the island. It's as breathtaking as all the photos you see. The sea looks all different shades of blue, beautiful. It's definitely worth a look.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Indescribable beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have never seen water so pure turquoise in colour-It looks like its been photoshopped! Not enough loungers and umbrellas but apparently that's because they didn't pay their required dues-naughty naughty! the rocks made it difficult to get into the sea but once in it is wonderful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Marvellous Myrtos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arrive early - 10 am latest! That has to be my top tip because after that the road to the beach gets really, really busy.  But it is a wonderfully dramatic beach - blue sea contrasting with white cliffs. There are some sunbeds to hire but no other watersports so not necessarily somewhere to spend the whole day. Take care with younger children as the beach does shelve steeply and the waves and undertow were strong even in August. If you arrive by car from the south, there is a layby on the left (before Myrtos village) that overlooks the beach, where you can get a good photo.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our day trip to Myrtos Beach was amazing.  We were mesmerized by the water from a distance while traveling to the beach.  Absolutely breathtaking!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited the beach by bus,limited buses but well worth a trip, beautiful stunning bay turquoise water, however you do need to be careful of the wind causing strong waves which can knock you off your feet!! Not safe for children to swim on those days. Dry steep road down,bus is only 2 euros well worth it.Don't forget your umbrella if you can't stand the sun all day, only a small cafe on the beach selling drinks, icecream and a few snacks.Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breath-taking view!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Words cannot describe the views at Myrtos. You simply have to see it.Be careful as the beach is not sandy! Sea boots come in handy.Parking can be crowded, it then requires to park on the roadside and walk down the hill.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The perfect beach if the weather is perfect!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is one of the perfectly preserved beaches looking west that combine exceptionally view with one of a kind clean coloured waters. It is almost not organised with few umbrellas and a very small bar so you have to carry your umbrella and towels. the view both from above and below is breathtaking, especially during sunset. Make sure you hit the beach with calm seas to get the max!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just Ok if you want to lounge about
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whilst I agree with many of the comments about the view from the hillside above (it is spectacular), you need to be forewarned as to some of the shortcomings of the location.1. Parking is limited, especially at peak times, arrive around 3pm and many people are leaving.2. don't bother with your snorkels, the combination of white sand and waves result in poor visibility.3. Bar only takes cash, no credit cards.That said, if you want to soak up the sun in delightful surroundings, paddle a little, then you'll enjoy your time here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Literally ... the Best Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have visited over 25 Greek islands and I can confidently say that Myrtos is the best beach. White sandy beach, crystal clear blue water, stunning natural environment, all set far away from the road, the noise, the chaos of contemporary life. Myrtos is reason enough to visit Kefalonia. It's magnificent!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Looks much better from above
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself is pretty, but it's terribly crowded. It would be a great beach if there was less people there.. A LOT less.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must see beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a fabulous beach, with an authentic feel and gorgeous pale sand.  The sea was warm and great to swim in, but there is a need for shoes, as the shoreline  is full of pebbles.  However, it was difficult to park, so I would suggest arriving early to beat the crowds.  There is a need for more sun beds and shades for the amount of people it accomodates and another cafe/restaurant would be benificial.  If you want breathtaking scenery, then have a drive out to this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better to look at it from the hill...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice view from the hill...BUT: is a pebbles beach (take shoes!!), gets VERY crowded (and parking gets impossible), has many cold water submarine springs. Reccomended for one visit only (get there quite early in the morning...)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Most Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was the prettiest beach we visited in Kefalonia! It's a very windy road down to the beach which gets full of parked cars arrive early or later on if you want to park close to the beach. There's a bar selling snacks and drinks not brilliant but better than nothing. There's not many sun beds on the beach so be sure to take an umbrella with you if you want to be out of the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wouldn't miss this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large pebbly beach without sun beads or umbrellas. The waves were fairly big (however it was quite windy). Warm and clear water. Handy shower and changing huts. Cafe on beach. Very famous Kefalonian beach, wouldn't miss.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nightmare drive and parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Looks stunningly beautiful   bluest sea ever but the drive and trying to park amongst frankly aggressive Greeks _  in a car they change_   was a nightmare    also the swimming was quite hard work with waves knocking you over  not for kids   and large pebbles  and the sea is actually cloudy with sand   so looks great but disapoints

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great photo opportunity
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Plenty of parking places on the roads to Myrtos Beach. Stunning views and the Blue colours of the sea are amazing. The drive around the mountains are not for the faint hearted though, but well worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and cave
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful peeble beach. There is no shade, unless you go in the cave, so you may want to bring an umbrella and chairs. Also pack food and drinks because there is not beach bar. We enjoyed it and the kids like swimming in the cave. However we didn't come prepared with chairs and umbrella so we didn't stay for too long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view from the top is absolutely breathaking, but the beach itself is i think overrated. It is a pebblebeach, it has no natural shade, there is no taverne or anything. But the sea is nice, although not different then on other parts of the island. It can be a bit dangerous at times with little kids or inexperienced swimmers.Take a sunumbrella, a mat and come before 11 otherwise you will have trouble parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A much- photographed beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I visited this beach as part of an excursion. From a distance it looks like the most idyllic beach you could imagine with pure white sand. However, the beach itself is made up of very fine white shingle which reflects the suns rays to make this beach very much a Sun trap. If you are looking for banana boats, net skis and the like then don't come here. This is a remote, beautiful beach which is quite difficult to access but beautiful nonetheless

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An imperative update
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When I visited this beach again in this season, I felt that I had to update my review dated Sept.28, 2015. This time I observed that the umbrellas have gone. There was not even a small buffet selling water and beverage. I couldn't see any lifeguard on duty in such a beach open to the high afternoon vawes. According to the locals, no one applied for a new contract for services and activities in this beach due to high taxing policy of the administration.So, If you want to visit this beach, don't forget to bring your umbrella, portable chairs, food and beverages with you and keep an eye on your children swimming in shallow water which could be dangerous for them by a sudden strong vawe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and breathtaking!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most amazing clear, blue water! The scenery and pictures coming down the windy road is so beautiful and leaves you speechless. Definitely take a camera and stop on your way down and enjoy the view.MUST: Bring swim shoes as the rocks are big and hurt a lot. There is no shade so if you do not enjoy being in the sun the whole day, a sun umbrella is required. There is a cave on the left hand side where you can go to take a break and catch the shade but it is usually occupied. When we went in July there was no bar/cafe where you can purchase snacks or water, so bring what you need for the day. Apparently, the locals said there is a bar/cafe open in August but I cannot guarantee that is true. There are lots of restaurants once you head up and go up the windy road but nothing close to the beach. There are no water sports or water activities in this area so bring your own entertainment. We brought a volleyball and paddle boards to keep us entertained. Bathrooms are available and a shower as well but no soap allowed in the shower area.Beaches like this one are hard to find so when you arrive, enjoy the views, enjoy the colors, the salty sea and take lots of pictures!! You will not regret it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous but not the best place for a swim
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever seen, but definitely not good for a swim. The waves were very strong, and the pebbles painful. Definitely worth a visit though!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Myrtos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach .Exciting drive down a very steep hill.Car park at the bottom.Small cafe on the beach.Beware the strong undercurrents,they will knock you over

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautyful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view is just amazing! Crystal clear water ,really worth to go there! The only problem is that there is no shadows anywhere so you may need an umbrella and not restaurants at all. Only a "snack bar" that offers sendwiches,soft drinks,beers and coffee.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breath taking scenery
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow, Myrtos is so stunning, it takes your breath away. One of the most beautiful beaches I ever been to. The waters, are beautifully blue. Beware, there were NO amenities down there, when we went in July 2017. So pack a lunch and umbrellas. There is some shade, early in the day but after midday, the best part of the beach is unshaded. Though, you can hide in the cave. It was the coolest place, like a natural air conditioner! Of course, nothing is perfect. The stunning views come with a price, I found the pebbles to be super painful to walk in. Do invest, in waterproof shoes – it will be worth it, as the majority of the beaches are pebbles anyway.A must see. I also HIGHLY recommend, doing a para-glide flight with No Borders. Truly incredible experience, gentle as a feather.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view of the beach as you descend the windy mountain road is quite breathtaking and it's no surprise that this beach is very popular with both locals and tourists.We were staying very close, so visited the beach 3 or 4 times.It is sandy in some places and pebbly in others, but very pebbly the nearer you get to the sea, so shoes you can enter the water in would be handy. The water itself is beautifully clear and as warm as bath water! Generally the sea is very very calm here, although on our final day there were bigger waves, although nothing dangerous, they just added to the enjoyment if anything.There are free to use toilets and showers, there is also free parking and a small cafe. There is very little natural shade in the beach, so taking a parasol is a must, although there did seem to be some for hire along with day beds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bar open. Not the best beach in Kefallonia.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived at 2pm and although busy waited no time for someone to move on & release a parking space. Small bar/sheltered shack open for drinks/ice creams - no food. And chaise longues/shower.Best from above for spectacular colour - no intimacy or prettiness from ground level!

reviews.title: Nature’s Masterpiece on the Ionian Sea
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is one of Kefalonia’s most iconic destinations, famous for its turquoise waters and striking white pebble shore. The surrounding cliffs create a dramatic and breathtaking setting. When the wind picks up, waves can be strong, adding excitement for those who enjoy a bit of adventure in the water. During the high season, the beach can get crowded, but visiting later in the afternoon provides a more peaceful experience and the chance to enjoy unforgettable sunsets. Easily accessible and full of natural beauty

reviews.title: Wild wonder not suitable for certain tourists
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, beautiful setting still wild. The choice of the few umbrellas, at a super honest price something forgotten now in Italy, and the absence of the bar are a plus, those who complain about it went somewhere else. Greece has something for everyone. I hope that it will remain so forever with a nature-friendly tourism.

reviews.title: Breathtakingly beautiful from the top, gut wrenching disappointing at the bottom
reviews.text: Visited in mid October - I’d hate to be here mid summer when I suspect it would be rammed. The beach is made of white pebbles - uncomfortable unless you bring sea shoes and chairs with you. Toilets and changing facilities aside (all clean!), that was where the facilities stopped - was it due to being mid October? Surprised to be honest, given this is one of the top spots to visit. Sea was just as crystal clear as it looks from the top - bit rough and shelved sharply. There’s natural shade depending on which end you sit on, but otherwise a suntrap and you needn’t take your own parasol. Road down was winding and parking good - again, I’d hate to see what it’s like in the summer. Glad we’ve been, may well go back before we go home, but to be honest, given the spectacular view from the top, the reality of it down below couldn’t be more different and we were desperately disappointed….

reviews.title: Beautiful to look at…
reviews.text: We’ve visited here a number if times over the years. Never loses its beauty but we tend to not stay long - not the safest of beaches for swimming especially for children. And why is there no taverna or cafe anymore?! So, in summary, take pics, admire but then move on!!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Stunning beach with stunning views from the top so make sure you stop to get the best photos of this lovely place. The sand is very fine but you might need beach shoes and it's gravel like in places .

reviews.title: Myrthos Beach, fantastically beautiful and highly recommended (possibly period dependent)
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach – fantastically beautiful and highly recommended!The approach leads over a winding but well-developed road – completely problem-free and at the same time a small highlight, as the view from above of the beach is simply gigantic. We were there in the postseason and found enough, even infinite parking spaces.The beach itself is impressive: crystal-clear, turquoise waters that delight from afar. We could easily lie in front of the beach and enjoy the atmosphere. Our five-year-old daughter had great fun – she could run into the water, swim a bit and jump in the waves.Important to know: Directly on the beach there is no kiosk or snack bar. If you want to eat or drink, simply drive 1–2 kilometers up the mountain (about three minutes by car). There you will find a small collection of restaurants and supermarkets, perfect for a break or to stock up on everything you need.Alles in allem: An unforgettable beach, dreamlike scenery, crystal clear water and well organized, even if there is no food downstairs. Absolutely worth a visit!⸻Would you like me to give you the review in a shorter, crisper version that you could post directly on Google Maps?

reviews.title: Top beach! But without the bar:(
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, easy to reach, some hairpin bends, there are several places to park. Lots of gravel, I highly recommend the shoes because it hurts. At the bottom there is also a natural cave, great for taking nice pictures. There are showers (4), the only flaw that there is no bar. So bring your own food and drink! Ps. There is a guy who distributes home made sugar doughnuts (cash only).

reviews.title: Charming island. After 10 years you haven't aged at all
reviews.text: If you go early before it fills up it is the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia. Beautiful water. I came back after 10 years and I liked it even more

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Breathtaking beach. We drove the narrow roads in the mountains  to get to it. The sea really was electric blue and sand was white. We didn’t swim as we’d heard that it’s not a safe shallow beach but still beautiful to see.

reviews.title: To see at least for a few hours ..
reviews.text: Beautiful beach mixed sand and white stone, personally I did not find it up to the reviews but probably due to the cloudy and windy day that made the sea rough and difficult to enjoy both for snorkeling and for a swim. In September we parked practically on the beach without problems.

reviews.title: Was passing through on way to Assos
reviews.text: Superb beach, which is deemed to be in the top few in the world, the sea colurs are just magical. Careful driving required, as the road has lots of tight and narrow hairpin bends.

reviews.title: The absolute beauty in every moment
reviews.text: I've always been going for 50 years and it's the most beautiful place on the planet. Especially this year without the over-organization, without a pitch bar. Whether in the morning or at noon or at sunset, wave or calm, Myrtos is unique. I am sorry that so many people who want to see him are finally burdening him and some who have only one day to visit him can not understand his beauty with this move.

reviews.title: So-so
reviews.text: The road to get there is ugly full of curves, arrived there the paid sunbeds are few and do not even give you wi fi, all crowded, full street parking, there is not even a bar to take a bottle of water.  Never again,

reviews.title: A wonderful beach...
reviews.text: A wonderful beach, with small white pebbles, easily accessible by car. I recommend arriving early, by 10:00, to be able to park without problems. Take water and food with you, as it is not served by bars and restaurants. There is a beach equipped for umbrellas and sun loungers and a bathroom and changing facilities.In the afternoon the water could get dirty because of the "uncivilized" on board the boats at the bottom.

reviews.title: Iconic and scenic beach
reviews.text: One of the most photographed in the area: from above it really leaves you breathless! Despite being very touristy and crowded, thanks to its size you can still enjoy it without feeling too "tight".How to get thereThe road is quite easy and on arrival there is free parking. It should be noted, however, that with the passing of the hours many cars begin to park along the road and the road becomes more complicated.Sea and beachThe seabed is composed of white stones (shoes recommended), with a spectacular blue sea but immediately deep and often rough: it is therefore not ideal for children or for those who can not swim well.ServicesAvailable some showers near the beach umbrellas.ConclusionA place that is definitely worth a visit for its beauty, but personally I would not choose it to return several times.

reviews.title: Best viewed from above. Not worth the risk
reviews.text: Kefalonia is beautiful and has so many gorgeous beaches. But this is not one of them. The pebbly beach is so overrated. It is dangerous due to a treacherous access road, strong currents, and past fatalities. Since the cafe closed the beach is full of litter, making it hugely overrated compared to most other beaches on Kefalonia. Myrtos is best viewed as a photo opportunity from above - that's all -  just like the postcard.

reviews.title: Mare turchese
reviews.text: Very nice and large beach with a turquoise sea. Sunbeds and umbrellas are free, but there are about thirty, so I recommend arriving very early to occupy one. There are toilets, but no kind of bar, so arrive provided with food and water.

reviews.title: If heaven exists it must be so
reviews.text: Beach and bay of indescribable beauty. We arrived at the beach early in the morning, when the sun had not yet reached the beach and we found paradise. Deep blue sea due to the crumbling of white rock, white pebble beach and white sheer cliff. Pristine beach (and we hope it will remain so for a long time) of breathtaking beauty to behold. The beach is absolutely not equipped. There are only about twenty umbrellas in the central part of the beach without any kind of Service (and I personally would not put these either). The road to the beach is very fraught and not absolutely safe. We only stopped for a swim and a walk on the beach and, in our opinion, it was absolutely worth it.

reviews.title: Pebbles, limited parking, crowded and deep water
reviews.text: Pebble beach, no bars, some umbrellas, limited parking and deep water. Not everyone’s cup of tea. The water is indeed beautiful, but deep. Not for children or those who cannot swim in deep waters.

reviews.title: The wrong day
reviews.text: We were in Myrthos on Tuesday. Arrived at 9.20, umbrellas and sunbeds sold out. Very rough sea, so no "quiet" baths. At about 11.00 a parasol was released and we gained the shade but we paid 15 euros since "free", as written on the sign of umbrellas, it seems that in Greece means "available" (?!) not free....If you add to that a white foam along a good part of the coast, we did bingo.No, not yet! We decide to leave the beach and discover that smartly the buses arrive until the end of the road, not exactly linear. So to get back inside the bus, we put a lot of patience and some swear words, ours and the drivers who had to reverse on the hairpin bends....

reviews.title: One of the best and most beautiful beaches i have visited
reviews.text: One of the best and most beautiful beaches i have visited, bring everything with you to enjoy a perfect day in heaven. We created a Kefalonia 7-Day Travel Planner that really helped us enjoy every day of our trip.

reviews.title: spectacular scenery!
reviews.text: When you arrive on the ridge, the view from above of Mirthos Bay is spectacular😍! The rock that descends to the sea and mixes with the turquoise colors of the sea is one of the most beautiful landscapes we have seen! Wild nature🌴 surrounds the bay and there are no bars and some umbrellas⛱️. BRING ROCK SHOES!! After lunch the water gets a little cloudy...  But the sea still remains beautiful.

reviews.title: Absolutely unbelievable!
reviews.text: We went on day trip with KCG travel, and this was a bus tour, which dropped us off at the very top of this magnificent beach. This was a photo shoot opportunity from its viewpoint, and it’s breathtaking! If we are ever in Kefa again. We will definitely hire car to spend day at this beautiful beach

reviews.title: OVERRATED! ABSOLUTELY NOT!
reviews.text: Panic road without guardrail overhanging. To get to a beach equipped only x 10 sunbeds occupied already at 9.30 am without bar even to buy water. The murky and rough sea is absolutely not worth it

reviews.title: All shades of blue!
reviews.text: The beach is really beautiful, with beautiful white round pebbles, but they release a little dust, so even the sea is not very clear. But clean and with wonderful colors, you find all shades of blue! The parking is located and is convenient, if you do not arrive very late (we arrived around ten and there were still several places near the beach). Definitely a beach to see.

reviews.title: EXPECTATIONS MET!
reviews.text: Beach that respects expectations. From above the view is sensational, but even when you get to the beach, the latter does not disappoint. Clear water, pebble beach (shoes recommended) and ample space for those who choose the free beach. There is also a space for the beach equipped with sun loungers and umbrellas (I do not know the price).Recommended to arrive early because otherwise you find yourself having to park quite far from the beach on hairpin bends. Always check the wind, otherwise you risk a big disappointment.

reviews.title: Beautiful.
reviews.text: The awesome beach of Myrtos with the wonderful blue waters. Very difficult parking, has showers, boat rescue and a place is organized with sun loungers.Always with plenty of people so the sooner you visit the better. It has pebble and no sand

reviews.title: Beautiful colors, the sea no big deal
reviews.text: Beach not equipped, sunbeds are only a dozen. There is not even a bar and a shred of shade. The sea has beautiful colors but unfortunately being to the west is often rough and you can not enjoy a nice swim. In summary a passage stage but maximum for 2/3 hours.

reviews.title: Probably bad experience
reviews.text: We went to the beach 19/8 had a wave and the waters were very blurred. Enough trouble until someone arrives and finding parking requires great luck! I don't think I'll visit this beach again.

reviews.title: Overrated beach
reviews.text: Overrated beach.  Maybe it was the day but the water was opaque and not clear, indeed there were traces of gasoline.  Parking impossible.  The beach is great but really uncomfortable to reach.  After our experience we recommend using the bus to reach this beach.

reviews.title: CONFUSION AND MURKY WATER
reviews.text: Beach to reach with hairpin bends with several cars parked along the road that make it difficult to transit. Small and always sold out parking, pebble beach, beautiful water seen from above, when you dive you can not see the bottom. No bar or restaurant, not equipped, you have to arrive very early with umbrella and food. Not recommended

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: We stayed on the beach after we saw it from the mountain. Beautiful from up. Arrived on the beach was a disappointment. There are much nicer beaches on the island.

reviews.title: Clear blue water!
reviews.text: Amazing beach! Beautiful landscape! A huge place that you can very easily find to sit but with a little difficulty in parking. It has a beach bar!

reviews.title: A dream sea
reviews.text: August 15th. White sandy beach and small pebbles; beautiful imare, a swimming pool. Free parking; arrived around 12.00 we parked immediately about 5 minutes from the beach. Free umbrellas and sunbeds... but of course all occupied given the time. Free bathrooms, changing cabin and showers. No refreshment points, no taverns, no bars.... present only a street vendor with a fridge bag in tow... 1 beer 3 euros, 1 small mineral water 1 euro. Rescue Service present. Boats approaching the shore were promptly turned away. Bring your food! Happy holidays everyone!

reviews.title: Famous for great reasons
reviews.text: Iconic beach with sea in unreal colors: it is mandatory to stop and take some photos from above! Parking is quite large but it fills up early, so better to go there in the morning. Even with the crowds the beach is still great and there is room for everyone, there is a central area with umbrellas and the rest is free. Watch out that if there is wind the sea can be quite dangerous. As services there is only the toilet, no bars or restaurants.

reviews.title: Overrated and over flowing with rubbish
reviews.text: We arrived early to find overflowing rubbish and dirty toilets. Unfortunately this beach has been ruined by overpopulation and lack of sanitation. We even saw a Durex packet in amongst the pebbles.

reviews.title: Wonderful Myrtos!!!
reviews.text: Amazing place and sea! Blue water and white pebble! That would mean Ionium ❤Heaven!!! It also has organized beach plenty of place for parking

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach has breathtaking turquoise waters. The waves can sometimes be very high and dangerous, but that doesn’t take away from its beauty. There is always an alert lifeguard on duty. The beach is partly organized, so it’s a good idea to bring your own items (such as umbrellas) before you go.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Wonderful beach is worth visiting, but not in August when it is lost.I went in June 2010.I would like to go again.....I look forward to seeing you again Oh this wonderful beach

reviews.title: Wonderful beach and sea
reviews.text: Wonderful beach crystal clear sea better visit it in the afternoon for parking. The road to get there is a bit steep overlooking the sea but worth it.

reviews.title: A passing day
reviews.text: Very nice beach.I recommend getting there early in the morning for parking (which is free) and to avoid crowding the parking lot (at about 12 it was very messy with cars and people). The road to reach it includes a narrow final piece of road and downhill hairpin bends, regularly alternated by the passage of buses and shuttles for transport. Comfortable beach and easily accessible from the parking lot, it is equipped with bathrooms, bars and some umbrellas.I recommend choosing a day not very windy and quiet because the sea can be shaken, with many waves that annoy the entrance into the sea.Overall it is a great beach, quiet and pleasant.

reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text: I have never swum in a completely blue water not transparent but blue... really never seen something like this...If you want to have sunbeds (free) you have to arrive by 9 am are few... then the beach will fill up... there are also toilets and showers... super recommended you have to see Myrtos

reviews.title: Not worth the hype
reviews.text: Really not worth the hype. Stunning to look at from above but when you get down there the parking is hectic and there are no facilities whatsoever. The toilets are typical beach ones so not great but there are no bars or restaurants for food or drink so youMust either bring a picnic or go back the very steep hill/mountain to one of the bars there. There are far far better beaches in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: The beach of the impossible blue
reviews.text: Probably one of the most famous postcards on the island! Beautiful...Beach of white basins, very wide, not making yourself feel crowds of people. It has lifeboat swimmer and beach supports, a small area for rent of umbrellas / loungers (although it's not difficult to fix your own umbrellas), but I'm not sure there is a support bar.Accessible by a zigzagging mountain road, with some viewpoints for panoramic photos. Free parking, and when full, it is always possible to park on the road, provided there is a skill for such...Attention! The currents that form the blue tones of the sea and the waves can make dives something dangerous, but it is always possible to check the conditions for swimming a few days in advance on the Greek weather website.Water shoes make walking on the beach more comfortable.

reviews.title: Must see beach!
reviews.text: Must see beach with the most beautiful range of blue waters. Natural and untouched beauty. The waves do get big though and the road there is steep!

reviews.title: Magic sunset.
reviews.text: Very wide beach that offers a truly magical sunset, in fact I think it is the ideal time to visit this place to take some photos both from above and once you get to the beach.Few sunbeds so equip yourself, but complete with bathrooms, showers and changing rooms.In the hottest hours a real kettle.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach not to be missed.
reviews.text: Iconic beach.  Do beautiful whilst on it or from the view point.  The sea feels a bit unsafe to swim in but that is widely shared.  Don’t miss if you visit Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: The beach is Wonderful, although with pebble or just because of that the water is turquoise blue, One has enough space. The journey is a bit long but worthwhile. Just a pity there is no beach bar etc.
Unique beauty landscape!!90% of the beach is free and has a canteen although it is better to go organized and of course early in the morning!!

reviews.title: New, but bad.
reviews.text: The place from above is wonderful, but once you get down it will be a disappointment (obviously it is all subjective) what no one writes above is that from this year the beach is free, so you can use the sunbeds with the umbrella comfortably without spending anything but you have to arrive early to find one because there are 30 of them in number. We arrived at 9am and fortunately we found a place, the beach is nothing much better, the bathrooms are three for each sex and are always very clean and provided with paper , but the absence of the bar is felt , plus once it is late cars and people continue to arrive who camp in front of the former lido and it becomes an impossible thing even to swim, we left out of desperation 🤦🏻‍♂️ clicks the comparison with Patani, Agia Kyriaki who are clearly more beautiful with picturesque landscapes and Aqua much cleaner and clearer because there is management and maintenance ... I would never go back

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: The view is amazing. Myrtos is fantastic and myrtoscottages@gmail.com is very easy to use. Lydia is very helpful and a warm lerson as well.The rooms were lovely and so was the garden .

reviews.title: Too many people
reviews.text: Large crowded sandy beach, a galley to park past 10am.Take a picture from the top and go to another beach...

reviews.title: Myrthos beach delusione
reviews.text: Breathtaking panoramic view... but when you arrive in my opinion it is not as beautiful as they describe it... there are no facilities or restaurants... there are 30 sunbeds that if you arrive after 8:00 are all occupied... bring the umbrella and the fridge bag to survive... rude lifeguards especially with Italians... and also the water is not crystal clear as in the rest of the island .. there are better beaches like petani beach..antisamos beach..skala...lourdata etc.... we were disappointed... great only x panoramic photos

reviews.title: Beautiful but don't arrive too late
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, as from the photos and videos seen online, definitely deserves.Usually there are a few waves and the water is immediately deep.Unfortunately there is no bar, only showers and toilets. There are some umbrellas and sunbeds (mid-July 2025), but very few, you have to be there very early to pick them up, we arrived at 10am and they were already all busy.Also the parking is not very large (when we were there it was free), there is to be there MAXIMUM at 10.30/11 because then it is up to park on the road and it is quite dangerous, then there is a whole piece of walking to do and considering that you arrive via a mountain road, I do not recommend it.If you don’t have a parasol with you, I suggest you stay maximum until lunchtime. Bring your shoes because there are stones!!

reviews.title: Beautiful mediocre beach just for photos
reviews.text: Beach more instagrammable than anything else, overall one of the ugliest we visited. The water has fabulous colors given by white stones that make it this blue color, beautiful from above but murky up close. It is worth just taking a picture while going to other beaches.The umbrellas when we went were free but you have to arrive early both to get one and to be able to park in the parking lot instead of on the street. Stoney beach and all exposed to the sun, so very hot.In our experience it was not helpful that the sea was very rough, so it was difficult to get in and especially out.There are free toilets and showers.It is very busy so there are a lot of people (who also arrive by bus).It wasn't worth it.

reviews.title: Unfortunately rough sea, but what a beauty!!!
reviews.text: Unfortunately we didn't get to enjoy a nice swim in this beach since the sea was very rough and the backwash very important. However it is worth seeing and, if you are lucky, even manage to take a bath!PS. Supply of beaches, bring umbrella

reviews.title: Awful.
reviews.text: We arrived early-ish on the 4th of July and we genuinely thought we had driven to the wrong beach. The neon blue water videos and photos must be photoshopped, we was so underwhelmed. Arrived at 10:30am and it was relatively full. There is only roughly 20-30 free sunbeds on this beach so IF you choose to go you need to be there before 10am or you’ll be laying on pebbles. The beach was genuinely dirty and derlict. Understandably, people like a quiet authentic Greek beach but this beach is absolutely massive at the bottom of a cliff with nothing, just a port-a-loo. There was a menstrual pad in the sea with us, seaweed, rubble & plastic waste. We thought that there was a sewage pump that goes into the sea of this beach. The town around Myrtos is cute though and worth a visit but the beach was such a let down.

reviews.title: Nice beach.
reviews.text: This beach has warm water. The shore drops off quickly into deep water. There is free parking. High rocks surround the area.

reviews.title: Pearl Of the Ionian sea
reviews.text: You can only give this beach less than the highest rating if you come unprepared.This beach is truly a gem of the Ionian Sea and was rightfully chosen as the filming location for the Hollywood movie Captain Corelli’s Mandolin.What does that mean? It means, first of all, that the beach is not accessible via highway, but rather by a road that climbs up the mountain and then descends through narrow paths to reach the beach, which lies at the foot of massive cliffs towering above it.The beach is not commercialized, so aside from restrooms, there are no other facilities. If you don’t manage to grab one of the few available sunbeds, you’ll need to bring your own umbrellas and chairs/sun loungers. Facing the sea, the right side of the beach has fine white pebbles/sand, while the left side is more gravelly and close to the cliffs, with clear warning signs about possible rockfalls. I will never understand why people still place their towels and umbrellas directly beneath those cliffs.The water is turquoise blue, azure, and crystal clear. It truly is a breathtaking experience. There is a parking area near the beach, but if you arrive later in the day, you might have trouble finding a free spot. A lifeguard is also present on the beach, which adds a sense of security for visitors.On the right side of the beach, there is also a tunnel – a passage beneath the rock – which is also marked with a warning about possible rockfall. But to be honest, I couldn’t resist the thrill and quickly passed through the tunnel, which is only about 10 meters long and connects the beach to the open sea.Be sure to bring your own drinks and snacks, as there are absolutely no food or beverage vendors on the beach, apart from a hardworking donut seller who occasionally passes by offering homemade donuts at €3 apiece.Enjoy the natural beauty of Myrtos Beach.

reviews.title: The iconic Myrtos
reviews.text: Lovely beach, about 1 hour and 10 min from Katelios. The beach is equipped with bathrooms and showers but without a bar. It is a perfect destination for families and for snorkeling, I recommend arriving before noon because after it gets crowded and it becomes difficult to find parking.P.S best beach I've seen in Kefalonia (in my opinion)

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Beautiful wild beach. Very ventilated there is no possibility to buy anything all nature great parking. Sea top cold turquoise to say fantastic is little

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  Could not find area to change into bathing suite  Well worth stopping to see this area. Take a lot of pictures

reviews.title: Top colours
reviews.text: Milto bella, gorgeous colors. You wore the umbrella because there is absolutely no service.The rocks do not make me crazy even for a queerion of comfort ', but 'a beautiful beach

reviews.title: Not worth it!
reviews.text: Overrated!!The sea looks exotic but when you are near it’s not appealing at all. Moss color see make you wonder!!Also is not organized. You must bring your own gear.

reviews.title: Myrtos beach
reviews.text: The view indeed from above was fantastic the experience down on the beach was less, boulders everywhere and also far into the water, so going with t in you had less trouble but getting out was difficult. It disappointed me but from above beautiful

reviews.title: Impressive panoramic point
reviews.text: Absolutely worth visiting but without much expectation.Striking panoramic point both during the day and at sunset.You can arrive by car near the beach and there is free parking. Very clean, transparent water, simple beach and not even equipped with a refreshment point (June).We went for a swim at Myrthos beach in the afternoon and it was not crowded, overall pleasant but not the best for us.

reviews.title: Beautiful but no bar
reviews.text: Beach to see!  Immersed in the rocks of the mountain, really a beautiful view. Clear water and pebble beach. There are toilets and showers but no bars or shops. Equip yourself with water!

reviews.title: Beauty with a Bit of Bite
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach delivers that turquoise tease and towering cliffs drama—but don’t expect a gentle dip. The sea’s got some muscle, and the waves come in swinging. Still, it’s a stunner from every angle, and the beach itself holds up well. It’s not just a photo op—it’s an experience. Just hold onto your towel.

reviews.title: Bring umbrella!
reviews.text: At the beginning of June the equipped beach I saw in the photos was not there (I do not know if they put umbrellas) and I went back up to the village to get one. Very nice, with very special colors, pebbles, clear water. There is a large parking lot that fills up at peak times but at the beginning of the day there was space.I paraglided and landed here: beautiful

reviews.title: Myrtos beach
reviews.text: The view of the beach from above is exceptional, deserves a photo, but the beach I do not consider the most beautiful, is devoid of umbrellas and bars, has only a parking, the water is beautiful as in all Kefalonia, but in my opinion there are other much more beautiful coves, such as emblisi beach

reviews.title: Wonderful bay
reviews.text: Impressive unforgettable bay, especially the drive down offers wonderful views, pitches are limited, so you should come soon, take bathing shoes, as the gravel is otherwise unpleasant for running, take enough food, especially water, as there is nothing in the bay, The road down is very narrow, in oncoming traffic you have to be able to maneuver well, therefore only something for experienced drivers

reviews.title: MYRTOS
reviews.text: One of the best beaches on the island.It's not an organized beach.Anyway, get your own umbrella and something to eat...Be careful because it deepens abruptly.Also, the waters are wonderful.

reviews.title: Best beach in Kefalonia
reviews.text: Amazing place, lots of car parks spaces available.Brilliant water colours! Clean area! There are 3 view points on the way down so make sure to stop and make your picttures. On the beach I highly recommend spot by grotto as there is a shadow available.Minus- no toilets available.

reviews.title: Great views but not the best facilities
reviews.text: Amazing views. Turquoise water. Toilets closed . No sunbeds. Not as good as antisamos beach. Disappointed as expected more

reviews.title: Paradise views
reviews.text: Paradise views. Large beach with crystal clear waters and nice temperature. I leave you in this comment the following suggestions or tips:1) To access this beach if or if you need car. In the main viewpoint there is a kind of mini parking to park some cars. If you continue to get down by car you access the beach and the closest it leaves you is approximately 50 meters from the sand, not the sea.2) Wear shoes to enter the sea, what you see from the photos is not sand, it is stone.3) If it is not high season, there is no beach service, no open bar. We went in late June and there was no service.4) The ideal time for your best photos is at noon, the sun illuminates in all its splendor that beautiful sea providing the best colors that you can admire from the viewpoint, stop obligatory to get the best memories.5) The water is crystal clear and with pleasant temperature.Visually it is a beautiful beach, it has often been chosen as one of the most beautiful beaches. If you are in Cephalonia, you can not stop going!!!! Worth it!!!

reviews.title: Too bad for nothing
reviews.text: Beautiful beaches for photos! Very photogenic but wild. It is not for bathing. Huge waves and sharp pebble. The dining room is also expensive and the portions are half. Disappointment!

reviews.title: Unique beach in the world.
reviews.text: the experience of discovering one of the most beautiful beaches in the world was a unique experience.  It is worth staying at least a week to interact with the local population and enjoy the healthy and genuine foods of the surrounding nature.

reviews.title: To visit for a couple of hours
reviews.text: Fantastic beach until it fills with tourists around 11:00.It is worth arriving early and then continuing to other shores.Services present but very scarce for the considerable influx of tourists.A couple of hours is more than fine

reviews.title: Admire from a distance, don't get close
reviews.text: Read in TA's Travellers’ Choice Awards 'Best of the Best Beaches' that "It rarely gets crowded". RUBBISH! If you want to go in the summer season you do indeed need to go very early if you need a parking space (& watch the road down, too many hire cars totally unused to narrow Greek roads.....) or to get your spot on the beach - then wait while it gets very, very busy.The other thing to note - & this is of VITAL importance if you have children or unless you are VERY strong swimmers, the waves are extremely strong & the undertow is nasty. There have been serious accidents at this beach (talk to locals, not tour operators). Yes, it's very beautiful; so is a tiger or some snakes but I wouldn't play with them. Look & admire from the top of the cliff road at the viewpoint, take your pictures - then go swim somewhere else.

reviews.title: Stunning beach, worth any drive!
reviews.text: We loved this beach, this and the one in Sami, Antisamos beach, are in our opinion, the greatest two beaches in Kefalonia, and well worth the drives from Argostoli or the south coast. Gorgeous views all the way down and then stunning when you are there. Lovely beach beds - think they were about a tenner each, and super safe beach… you can leave all your keys, phones, bags etc and go swimming together and everything was fine. Gorgeous clear water and lovely and warm- beach / rocks shoes would be a bonus! The parking is tight in peak times so set off early. There are two brilliant restaurants either side of the last junction before you head down to the beach too! It really is as good as it looks in the pictures!! 🥰

reviews.title: Scenic Myrtos is deadly on feet
reviews.text: Iconic Myrtos beach is stunning to look at but not the most enjoyable swimming experience. As others have noted it is a pebble beach.  With the strong undertow, it took all my strength to drag myself out of the water. I literally had to crawl out on my belly and it was painful to walk on the pebbles in bare feet.  I would not recommend this beach for families with young children. If you do go, bring water shoes!

reviews.title: Beautiful crystal clean water
reviews.text: Wow ! Incredible crystal clear water ! One of the most beautiful beach we could visit in Kefalonia. Worth to visit. A bot hard with parking, watch out for large rocks in the parking lot, tight spaces and cars that don't look where they park, during our stay someone scratched our car, we also saw that several cars had trouble leaving the parking lot, very steep parking spaces, tight spaces and small parking lot as a big minus of this place but the water and beach make up for all the rest. Very friendly little bar that serves great iced coffee, beautiful beach, the day we were there it was a bit windy so the waves were also very visible, for people who like this vibe  it gives a lot of fun, for people who prefer calm water it would be a great place to sunbathe.

reviews.title: Yet another wonderful beach in Kefalonia
reviews.text: I had read that we should not go to Myrtos in case of wind because of currents and waves. We were lucky, there was no breath of air. The view from above is incredible with its different shades of blue. But swimming is just as amazing. As we move forward the water changes color. It was very hot about 28.30 due to the heatwave. The road to get off there turns but is not narrow so it’s going well. A must on this beautiful island.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  Picture perfect.  Just somewhat off the beaten path.  We were there off season so it was just the scenery.  No services available.

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: Pictures do not do it justice, it is just as described. Gatorade water like, bluest blue. We went during off season mid October so everything was closed however the view you cannot beat

reviews.title: Beautiful but dangerous
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is incredibly beautiful. Looked at from the cliff top it is stunning and the water is turquoise and warm. But it is incredibly dangerous. On the day we were there a man drowned despite there being a lifeguard there. Its remote location meant it took 30 mins for an ambulance to arrive. So worth a visit but stay out of the water

reviews.title: Stunning postcard beach but otherwise I was disappointed
reviews.text: Stunning beach but not the best in Kefalonia. Perfect 5*postcard beach but not the best to relax there. Beach wide and long, with rather bigger pebbles, the same the entrance to the water which starts to be qucikly deap, can be difficult  to get off when big waves. No lifeguards on duty. Water crystal clear. Absolutely no shade at all, so take plenty of sun loution , umbrela as there are not many beds with umbrela to rent. Event the tavern was in the middle of September closed.

reviews.title: Bloody scary
reviews.text: Mytos beach is stunning, however, the sea is treacherous. The waves are enormous and crash on the land with so much power that they bring large stones with them. The beach quickly dips to  very deep water, which means when you are trying to get out, you are quickly swept back and fall under the waves, tumbling as if you were in a washing machine.This felt like a near death experience, and if two men's hadn't pulled me out, I don't think I would have made it. In October, there were no life guards and no red flags to say how dangerous it could be. There should be massive warnings about the danger lurking in the waves.

reviews.title: Don’t miss this!
reviews.text: After seeing pictures of Myrtos beach on previous reviews we really wanted to visit, we were not disappointed. Mid September visit and the water was so warm still. An absolutely stunning natural arena shaped beach. Stayed for several hours, swimming, watching and just enjoying the sheer beauty of the place. Do not visit Kefalonia without a visit here, simply a must!!

reviews.title: A Breathtaking Viewpoint
reviews.text: Mytros Beach is nothing short of a paradise, offering a breathtaking viewpoint that captures the essence of coastal beauty. The crystal-clear waters shimmer in mesmerizing shades of blue and green, inviting you to take a refreshing dip. Soft, powdery sand stretches along the shore, perfect for lounging under the sun or building sandcastles.As you gaze out at the horizon, the stunning cliffs surrounding the beach create a dramatic backdrop, making every moment feel like a postcard. Whether you’re relaxing with a book or enjoying a swim, Mytros Beach is a serene escape that leaves a lasting impression.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach💙🩵
reviews.text: Beautiful!!The fact that from September there are no more sunbeds, etc., makes it even more beautiful for us. Also the drive to the beach, along the cliffs, is spectacular.

reviews.title: Beautiful - september 2024
reviews.text: Beautiful big beach with clear water, in september there was not owercrowded. Parking free. Nice view from road, must - have picture here!

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: One of the top rated beaches in Europe. The sands are dazzling white and the colour of the sea with the cliffs framing the whole scene.

reviews.title: Not all that - road situation spoils it
reviews.text: Lovely views and breathtaking given the surrounding mountains.Water was nice and clear.Beach is pebbly so beach shoes recommended.We found the road up and down really scary and steep, must be a nightmare in height of summer.I wouldn't recommend as there are other nice beaches to visit without the road issue.

reviews.title: Breathtaking Beach
reviews.text: A truly breath taking beach, the view point up top gives a gorgeous view of the clear water colours. They have plenty of parking and close to the beach so accessible for all, they have a little hidden cave on the left side of the beach which is a true hidden beauty.

reviews.title: Mah!
reviews.text: A day of strong wind was enough to make "the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia", in an expanse of milky, murky and dirty water, not at all inviting to swim.In my opinion, very much overrated, I could provide a list of at least 20 most beautiful beaches in Kefalonia alone.Oh, I forgot, plant closed.

reviews.title: Should be on the Internet from September no service
reviews.text: The beach is very nice but from September no more service lie parasol and kiosk everything dismantled it was still nice bathing weather therefore disappointed

reviews.title: Run by unprofessional, sloppy, slacker people.
reviews.text: It just deserves to be seen, then go elsewhere it gets better. Kefalonia is rich in beaches that are better equipped, and certainly better managed.

reviews.title: Small great place
reviews.text: Great place with nice streets and surprising shops. Nice boulevard with good restaurants. Beautiful ride through the mountains

reviews.title: Beautiful island
reviews.text: The place was green with wonderful smells. The friendly people are ready to serve you and the beaches are beautiful

reviews.title: Lovely beach to visit, go early for parking
reviews.text: Finally got to the beach on the 2nd attempt, 1st time we arrived mid afternoon after visit the caves and it was far to busy, we're people parked at the top and walked down, so we came back 2 days later, arrived approx 11am, weather wasn't the best but we preserved, then it got better and we spent good 4 hours here, beautiful. No sunbeds or umbrellas or bar though, all closed, it was a Sunday of that makes a difference. We drove from Lassi, nice drive approx 45 mins.

reviews.title: Beautiful but dangerous
reviews.text: This is no doubt a beautiful beach a mixture of sand and pebbles. However the surf is deadly. Sadly the day we visited a man drowned while we were there. Beware of the warning flags. The water is a gorgeous blue so my advice is to look and enjoy but don’t swim.

reviews.title: Beautiful sea
reviews.text: We didn’t go down to the beach but took pics from the view point. Our tour guide told us it was a white pebble beach with some sand, that’s what gives the water the changing turquoise colour. It was very beautiful. Wise we had more time to go down.

reviews.title: MAGIC ✨✨✨
reviews.text: THE BEST BEACH OF GREECE AND THE MEDITERRAN...FOR WHO CAN AND RESIST !!!THE PRISONERS YOUR CUBADAKES...AND ON A SANDY BEACH.

reviews.title: A beauty but a bit too busy
reviews.text: A beautiful beach for sure, and the usual steep drive down with steep drops below. We came from Divarata direction. We got down there and it was rammed. The car park and all the approach road were full. We found a space but frustrated drivers were coming in after us. We found the cafe closed and therefore no sun loungers available to hire. Disappointing as we’d had no food, so we left. It was busy, quite a commercial set up and having seen it on our very short visit, we probably won’t return. Not that it wasn’t nice, but there are plenty of smaller and equally beautiful beaches around. Nice photo opps from the road if you dare, and are allowed to stop. Divarata is a nice village so stock up there before you head down to the beach.

reviews.title: Hard access we went twice and turned backwards
reviews.text: Only disappointment we got from this beach a lot of advertising for nothing!!! Even parkingers had to pay shame for Kefalonia!!!

reviews.title: Cefalonia, Greece
reviews.text: one of the best islands in Greece. Little widespread and hidden by the clamor fashion of Mikonos and Santorini. But it was the most beautiful one we know. the beach of Myrtos is as or more beautiful as Zakintos (kkkkkk) the blue of the water is constant!! TEm beaches of more amazing blue, it is rustic and natural, has warm water beaches and other emerald greens. An Incredible Place

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The view of the beach from the viewpoint from the road towards Assos is really amazing. We were at this beach in mid-afternoon at the end of August and there were lots of parking spaces available. The beach is composed of small pebbles and were not too crowded. At the level of furnishings, you can find a snack, showers and even deckchairs for those who wish (fairly far from the water). The turquoise water does not lend itself to snorkeling, but the situation seen from below is also very pretty (the sun sets in addition facing the beach). For us essential beach to do during a visit of Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos Beach in September @ 3pm in the afternoon.No problem parking & beach was not overcrowded. Didn’t bother with sun loungers as spent time in the seaI was a little bit concerned about the road to the beach & the waves after reading some previous reviews on here.I didn’t think the road was dangerous & the waves when I visited certainly weren’t dangerous either. Although I would agree it’s not ideal for little children as it gets deep quickly.As always in life - it’s good to do your research beforehand but don’t let that put you off experiencing something firsthand for yourself.I agree with its rating as one of the best beaches in the world - and the drive to the beach is absolutely breathtaking.

reviews.title: Nice, but it gets better...
reviews.text: Undoubtedly a beautiful beach to see.There is an equipped part and a free part for those who are equipped with everything necessary.You have to arrive early, by 9 or shortly after because the parking lots are few and not all are comfortable.

reviews.title: a beautiful blue
reviews.text: one of the two most beautiful beaches of Kefalonia..view from the top panoramic beautiful with evil color of a blue introvabile..beach equipped with sunbeds and umbrellas at 15 euros in August, convenient parking better arrive a little early because very crowded...

reviews.title: To see only once
reviews.text: Viewed from above it is a wonder, but then you realize that it is uncomfortable, access to the sea is difficult due to the presence of pebbles and because the water is immediately deep, the real problem is just the sea water as it is full of foam of non-natural origin, definitely due to drains.

reviews.title: When you say aquamarine color
reviews.text: Certainly among the most beautiful to visit. It deserves 5 stars for the ridiculously beautiful color of the water. You know the aquamrine? There, exactly that. The beach is equipped, 15 euro two sunbeds and thatched umbrella. There are showers, toilets and a small bar with croissants in the morning and pizza for lunch. All pebbles even in the water, shoes are indispensable. The water rises immediately, children always need an adult, especially if small.

reviews.title: Hard for families
reviews.text: The beach is dangerous for families because of the waves and steep depths..leave the stones difficult to please the children.On the other hand it is difficult and parking unless you go in the morning before 10..But from above it looks magnificent..The landscape as a landscape either above or below is very nice..

reviews.title: We will go back!!
reviews.text: Wonderful sea. Amazing view from above. You have to go when it has no waves, to let you swim in its waters of all shades of blue. The sooner the better for a parking spot. There is an organized section with sunbeds, canteens, dressing rooms and showers and free space for nature lovers.

reviews.title: Amazing picture
reviews.text: An amazing beach like a picture One of the best beaches in the world If you are lucky to find the water calm then you are the luckiest person on earth The colours are fantastic the water is crystal and the waves amazing Totally worth it ! Be careful due to deep waters and huge waves Is not a joke especially for young children Enjoy with awareness and have many pics!You can’t see that everyday

reviews.title: Magic!
reviews.text: Experience!!!! One of the most impressive beaches! It is advisable to go relatively early to park comfortably or in the afternoon, after 6 pm, to enjoy the sunset ❤️

reviews.title: Beautiful colors and panorama
reviews.text: Definitely one of the most beautiful beaches. The view coming from above and the color from the water are unbelievable. We rented an umbrella (15 euros with 2 sunbeds). Just arrive, find a free umbrella and they will come to you to charge you. The beach has free showers and a bar. We took a day of rough seas (fun but dangerous). We stayed until evening to watch the sunset.NB: do not be frightened by reviews that say that the street is horrendous and that there is no parking: surely arriving early you will find the best parking lots. But the road moderating speed is absolutely feasible

reviews.title: Go when there's no wave
reviews.text: The famous beach, which is worth seeing. On the road there is a stop to see the bay of Myrtos from above, amazing view. The route to the last section makes it difficult and especially the parking that wants luck. Later at noon we found it. We reached a calm sea, it was not the cleanest though and deepens sharply. Beautiful colors, beautiful environment with white pebble, sunbeds 15 euro per set.

reviews.title: Myrthos beach
reviews.text: A white beach surrounded by high hills, beautiful blue sea.Umbrella service with sun loungers, bar available

reviews.title: Turquoise water
reviews.text: Well what about, the photos speak for themselves is a fantastic place with a beautiful sea even if a little rough, bring your shoes from stones and an umbrella and two sunbeds cost 15 €. There is a bar that makes sandwiches, toilets and even disabled toilets. Beware of parking, after 10:30/11 it is overflowing

reviews.title: Disappointment!
reviews.text: Too silly for nothing! We went, we got the credit for parking, we didn't go into the sea because of huge waves and we left! Before he goes, he's checking if he has northerns. Not recommended for kids!

reviews.title: More beautiful from far than near
reviews.text: More beautiful from a distance than close, but it is still among the top of Kefalonia. Convenient parking and there is also a bar that offers little stuff to eat.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but not the best
reviews.text: If you arrive in the morning around 9am you have all umbrellas free and you can choose the place. The morning is all shade but around 10 the sun comes and the water turns a beautiful blue color. Too bad that today there were waves and so we could not fully enjoy the sea. Parking just behind the beach.

reviews.title: Tourist trap...avoid!
reviews.text: Completely overrated beach. Can't actually see the beach because of the number of sunloungers and umbrellas (all of which were fully booked anyway). Parking is the stuff of nightmares (we arrived at 11am and had to park at the top of the hill on a verge. The pollution must be horrendous due to the amount of cars. I'm sure at one point this was a stunning place to visit but not now. I personally wouldn't recommend.

reviews.title: Very nice.
reviews.text: The view and the sea are wonderful. The sea is somewhat dangerous for children because it deepens sharply. Set of sunbeds 15€, coffee ok.Narrow road

reviews.title: Patience and strong nerves to have
reviews.text: View great.... access better to have made life insurance and mixed car...water overestimating for them....the bar that operates there needs patience in the queue and when it comes your turn to have a kidney about for what you get... you mean that the coffee is miserable as in all places in Kefalonia...the sunbeds at 15 euros.....but you will definitely need an orthopedist after you leave...good courage....

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Arrived early, breath taking views on the way down. We got there before 10  and there was parking space and sunbeds.  Bus trips arrived and car parking soon became tricky.  The beach is beautiful as is the water, however big waves meant that it was tricky to get in and out and our teenage daughters got taken under a few times and this wasn’t going to be an all day beach trip due to not being able to 100% enjoy the sea. We stayed for a drink in the small cafe.  Beautiful but perhaps not a beach for young children. We then moved on to Assos and Fiscardo, this was a great day exploring that part of the Island before returning to our base nr Skala.

reviews.title: Not to be missed
reviews.text: Very long beach equipped with sun loungers and umbrella set at 15 EurThere is a fairly large beachfront car park but since the beach is the most famous in Kefalonia it soon fills up.The bar behind the beach sells drinks and sandwichesBeautiful and immediately deep water with stonesGiven the size you can still find a place easily.Not to be missed

reviews.title: More beautiful from above than from below
