reviews.text: Forget the snorkel mask, its turquoise color is due to a whitish color (limestone) and the visibility is complicated. Pretty cave. Showers, toilet block. Snack is expensive. Small round pebbles. It was very hot, no wind, the fact that it is collected must play according to the direction of the wind... Huge parking at the very bottom, places available until around 10am/10.30am the day we went there (mid August).

reviews.title: Beautiful colors but uncomfortable beach
reviews.text: Pebble beach a little uncomfortable, Recommendation to go early in the morning to be able to find parking nearby.Beautiful colors but, in my opinion, it is not the best in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but very dangerous road!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches seen so far here in Kefalonia, crystal clear water with rocky bottom (we recommend rock shoes).Beach equipped with umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and bars.The cost of an umbrella and two sunbeds amounts to 15 euros.Do not underestimate the very dangerous stretch of road to get to the beach.The end of the road is not safe, as there are no protective barriers. Also, the road is two-way and the high height does not give you security, just for this reason I would not go back.

reviews.title: Hard to access , pollution seems . I would choose some other beach to swim .
reviews.text: Difficult access. Unfortunately the waters are full of bubbles, pollution seems. I would choose some other beach for bathing. Only photos from above...

reviews.title: More pain than pleasure.
reviews.text: The view from above is really incredible! Beautiful colors, everything you need to take amazing photos!We had to park quite far, about 17 minutes walk to the beach and unfortunately we were not compensated for the inconvenience. The waters were incredibly dirty the day we went there, they didn't invite you to swim, we all stayed 2 meters from the coast.Although there was a lot of people, the beach was clean.For children it is inappropriate, deepens very quickly, needs attention and supervision.The canteen has the necessary, at priced prices.On the positive, the saviors and the toilets that, despite the world, are kept quite clean.

reviews.title: When the species has heads
reviews.text: We returned to the myrtle after 25 years !!!we were teenagers and now we are ...everything has changed..The myrtle, however, remained the same!You are shocked by the beauty when you see him from above the same and from below!work of art of the species!the words are poor to describe him!!

reviews.title: Beautiful but it gets better!
reviews.text: Nice beach but too crowded. Beautiful sea but it gets better.The only bar available is really very expensive. Unsurpassed sunset! You have to go there early in the morning otherwise you will not find parking easily.

reviews.title: Braving the wind and the big horses...🌊⛱️
reviews.text: Beautiful pebble beach, clear water.We caught a windy day and high horses ;we stayed in the area of free umbrellas, and we enjoyed braving the waves, sometimes so high that they were scary!we took advantage of the beer of the small gazebo at the entrance of the beach and the fried doughnuts with sugar of a street vendor that were not bad (a doughnut 2 euros, chocolate maybe a little more).The equipped beach had several rows of umbrellas, free showers and bathrooms .parking behind the beach or along the road that goes down to the beach in curva.arrive early:although large is a crowded beach!remember the rock shoes

reviews.title: Unique beauty
reviews.text: Special beauty.We came in time for parking and sunbeds.Friendly prices It's a shame that the nice canteen has nothing but standard frozen.If I knew it I would have been supplied by oven & ananas coming.We'll probably come back while we're on the island.

reviews.title: It must be visited!
reviews.text: Recommendation to arrive in the morning by 9.30am to find a place for the beachfront car and to consult wave forecasts.In the morning spectacular sea, at about 11.30 the beach fills up to the unlikely and the water gets dirty thanks to the yachts that park in front of it.But a visit is worth it .. maybe not all day a bath and go.

reviews.title: not to be missed
reviews.text: Not surprisingly considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, a must-see in Kefalonia. Recommendation to arrive early to enjoy it in peace, find free umbrellas (if you are interested - 15 euros umbrella and two sunbeds) and find convenient parking, after arriving is a delirium. There is a bar that sells snacks and also makes reasonably priced sandwiches. Sea with really beautiful colors but not really suitable for children because immediately deep.

reviews.title: The beach acropolis?
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, impressive, the spectacle and its colors have no rival. But the hassle of getting there, and especially where to park, is such that you don't know if it's worth it. Unfortunately, the sea was not clean, it had enough waste, probably from the 6-7 boats that were stretched deeper inside. The people on the beach, although quite, kept the rules of cleaning. In plus, the 3 rescuers and the beach bar with facilities for the necessary.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Accessible only when there is no air..It is dangerous sea but worth a visit.. Great view before you come down! The road is normal in general until there. It is only difficult for 2-3 minutes to download because they park on the mountain side due to lack of space!

reviews.title: Absolute bliss
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing beach, the colour of the water is stunning all day long. 2 sun-beds with an umbrella for €15 for the day but they are not padded.  There is no waiter service. The roads are steep and narrow with hairpin bends. Do not attempt if you are scared of heights 😂 You must go early, by 11 there were no car parking spaces left so people just parked on the road making the trip down the hairpin road even more perilous.  It is stoney so bring beach shoes.There are toilet facilities, showers and a small cafe shop which is reasonably priced. Enjoy your day.

reviews.title: Number 1 beach of Kefalonia
reviews.text: Amazing waters! If you go by 10:30, you'll find it convenient to park. The cost of the set umbrella sunbeds is very reasonable.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, worth a visit
reviews.text: A great classic of Kefalonia. Although it is one of the most famous beaches, it still remains very simple, with only one bar and long rows of umbrellas.The beach is pebbles mixed sand and the sea is a clear blue.The cost of an umbrella and two sunbeds is 15€.Parking near the bar but only if you arrive early (around 9/9:30), otherwise you have to park along the hairpin bends. Large area of free beach You can order at the bar directly from the guy on the beach who brings you what you order at the umbrella

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in the world
reviews.text: The beach is spectacular. There are no words to describe this place. The viewpoint, the way there. The white stones, the cave on the left side, the sea of neon color, translucent, amazing. And because there are no bus and bars the place is even more perfect. The road there is quiet. There are argostoli buses I think from 2h/2h I WANT TO COME

reviews.title: Third fourth beach...
reviews.text: It had a fine air and the sea was dirty!! I have no reason to lie floated garbage and a dead fish, the landscape very beautiful for it 2 stars otherwise neither one

reviews.title: Beautiful, white beach with pebbles, recommended!
reviews.text: Beautiful views on the way there, but you really should drive there too. Is a pebble beach though. I lost my prescription sunglasses there due to the intensity of the sea / waves. So pay attention with caps, glasses ... from Lassi region it is a good 45' drive. Mss the most beautiful of the island

reviews.title: Myrto beach a must go to beach
reviews.text: Recent trip to Kefalonia; beaches were beautiful but Myrto beach stood out ; bring your own umbrella and get there early if you plan on parking as you may have a wait to find a spot

reviews.title: Beautiful but be careful!
reviews.text: The beach is breathtakingly beautiful. In the end of July there were sunbeds and umbrellas to rent (€15 total for the whole day), a bar and free showers, toilets and changing rooms. I would recommend but be careful: if there are strong waves you could slip on the pebbles or be submerged even in the shallow. The water also goes deep in a few meters.

reviews.title: Iconic beach
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is one of the most iconic and photographed in Greece, characterized by white sand and pebbles and turquoise waters.Despite its popularity, Myrtos maintains a quiet and pristine atmosphere. Perfect for swimming and relaxing, it offers an unforgettable bathing experience in one of Kefalonia's most fascinating landscapes.There is the possibility to park near the famous beach, there are beaches and places to eat.

reviews.title: Myrtos beach
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach, the most popular beach on the island, certainly lives up to its reputation. The striking blue water and iconic cliffs create a picturesque setting that attracts many visitors. However, the popularity does come with a downside: the beach can get quite crowded, and the water isn't as pristine as some of the island's lesser-known spots. Despite this, the vibrant blue hues of the sea remain stunning, and the small cave along the shore adds a charming touch to the experience. It's a beautiful spot, though for a more secluded experience, other beaches might be preferable.

reviews.title: A Beach Day in Kefalonia
reviews.text: The beach and the sea was amazing! We easily found a sunbed and the cost was affordable when you compare with the other beaches in Kefalonia. The waves were so big and it was not easy to jump into the sea.

reviews.title: Beautiful from above
reviews.text: Very nice beach from above, a beautiful color and great beach, but with only one beach, we could not find umbrella and sunbeds. Rough and dirty sea, you could not see the bottom.

reviews.title: Beach absolutely worth visiting
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Kefalonia.Completely blue water and really beautiful bay. It is a stony beach (special shoes are recommended to enjoy it to the fullest). There is ample availability of free beach, as well as sun loungers with umbrellas at average prices. The only real flaw parking: I recommend arriving early in the morning so as to find a place easily, otherwise you have to park along the road to go down to the beach which is not the best. There is also a fairly simple bar. Overall good experience and definitely worth visiting at least once.

reviews.title: Stunning views to the beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach from views up the top so we went down to watch the sunset one evening. Unlike the coves & other beaches we went to this wasn’t clear but the most gorgeous shade of turquoise.The waves are very strong & the bottom falls away quite quickly from the shoreline so not suitable for small children. It has white stones & pebbles so sea shoes are recommended but watching the sunset here was beautiful while we bounced in the waves. We got to the beach about 7.00 pm, parking was free & spaces after the hairpin road down ( its entry/exit different routes so not worrying about passing)

reviews.title: Beautiful white stand with blue sea
reviews.text: Nice beach now less crowded due to closure road from Lixouri. You have to drive all the way around. Nice clean beach with beautiful blue sea. 2 beds and parasol 15 euros. Can be high waves than less suitable for smaller children

reviews.title: Wonderful, unique sea colors
reviews.text: Myrtos must be seen with the calm sea, otherwise it loses its magic. So inquire before you go, no use pretending to see the best of Myrtos with waves of 0.3-0.4,0.5 m. We saw it in July and, unfortunately, from after 11 am until 5 pm on the shore it looked like a tent city with all the umbrellas planted by people. Bar good for breakfast not lunch.But this does not change my Rating on the view the beach and especially the water. Then obvious that beaches like this appreciate them at their best in May June September.

reviews.title: Not to be there all day
reviews.text: Unexplained positive reviews, rough and dirty sea. In high season to come at about 9 'already after 10 the parking lot's full. To arrive road full of hairpin bends and steep. In the end it's feasible just to organize but it's not worth paying for the beds and much less stay there all day. Recommendation to come early take a bath and two photos and come away. There are nicer beaches and the only bar there is not good.

reviews.title: Much appearance and very little substance
reviews.text: So beautiful from above, with beautiful colors and then, once down, it turns out to be a white stony (if you do not have the appropriate shoes to enter the water is a very painful undertaking). What from above look like cliffs overlooking the sea are just big landslides, there is only one establishment with no infamy and no praise but with a cost of renting deck chairs and umbrella that screams revenge compared to the average costs of the island. A little-stocked bar, scarce and hard-to-find parking spaces after 10 am, a flood of people who are even brought with tourist buses. Never again, there are dozens of much more beautiful beaches in Kefalonia!

reviews.title: Mah
reviews.text: I agree with the latest reviews ..dall'alto bella but then it is murky... immediately very deep... it is not sand but pebbles with a bit of sand... and the gentlemen of the place say that it is very rare to find there the calm sea... x me there are much more beautiful beaches ...However free parking ... establishment with umbrellas at about 15 euros ... and also free beach ..

reviews.title: Amazing place !
reviews.text: Thougt it would be good to share a more recent review of this beautiful place. We visited  Myrtos beach in July ‘24 on a Monday in high season. It is indeed good to arrive before 10.30 to have a reasonable chance of parking your car at beachlevel and still have a choice for some sunbeds. After 11.00 all will be full and cars will be parking back up the road.The road itself is not too bad, albeit a bit narrow towards the end. For those who have been to Balos beach on Crete, this is easy !There’s a modest beachbar with a simple takeaway menu; hotdogs, sandwiches, pizza and the like. Lots of choices for drinks at tourist prices. They offer toilets and showers as well, that would be expected at such a destination.The sea is absolutely gorgeous ! Many shades of blue, but depth is increasing quickly and there’s some serious waves and currents, so beware. Mostly a white pebble beach, that enhances the sun power, so wear something on your feet and use lots of sunscreen.There’s a small cave on the left side, where you can swim outside to the sea; sort of a mini ‘Tunnel of Love’ for those that been to Corfu.Hope this helps, set your alarmclock and GO !Ps. You can do Parapente from the beach, where they drive you up and you’ll land back on the beach !

reviews.title: Nice but...
reviews.text: We arrived at the beach around 10 am, there were still places for cars but few umbrellas and I must say we were lucky to find one of the very few in the front row. Sea of a beautiful turquoise color but unfortunately it was a bit rough so there was some dirt here and there floating. Recommendation shoes because the shore and the seabed are made of stones even quite large. Two sunbeds (uncomfortable) and an umbrella for 15€. Then there is a small kiosk where you can eat (sitting on benches because there are no tables). We arrived in the kiosk at 12.30 and already many sandwiches were finished and even salads. In conclusion it is a beautiful beach, certainly very characteristic, but there are more beautiful and better equipped.

reviews.title: Look at it from above
reviews.text: It deserves a picture but panoramic from above, I found it very disappointing that you can not see your feet in 20cm of water... beautiful colors, for goodness sake to look like a pool, but getting closer it is white, peat, and from what I know it is always so...  He does not deserve the coat of arms if with a mask you can not see ten cm away! In Kefalonia there is much better!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches. Unique sea. Of course a lot of people and understandable. Prefer the afternoon to admire the sunset (it also has umbrellas, sunbeds but they respect the space and there is enough for anyone who does not want to pay)

reviews.title: Beautiful but only for a passage
reviews.text: We went to lunch and found parking right on the beach. Very beautiful and the view from above is worth it. I was relieved to see cars parked 500 meters above... There's plenty of room for your umbrella, but... The beach is full of stones, crocades and feet hurt. We went to many other beaches in Kefalonia but here we suffered! Even the kids complained. Our little girl was yelling out trying to make her play. Needless to say, rubber shoes we didn't have. For us the worst beach of the island we have seen, the kids asked to leave almost immediately.

reviews.title: Wild beauty
reviews.text: The environment of this beach gives it a great advantage over other similar ones. Endless cliffs, rocks imposing, wild, white to pebble pebbles inside and outside the water and waters with this incredible alcoholic - turquoise color make up the special beauty of Myrtos. Right and left there is plenty of free space for your umbrellas. If you want to use the umbrellas of Bitsomore you will pay 15€. It is important to know that on the right side of the beach the pebble is large, it is not easy to walk you will need the special plastic Shoes Sea. On the left however the pebble is very thin and you can more easily walk (the side of the cave)

reviews.title: Discovering myrtos
reviews.text: beautiful from above and below, with some organizational flaws: storming, few umbrellas, little assistance, you could do more.The air spins little, a hot basin so equip yourself properly, anonymous kiosk, scorching heat!

reviews.title: Very good.
reviews.text: Congratulations to the Municipality of Pilaréon providing free umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and sanitary facilities (and for disabled people) on this beach

reviews.title: Spiaggia spettacolare!
reviews.text: A wonderful beach and convenient to reach since the parking lots are behind the beach. The sea is wonderful, Recommendation to everyone to go for a swim; not far from there, you can set on the navigator the View Point of Myrtos, you can see the beach from above, very suggestive!

reviews.title: Postcard of the island
reviews.text: On this beach we have read a lot and I share many things.Before arriving early, 9.30, we could admire and photograph it from above and the view is spectacular, arriving early then you can park down close to it and we had brought everything you need, umbrella, shoes, ..The beach is white stones that with the sun reverberate a lot in a species of basin surrounded by high cliffs, be careful to go too close to them as there is danger of landslides, for this reason we positioned ourselves away from them.The sea when we were there was practically calm, what unusual it seems, the colors are beautiful with a beautiful range of blues the entrance into the water however is immediately high and you have to be careful.Its position means that around noon if there is no wind it creates a hood of heat so around that time we decided to go elsewhere.Refreshment kiosk, umbrellas and sunbeds and bathrooms available.With these precautions, arrive early and leave when it is too hot I must say that we enjoyed the time spent here perhaps also because the sea was calm.

reviews.title: Beautiful for pictures
reviews.text: The beach itself looks stunning. We visited in the begging of June and there was no umbrellas or what so ever on the beach, so if you haven't brought your own umbrella, you can not stay more than 30min. because of the heat. The beach is pebbly and preferably you need shoes. It is not suitable for children, as it is deepens quickly. The parking is an issue too, if you do not go early.

reviews.title: Francesco
reviews.text: We were bitterly disappointed. Described as the most beautiful beach on the island when in fact there are better ones. The sea is a beautiful turquoise, but the pebbles prevent you from fully enjoying it. We recommend shoes and umbrella, also because those made available are insufficient for the large turnout. The kiosk is well stocked but do not expect gourmet dishes, you will also find benches and not tables to sit on. The only positive note is the beautiful sunset.

reviews.title: Rejected
reviews.text: Bocciatissima!  Road to get very dangerous. Beach WITHOUT services. If you go there bring everything, umbrella, chairs and especially eat. There's a bar with no tables and only benches to sit on. Absolutely insufficient for turnout. Pebble beach, bring shoes. Yesterday we were in Petani, something else entirely!!!!!! Equipped beach, excellent quality restaurants.Myrthos mi spiace ma non mi rivedi!

reviews.title: Twice we went to see if it improved and nothing. Water full of weeds bird feathers and more
reviews.text: Fine overrated dirty sea parking small to forget. Claim made when comparing other Greek islands

reviews.title: A thousand shades of blue
reviews.text: Exciting panorama. Beautiful colors. There is a lido and a kiosk. Arriving by 9:30-10:00 you will find the umbrella for 15 euros. Parking nearby. At the kiosk you can have a sweet breakfast with chocolate croissants, but also a quick lunch with many types of pie-rustici.Very clean bathrooms and presence of several showers. Definitely not to be missed!

reviews.title: Important to know before you go!
reviews.text: The water here is very beautiful and clear BUT the beach is pebbly/rocky.  You MUST have water shoes or it is painful and difficult to get in and out of the water.  The water was rough/waves when we went and no real shallow water for kids to play in.  You MUST have an umbrella or the sun is scorching mid day.  Umbrellas and chairs are available for rent but go quickly.  Cantina open for drinks and snacks, bathrooms and rinse showers available.  Parking is a little chaotic and a long windy hill to get to beach level. There is a cave at the end of the beach but can't swim in when water is rough.  We made the best of it!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: After reading about it being the most beautiful beach in Greece I was somewhat disappointed. Place packed with cars and yes water looked beautiful but nowhere to sit. Locals not so friendly

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Undoubtedly the sea, with its colors that fade from turquoise to dark blue represents a spectacle, but the beach itself is disappointing. Sand (little) and pebbles (many), you need rubber shoes, a backdrop of stones that descends quickly. Few straw umbrellas, aluminum sunbeds without mats, no coffee table. 15€ for umbrella and two sunbeds. We arrived at 9:15, at 10 am they were all busy, and the parking lot was also full. At the back of the beach there is a bar, higher than average prices, no beach service.

reviews.title: Lovely to see but don’t go!
reviews.text: We had visited the beach in 2011 and it was beautiful. We went back today. The colour of the water is amazing, as always. We arrived on the beach at 10am, which we considered reasonably early, to find almost all of the sun beds already occupied. No umbrellas available. The sea is really rough, definitely not for the faint hearted. The worst aspect though is the traffic/parking. No organisation, complete chaos, people parking wherever they want, sometimes blocking entry/exit down the scary, hairpin-filled road with sheer drops down the cliffs. Oh, and they throw in a few truly massive coaches every now and then. How they get up and down that road is beyond me. The place needs properly organising with parking restrictions. There needs to be a limit on the number of vehicles allowed down there and the big coaches should be banned. If nothing happens I am certain there will be a serious accident on that road one day.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Wow WoW WoWThe most stunning water I’ve ever seen.Beautiful beach loads of space.We drove here in Citroen c1 and had no problem. Parking fine too.  We took a picnic cos wasn’t sure taverna would be open. It opened late afternoon! Enjoy hard not to.

reviews.title: Deludente!!!!
reviews.text: We arrived at the beach in Myrtos Beach in the morning at 09:30 on 1 July 2024, we had read that the beach was equipped, instead when we arrived there were sunbeds and umbrellas all dismantled, we asked if there was the possibility of having a pair with umbrella and we were told that maybe they would mount them in the afternoon if not in the next few days!! I would say that in July we expected more organization!! So we changed the beach.

reviews.title: The real beauty
reviews.text: This is the must visit place on the island.Combine it with a lunch in Divarata and drink in Asos!I wanted to visit this beach since I watched the movie Captain Corelli’s Mandolin.We were there at last day of June and still there was no sun-beds and canteen didn’t work. So, to be on the safe side, have your own umbrella, enough drinks and some flip flops. They told us canteen will be open early July.  The road is in a very good shape. If you are a good driver, it will not be a problem. I read some reviews telling that road is narrow, but there are more narrow roads on the island. It is a few minute drive from Divarata and you will enjoy the drive and views.Beach is really beautiful, clean, with white pebbles, fantastic colours, nature as it should be. You can sit on the shore and admire beauty around you. Enjoy!!

reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: Beautiful and unique place. The sea changes color continuously and creates spectacular effects. To visit absolutely.  A place to respect for its uniqueness

reviews.title: *Not for nothing one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece!"
reviews.text: The drive down to the beach offers fantastic views. The color of the sea incredible; beautiful but hard to walk pebble beach and no bars, umbrellas or sunbeds. Toilets available.

reviews.title: Great to view but not so good actually being on
reviews.text: Great to view, not so great to spend time on. Way too pebbly and shingly for me personally as I prefer them sandy. Also, you need to be a confident swimmer as its quite tidal. Overall it looks way better than it is in my opinion.

reviews.title: Lush beach
reviews.text: Went here with a group, had a great time. The views are sensational, it is great to swim in the sea. Well worth a visit to this beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful, stunning beach⛱️
reviews.text: After a step ride down the hillside you will come to the beautiful, white pebble beach. You can park your car at the back of the beach free of charge. Absolutely stunning crystal clear blue water. Lots of fish swim right near the shallow part of the beach. Great for snorkeling. Make sure you have beach footwear to use in the water as the stones can be painful to walk on. A stunning location. Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning, we didn’t drive down to it as hire car would never have made it up winding hills again! It can also have some dangerous currents from what we heard.

reviews.title: Picture perfect view but no beach experience.
reviews.text: Beautiful view. Postal perfect picture but nothing more. Don’t expect to be able to get in the water if you have kids. Extremely strong waves and dangerous for anyone who is not experienced. White pebbles. Bring water shoes otherwise it will be difficult to walk around. No facilities available. No shade or umbrellas. Bring your own.

reviews.title: Unbelievable!!!
reviews.text: FantasticWe had gone by boat Unbelievable beauty and relaxation of the mindImposing and parallel beautiful colors of the water

reviews.title: Beach visit
reviews.text: No facilities except life guards. Unusual given that quieter beaches have food and drinks to buy and sunlounges to hire.

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Beautiful sea, with all shades of blue, but....the beach has no assistance, no umbrellas, or anything. Just a small, strictly closed wooden building. A MASSIVE landslide overwhelms it and pushes its debris almost halfway to the beach. I was told that a small bar only opens in July and August and that the problem is the landslide. We "folded" on Petani beach, equally beautiful and of which I attach the photo.

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: The views from above are incredible and well worth a look, the beach is lovely but it is much more comfortable on Antisamos in my opinion.

reviews.title: Beautiful.
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach and a must when visiting Kefalonia. Crystal blue milky sea with lots of pebbles so take water shoes

reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.text: Stunning beach, with spectacular viewsAlthough a tad cold when we were there, clear sea. Enjoyable few hours. Could do with a little café/beach bar although did look like there is one maybe bit too early in season. Drive down fabulous views, we even passed a heard of goats on route

reviews.title: Bring all your own stuff
reviews.text: Myris beach is stunning, from above. That's why they take all those amazing photos from there.The beach's is still just a (very stoney) beach. We went as part of a 3 sight excursion  and we were able to drive all the way down the very twisty road to the beach itself.  We arrived just after lunchtime and already there were a lot of cars parked. Our (Greek) driver and guide was very annoyed that, despite it being late May, no beach facilities were open and he felt he had let us down. No bar or cafe open, no toilets open save one single gents toilet, no loungers or parasols. No doubt these will be available later on in the year but until then you will need to bring your own food water, and some shade with you. Beach is very pebbley and gritty so walking can be difficult, beach shoes are a must and under the water underfoot is still treacherous. Water clear, ideal for snorking but nothing to see as nothing grows amongst the grit and pebbles. Without the bar or loungers a couple of hours at the most. Really not worth the effort  but you do get a lovely photo on your way out.

reviews.title: Beautiful Myrtle!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Greece! We can't wait to visit it again in July 2024! Kefalonia forever!

reviews.title: Mediterranean essence
reviews.text: Impressive viewpoint of this beautiful beach, possibly the best known in Kefalonia. Small parking lot for about 8 vehicles.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world, in season it is best to arrive quite early 9/9.30am, umbrellas and deckchairs at reasonable prices, possibility of bringing your own umbrella, don't forget your beach shoes. Beautiful water, kiosk that doesn't do hot dishes but above all packaged sandwiches

reviews.title: Superiority
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Greece. unique crystal clear waters beautiful scenery that will amaze you on the left side of the beach go see the cave

reviews.title: Impossibility of vehicle access to the beach in the summer
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach but in the summer access and parking is almost impossible. It is the only beach in which the only thing we managed to do was to go dead-end with the car, without stopping anywhere, and to return to the main road, having escaped for a little dead-end and scratches on the vehicle. No control over the way cars park in the space, creating dead end traps. I'm sorry we didn't swim but I won't go again

reviews.title: Beautiful beach...Unforgettable experience...!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with turquoise waters, which are crystal clear, white pebbles and white sand. Be careful in deep water, especially for those with small children. Driving down the road and seeing her from above literally leaves you... with your mouth open. I have visited it many times in the past and I always leave excited, even on our last visit (June 2020) when due to the corona pandemic the beach bar was not working, there were no sunbeds and umbrellas and the people were quite limited. The cave to the left of the beach is impressive. It is a beach that anyone visiting Kefalonia must visit. You have to go...don't miss it...well worth it!!!

reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: Heavenly....an absolute must see. Rent a car and go to a piece of paradise. Afterwards, stop for lunch in the nearby restaurant. Alexandros. Impeccable. Local lady who speaks perfect Italian. Very kind

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, watch the currents
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, which is relaxing. The sea was fairly choppy and no one was in it, which I was told is usual for Mytros Beach. I managed to have a quick swim, but came straight back in due to the strong undercurrent and I am a strong swimmer, so please be weary of it. There is a cafe, toilets and a lifeguard on duty at the beach. You are no longer allowed to go into the cave at the fair end of the beach, due to falling rocks. There are view points of the beach up at the top of the cliff, at both sides, which provide a fantastic view of the beach. 100% recommend, such a beautiful beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful during the day, spectacular at sunset
reviews.text: Pebble beach similar to Antisamos, but with very few fish visible. A small cave can be reached with a few swimming strokes (land entrance closed due to risk of landslides). Very hot even in June-July because it faces west, on the other hand it offers beautiful sunsets. Very crowded from late morning, it is best to get there early to park near the beach, otherwise you will have to stop along the access road or in the paid car park. In the inns on the beach you can eat well at average prices.

reviews.title: Suggestive
reviews.text: The water has enchanting colors and for 10 euros a day you get 2 sunbeds and an umbrella. Bar very poor for food, better to organize from home. Mainly made of white pebbles, for me who love sand, it is definitely not my favorite beach but it should be seen at least once.

reviews.title: Enjoyable Day
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful.  The water is crystal clear and when we were there, the water was warm.  You must have water shoes because the beach is very rocky.  Also, they do have beach chairs but not many.  Also there is a little cafe you can get something to eat and drink, and they have bathrooms and shower.

reviews.title: You are the most beautiful in the world!!!
reviews.text: If you think of a beach, the most beautiful one you can imagine....yes, it is the most beautiful in the world!!!

reviews.title: Blue clear water, small cave and a private like feel
reviews.text: Beautiful pebble beach with clear blue water and a small cave for exploring. Cafe and snack bar on site plus umbrellas and seats for a slight fee.

reviews.title: Lovely looking beach but be careful
reviews.text: On our way to Fiskardo we stopped off and had a look down to Myrtos beah. From distance it looks like white sands, but the locals informed us that it's actually small pebbles.It does look uber-gorgeous, but another warning we were given is that there can be some nasty undercurrents off the beach, so please be careful when swimming especially the little ones.Also, it's a mini rally stage to get down from the main road.

reviews.title: A corner of sky in the sea 😀❣️
reviews.text: Breathtaking colours, crystal clear water, a very long beach with few umbrellas, therefore very free 👍, but equipped!The only really sad flaw: management of the refreshment point is chaotic, poorly stocked and of poor quality, very impatient managers!!!!!It's probably not the place for them, because in a sunny paradise only smiles and kindness can reign.

reviews.title: Beautiful but not the most beautiful on the island
reviews.text: The directions are not very clear and we struggled to get there. I recommend arriving in the morning before 10am because the car park doesn't have many spaces. The beach is very large and spacious, with pebbles which require shoes. Unfortunately the day I went the sea was rough and not being a fan of waves, I only got my feet wet. The sea water is clear with a beautiful blue color, and immediately becomes deep. It is equipped, there are showers and a small bar where you can buy drinks and sandwiches. Definitely a beautiful beach but, in my opinion, not the most beautiful on the island, as it is considered

reviews.title: Beautiful island. Beautiful beaches. Good food and nice people.
reviews.text: We were in Skala.Beaches are partly sand and there are stones where the sea begins. The water is very clear. We rented a car for 3 days and explored the island. Also took a boat trip to Fiskardo. The capital is very beautiful to see once. Myrthos beach is also great.😍. Would love to come back again.

reviews.title: Incredible!!!
reviews.text: Incredible. It is important to know that it is necessary to bring booties or diving shoes, there is no sand. The sea has a fascinating temperature and color, I recommend going mid-morning to appreciate the beauty with the full sun.

reviews.title: Must-to-do with caution (E-Bike)
reviews.text: We rode down to the beach on our e-bikes and what a wonderful and colorful memory it was. The beach is long and therefore not crowded. There is water from the showerhead for showering. The road is more good than bad. Caution is advised but it is still a must-do.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: Approaching Myrtos beach, you can see what all the fuss is about, simply breathtaking and stunning.Beach is glorious, rock foreshore which requires the special beach shoes for optimal experience, however waters are crystal clear and great for swimming.Snorkelling available is different areas , including near the cave.Beach chairs available for rent, parking okay , but get in early to be sure, toilets and shower, and cafe also available. Overall, fabulous experience and probable number 1 must visit in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach Kefalonia
reviews.text: The water is clear and Beautiful to swim in and look at.  Please note that it is a pebble beach so would recommend some wet shoes as it can be difficult to walk on.When you look down from the main road viewing point it looks like sand. Parking is plentyful but can get very busy in the afternoon.

reviews.title: A lovely beach
reviews.text: Busy busy busy. Lovely beach with one little cafe bar. Sunbeds €10 for 2 with umbrella which considering its a famous beach, is really good. We had a lovely peaceful day.

reviews.title: Amazing and memorable
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have been to and I have been to several around Greece. The water is quite cold though but nothing to deter you from being there. The waves are strong and the water can be deep as you enter. I wouldn't recommend it for small children unless supervised at ALL times. There are toilets there and a canteen to buy some water and snacks. The umbrella and 2 beds costs 10 euro with an extra 3 euro for each additional bed. The main thing to highlight is the drive, which is not for those scared of heights. Small cars are recommended, as the roads are narrow, dangerous and in some cases fit one car. So if you come across another car, it will be challenging to reverse or move to the edge due to cliffs with minimal barriers. You may see mountain goats on your drive which add to the areas beauty.  I would recommend going but only if you're ok with all the above.  We loved it! Just beautiful.

reviews.title: STUNNING SCENERY BUT NO FACILITIES
reviews.text: Views speak for themselves.  Beach is stunning and the water is crystal clear. However, nowhere to park car except on beach which I think is truly awful.  No beach bar or toilets.  So if you go there, make sure you have food & drink with you and a can to pee into!!

reviews.title: In the blue... painted blue💙
reviews.text: We toured almost all the Greek islands but Myrtos seen from above on a sunny day is inexplicable!!Pure wonder

reviews.title: The bathroom here overcomes the inconvenience of access
reviews.text: Water with incredible colors, but in August be aware that this beach (a single beach) is super crowded. We arrived on 2 wheels and luckily! The road to get to the car park is bumpy, downhill, unprotected and even frequented by coaches!! So if you don't want to ruin your day, set the alarm and arrive early. I imagine that in the low season it is a dream because a bath here is absolutely worth it. Not recommended for children who don't know how to swim, because I took three steps and I mean 3, and I already couldn't touch it anymore.

reviews.title: Azure
reviews.text: The views and the color of the water is simply stunning. The beach is a pebble  beach and when its windy the waves are too rough to swim in. There is a lifeguard on duty and serviced sunbeds and loungers but your are free to setup on your own also. Would recommend coming well supplied as the road up and down is steep.

reviews.title: Myrtos Stunner!
reviews.text: Stunning beach on the Island of Kefalonia, Greece. Beautiful drive and the hike here has to be one of my 3 best in the Mediterranean.

reviews.title: STUPENDOUS !
reviews.text: Amazing view !! Beach with beautiful colors! Worth a visit but you have to get down early at least before 10am otherwise the umbrellas are sold out! Worth seeing! The best beach in Kefalonia!

reviews.title: Like a poster
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing beauty. Like a movie, like a travel show. But I caught it on a windy day and I couldn't enjoy the water as much as I would love to. You can also have parachute there!

reviews.title: PARADISE, GO EARLY AND BRING FOOD FROM HOME
reviews.text: A paradise as long as you go there by 9.30 in August, bring food from home and choose the day carefully due to wind and rough seas especially with children.A surreal place of breathtaking beauty, at sea it feels like being in space... indescribable and absolutely worth seeing!To be seen in the morning at 9.30 in August because at 12 it loses its poetryThe tavern here only has horrible pre-packaged cold sandwiches, expensive and terrible

reviews.title: Beautiful, but chaotic and overcrowded.
reviews.text: The beach and the water are beautiful, the colors are mesmerizing, so much is true. What they don't tell or show you is the surrounding chaos. The beach is crowded with coaches full of groups coming down. There are sunbeds and parasols everywhere, but around 11:00 none of them will be available anymore. There are people arguing over parking spaces. Guides from the buses are screaming at people in cars to secure their spot.The road leading to the beach is very steep and everyone and his mother is trying to get down there. Also the people that shouldn't drive on these roads, leading to dangerous situations.So 5 stars for the beauty of the place. 1 star for the experience.If you don't mind big crowds, you're going to have a great time. If you don't like crowds of tourists, your experience could be a little stressful.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Truly the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia together with Petani Beach!Very large beach, both equipped and free, spectacular blue water.Unmissable!

reviews.title: Absolutely necessary to visit.
reviews.text: The beach is large, it has sunbeds and umbrellas ( 2 sundbeds and 1 umbrella 10 euro) but  you can also bring your own umbrella.  The  beach is covered with small and large pebbles, you should bring special footwear. The water becomes suddenly deep  with big waves. The blue shades of the water are  fantastic!You should come at the first hours of the morning because becomes crowded.

reviews.title: To be seen. But…
reviews.text: It is definitely a five-star beach, without any ifs or buts. Before arriving at the beach it is recommended to pass through the Myrtos Beach view, which allows you a panorama of the blue sea full of Myrtos. The beach has one big flaw: the sea. And I'm not referring to the color, but to the fact that finding the sea calm and flat is a lottery. I believe, but have not verified, that the best time is around 8:00/8:30 in the morning at the latest. Finding parking is not easy, you have to go down and hope that someone is leaving while you arrive. Beach made halfway between pebbles and sand. Worth seeing though if you pass through Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Stunning beach - well worth a visit!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with aquamarine blue sea. Best to arrive early to get a sun-bed and good parking spot. Sea was lovely to swim in but waves powerful and slopes away steeply. Not very suitable for small kids. Would definitely recommend visiting but arrive early!!

reviews.title: Caribbean Blue in Kefalonia
reviews.text: The road to the beach is in good condition, practicable by any car, and the scenery wonderful. The car park is full after 10 o'clock. There is a beach bar, and the sunbed fee is 10 Euro, but there is enough space and privacy for your own umbrellas. The water is an unreal blue, the scenery dramatic, and a lot of powerful big waves. The entrance to the sea is steep, and the currents quite strong.

reviews.title: Rubbish everywhere. Disgusting abuse of somewhere so beautiful.
reviews.text: Over crowded , over used litter everywhere. I was so disappointed and angry. How can anyone let such a beautiful beautiful setting get so trashed.   The cigarette butts , plastic and other rubbish in the sea was gross, it made me feel sick.

reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.text: White pebble beach and spectacular sea, not transparent due to the seabed which goes down almost immediately, but beautiful colour. The only flaw is that the road is a bit bumpy, otherwise a very pleasant day

reviews.title: Excellent beach, scarce facilities
reviews.text: Named in top 10 world beaches by many magazines and agencies, Myrtos certainly deserves it.Dramatic setting between two huge cliffs with gel like aqua marine water is best seen from the road view point up. Zig zag paved road (10 y ago it was gravel road) takes you down there, so no problem to access it. Once down, parking is the biggest problem - we circled almost half an hour to get a spot (parking is free).Beach is long and wide, so despite huge number of people in July peak season it didn't seem crowded. Water is movie like, simply gorgeous.However, there's only one establishment selling food and drinks and renting sunbeds. Lines are huge and food junk with inflated prices (ordinary bakery stuff, didn't see nothing below 5 euros a piece). We stayed some 2,5-3 hours and moved to Antisamos beach which has much more facilities.

reviews.title: Hidden Paradise
reviews.text: Amazing beach, crystal clear waters. If you visit Kefalonia this beach is a must. A hidden paradise residing in Greece.

reviews.title: Colors of paradise, hellish journey
reviews.text: Undeniably crazy colours, but everything else is a nightmare: the merciless crowd at the car park after 10.30am, sunbeds and umbrellas sold out already at dawn, a small bar to serve an entire beach, cars everywhere along the road which make the dangerous journey, and we traveled by car, I can't imagine with a scooter. Pebble beach and immediately high water, rock shoes recommended. Defining the beach as "equipped" is an understatement.

reviews.title: Magnificent beach
reviews.text: Nice and long beach, with beautiful colors. It has some umbrellas but most people set up their own. It is definitely worth a visit for anyone who hasn't been, certainly the times to arrive before 11 are the most suitable for parking and to sit wherever you want!

reviews.title: Enchanting
reviews.text: The glance between the turquoise and blue of the sea makes you forget the color of the sky.Before you even arrive you want to dive in.The road to get there, even if it is asphalted, is not easy due to the cars and the presence of sand. Especially if you find yourself visiting it with a scooter. Convenient to leave it anywhere to admire this wonder up close..The beach is characterized by smooth white pebbles. . Better to wear appropriate footwear.The sea is gorgeous. Found a windy but pleasant day and slightly rough sea. But the spectacle of colors and the view that opens up to you cannot be compared to the difficulties encountered.The undertow created on the pebbles emits a sound never heard anywhere in the world. It seems that the sea has its own voice... what can I say, simply wonderful, to the point of returning again before leaving

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Viewed from above. Quite busy in high season and parking difficult. There are even coaches going down.

reviews.title: Colors never seen before
reviews.text: Suddenly paradise. From above, before arriving, you are left breathless: you don't see turquoise like this anywhere else. Once on the beach you are surrounded by the beauty of the colors. Impressive

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: Beautiful white pebble beach. For my taste, it's not very wild, that is, well organized with umbrellas and services and very busy.Definitely worth seeing but out of season

reviews.title: Screw all that!  A total zoo!
reviews.text: Never again!Stop at the look out points along the high road as you approach and take the proverbial “been there done that picture!”Don’t drive to the bottom, lest you have a desire to get stuck, risk life and limb in the ridiculous traffic jams created by every idiot and his brother who got their driver’s license via correspondence course, OR drown in the high surf.That’s assuming you survive the ride to the area.Take the pix and go elsewhere to enjoy your day and different beach.A total waste of energy, time and treasure as far as a beach goes.I am done!

reviews.title: To admire rather than swim in
reviews.text: More beautiful from above than up close. Strong chromatic contrasts between the light blue of the sea and the white pebbles, but also dangerous due to the step that forms a few meters after the shore and the undertow that is present in case of slightly rough seas. Not suitable for snorkeling. Acceptable establishment prices, limited parking, the road to get there is asphalted but not exactly simple.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in kefalonia
reviews.text: An amazing beach, well worth the hair raising drive down! Parking is a bit tricky but it’s so stunning, it’s not to be missed. A beach bar and sun beds and showers are available. A fantastic day out!

reviews.title: A sea of relaxation
reviews.text: White sandy beach with pebbles. Accessible barefoot. Turquoise sea.Pros: umbrella with two deckchairs €10, large free parking. (I recommend arriving early)Flaws: small bar for the large and renamed beach where it is located.The sea immediately becomes deep. To be considered for families.Ps: there are no waspsOverall great experience.

reviews.title: beautiful from above, azure blue, pebbles, simple meals, no guardrails on the way there
reviews.text: Positive:- very nice view from above to the bay, beautiful- azure blue water- pebbles but reasonable to walk on- showers on the beach- free parkingNegative:- the road there has hairpin bends and no guardrails, which is why we have only been here once, we thought it was dangerous, especially with oncoming traffic- Seawater deep quite quickly- Not a restaurant for an extensive lunch, but an opportunity where you can get some simple things such as hot dogs, ham/cheese sandwich, pizza slice, etc.come early because of parking- We prefer Petani, a similar bay but with good restaurants and a better road with guardrails. The view from the top of Myrtos is the most beautiful

reviews.title: A panorama that leaves you speechless
reviews.text: Beach with breathtaking views, the water is a surreal blue (as seen in the photos) and you can immediately notice the contrast with the blue of the sea offshore. The beach is sand mixed with pebbles (I recommend shoes) and there are free showers and cabins. The road is steep in the final stretch and the terrain leading to the (free) parking is gravel. There is only one well-stocked bar and two sunbeds and an umbrella cost €10.It would be advisable to check the winds before going there, as we found the sea to be too rough with high waves, so much so that it was difficult to swim.

reviews.title: Viewpoint
reviews.text: This beach looks amazing and breath taking from the view point. But it's a long winding road to get down to it. And then when you get there you find out that it's lots of white rocks.

reviews.title: Not naturally beautiful water color
reviews.text: A great place for everyone, except that young children should drip in the sea under the care of adults due to the high waves...beautiful color of the water, clean beach..there may be a problem with parking the car

reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.text: This beach has an amazing view. I recommend to all to visit at least one time. The single inconvenience is that there are so many rocks there.

reviews.title: A beach not to miss.
reviews.text: This is definitely a beach worth adding to your itinerary. I would recommend going early if you are driving as parking is limited. I arrived at 10.30 and there was plenty of spaces. The drive down is long, with air pin bends but don’t let this put you off. The road is in good condition and as I’ve noticed most locals are patient with holiday drivers. When you get down there the beach is your reward. Shingles beach, the best thing I packed was beach shoes. There are clean toilets, parking is free. There is a bar serving cold/ hot food, reasonably priced. Probably one of the best beaches I visited, if not the best.

reviews.title: So much could be improved
reviews.text: I was lucky to visit Myrtos on a non windy day and really enjoyed the water. However there is much to improve upon:The beach bar is operated by the municipality themselves instead of auctioning to a private entity as the majority of other beaches do. So the people that work there are civil servants and they have such a mentality too. At 17:30 they all go home leaving hundreds of people who thought they cameto an organised beach, without food and water. Furthermore, the sunbeds are not even close to enough for the number of visitors the beach gets and are placed very far from the sea, close to the beach bar. As a result, visitors who cant find a free sunbed / umbrella, bring their own and sunbed customers cant see the waters. Finally, the beach bar had run out of most items by 15:00, seems nobody cares to order stock according to the demand due to the monopoly of the situation. If you dont like it after all, you can walk up a kilometer which is where you parked, drive your car to the nearby village and get something to eat.

reviews.title: Nice but not the first
reviews.text: According to most it is the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia and one of the best in Greece. In fact the water has beautiful colors typical of the Mediterranean sea but in my opinion it comes after Petani beach. There is a choice between a free or equipped beach, the prices are modest, in line with those of Kefalonia, between 10 and 15 euros for an umbrella and 2 sunbeds. Like many beaches on the island it’s made of pebbles.

reviews.title: Stunning views, great beach!
reviews.text: Great beach with stunning views! Sea was nice and warm too. We went at 5pm and although it was still very hot, it wasn’t too busy. The roads are tight to get up and down there so if you are not a confident driver be warned! Some great views on the drive otherwise. There are changing and WC facilities down there which are free to use which is handy too. Definitely worth a visit if you are in kefalonia.

reviews.title: Don’t believe the hype
reviews.text: Horrible beach, parking awful, just dump your car anywhere down the cliff road, sticking out? No issue just put on hazards. The toilets are Dirty, one ‘eating drinking place’ whucdikd hot dogs or pastry things, and juice etc. little seating and what there was was filled with cool guys with feet up, if you want an instra photo fill your boots, but there are better beaches with better parking, I fail to see why this is voted best beach, do NOT believe the hype, stay away.

reviews.title: Lovely day at this beautifully located beach.
reviews.text: Anyone visiting Myrtos Beach in July and expecting it not to be busy has some seriously unrealistic expectations I would suggest. Yes, the beach was busy but to be honest I've seen more packed beaches in the UK at the first sign of sun. I can also see that if you drive down it is perhaps quite stressful given the hairpin bends and amount of cars but this is not the beach's fault. We took a taxi from Fiskardo, which cost 45 Euros each way and took approx 40 minutes. The beach is in a beautiful location. It is a shingle beach, so beach shoes were useful. The sea was blue, clean and clear. There were plenty of sunbeds, which were very reasonable at 10 Euros for 2 plus a parasol. The beach cafe was clean, well stocked with drinks and snacks and we didn't experience (or see) any long queues. Toilets are of the portaloo type but again were clean and stocked with toilet paper. Perhaps previous reviewers had a particularly bad experience but it was certainly not ours, we had a lovely day. The earlier you arrive, the quieter it is.

reviews.title: Fabulous Beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach.  We went early, arrived at about 10am and parking was fine.  Got ourselves a couple of beds and a shade and stayed there all day.  The sea is warm (July).  There is a beach bar at the back of the beach and also toilets and showers.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I have to agree that this beach looks the part from the top road, makes for a lovely photograph.The only problem is when you get down to it it’s a big disappointment, very stony and overcrowded when we visited in July. And the facilities are not up to much either, it would be way down on my list of best beaches in Kefalonia in fact bottom of all I’ve visited so far much hyped but failed to deliver.

reviews.title: Nightmare with stunning views
reviews.text: Nightmare parking Impossible Parking Crowded Badly organised Nightmare Never go there Plus sideGreat views Stunning location Just to crowded with buses and cars parked everywhere!!!

reviews.title: Like nothing you have ever seen!
reviews.text: This beach is paradise!!! The most beautiful beach I have ever been to! The moment you walk down steps you find yourself in heaven. There are no words to describe this beauty!!!

reviews.title: Short visit but definarely worth it as a point of interest if you are driving.
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach, pure white pebbles creating a spectacular array of colours of the sea. Well worth the visit just to see it. When we went swimming was not possible due to the waves but it was still very busy. Be prepared for limited parking even though the parking area along the beach is big, and very narrow and windy road down.

reviews.title: Better beaches on the island
reviews.text: There is no doubt this is a beautiful beach.. however the decent up and down is treacherous .. cars parked everywhere, extremely tight hairpin bends, dealing with large coaches, no barriers, people walking up and down.. When we finally managed to get down, we drove on straight back up.. there are thousands of people here with only one cafe bar and a couple of portable toilets.. so I can only imagine how dirty the sea water must of been. Not a pleasant experience at all and there are more beaches that are just as pretty if not more so with far fewer people and better facilities. Save yourself the trip, it really is not worth it!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with nice amenities. Sunbeams, snackbar, restrooms.  The view from above the beach is spectacular. The water was incredible!

reviews.title: A great photo point from the top but that’s it
reviews.text: A little disappointed. Stunning views of the beach from the top but when you go down you realise it isn’t a sandy beach but white pebbles which give it the white sand effect. Very uncomfy to lie on as there are no sun beds here. The many coaches bringing tourists descend on the beach so like ants and the entrance into the water is impossible without water shoes and then the water is cloudy with poor visibility for snorkelling.  It makes a great photo but that’s it

reviews.title: Beach visit
reviews.text: Excellent beach like many on kefalonia it has crystal clear waters and is very picturesque, ideal for families, rock shoes are advisable like most beaches its,a mixture of sand and small stones I would definitely recommend going

reviews.title: Breathtakingly beautiful
reviews.text: Breathtakingly beautiful!The weather let us down on the day we visited , nevertheless the beach was so beautiful and so peaceful.The beach is very clean and there is a small cafe for drinks .After watching the movie Captain Corellis mandolin, which was filmed on this island, it was amazing to actually visit and view such gorgeous locations.

reviews.title: Possibly my favourite
reviews.text: Absolutely hit the spot for me … just beautiful!Obviously your experience will differ depending on the weather and number of other visitors, in our case the variables were just right.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach is Wonderful
reviews.text: Wind? Waves? Mega-Crowds? Danger? Not for us. We completely enjoyed this stunning, amazing beach experience. Water shoes are a must, along with water and snacks. I would go back in a heartbeat!

reviews.title: Paradise in motion
reviews.text: Early morning start for the entripds.. we jumped in to the rental car and fired up the engine, it spurted in to life as ever reliable. Our plan today was to navigate the mountain passes to Sami.. As we drove we experienced an invasion of our senses, the smells of kefalonia forever in our senses and thoughts. The lush countryside playing out in front of our eyes, the locals sitting by roadside cafes drinking coffee and slowing their heartbeats even lower in the flat line island. As we passed we could smell the thick coffee beans and the hum of distant tractors in the fields Sarah turned to me and asked what time it was.. I didn't know and further more didn't care, time stands till here. We only think about time when the sun is up and it's food time. So I turned left towards Porus. Continue over the mountain passes and eventually we spy Myrtos beach. What a wonderful sight and at the same time a frightening one.. Our little fiat Panda now turns in to a 4x4 mens machine as we traverse the hairpin bends and wild mountain goats springing to attention around the vertical drops. After navigating what appears to be something out of the Italian job bends we see the beautiful Myrtos beach and guess what it's free parking and the beach is clean and welcoming. It has small pebbles but you can place your towel down and immerse yourself in to these pebbles. In high season they put out sun beds and there's a lovely beach hut selling wares and food/drink. There's also clean spacious toilets and changing rooms not like the grubby UK resorts with filthy toilets and amenities. We settled down and relax.. sun, sea and lovely company in this paradise of Myrtos beach. When we were there they were paragliding which was a sight to see. Bad points. Nil. Unless you call the hairpin experience. Everything is great good old kefalonia keeps on giving.

reviews.title: Great looking beach. Little hard to park in high season. Go with sea shoes or with a boat.
reviews.text: Great extra large with white pebbles beach. Really beautiful colour of the water. Scenery is amazing. Not great to walk on the pebbles though. Also a bit hard to park in high season.

reviews.title: Absolute bliss.
reviews.text: We visited at the end of May and were blown away. This has to be one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!The beach was easy to access by car. There were a couple of small pull overs on the way down to admire the view and there was plenty of free parking at the bottom (it was only the start of the season so I'm not sure how busy it would get in the peak summer months).The beach is pebbly and not sandy - I would recommend wearing some sea shoes/sandles as the drop into the water from the beach is steep and quite difficult and uncomfortable to walk down/up with bare feet.There were no cafes on the beach but plenty of small shops from which you can buy drinks etc.from at the crossroads as you turn down to the beach from the main road.Advice - bring swimshoes, bring plenty of drinks/snacks and an umbrella as there is no shady areas.

reviews.title: More than worth the drive.
reviews.text: Beautiful white stone beach. Sea was cool but really refreshing. There’s a free car park at the bottom.  Not sure if there’s a bar in high season. There’s a small building but this was closed up. Word of warning - it gets hot down there and unless you take your own parasol there’s no shade to be found. The sun bounces up off the white stone as well.  It’s hot, and we were there in May!  It’s not warmed up yet! It’s a totally relaxing beach though. There’s no music blaring, no one shouting. Just the beautiful view of the mountains and the sea. When you leave stop at the top to take a look at the stunning view. If you don’t like heights hold someone’s hand!

reviews.title: Intsa worthy and spectacular!
reviews.text: The descent wasn’t as bad as expected after reading other reviews - decent road surface compared to some other beach tracks we’ve explored whilst in Kefalonia but if you’re a nervous driver you might find it a bit daunting. Appreciate that we visited early in the season so didn’t have any problems with meeting vehicles coming the other way or parked on the road. The view points on the way down provide breathtaking vistas of the beach and Instagram worthy photo opportunities! Striking white beach with spectacular turquoise waters. What’s not to love?!The beach itself is made up of millions of small beautiful white pebbles and not sand, so be prepared and being suitable shoes for wearing into and out of the sea, otherwise you’ll be crawling out on all fours in an ungainly fashion and looking like you’re on the way home after a heaving night in Malia (not my husbands best look 🤣)The caves to the left of the beach are pretty cool. Plenty of parking (although this may get very busy as the summer progresses). Facilities weren’t open, but we expected that given that it was early in the season. The beach was lovely and clean - other reviews indicate that’s not the case and again, perhaps so as the beach gets busier but all in all, it was well worth the journey from the south of the island.

reviews.title: Spectacular views but take appropriate footwear…
reviews.text: We went in may when the beach wasn’t busy and nor was the road in…I imagine it could be different in the peak season. Steep descent down…but the road better than many others we have done this week. Lots of (free) parking. Stunning views. Crystal clear water and a great cave off at the far end (south). Toilets weren’t open though yet (just a dodgy portaloo) and although it looks like there will be a bar, not open yet. Can imagine it would be an amazing spot to watch sun go down. Main recommendation is to take good beach footwear…the stories about the pebbles are true. Have to confess I was crawling out of the sea on all fours.

reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.text: Fantastic view from above is a must before venturing down to the beach, the beach like most on the island is a mixture of pebbles and sand, the water is crystal clear with a blue tint offering a picture perfect image.Would recommend to anyone visiting the island

reviews.title: "Top 10 In The World"??????
reviews.text: We stopped on the road well above the beach for a photo op. Yes, the location surrounded on three sides by steep sandstone cliffs is quite spectacular and the azure waters of the Ionian Sea amazingly beautiful but I don't believe it ranks in the world's Top 10 beaches as our guide intimated!!!! Great photos though!!

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach on the planet
reviews.text: We landed here after hearing how wonderful the beach was. Although we are out of season and nothing was open here, the beach was deserted so we had it to ourselves. It didn’t disappoint- we went in a fairly windy day and the waves were amazing. And the blue of the sea - the pictures don’t do it justice. I can imagine in summer it would be packed but late April and September, the locals say is best time to come. Things are more open and weather is not windy.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Waht an amazin beach, the views, the water and plenty of facilities while you are there. Excellent location, accessed by a twisty and winding mountain road.

reviews.title: Beautiful water
reviews.text: Totally deserted. Had beach pretty much all to ourselves. Plenty of parking. Not sandy, but small rocks. Once in water was delightful

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning
reviews.text: Unbelievably  stunning beach. A must visit. We visited out of season and it was virtually an empty beach!

reviews.title: Spectacular spot
reviews.text: Indeed a spectacular beach accessed by a steep twisting road Very well organised with beach beds, showers and toilets. Has a small cafeteria which is ok for a light snack and drinkPebbles and not sand but despite that well worth a visitEnjoy the views from above

reviews.title: Not as amazing as it’s reputation
reviews.text: Went because of the hype, it was quite a trek to get there by car down treacherous cliff edge mountainous roads. The colour of the water is certainly stunning. To be fair, once we got there we found out the water us choppier in the afternoons. For us, the water was so tough with huge waves crashing before hitting the beach we didn’t actually go in. Took some photos and left. There is one bar/snack facility down there, don’t know prices. Also several camper vans parked up where people were staying on the beach. One to tick off,but just wouldn’t bother to come back.

reviews.title: A Must do in my opinion.
reviews.text: We last visited here 16 years ago and it's really good to see that the facilities down here have improved vastly,good clean toilets nowadays and a decent restaurant.As we only wanted a cooling swim on the drive back to Lassi from Fiskardo we didn't bother paying for sunbeds,but unfortunately none of us had brought the definitely required sea shoes to get into the water,so quite a painful difficult experience to get to the water.The sea was relatively calm during our visit so a delight to enjoy the cool clear waters.

reviews.title: Stunning myrtos beach
reviews.text: Wow what can you say absolutely stunning beach, beautiful trip down to the beach stunning views , the sea is the most amazing blue colours never seen so many different shades of blue

reviews.title: Stunning beach.
reviews.text: This beach is one of the most stunning beaches I've ever seen. The views from the top of the cliffs are amazing. There are plenty of amenities on the beach, food, drink, changing rooms, toilets and showers. There was also a lifeguard. Definitely worth a visit, especially when the waves are up. The beach itself is pebbly so I would recommend beach shoes or flip flops.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A beautiful white pebble beach at the bottom of a winding hill road. Plenty of sun beds, good clean toilets and snack bar. The sea is crystal clear. A little difficult to get in and out as you sink into the pebbles but once you’re in it’s refreshing. A must visit in Kefolonia.

reviews.title: Wow, amazing beach and fabulous facilities
reviews.text: An amazing Greek beach with crystal clear water. Excellent toilet facilities, free parking, changing cubicles and a large cafe serving food and snacks. Highly recommended!!

reviews.title: Dirty Sea
reviews.text: I would say if you came here today you’d have to avoid the scum and what looks like effluent when you get in the water. Great shame, maybe boats dumping their load, not sure but not pleasant either. 😢💩

reviews.title: Stunning turquoise beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach with a really nice turquoise water surrounded by a huge white coast. We enjoyed it so much that we went there twice during our stay.For the first day, the water was calm so we could swim around, but in the second day, the fun was unleashed by the big and nervous waves that were smashing the beach!!! Also, on Myrotos beach, we had the most incredible sunset.Unfortunately, in August, it is very crowded, full of cars parked along the road.

reviews.title: Beautiful bit of heaven!
reviews.text: We drove from the resort of Lixouri to Myrtos beach, what a scary drive around the very winding mountains , lots of gear changes, but well worth it to see a little piece of heaven! You have to arrive before 10am if you don’t want to have to park on the road and walk down the cliff side.  There are toilets, sun beds  and umbrellas (10 euros for 2) as well as a beach bar which sells cold drinks, ice cream and other snacks. Bring swim shoes as it is a very pebbly beach as with many in Kefalonia if you truly want to enjoy the sea.

reviews.title: Truely stunning beach BUT not family friendly
reviews.text: Amazing beach, views and everything but if the wind is inward blowing, you CAN NOT swim as the waves are 2 to 2.5 meters high. It's not family friendly at all as the water depth goes from knee hight to 2+ meters deep in a space of 2 meters! There's a great little cafe. A must visit but just be careful with the sea.

reviews.title: Nice for photograph taking
reviews.text: An overrated mess!  The beach is wonderful for the photograph taking, and there is an access road to it, which works unless there is a bus in the way, when it becomes suicidal.  Beautiful blue water, whereas the beach itself  is a dusty overheated pot with pebbles.  Just like everything else, parking is improvised.  Recommended for rented vehicles only.   At the end of the beach there is a small cave and it is interesting to swim through it, although there is a sign saying hat access is forbidden due to rock slide, which no one pays attention to.  The entrance to the sea is the best close to the cave.  Nice to see, take a photo and never come back.  Kefalonia has a serious issue with roads.

reviews.title: dissapointing
reviews.text: This place takes a great picture due to the stunning colour of the water and the contrast with the white beach. However, beauty is only skin deep and in every other respect this is not a good beach in my opinion.The beach is composed of chalk pebbles which are quite painful on the feet and the water is often very choppy and the water gets deep quickly, so beware, particularly if you go with kids. The water looks so cool because it's full of chalk dust, but this makes it impossible to see anything in the water unless you swim pretty far out.Lots of tour boats come here and hang around off the beach...and flush their toilets into the water! I swam out and had an unfortunate encounter with a load of poo!You can hire loungers, but if they are all taken then you might be able to hire parasols from the lifeguard hut, otherwise you'll spend your whole time under the relentless sun. There is a beach bar but didn't go in there.The whole place is in a pretty stark and unforgiving setting and it's like you are on a beach in the middle of a desert. Didn't enjoy the experience at all and there are far better beaches elsewhere on the island.Parking is also a pain.If you are passing by, then pop in for a while if you can park, but no point in making a special journey. I won't be going again.

reviews.title: Best sunset in the island
reviews.text: Water is beau, you can find place in the afternoon on chair and umbrella… the sunset is amazing, Bring your drinks and speaker and enjoy a perfect sunset

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text: Loved this beach. From other reviews I wasn’t expecting to enjoy myself so much, but apart from the pebbles being bothersome (make sure to wear shoes to walk down to the water), the beach was quiet and clean and the water absolutely stunning in both colour and temperature. I arrived at 1130 and had no troubles getting a park (free to park). I did not find the swell at the beach dangerous when I was there. The view from the lookout, or even if you pullover driving up to the top, is incredible. Highly recommend this beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful but difficult
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous, pebbly and it’s pretty painful to get into the water without a good pair of water shoes. I have knee problems, so wouldn’t recommend it for others with the same dilemma.

reviews.title: Stunning beach and beautifully clear water to snorkel in
reviews.text: We hired a car and drove there from Skala after visiting mellisani cave. Stunning views as you drive down to it. Looks deceptively like white sand but it’s actually pebbles. Cars park all along the road that winds down to the beach. I would recommend that you drive right to the bottom then start from there to find a space as there are people coming and going all the time.  I would highly recommend buying a parasol from the shop in the little town at the top before you drive down  (around €13) as there is no shade unless you hire a sunbed.We just wanted to snorkel and had beach shoes with us so when we reached the rocks it was easy to clamber around. Spent a wonderful couple of hours snorkelling around the rocks in the beautifully scenic bay.

reviews.title: Take a photo and move on!
reviews.text: The colour of the water is dramatic no doubt. But as others have said, take a photo and move on. Horrible road down to the beach with no barrier. The beach itself is all stones and the sea gets deep really quickly. Water was very rough (though no wind) and I certainly wouldn’t recommend going in unless you were a very strong swimmer. Definitely not good for children, at least when we went. There are life guards on duty though which tells you something. Car parking ok and there is a beach bar. There are much nicer beaches elsewhere on the Island.

reviews.title: What a Wonderful Beach
reviews.text: What a wonderful beach. One of the best I have ever seen or been to, anywhere. The view from the high road was amazing and hardly changed as I came down to sea level. On this day there were about 150 cars and possible 400 people. Beachside bars, shops, water rinse station and bathrooms. Everybody was having fun and getting a "little cooked" in the 40 degree temperature.

reviews.title: Do take a photo from the above, then move on!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, no doubt, but not suitable for swimming (too rough, not clear water)  or relaxing by the beach (too pebbly, too busy) during high season.  I am sure it is lovely if you visit there like May or September? A car park was full by 1030am in mid-July and frankly speaking, there are many other wonderful beaches in Kefalonia.  Although there was NO WIND on the day we visited, the sea was still so rough that we could not swim for long.  Plus the water is murky and has no visibility.
