Be very careful if you have little ones - it gets so deep so quickly -like 1 meter in from the beach, you cannot reach the bottom.  I would recommend you take a photo from the top of the hill, take in the gorgeous view, and then swiftly head to Assos or other places on the island.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Bring water shoes! So glad we did but the beach is almost all small river rock and is very challenging to navigate bare-footed and in the water. There seem to be new facilities at the beach with a bar/cafe, restrooms and changing rooms. The water is ridiculously warm but not as clear as some of the other waters in greece.

reviews.title: Great beach but busy
reviews.text: A magnificent beach that needs beach shoes to cope with the pebbles. Busy though and the beach bar has little to offer.Come early to get parking by the beach, otherwise it could be a steep walk.

reviews.title: Love the beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world.  However, due to it being open to the sea, with no island protection, it has extremely strong undercurrents and is difficult to swim.  Great to visit, and relax, not for swimming.  Pretty decent beach bar too.

reviews.title: Spoilt by sewage
reviews.text: We have been to Kephalonia many many times and Myrtos was my favourite beach. Very sadly we went in June and there was raw sewage floating in the water. We can only assume that a boat or boats had emptied their bilge tanks into the water and it was disgusting. There was s**t in the sea and lots of it. We got out very quickly and showered and left immediately.The beach itself is stunning - yes it looks like white sand from the top but it is white pebbles when you get down onto it. You need beach shoes to get into the water. Sadly this wasn't our only experience of the water being dirty, last year we were there and there were bits of food floating around. I don't know how they can police this but they cannot let the boats empty their tanks into the bay. It really was disgusting and very dangerous if you were in there and swallowed the water.

reviews.title: Uncomfortable but “wow” view
reviews.text: Beautiful view but that was all. Uncomfortable sunbeds, no tavernas or bars. We went back to Gradakia beach after 1h.

reviews.title: Looks great and inviting from the road
reviews.text: We have driven passed Myrtos beach a few times in the past and the beach looks so inviting so much so that during our last stay in May we decided to drive down the winding road to the beach. When we parked we were very surprised and disappointed that the beach was made up of large pebbles and no sand.There weren’t any facilities such as bar's, cafe's consequently we stayed for 5 minutes then drove away.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Beautiful!! White pebbly beach and turquoise waters, can be very busy and parking difficult so would go early. A must see while there. Great restaurant in the village just before the turning for the beach.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and breathtaking coloursPeacefull and amazing place to visit!When in kefalonia id a must!

reviews.title: It's alright
reviews.text: Need to arrive by 10am to rent a sunbed and brolly, / or bring your own - no shade anywhere. We got really lucky at midday, the rental girl took pity on us with 3yr old. Fairly steep shelf into the sea, strong waves and very strong pull back out - not the best place for small kids but we had fun for an hour. High point was the wow factor when the beach swings into view from the road. Great to visit if you're near or passing, but the hour drive up from Skala broadly wasn't worth the effort.

reviews.title: Beautiful views from above, overrated beach below.
reviews.text: Definitely worth stopping at the viewing point along the road on the way to/back from Fiskardo and Asos (would recommend visiting both) to look out at the coast line and beautifully blue sea, but not worth going specifically for the beach and swimming. The sea has a VERY strong backwash and you can get easily knocked over. It also gets deep quite quickly, so the waves break on you, which really put us off swimming. I would suggest the beach it’s more suited for a strong and confident swimmer. Also worth noting it’s a pebble beach. It wasn’t too busy when we visited around 6pm and there was plenty of parking. The drive down is steep and winding, take it slow if you visit. Overall, we definitely preferred the beach from the viewing point along the road, than spending time on the beach below. There are nicer beaches across Kefalonia to sunbathe and swim at. We would recommend Antisamos (near Sami) and Skala or Kaminia (in the south).

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: It’s a cool beach, busy and the sea can be lively. Nice beach bar and showers, parasols, toilets etc. gets very very hot and not a great deal of natural shade.

reviews.title: Blue blue sea
reviews.text: One of the bluest water beaches I’ve been too and we’ve been to Caribbean Maldives USA. This is definitely a beautiful place. Strong waves make it hard for weaker swimmers to get in but it’s soo pretty.

reviews.title: Myrtos viewpoint - great use of our time on the last day of holiday, mostly in air conditioned car, but great sights not to be m
reviews.text: Myrtos view point - We didn't go down on to the beach this time, as we did this trip on the day of our return flight. Checked out of villa in Trapezaki at 10am, drove along the main coast road from Argostoli to Assos for lunch, stopped at the Mrtos viewpoint on the way back and was at the Airport for a little before 2pm.The roads are good, as in the surface is clear, mostly flat and wide enough for 2 cars to pass at almost all points along the way. Spectacular views (for passengers) all the way. On the way back towards Argostoli, you are on the correct side of the road to pull in to the view point easily. But you can also do it from the other direction. I'd say there is enough room for 6 to 8 cars. If there is a tour bus parked up, this obviously leaves less space. Worth the journey and great use of our time on the last day of holiday, mostly in air conditioned car, but great sights not to be missed.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Overrated beach with very hairy drive down/up. Stop and view from top and carry on to a much nicer beach just down the coast  Agia Kyriaki (must quieter and calmer) The beach gets very busy so best to arrive before 10 am. Rough sea when we went - do not go in with sunglasses!!!

reviews.title: The best beach in the world!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have ever been to in my life! Incredible green and blue waters that impress you from the first moment! very deep sea but if you are lucky and there is no wave it will be one of the most beautiful experiences of your life!

reviews.title: way-way overated
reviews.text: Way-way overrated! The water may look like this from a drone, but when you swim, it's not as clear at all. It gets deep very close to the shore and there are only stones, not sand. There is only one bar operating on the beach, so everything is expensive and you have very little choice for food and beverages. The umbrella and long chairs are rented for 10 EUR, but they keep renting them multiple times per day (when we left, at noon, another couple came and they rented the same umbrella again, which I am not sure is legal). Anyway, it;s nicer to see the beach from one of the belvedere spots along the road, than to spend time on the beach. Totally not appropriate f or children.

reviews.title: Nice beach, lots of space but no nicer than others in Kef
reviews.text: We finally made it onto the beach (rather than just looking down on it!)  last week & we had a mostly pleasant afternoon. As others have said, the beach definitely looks better from the road above. It’s nice enough when you drive down to it (yes the roads are a bit hairy but then that’s Kefalonia) but no prettier than other beaches I’ve visited. A vast bay means there’s plenty of room for everyone. My husband was stung by a jellyfish as soon as we entered the water which was a bit of a downer but he survived! So we stuck to the beach after that. A nice beach to visit just to say you’ve done it.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Wonderful beach for sure.Come early if you want to have a car place and sunbeds, or take your own umbrella with you. It’s burning hot without, no shades.Beach is a mix of sand and pebbels

reviews.title: Must see!
reviews.text: Can understand why it’s one of the most photographed beach in Greece. Absolutely incredible views and we even managed to watch the sunset from there.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Beautiful beach Pebbles but smooth completely round ones white The day we went down to myrtos sadly so had the jellyfish so couldn’t go in The lifeguard was telling people to stay out of the sea shame as it was lovely and calm it’s usually quiet rough

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviews.text: Family of 9. Very rough water the day we were there.  Very rocky beach that was difficult to walk on.  Water shoes recommended. Fee for use of umbrellas and chairs. Refreshing!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach authentic and brilliant scenery although is majorly busy therefore water is not very clear and is costly and difficult to get a sun bed but all in all a amazing beach

reviews.title: Beautiful sunset. Beautifull beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful sunset. Beautifull beach. It has both sun beds and no sun beds areas. The water is light blue and the beach is full of small white pebbles.

reviews.title: A lovely way to cool down after a lunch in Assos/Αsos
reviews.text: Amazing rock beach, now with life guards, kiosk, showers & free parking right beside the beach. Take your rock hopping beach shoes!!

reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY STUNNING
reviews.text: Breathtaking from high above, even more stunning down by the water, super refreshing in the sea. Unforgettable

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach.
reviews.text: Absolutely amazingly beautiful beach with picture postcard views. It is not a sandy beach it is very smooth pebbles, we took beach shoes to make it easier to get in and out of the water. The pebbles were also surprisingly comfortable to lie on, just arrange the pebbles to suit your body shape. A must place to visit if your in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: Great beach, long drive down to it!! Plenty of parking available. Small beach bar, not sure of prices / stock as we didn’t use it. Changing rooms and toilets available next to it.The beach is long and wide but you need to take your beach/rock shoes unless you’ve got thick leathery skin on the soles of your feet!! 😂No sun beds or parasols available when we visited, so if you can bring along your own!!The view down to the beach from the roadside above is stunning, well worth the drive out alone. 😎👍

reviews.title: Wow wow
reviews.text: Wow. This truly is a stunning beach. Probably one of the most photographed beaches in the world, and you can see why. White glistening sand and turquoise blue waters. This really is a taste of paradise.

reviews.title: Picture postcard beautiful.
reviews.text: Stunning. Vast. Painted turquoise sea. A beach not to miss.Plenty of free parking..Easy to find. We stopped here for a couple of hours enroute to Fiscardo for lunch.

reviews.title: Did not disappoint!
reviews.text: Absolutely unreal, beautiful and worth the trip- I have to recommend you take a parasol, beach shoes and food water as there were no facilities but it was worth the drive over

reviews.title: Super visit on your Way to Asos
reviews.text: Defently s super visit. Nice cave and super water With deep blue Ocean With Nice small gravel rocks that gives Nice Sound on the wawes

reviews.title: Look around!
reviews.text: Visit other beaches on Kefalonia before saying 'this is the most amazing beach on the island/in the world'  because, honestly, its not. The colour of the water IS amazing but so is it at Petani/Atheras and multiple other beaches. Atheros has 2 taverns but no beds, with a swallow beach, not tidal but that's the appeal. Petani has 2 taverns, beds, kayaks, pedalos, deeper water but no strong currents, and is way prettier a beach than Myrtos.

reviews.title: Lovely beach!! Narrow road and no restaurant there 🥳
reviews.text: People say it is the most beautiful beach of the island! I saw it from above and it looks amazing. I will drive down these days. I was told to swim in the middle and be cautious of the drag of the waves. Best to be safe than sorry and not swim at least at this beach 🥳🙏🏼 Cristal clear waters!! There are no bathrooms, chairs or restaurant. Bring your water and food 🙏🏼🥳

reviews.title: Wow what a view
reviews.text: This beach is picture post card stuff you see pictures of clear blue sea on a white beach and this beach beats it hands down. Very small beach and I would assume that peak season you can't move for tourists. They were building a beach bar to open shortly. Word of warning the drive down to the beach isn't for the faint hearted and there is no shade so lots of suncream for us white bits

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but hard to walk on with peddles, also strong current so knocked off feet quickly not suitable for children or non swimmers

reviews.title: Beautiful View.
reviews.text: On our Holland America tour of Kefalonia, we did a brief photo stop of Myrtos Beach.  However, we did not actually drive down to the beach.The views were beautiful.

reviews.title: Just insanely beautiful!! A MUST!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. The color of the water, the overlook, everything about it is just incredible!

reviews.title: Beautiful but....
reviews.text: I am not sure why but I was bit disappointed. To get there it is a hard-core as the road  is narrow and not for the people with fear of hight!! From above it is a picturesque place but on actual beach the sand amd the water  is not as spectacular . There are better beaches in Kefalonia but still Myrtos is a must see. Beach bar is very basic with drinks,hot dogs and crisps.

reviews.title: Nice views but there are better beaches
reviews.text: A nice place and relatively quiet but not suitable for young children as the incoming tidal wash is quite strong and it gets very deep very quickly (less than 5-10m from the shore you are no longer standing). The water is very murky so snorkeling isn't good. Overall a nice place but probably not worth the effort to get there unless you're nearby.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: A most fabulous beach for the family which has strong currents so may not be ideal for toddlers and small children. A blue flag with lifeguards and lovely cafe, with plenty of free parking.

reviews.title: Only from above
reviews.text: As I write on the title....This beach worth only from above! Just take couple of photos from above and go.I have visited so many beaches around the world and still can not understand why this beach is so famous and has also so many awards.First of all is very far from everywhere, at least 40 minutes driving in a not so good road. Secondly the road that leads you to the beach from the main road is in very bad condition and narrow and dangerous.Thirdly when you arrive you realise that the beach is full of big white pebbles which means that you can not place your towel anywhere.The time I went it was not organised but still nothing special even organised.The beach as well as the water were so dirty, full of plastic bags and bottles and many other thingsWater was foggy and cold and as many say dangerous. With no wind there were large dangerous waves.One time for photo is enough.

reviews.title: Amazing but difficult!
reviews.text: One of the most visually spectacular beaches you will ever see. Amenities-wise though, one of the most lacking beaches in the world!Do take some swimming/diving shoes because the stones really hurt the feet! Also, take some umbrellas, refreshments for the day and anything else you may need to sustain a beach trip because there are no shops on the beach. And parking is a bit of a mission too when its busy.The sea is quite rough, and there are some currents that won't be suitable for small children to swim in, but worth the visit for the sheer beauty of the place.

reviews.title: not quite the buzz I was expecting
reviews.text: Fantastic to see. however when we visited (Sep2021) It was plagued by wasps. the sea was too rough to enter and the facilities were poor. we paid for sunbeams before we realised the wasp scenario, after being stung while trying to drink a can of coke we left. got some nice photos but won't be visiting again.

reviews.title: Great beach, terrifying drive
reviews.text: Firstly, the drive to the beach was terrifying: Winding roads with large drops, sudden bends and no barriers. As someone who is afraid of heights, this really tested me and  I was surprised to see the road so poorly maintained when it the beach is obviously so popular. (Perhaps I am an outlier given that this isn’t mentioned more prominently in other reviews, but if you are not a comfortable driver and/or afraid of heights be warned).The beach is busy so get there early to get a sun-bed and decent parking.Not a lot of amenities on the actual beach - just one beach bar with some basic snacks and some toilets (which were well maintained).Swimming was the highlight with beautiful water against the backdrop of the cliffs - I truly found it special. Water does get deep quickly but when I visited, waves and currents weren’t an issue so seems to depend. Probably not very suitable for children given it gets deep quickly and takes a bit of an effort to get out with the step incline of pebbles.All in all, loved the beach but the sketchy road to the beach needs to be improved and I don’t think I could have my nerves repeat the experience.

reviews.title: Picturesque yet pebbly
reviews.text: One of the most stunning beach I’ve seen in Kefalonia. But it’s not suitable for kids as the waves is too high and current is too strong. The beach is pebbly and it’s recommended to bring aqua shoes.

reviews.title: Beyond expectations
reviews.text: The beauty of this beach and its surroundings exceeds any expectation, but unfortunately there's a lot of people (and I mean A LOT) who also know about this place... My suggestion? Go early in the morning, around 9 am; you'll be able not only to park you car by the beach, but also to enjoy until midday or so, a really stunning place. If you're not traveling with a cooler, a basic canteen for coffee and refreshments will keep you hydrated while you're at this one-of-a-kind-place. Don't miss it.

reviews.title: The bluest blue
reviews.text: Surreal waters.One of the most famous beaches in Greece worth visiting and experiencing! Don’t miss it

reviews.title: Better than the pictures
reviews.text: Went here August 12/21.  Beautiful to look at. They day I went the waters were rough. Nice white rocks at the shore.  This area was hit by a flood as a result the facilities are extremely limited.  There are some chairs but not enough for the amount of people attending this high tourist attraction.   The parking is a nightmare. I recommend water shoes as this is a rocky beach. Must see

reviews.title: Outstandingly beautiful
reviews.text: Hold onto your hat as you experience the winding and at times pretty terrifying track down to beach. But when you get there it is worth the effort. Parking can be a bit tricky at busy times but once you are on the beach and in the sea it all feels worth it. The colour of the sea is magnificent and even though the waves can be a bit rough at the shore but the water is warm and if you swim out a bit it gets calmer.There are sun loungers and umbrellas for hire which are necessary if you don’t have your own as there is no shade on the beach and the sun is unrelenting. There is also a beach bar and showers. But really the sea is the star of the show.If you have small children who can’t swim then just be aware that the water gets deep quite quickly and the force of the waves can knock you over at the water’s edge.

reviews.title: Not worth the hype
reviews.text: The beach has a beautiful landscape when viewed from above. Once down there, the actual experience deteriorated, as the sun loungers are not enough, and laying on the pebbles is rather uncomfortable. Swimming is fun in the waves, but getting off the sea is rather perilous, especially as waves can be massive and the stony ground not ideal to offer you good support.

reviews.title: Go out of season or be prepared for crowds
reviews.text: Beautiful turquoise water and lovely setting. Go early or out of season. Bit too busy for us. Parking a challenge, no sun beds left and no eating facilities so take water and a picnic.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: Amazing landscape, beautiful beach, clean water. There are some sunbeds and umbrellas, but most people bring their own. There is no shade, so be prepared.There was no beach bar when we went (there was one behind the umbrellas under construction), so bring water etc. We arrived around 11am and it was already quite busy. There is some parking space just before the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful but dirty water
reviews.text: Whilst stunningly beautiful, both from the approach road down the cliff and the beach itself, this wouldn’t be my favourite beach on the island. Amenities are under construction and for a crowded beach, there was relatively little atmosphere (no bars etc). Most disappointing of all was the cleanliness of the water - too many boats at anchor offshore have left a wide trail of sewerage that lingers in the waves making swimming an unpleasant experience on this visit.

reviews.title: Marvellous.  Deserves all the hype
reviews.text: Firstly, get there early (would suggest by 9.30) to ensure you get a place in the beachside car park (not obstructive) rather than having to park in the steep road leading down.  Despite its popularity it's relatively undeveloped: paid for sunloungers and umbrellas are relatively few and their style bel ends in well- they are set back from the sea.  Most people are sitting on the beach itself.  More areas of  sand on the beach than we expected, mixed in with small  white pebbles so easier on the feet than most N Kefalonia beaches.  No cafe or beach bar although one seemed to be in early stages of construction.  Sea is warm and clear, although be warned it slopes away dramatically.   Overall, An essential stop on any Kefalonia trip.

reviews.title: Kefalonia 2021
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach at Greece. The water was so clean and the place was peaceful . The only problem is that there is not a store to buy something to eat or drink

reviews.title: Parking problem, no atmoshere whatsoever
reviews.text: This beach is made only for viewing from a distance. Its amazing. The drive downstairs is very bad, with a lot of holes in the road and a lot of curves ( asphalted). Downtairs you will two parking sides ( only stones not asphalted).There is not enough parking for the people visiting. So al lot of people parking it on the road which you have to drive to get downstairs. Not a happy thing to do along the abyss.We where there 10:30 (EEST = greece time) and after 10 minute  searching we where able to get hold on a parking place.  Do not come here after 11:00 (EEST) you are to late and will not find a parking downstairs. This is only in the months of july and augustus.  Otherwise you will need to park near the abyss. The beach bar is being build at the moment ( 2 augustus 2021) so bring your food with you. There is a car driving up and down to get some food if you make and order, but it is very busy. The guy where you can make an order stand near the showers. I did not see any toilet.The beach it self is very dirte which a lot of stones, bring your swimming shoes with you. The drive to myrtos was very fine but the beach there was no atmosphere whatsoever downstairs.  Left after 2 hours. You have to visite myrtos because thats where kafelonia is known for.Good luck!

reviews.title: Beautiful to look at, hard to swim in
reviews.text: From the viewpoint, the beach looked so beautiful that you thought it was a dream. However, it's really hard to swim in because the bottom is full of big rocks/pebbles, and the strong waves kept crashing you against the rocks. It gets deep quickly. The water is very "cloudy", so you can't see the sea bottom or even your hand/feet.

reviews.title: Truly stunning
reviews.text: Most amazing turquoise sea with large waves. Though it is an uncomfortable pebble beach and no swimming. Quite a steep drive down but worth it.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: We stopped off at the viewpoint above to marvel at this amazing beach. The colours are so impressive, it almost doesn’t look real. A must-see.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: This beach is stunning. The colour of the sea is unbelievable have never seen such a turquoise blue sea!

reviews.title: Large family beach
reviews.text: À large very family oriented beach, rather nice but not exceptional. You can try to escape to the west extremity to find a naturist compatible area.

reviews.title: OVERRATED!
reviews.text: Very disappointed with this beach. The sand looks like a construction site, there is no infrastructure whatsoever (bar, sun beds) and hills around it are not that nice. Go to Antisamos, much better!

reviews.title: BEST FROM ABOVE
reviews.text: I give it  a 4 because, although stunningly, breathtakingly beautiful from above, when you get to the beach it is all white pebbles.  Whilst they in themselves are so, so lovely, they are hard to walk on.The beach into the sea shelves quite quickly and is not such a good place for young children ... nor for anyone who isn’t a fairly good swimmer. There are a lot of underwater currents there too ... so whilst it’s a lovely beach, it can be a challenge, particular when the surf is up!  I’ve been there when the sea has been as flat as a pond and have floated quite happily in the aqua sea ... I’ve also been there where the sea has tried to claim my bikini bottoms as I’ve tried to get out!   In fact, if you have mobility issues, Myrtos is a bit of a no, no.

reviews.title: So relaxing
reviews.text: Visited Cephalonia quite a long time ago (when it was and hopefully still is) unspoiled & HAD to visit this beach for snorkelling and a swim.From a distance, the beach & see look stunning, but it is not sand, it is small pebbles and the water is such a light blue colour because the cliff walls are (I assume) chalk, so once you get into the water & try to have a look underwater, you can't actually see anything hahahahaWe were also warned about a jellyfish invasion, so imagine my horror when snorkelling and my right arm waved through what felt exactly like the top end of a jellyfish - my friends all fell about laughing when all they heard through the snorkel was "WHAT THE **** IS THAT?!?!!" only to discover that it was a discarded plastic bag which as the exact texture of a jellyfish! Hey hoGreat place - Cephalonia was (and is) a wonderful place.

reviews.title: Don’t miss out on this fabulous beach
reviews.text: We called here as part of a day tour.  This beach is as beautiful as the pictures of it are. Well worth a visit

reviews.title: Road closed cannot visit
reviews.text: Not sure why no one else has written these to save people time but the road is closed, we tried to walk down and another point the road is fully closed and says not safe to walk down - not sure if the road has come away or there has been landslides like in Assos ( also don’t bother visiting as roads closed due to damage from landslides also)

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning. Must see it from above to appreciate the blue sea. Beautiful drive around the coastline. Watch out for the random goats

reviews.title: Best viewed from above
reviews.text: An absolutely beautiful beach viewed from above. I was on my way to Fiskardo so I didn't really have the time to actually go down to the beach. I was told that it can be very busy and that the view from high on the cliffs was the best feature. Certainly, I'd recommend it.

reviews.title: Great views from above
reviews.text: This beach is obviously the most famous. The views from the mountain are stunning and the drive up and down as fairly straght forward. I would recommend proper swimming footwear as the pebbles can be quite painful. Nice place to visit but head to Makris Galios if you like sandy beaches. The water is more wavey than Makris Galios.

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. The sea has all different shades of blue which is amazing, really cool to swim in (but be careful of the rough waves!), never seen a beach like it before. Not loads of choice for food but that’s okay for me, prices weren’t too bad either. We got a taxi to take us there, it was the more expensive option but meant we got to avoid the steep drive down and had no hassle with traffic getting there or back. Really recommend as a must see in Kefalonia!

reviews.title: Raw beauty and force
reviews.text: The beach is stunningly beautiful, even more so when the waves are huge. If you use your common sense and watch them from the shore you'll be witness to a great display of the beauty and force of nature. The whole experience is beautiful: the many shades of blue in the water, the thunder of the crashing waves, the small droplets of water the wind brings on your face and the smell of the salty sea.Adding to what two previous reviewers said about the guy that "tried to win the Darwin Award", he was eventually rescued by a helicopter after staying 6 hours on a small anchored raft with a lifeguard, riding 3-4 meter waves. May sound fun but I'm sure it's not.Take caution when swimming here, even when the waves seem small-medium, as the water is deep and there is a current pulling you back into the water when trying to get out, so you'll have to fight it a little. As a bonus, exiting the water you'll step on rocks that will prevent you from exiting elegantly. More common would be exiting doing the Australopithecus walk or sometimes even on all fours.If you accept those things and are aware of and respect the power of the sea here, you'll have a great experience.

reviews.title: Viewed from coastal road only
reviews.text: Sorry didn’t visit the beach in person but as we were on the coastal road our taxi driver insisted on taking us past for a photo

reviews.title: Amazing beach with huge waves!
reviews.text: Such beautiful blue sea. It was a bit rough when we were there and you couldn’t swim in the water but the waves made great photos!

reviews.title: Stunningly beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is well worth a visit but be aware it’s not for swimming. It has dangerous currents that pull you out. There was a lifeguard but he was constantly asking people to come out of the water.There is only a small beach cafe selling drinks and snacks, no restaurants and the toilets were pretty grim.

reviews.title: Respect the force of nature
reviews.text: Reading a review left two days ago when some idiot went against the lifeguard’s warnings into the sea as it was getting dark, I feel compelled to leave a counter review that properly rates the beach and sea and experience versus the people trying to win Darwin Awards.  The waves are powerful, and you should only enter the ocean after waiting for the larger waves to pass (I believe they come in patterns of 7 at a time?).   I wouldn’t let small children swim there as the waves do break violently , and mediocre swimmers need not apply.  But the beach and ocean there is perhaps the most beautiful I’ve ever experienced, and if you respect nature, you will be rewarded by an awe inspiring vast turquoise expanse.   There will always be families who do not recognize the strength of the ocean and these waves in particular... but it should be immediately obvious by first observing (if only people all took the time to do so...).   I would NOT let small children frolic by the shoreline, just as I would not encourage toddlers to pet crocodiles.

reviews.title: Myrthos beach
reviews.text: Our time spent at myrthos beach was excellent: the waves were spectacular and the sunset was magnificent.This is a place where we will definetly come back.

reviews.title: Be very careful when swimming we saw a horrific incident
reviews.text: Today is the last day of our holiday and we wanted to see the sunset at Myrtos Beach.  The waves were spectacular as was the sunset.   However there was one man swimming in the water alone.   At first it appeared that he was having fun but as the light faded it was clear that he was unable to return to the beach.  A crowd developed and various people tried to assist including locals with life buoys, flash lights, long lines etc. We are not aware of the fair of this young man but it was a horrific scene.   We did not know what to do so felt the best we can do is to warn others here. Please take extreme care if considering to swim here, especially is no life guard is on duty.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach on Kefalonia
reviews.text: I was with my girlfriend for 2 weeks in Kefalonia. And I can say it was the most beautiful beach, that I seen on the island. I have visited other beaches, but this one was  amazing.RegardsAndrew

reviews.title: Beautiful blue
reviews.text: This beach is stunning and the bluest sea ever. It is not however good for swimming or even just a dip to cool down. The waves and current when we went were very strong and knocked my husband and teenage son over straight off after about 1.5 meters in. They loved it though and it became a challenge to get past the breaking waves! My daughter found it scary and after one try wouldn’t go back. There is a lifeguard. It is definitely worth visiting for the view but I couldn’t spend all day there as couldn’t really enter the water safely.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: A beach so spectacularly blue you have to pinch yourself hour after hour to check you are not dreaming. The water is immensely clear and the blueness goes on forever. It is a cove surrounded by luscious green mountains - with mountain goats for added Greek authenticity and the white sand is like silk upon the soles ofYour feet. The waves are strong and the current powerful which makes it difficult to get out for a swim but it is immensely fun playing around in the waves on the vast shoreline. There are umbrellas and sun beds for a small fee of 3.50 each and a little beach bar with showers and toilets. I would recommend getting here before midday as the car park got quite busy. On the way down to the beach you must stop off at the viewpoint and film the panoramic views of the mountains meeting the ocean - I have never seen a view like it.  OnlyA couple of warnings would be there are paragliders which land on the beach so be careful to stay out of there way and be careful with children playing in the sea without an adult. As I said the waves are powerful and will. Drag you under if you are not careful. I cannot recommend a beach to go to more highly than this for a perfect peaceful and fulfilling day on your travels.

reviews.title: Great view
reviews.text: The best thing about this beach is viewing it from the top which offers a truly spectacular view.The road down to the beach is bendy and busy as is the parking.We arrived at 11.30 and beds were plentiful but within an hour none were available.The composition of the beach is made up from coarse sand and becomes pebbles nearer the Sea.The waves can be high and the drop is quite sudden.In a normal season without the travel restrictions I’d imagine a very busy beach.There was One refreshments vendor which was always busy.The sun beds (2) and shades were reasonable at €7 for the day and we’re sanitised before use.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach - steep drive!
reviews.text: The white stones create an azure sea which in August was perfectly cool and refreshing. Get some sane shoes because the stones can hurt one's feet a bit and an umbrella is a must, and at times rentable with longer. The scenery and the drive memorable.  Make sure to capture a groupie from the view up, waaay up above!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, would go later in the afternoon
reviews.text: Beautiful sea- such a vivid blue! The sea was wavy but we managed to stay in line with our bags. We arrived around 4:30 and the beach was still busy, especially the car park, but we managed to get a parking spot close to the beach whereas other cars parked half way up the hill. The beach was still busy when we arrived but we managed to get an umbrella and 2 sun loungers which was fab as the sun was still strong. I would recommend going early or going a bit later when people might be leaving so you can get an umbrella as it is hot! There are more beautiful swimming spots around but this is still worth a visit.

reviews.title: Breathtaking view
reviews.text: Breathtaking view Cold waters and waves . Make sure that you will visit that beach early so you will find parking easily . The sun beds are some how for safety reasons (because of the waves) a little bit away from the waters. It is strongly recommended to wear special shoes for the small rocks that will make your beach walk a little bit annoying. I noticed that there are lot of yellowjackets around the subbed area so please be careful

reviews.title: Views are amazing
reviews.text: The drive down is interesting but the views are stunning. The parking is grab a space where you can. I can see why it is photographed so much as the views are stunning. A word of caution the sea was rough when we were there and it gets deep very quickly so watch out if you have toddlers. There is a small cafe on the beach which is very reasonable priced - worth a visit for the views

reviews.title: Nice peisage from up but not so good no interesting  7€ sunbeds
reviews.text: Nice peisage from up but not so good no interesting i first of all is a rock beac and if you don’t have slippers you break your feet, the parking is very bad is free but you don’t have any place , you can use sunbeds 2 and 1 umbrella 7€ or free withyour owns,, the water from thw white rocks i think calcar or ... is white but not clear like antisamos beach or other , the best peisage is fromUp

reviews.title: Amazing view 'from a distance'.
reviews.text: Unbelivably many tones of blue and great for view and photos but not much fun swimming in. Pebble stone entry and big churning waves makes entry and especially exit tricky almost dangerous. I had to grab my little kids and pull them.out of the waves and later on watched many adults struggling and tumbling in the waves. Amazing photo background but not bery practical to swim.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Good beach. The view from above is magnificent giving onto a clear blue sea. The beach in itself is nice too. Very rocky so I recommend a sturdy pair of shoes. The water is quite warm and a beautiful translucent turquoise blue. Not too many people either which is great. No restaurants or toilets around.

reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.text: It is a really beautiful beach and saying anything else would be a lie. However, if you intend to go there, don't forget your aqua/swimming shoes as we did! The rocks are pretty, but not comfortable to walk on. Not to mention the very small ones right where you're about to enter the water - your feet will sink.The water was nice, the colors are fascinating indeed - amazing turquoise! But it gets pretty deep very shortly after you go into the water. Still, it should be visited and, of course, the picture you'd take will be great!

reviews.title: The best beach in the world
reviews.text: First time in Kefalonia last year, we visited myrtos beach and was fantastic!!One of the best beaches in the world, shoud be visit

reviews.title: Go early in the Summer
reviews.text: Simply a beautiful beach..... we were advised to go early in the morning in order to get parked. We got there for around 9.00am and it was cool because the beach was in shadow. It quickly warmed up.We explored the cave and swam in the sea and saw lots of fish...... we even saw the little fish come to feed when the stones got moved. So glad we went here.

reviews.title: Lovely🥰
reviews.text: I didnot have time to swim but seems to have no private beach facilities from above, lacking comfort. I cannot imagine myself lying on a towel on pebbles. I just passed by but the view was splendid.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach way down a long windy road. Water is a spectacular blue color. Nice beach, but can get crowded. Umbrellas and chairs available. One of the nicest settings.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've seen in my life. We stayed in Fiscardo and it took us 30 minutes to get there. The view from up the road leading to the beach is stunning, make sure to stop and take some pictures:)

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach set within a cove. It is a pebble beach so remember shoes, on the plus side no sand in your shoes and clothes. The road down to the beach is great and view at the top of the cove are amazing.

reviews.title: Suffice it to say Mirtos
reviews.text: If you are in Cephalonia, you should not miss this beauty.Long beach, beautiful turquoise, parking by the beach, should not miss it.

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: Not been to a better beach in my life. Could do with more sunbeds. The rocks instead of sand are bit painful as well. Take shoes!

reviews.title: unreal view of the sea
reviews.text: It is impossible to describe in words that beauty.And that view creates huge expectations.In my case upon arrival to the island,we saw this beauty,it was unreal,like moment from dream.In September the 16th we came to Myrtos beach,the road just ok,parking big in front of the sea.White,fine pebbles ..turquoise blue sea of unreal blue ..perfect contrast blue-white..It was sunny,35 degrees.We had our umbrella,and you have to bring everuthing you need,because there is no cafe or restaurant on the beach.This beach is the most popular in Kefalonija,so it is must have here.We saw,for example,the buses that came all above the beach,for tourists only to experience that view.Be sure to check on Greek meteo the state of waves,because the big waves can spoil the pleasure(no smimming for example)

reviews.title: Late evening swim!
reviews.text: No matter where we go, each year at least a 4 days visit at Kefallonia is a must.  Each time the best swim takes place at Myrtos. Never at noon due to the extreme crowds and the burning rocks of the beach.  Ideal visit the beach late noon around 1700 and stay till dawn to check the sun fade away west. Very nice beach bar.

reviews.title: Astoundingly beautiful - best photographed from the top road
reviews.text: I had read so much about Myrtos Beach before we arrived in Kefelonia that I was worried it would be a disappointment when we got there. Fear not! You will be absolutely knocked out by the colour of the water here. It sneaks up on you. We did it on a drive up to Fiskardo. The drive up that side of the coastline is spectacular. The water colour at the lookout point above Myrtos Beach really is exactly how it looks in those photos. They are not enhanced. We did not go swimming here so I can't comment on the notorious currents at the beach, nor the apparently difficult switchback road from the top of the mountain down to the beach. We did quite a switchback road down to Assos so if it is similar to that, it would be bearable. Do not miss this natural stunning beauty.

reviews.title: Stunning scenery and crystal clear water- late October visit
reviews.text: We visited the beach late October, therefore it was almost empty and absolutely beautiful. The sea was very calm and still warm, we didn't have any problem to get in and out of water like other people described. This almost deterred me from visiting, but I am glad we went. It was certainly worth the drive. We also didn't have water shoes, the pebbles in the water were quite small. On the beach they varied in size and after a few metres from the sea the beach turned sandy.  It is definitely worth a visit especially outside of main season.

reviews.title: Blue and beautiful
reviews.text: Great overlooks from both sides of the beach. Fun switchback road down. Great spot for beautiful pictures.

reviews.title: Warm sand & sea
reviews.text: Picked this beach to spend the day prior to late evening flight from the airport which is close at hand.Good parking under the pines. Free subeds, waiter service, clean, beatiful sand and very warm sea.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Most beautiful beach in Greece!! Stunning view just in paradise! The waters are very deep so you need to be careful!!

reviews.title: Fab beach
reviews.text: We loved this beach where you can walk for miles. Has a couple of restaurants that also serve cocktails. You can utilise some water sports on offer lay back and enjoy the music streamed out by the bars. The sunset was just breathtaking with a trumpet player blasting out popular songs whilst the sun set. Really magical so we went back for more!

reviews.title: Stunning isn't appropriate
reviews.text: This beach is a 28 minute drive from ArgostoliIt is currently, still open, however, the lounge chairs have been removed and the restaurant, bar is closedSeveral folks are still sunbathing. Take your own beach chair or sit on the soft sandStop along the mountain road at the scenic lookout instead

reviews.title: Stunning !
reviews.text: What a stunning and gorgeous white sandy beach 🏖. Water is crystal clear and the views getting to the beach are amazing. Can totally understand why the local people are so proud of this location. I think the pictures speak for themselves 😍

reviews.title: Layered Blue Hues of Sea
reviews.text: Ah, what a scenic beach! The drive down the hill to the beach has lots of switchbacks, but taking it slowly gives passengers in the car plenty of viewing opportunities to the beach below. There's not a ton of parking, but we went a little later in the day so we found a spot. The beach is sandy...until you get closer to shore and then it's limestone so you should bring swim shoes. I wore closed Tevas and the rocks still found their way in making it really hard to walk. Limestone feels like quicksand so, between that and the bits of rock, if you aren't sure-footed to begin with, definitely bring a friend to help you get out of the surf. If I hadn't done that, I might still be there!

reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: Accessible by car. Crystal clear turquoise water. White pebbles. Warm & calm. Blessed experience.  Must do.

reviews.title: Amazing beach!!
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing beach, tropical blue water, perfect for swimming! No sand but the pebbles underfoot are fairly soft at myrtos. Amazing scenery - such a beautiful place!!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Amazing beach soft sand clear water beautiful lovely bars and cafes on the beach, making our lazy days wonderful.

reviews.title: Very pretty
reviews.text: We drove down the steep,hills with hair pin bends to the parking spaces, there were toilets and changing rooms, best take your own drinks and food, the refreshment area was closed. The beach looked beautiful from a distance, it was white pebbles, I found the sea drops off sharply, it was crystal clear, quite a heat trap ..... bliss

reviews.title: Picture Postcard Beach
reviews.text: We visited Myrtos Beach at the end of the season so it was extremely quiet.The colour of the water is simply stunning, you definitely need to see this if you visit kefalonia.

reviews.title: Breath taking
reviews.text: This is one of the most stunning views I have ever seen. An absolute must if you are on The island ❤️

reviews.title: On the way to Assos
reviews.text: It is just a beautiful beach. What a view from the watch point. Amazing colours and and great scenery

reviews.title: Stunning Beach and water
reviews.text: This Beach is a must stop when travelling on Cephalonia. Beautiful beach and not so far by car from any place in Cephalonia.

reviews.title: One of the Nicest Beaches
reviews.text: We traveled to Cephalonia after September 15 and for good reason. Small crowds. This beach can get quite crowded and parking is limited. The water a views are beautiful. Plan on renting an umbrella and two lounges for 10 euros. There are showers and dressing areas available. The restaurant was closed so I am guessing its seasonal.  Very important: Bring some water shoes. The beach is covered with beautiful smooth stones and its a lot easier to walk on with water shoes. The water was calm the day we were there but it could get a little rough. Another hint: When you come down the hill in your call there are several spots to take some photos. Do it. Also, stay to the right at the bottom and park on the beach right behind where all the umbrellas are. Very convenient to be able to have quick access to your car for clothes and food. Enjoy!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach with turquoise sea, you do need beach shoes because of the pebbles. The sea was so clear it was great for swimming and snorkelling.

reviews.title: Beauty spot ruined by filthy people
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and sea with toilet facilities sun beds and parasols water very rough tho and you need to keep your wits about you!On leaving beach we noticed people had emptied toilets in the parking area excrement sanitary towels and tampons along with wipes etc left everywhere disgusting no excuse

reviews.title: Mertos beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with few cafes etc careful of the undertows in the water they can be very powerful even at shallow depths, very steep twisting road down to the beach and of course back up to the top of the hill. Lovely place to spend a day, if you have a car bring your own food and water as will save you money cafes a little expensive great place worth a visit and great for pictures of the beach from the top of the hill and on the road to Assos looking back towards metros beach, kind of a must see once type of affair 😎

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: This looks magical from the top of the road and once you drive down, the beach and sea are also amazing! Pebbles can hurt your feet a bit and would suggest going early (9-10am) as it gets super busy later and parking can be tricky.

reviews.title: Awesome views
reviews.text: Having read the views of others as you do on TA, I was almost persuaded by some of the negative ones not to bother going. I'm so glad I cast them from my mind and went. It is without doubt one of the most beautiful sights I have seen. From the viewpoints above and on the beach itself. Beach not crowded, late September but 30° is hot enough, no issues with the winding road down to it with plenty of areas to pull in if needed. Crystal clear waters and good snorkelling at the northern end of the beach. Blown away by it, best one on Cephalonia for us but Antisammos comes a close second. Will go again before leaving.

reviews.title: Nice white (tourist) beach
reviews.text: The colors of Myrthos, white rocks and bleu seas, are beautiful. There are some sunbeds and it’s nice to take pictures for holiday memories. Best place is the parkinglot at the mainroad. There are better beaches to visit, only thing is that these only can be reached by boat.

reviews.title: Exhilarating views but!!!
reviews.text: The views of the beach are breathtaking from up above and there is quite a nice beach but there is a very dangerous under current that takes you off your feet when trying to get out of the water and drags you back into the sea

reviews.title: It is beautiful and perfect for snorkelling beach.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed Myrtos beach . It was beautiful and relaxing beach . I also done some good snorkelling for beginners there.

reviews.title: Beautiful from above
reviews.text: The beach is lovely from above but considering it's one of the bigger tourist pulls on the island it's a little underwhelming once down by the sea. There are no facilities. The beach is of course completely stoney which is what makes the lovely colours but not very comfortable to sit on for any length of time. There is also a strong rip tide so caution for those swimming. Still very pretty though.

reviews.title: Paradise!!!!
reviews.text: Love the film....had hoped to get to myrtos beach for some time. Well it was totally worth the drive from Skala. It is a visit I will never forget!! Paradise doesn't quite sum it up. Turquoise sea, shingle pebble beach-- please take sea shoes as very painful under the feet! Also be careful of the unpredictable waves as they knocked both me and my partner of our feet several times! Quiet and non commercialised unlike anti samos. You gotta go if you are on the island of Kefalonia!!

reviews.title: Short visit to Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: We visited around 5pm on a pleasant afternoon and this seemed like a good time to avoid the crowds.The view from above the beach on the approach road is probably the best, as once we were on the beach we didn't consider it to be as stunning as we had been led to believe. Perhaps our expectations were too high.The approach road is quite untidy with a fair bit of graffiti and the beach itself is mostly pebbles with very little sand. The sea comes in with some force and is pretty impressive with its lovely blue colour, but I have been on much nicer beaches in other parts of the world.

reviews.title: Electric Blues
reviews.text: Pictures don’t do justice to the views of Myrtos from the viewpoints on either side of the beach - quite simply breathtaking. The drive down the winding road is comfortable but parking is at a premium at busy times. The beach itself a mixture of sand and pebbles so beach shoes are advised. The view from the beach looking out to sea is one that will live long in the memory. The water itself is warm but cloudy due to the churn of the white rock. It also shelves quickly from the waters edge and you are very soon out of your depth. There is also a very strong rip when standing on the edge which can pull you in so be careful - confident swimmers will love the waves, less confident may find it a struggle. It is a “must see” when visiting the island if only from the viewpoints.

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: We saw the beach from the viewpoint on the main road where there is parking and you can take that famous photo of the beach easily. We did not have time to go down to the seaside and be there but it was enough for me to just look at it from afar and admire! Well worth seeing.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach View
reviews.text: My partner and I stopped off up on the road above for a view whilst on a holiday in Kefalonia. The view is absolutely stunning, especially if you have seen the Captain Corelli's Mandolin film. We didn't actually go down on the beach itself so can't comment.

reviews.title: Nice beach but disappointed with bar
reviews.text: This beach was one of the top recommended when researching for things to do in kefalonia. The beach is okay, clean and pebbly. I was a bit surprised that there was only one bar serving drinks and food and closed early at 5pm. The beach’s view point was much nicer in comparison ( pictures attached) Highly recommend the view point. Could skip the beach if necessary.

reviews.title: The most amazing beach in the world
reviews.text: Well worth the mountainous, scary roads to get there. It’s truly incredible. The violet light in the sky against the turquoise sea is astonishing

reviews.title: Realy great, but full of people
reviews.text: This is the greatest beach we have visited on Kefalonia. But you must be aware of hundreds people coming here. It is better to go there early morning, or you will have to leave the car 0,5km up the road and go by yourself. It is full stony beach, so water shoes are necessary! Beautiful small cave is bonus to see here.

reviews.title: Visually stunning, amazing!
reviews.text: Wow, perfect Turquoise sea, clear as clear can be, slightly tricky drive down but worth it, perfect white little stoney beach so beach shoes needed. If this beach view from the road above docent make you go wow then you're dead inside.

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: The online reviews raved about the 'best beach in Greece'. Well, I was underwelmed by what I found. Sure, the setting was impressive. A patch of sand between two high rock faces gave some nice photos, but the beach itself: too stony by half, not enough sand. The sea bottom sank away quickly and trying to make a dignified exit from the sea was impossible, as we 'oooh' and 'ouch'ed are way over the rocks climbing out.

reviews.title: You have to be there!!
reviews.text: We visited Myrthos as part of a cruise tour!! What a beautiful beach!!! It’s water were transparent! Just spectacular!! The drive down the cliff was scary!!!! But sooo beautiful

reviews.title: MUST SEE! Perfect❤️
reviews.text: No words can describe this beauty. This is absolutely one od the best things to see on Kefalonia. Stunning!!! Watter is so clear.. and blue.. realy rare. What a beautiful nature..

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Myrtos Bay is truly a beautiful beach. It is covered with small pebbles (so bring shoes you can swim with) and incredible blue sea. There are some loungers and umbrellas to hire, but we bought our own parasol which was fine and meant you could get a bit further from everyone else (it can be a bit busy). The sea is clear and good for snorkelling, but we had been warned that there can be very strong currents so not to swim beyond your depth.

reviews.title: Be very careful!
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos last week. It was fine, gentle sea swam  & floated about with no problems. Went again today & totally different, the waves were bigger, nothing too dramatic if you’ve swum in cornwall, all was perfect until I tried to come out of the water. I am a confident swimmer, but the undertow & currents were so strong I didn’t know which was was up. If my partner hadn’t come to my rescue I honestly think I would have drowned. Please be cautious. The beach shelves steeply & the undertow is wicked. I feel lucky to be alive to write this. Warnings definitely needed here, lifeguards also.

reviews.title: Best seen from above.
reviews.text: An attraction that would be more popular if less people went there! Spoilt by remember of cars and wall to wall sunbeds.there are many more nicer beaches on Kefalonia. Driving down to,and back from this beach is a nightmare especially if you meet a bus going in the opposite direction.

reviews.title: Fabulous beach; difficult access!
reviews.text: We visited this beach as part of a tour. The beach is stunningly beautiful, with crystal clear water, so great for swimming. The pebbles shelve away steeply though, so probably not as suitable for young children or less confident swimmers. The beach is mainly small pebbles, so jelly shoes or flip flops needed. Glad we weren’t driving down to the beach as the road is long, steep and full of hair pin bends.

reviews.title: Family day (half-day) on the beach
reviews.text: Lovely half-day on the beach with the family.  This was a repeat visit as we had come before in 2017.  Spectacular beach and cove when viewed from above or on the beach.  Get there early as the parking is limited and be careful how you park as a late arrival may block you in - a real pain if you want to leave before the crowds!  Tricky drive down and back up due to late arrivals parking on the access road.  Don't be deceived it looks like a really nice sandy beach but it is not, all stones I am afraid but water is fantastic.  Best improvement since 2017 is the opening of the taverna on the beach so you can get snacks and drinks there.

reviews.title: Beach Vacation
reviews.text: I liked this place. It has a fee of ten Euros to use the chairs and umbrellas. I didn’t mind. You can bring your own. The waves were a lot of fun. We arrived at 11:30. Parking was crowded but worth the hassle. They had a small cafe there but I didn’t try it. They do offer parasailing if you want.

reviews.title: stunning beach
reviews.text: parking is difficult but worth the walk if you have to park on the road further up and walk. Take jelly shoes as the pebbles are hot and difficult to walk on - stunning location and would recommend

reviews.title: Worth a visit but very pebbly!
reviews.text: We did a little road trip today, Assos, Myrtos Beach and Fiskardo. We are stopping in Kateilos and hired a car. This is a "famous" beach and it looked beautiful from above. We ventured down. It's a nice beach but few things, very pebbly and I would suggest some of those water shoes cause even the sea was full of hard pebbles. Also, the showers could do with being a little close to the road, as, by the time you've washed the sand off you're stepping onto more sand to get off the beach and to the car.

reviews.title: A must do in Kefalonia
reviews.text: We went on a day where there was no wind so the waves were not high. The scenery is beautiful, the water colors unbelievable but too wild for me to swim. I prefer calm shallow waters, definitely not for children.You can go for paragliding there where you go with an experienced person. I didnt do it but it must be a fantastic experience with such views.

reviews.title: Spectacular Beach
reviews.text: This beach is just a lovely wonder to behold. The turquoise water and the lovely views all around. We took a taxi from the cruise port, which took about 40 minutes through a scenic ride. The ride too and from was just breathtaking. Definitely worth the time with plenty of photo opps along the way. We got there pretty early, around 9:30 am before the beach got too crowded. You can rent day beds and umbrellas for 10 Euros. There is also a bathroom facility and snack bar/restaurant right onsite. We stayed for about 4 hours. When we got there, we felt like we had the beach to ourselves. When we left, it was packed. It's definitely worth the drive to visit. The beach area is part sand and part small pebbles. I highly suggest you bring water shoes. It was painful to walk barefoot, and it is still full of small rocks when you get in the ocean. The water is truly beaufiful.

reviews.title: Not what I expected!
reviews.text: When viewing from above just breathtaking.  When you are in the beach, not enjoyable, rocky beach I suggest water shoes, too many waves be careful with children.  If you arrive around noon you will park your car very high up the mountain, better to visit early morning or past 5

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Just as beautiful as the photos. Whether you stop for the photo from above or spend some time on the beach, it's well worth it. In summer if you do spend time on the beach, arrive early, it gets busy!

reviews.title: Soooo! Blue
reviews.text: We were driving up the coast to Asos when we stopped at the lookout overlooking Mytros beach. We were stunned at the incredible blue of the water and the white of the beach. I was positively idyllic. There was limited parking as it’s quite busy. Any beach lover would love a visit to Mytros.

reviews.title: Holiday with friends
reviews.text: We went on holiday to Kefalonia with our ex neighbours who raved about the Island having been there 4 times previously. They had never been to this beach and we were all looking forward to it and the dramatic views from the top of the cliffs and still quite impressive when on the beach made us initially think what a good choice. However to get into the water was very difficult due to the stones which slopped down into the water. Once we managed to get past the stones we found it got deep very quickly and the undercurrents felt quite powerful. We all agreed it was nice to see the first time but definitely not somewhere we would return to!

reviews.title: The view and the water and simply amazing
reviews.text: We took a cab and arrived at 10:30 a.m and we prearranged a pick-up for 2:00 p.m which was just the right amount of time.  10 euros for a umbrella and there were plenty when we arrived.  Water shoes are a must (as the entry into the water is rocky). Taking pictures from the top is also a must.

reviews.title: Go for the view not the beach
reviews.text: The view from the top is amazing and definitely worth to go there but the beach is quite a let down with mediocre facilities and mucky waters with difficult entry and exit of the sea.

reviews.title: Just breathtaking
reviews.text: Must visit for sure. An amazing beach you rarely visit. Yes it is crowded. Yes you may have parking problems. BUT totally worth it. There is much space on the beach for your own umbrella so you dont have to wait in the private seabeds. Amazing blue colour combined with the rocks around and the sun. Just perfect.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but very busy with tourists - a victim of it's own beauty
reviews.text: This is a wonderful beach and the view from the top of the cliffs is fantastic. It's clean and lovely but unfortunately also discovered by coach loads of tourists. Best to go early or late and avoid the coaches

reviews.title: Day trip
reviews.text: The views from the top of the mountain looking down on the bay are spectacular. The beach itself although pebbles has beautiful turquoise water and is a delight to swim in. There are simple facilities there which is good as it would take at least an hour to walk back up to the cafes at the top in the village. By 10.30 am the traffic down to the bay was heaving and there is no way I would have wanted to drive down to the bottom on a precipitous toad let alone trying to get back out of a disorganised parking system. We went on an organised tour with the excellent Avgerinos your company.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: You HAVE to visit this beach if you come to Kefalonia.Great water, landscapes, even some small caves in the mountains around.The only BIG problem is the parking space. If you want to visit Myrthos you have to arrive there before 10 o'clock, else your car is gonna sit somewhere uptop, stranded on a cliff.

reviews.title: Beautiful sea
reviews.text: Wow I have never seen sea this colour. Absolutely stunning the drive down to the beach was scary and wAtching the coaches go up the hill was worth a watch. I would recommend A visit but be careful the waves are stronger than expected and may knock you off your feet. There is a bar and sun beds and clean toilets. Gets very busy

reviews.title: Most amazing beach ever
reviews.text: Besides the Maldives, i have never seen this kind of amazing blue in any other sea. Wonderful for swimming and the beach is clean, well organized with umbrellas, not noisy. I would recommend taking chips with you or a snack because they mainly serve drinks.Don’t miss to pass by the balcony to take a picture from the top.

reviews.title: An Experience That Must Seen First Hand
reviews.text: We first experienced Myrtos Beach from the cliffs above and knew it was a place that we had to visit... and when we did it didn't dissapoint, it's a beautiful jewel in Kefalonia's crown. The water has to be seen to be believed, now there are food and drink facilities down on the beach again the carpark and road get crazy busy but don't let that put you off go see for yourself.

reviews.title: What a beach!!!!
reviews.text: The water is crystal clear. There is a beach bar in the area. Moreover there is a watersports area. The place is very famous but the access is difficult

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We went later in the day (about 4pm) so it was a little quieter so got a car parking space and sunbed no problem. The beach is stunning and the water is a beautiful blue! definitely worth a visit. (Its a pebble beach so suggest you wear your flip flops down to the sea!)

reviews.title: Gorgeous waters !
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach! If you are driving (we hired a car) get there early to get a car park. beach chairs and umbrellas are available to hire on the beach for 10 Euro for 2 sun beds and umbrella! Take beach shoes as it is pretty rocky getting to water and in water. It is a large beach so plenty of space so you don’t feel on top of one another - loved this spot just gorgeous!

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: A lovely beach ,but can get very busy .There are sun loungers on the beach, but you need to get there early . But be warned parking a car can be a nightmare and if no umbrellas ,can be very hot in mid summer .

reviews.title: Nice beach but difficult parking
reviews.text: Nice clean water and space enough on the beach once you’re on it. During high season it can be difficult to park next to the beach and one has to drive up again to park.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful places I’ve been
reviews.text: The beach is huge, calm water, rocks instead of sand. There’s a small cave in left side (left if looking to the sea) and I felt really sad about people be smoking inside. And smokers leaving cigarettes in the beach floor. If you are a smoker please watch yourself and don’t leave cigarettes on the floor wherever ! The most beautiful about this beach is the view from the road, there’s view points in left and right side of the beach...both views simply amazing. Parking can be a problem if you arrive after 10:00am during weekend.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: Myrtos is stunning. We went at about 6pm on the way back from Fiskardo to Skala. The waves were fun, it's pebbly so doesn't make for the most elegant exit from the sea! Lots of sun beds. It gets busy with parking but as we were there at the end of the day it wasn't an issue.

reviews.title: Best by boat
reviews.text: Stunning beach, but SO crowded with disproportionate lack of facilities and parking. We drove in and straight out. Visit by private boat would be the learning. The ‘local’ tavernas are also underwhelming. As stunning beaches and way better eateries elsewhere. Great post card picture, reality not.

reviews.title: The most photographed beach in GR
reviews.text: Must see on the island! Very romantic and would recommend to go there either early in the morning or later in the evening to see the sunset!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful but go early!
reviews.text: Stunning beach with crystal clear turquoise water. It's big enough that even in August it doesn't feel too packed. But def get there early (around 10am) to get a car space.

reviews.title: Like a factory made cake!!!
reviews.text: We saw this beach recently on our drive up to Fiskardo. From the main road, the beach  is nothing short of spectacular. The white sand and cliffs with many shades of blue, create a vision which is so so special. I could see it was very busy with cars parked along the road leading down to it so we decided to visit it later on in the day. It was the right decision as we managed to drive all the way to the car park by the beach and park quickly and easily. However, my husband likened it to a ‘factory made cake’ which looks amazing but is a disappointment as you bite into it!!!! The beach was a dusty, dirty mix of pebbles and sand, which was more like builders sand, in fact , to me it seemed like a beach that had been extended by man! I do realise that for many families it’s clearly a popular beach, room to play and spread out, but after the massive wow factor looking down from above, I would suggest you look, then find somewhere further along the coast to relax and enjoy Kephalonia’s beautiful coastline!

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: This beach is absolutely stunning.  It was busy, but worth it to see the clear waters.  It’s definitely worth a visit and is recommend going to Assos too that’s about 10 min drive further up the coast.The beach has toilets and a bar/cafe too

reviews.title: Beautiful sunset
reviews.text: The beach is very large and beautiful with a little cave on the left. There is a bar where you can buy sandwiches, icecreams, beverages. The beach is provided of umbrellas and sunbeds.The view of the sunset on the beach is breathtaking.

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Took photos from view point above. It was amazing,  the colours were stunning. Windy narrow roads,don't look down !

reviews.title: bedazzled!
reviews.text: prepare for some great waves!a water so blue and sand so white, it is no wonder this beach has made it to top 10.be careful with the waves, as there are strong currents and you can end up feeling as inside a washing machine. other than that, it is a must when in Kephalonia. nice place for sunsetyou can also enjoy paragliding there.Amazing view!

reviews.title: Pretty view from afar
reviews.text: Gotta be prepared to park a bit far away from the beach which is annoying and exhausting but the beach is really pretty. During the afternoon when it became more calm, it was very dirty and  jelly fish were close by! Before it was crystal clear. There were no restaurants nearby, not really worth a second trip.

reviews.title: Very crowded in the summer!
reviews.text: The beach was stunning and the sea light turquoise, just as the pictures show, however they don't show just how crowded these stunning beaches are.  August is also the Greeks holiday time, so not only do you have the tourists from other countries trying to get to these stunning coves, but also the Greeks trying to enjoy their fabulous lslands.Not for us in the heat and height of summer - next time we come to Kefalonia, we will visit this gorgeous Island out of season.

reviews.title: The best in Kefalonia!
reviews.text: For me is the best beach in Kefalonia, by far. I went there in August and It was easy to park the car and the beach has a lot of space (we had a lot os space for us). The water is hot and transparent. I recommend you to go to the viewpoint where you can take probably the best photos of your holidays! Incredible!

reviews.title: August
reviews.text: Immediately deep water not suitable for small children the road is dangerous and full of precipices.Not recommended in August the water is beautiful.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach  with turquise  watersIt has not many sunbeds and umbrelasThere ia a bar for drinks , snaks.....The most important problem is the parkingIt is a must - you should visit it

reviews.title: Natural beauty, but busy!
reviews.text: Myrtos is a fabulously beautiful beach and definitely worth a visit. The sea almost doesn’t look real with the white rock below reflecting through the water to turn it acquamarine.The drive down is fine until you get to the bottom, which is pretty congested. Better to leave the car on the side of the road and walk the last bit. The beach itself is large and pebbley with virtually no shade. There’s a small beach bar there too which is useful for drinks and snacks.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a breathtakingly beautiful beach. Our family really enjoyed our time here and would advise getting here relatively early (by 10ish) in order to park easily and get great photos without too many others around. It’s a pebble beach, so rock shoes help we found. There are great views of the beach from the coastal road above to the North. When we left at 12, parking looked to be very difficult and the beach was pretty busy.

reviews.title: Perilous narrow steep drive - horrific experience!!
reviews.text: Drove all the way here from Skala and the imbeciles parking on the VERY narrow, thousands of metres high , steep road which goes on for over 2kms, made me so mad. You can’t turn round, and if afraid of heights you will be petrified. I am! The car drivers so selfishly park on this road that there are traffic jams on the way up and down and you are stuffed! They even park on the red markings which clearly say NO PARKING. This means inevitable traffic jams and no way of turning round. You will likely have a hire car, which is a different ball game to your own car and I didn’t like being so close to the edge on a steep incline as this is. It was so horrific that my car passengers freaked and I had to stop the car and get out. I had to ask another car driver - a French guy - to please turn my car round as I wasn’t going to head to the beach as it was too awful a drive. He literally did a ten point run for me which I didn’t have the nerve to do on such a thin road , and my car was literally clinging on the edge of the cliff with thousands of metres drop down. Terrifying!! How I drove up to the top of the road I will never know, with aggressive drivers on the way down seemingly not caring if your car went over the edge. I drove in first gear the whole way up. We did not regret not visiting the beach. There needs to be a better way of getting there than this!We went to a stunning beach just down from Agia Efimia instead!

reviews.title: Sadly spoilt
reviews.text: In the height of tourist season this beautiful beach of tiny white pebbles is best avoided...unfortunately! Unless of course you don't mind being rammed on with 100s of other tourists and having to park a mile away up a steep hill that is! Best viewed from the top road, take some photos and move on...in my opinion!

reviews.title: Great scenery
reviews.text: Lovely big beach with amazing view and relaxing atmosphere. Very crowded if you come too late. Parking will be a problem after 9:30/10:00.

reviews.title: To enjoy Myrtos in August stay away after 10 am
reviews.text: August is a popular month for tourists. Myrtos is a breathtaking attraction for the hordes of tourists arriving by any means available (boat tours, buses, cars, bicycles ) and i am talking about HORDES of tourists. Despite the fact that the beach is long and wide, its literally INFESTED with people. The only “beach bar” that monopolises  the entire beach has queue of people waiting for a bottle of water  or coffee which sometimes exceeds 15-20’ waiting under the sun. Its CRAZY. My recommendation in order to enjoy this utterly magnificent beach is to bite the bullet and wake up EARLY . I mean EARLY so you can be at the beach the latest by 8.30am . During  this time of day one can feel that is in paradise. Calmness,space, quietness . True heaven.

reviews.title: Stunning beach but....
reviews.text: This beach is stunning from the lookout point - the blue hues are out of this world. It is also gorgeous from the ground. As for swimming, there are large and dangerous waves that hit against the shore and a very strong current pulling you in. People were getting pummelled by the waves (including me!). These are not nice waves that you can ride safely on a board or anything like that - they are dangerous! There is no lifeguard either. The locals said that the beach is like this 50% of the time, sometimes it can calm down in the afternoon. I would stay more than an hour here is the conditions are rough as this really isn’t a relaxing, swimming beach.

reviews.title: Stunning view, may be very crowded
reviews.text: Breathtaking scenery where the sea meets the mountain, with clear blue water. The beach it's long and large, with some sand and rocks. There are sunbeds and umbrellas.
