However near the water there are only pebbles and the entrance in water is very steep - 1 meter and you can't touch the bottom.Make sure to go early in the morning to catch a parking spot,  otherwise people are parking on the steepy slopes above the beach, more then 2km. We visited it on a Sunday.

reviews.title: Very crazy beach, no lifeguards
reviews.text: It’s the most impressive beach with crazy waves I know. But nobody there is interested in healthy guests; there is no lifeguard, despite there are heavy waves. It’s more important how and wehre is your parking; for this controlling they have guyes.The stuff of the food-station is arrogant and unfriendly.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but......
reviews.text: The good: Myrtos beach is a beautiful beach. From high above, looking down onto it, it looks like a dream. The beach is made of beautiful white pebbles and sand. The water is warm and clean. It is a very large beach and gives the option of “ organized” meaning beach loungers and an umbrella and also bring your own umbrella and towels. It has one snack bar which was VERY BUSY but the employees managed to stay friendly and patient. There is a cabin that offers several bathrooms and even a few changing rooms and there are showers on the beach to rinse off the salt. There are also little taverns at the top of the road leading to the beach but I would suggest that you either eat before or after going to the beach. The not so good:The approach to the beach is a rather narrow 2 1/2 kilometer drive. In August, particularly during peak swimming hours, ( meaning morning until about 1:00) it is absolutely BLOCKED) with traffic. The first time we tried to go, there was a steam of cars coming UP from the beach telling us to turn back as there was “No Room” down below. We turned back and went another day but arrived about 3:30-4:00. The approach was open. The beach was still full and we stayed until 6:30. The day was still hot and the sun was still high. I recommend this strategy. General info:The “organized” part of the beach is quite a distance from the water.  There are plenty of chairs. I would recommend buying some “ water shoes”. This helps tremendously for pebble beaches. I would say that since this beach is so famous and is shown on many post cards and travel logs, you should go once but keep the information above in mind.  Also, I had a beautiful little butterfly land on my finger! Extra plus! ⛱😎

reviews.title: Avoid this place. Just take a photo from top
reviews.text: Driving down and trying to find a park on the edge of a steep cliff is like a nightmare. The place is packed with tourists. Save your time and check out a more exclusive beach nearby. Worth a snap from up the top only but drive down at your peril.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Most beautiful picturesque beach i have ever visited, it was very busy, no available sunbeds but just sitting on our towels and swimming in clear water was fantastic....Don't forget your beach shoes

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: The beach is really stunning and with sand and clean turquoise waters is certainly one of the most beautifull beaches in Kefalonia. But parking is very limited and you have to park on the roadside, at least a 20 minute climb away. Also tthe sunbeds and umbrellas are where when we arrived (10:30) almost  taken. Small bar for refreshments and food (sandwiches,  hotdog,  cheese pie). At 2 a clock there was no sandwiches and cheese pies.So, come early or do not come that all. Too busy in August.

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: The beach looks stunning from the cliff and is certainly one of the sandiest beaches in kefalonia. However parking is very limited and lots of people have to park on the steep roadside, at least a 20 minute climb away. There’s a refreshment bar there but with very long queues. Really wasn’t for us..... took one look and decided to leave that one and go elsewhere.

reviews.title: Amazing pebble beach in Cephalonia but 2 advices for you
reviews.text: Myrtos beach was an amazing end to our excursion trip in  Argastoli the Cephalonia - Greece .. just be ready with you sun screen and beach shoes tight on your foot .

reviews.title: Nice photo op from the cliff, but dirty sea.
reviews.text: It looks beautiful from the road, white beach, blue water. So we stopped and went for a dip. The water was filthy with scum on top along the whole stretch of beach. In short take a photo and move on.

reviews.title: Dirt everywhere
reviews.text: It's my second time in 8 years. Same thing happened twice: the water was clear until yaughts arrived.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Stunning views on the way to this beach lovely village pass through , beach is amazing caves to explore very busy when we visited

reviews.title: Gorgeous but I prefer Lourdas
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is beautiful - from above! Nothing compares to the dramatic contrast of white cliff, blue sea, dazzling white sand. The beach itself is lovely but small, rather crowded and without many facilities. The drive there, with the inconsiderate car owners parking literally on the road on the way, is irritating. So worth a look but I am very glad I chose to stay someplace else as my “home base”.

reviews.title: best beach to reach by car in Cephalonia
reviews.text: There is no better beach you may reach by car in Cephalonia. Go in the morning, to get parking, at noon it's crowded. Get a good camera and make pictures from the road, from the beach, from everywhere. A drone for photos is a good idea too.

reviews.title: Breathtaking and unique!
reviews.text: I have never swam in that shade of turquoise.,. pure magic! You have got to be there, no photo can ever capture the incredible colour of this water!! Paradise on Earth 🌎! Defiantly s ‘bucket-list’ item!!

reviews.title: Worth a visit but not a long stay!
reviews.text: Definitely worth a visit to the view points to get the obligatory photo, but unfortunately, like most over touristy places, the beach had a lot of rubbish on it and in the water. Still nice to visit, but wouldn’t go out of your way!

reviews.title: Myrtos beach - the best beach ever
reviews.text: Such an amazing beach.  You must visit.  Amazing colour water and white sand.  Truly stunning.  Drive down to beach a bit hairy.

reviews.title: L...O...V...E...D  it!
reviews.text: One of the most stunning beaches I’ve been to and waters (other than those reachable only by boat) I’ve swam in. Yes, you can take a stunning, postcard perfect photo from above but to get the real feel of the beach one should really spend some time on it. Despite the pebbles the water is just stunning, and hiring a bed inexpensive (let’s not even compare it to France or the Amalfi Coast). The beach is enclosed in a bay like area, and the water very calm, making a long swim very enjoyable. A must visit when on the island!

reviews.title: Pebbles and strong waves
reviews.text: Beautiful and picturesque so you can definately get you postcard picture especially from above but on the beach itself its all pebbles and rough on your feet so make sure you have shoes or sandles you can wear on the beach and in the sea. The waves can be quite big, the pull can be quite strong and it goes from shallow to deep within a meter or 2. Stayed here for about half an hour before deciding the waves and the pebbles were a little too much for us.

reviews.title: Beach Definitely worth a visit
reviews.text: Great beach, not too crowded as it’s larger than the smaller ones in the north of the island. Parking and access not a issue if you get there in the morning. Sandals required to walk over shingle. All the beaches are different, good to have lots of choices.

reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text: Struggling to say very much positive about this beach. It’s not that it isn’t a beautiful beach but it’s so spoilt that the actual beauty of the beach pales into insignificance. If you enjoy sitting next to a very busy car park, listening to a man using a whistle to direct traffic one way, then this is the beach for you. Sadly for me, it detracted from what should be a stunning experience. The water was choppy and, in comparison to other beaches on the island, cold.  No desire to go back.

reviews.title: Only for short stay
reviews.text: Direction from Argostoli by bus to Divarta. The beautiful beach, which drives a minibus from Devarte, costs € 1.5.  Minibus travels several times during the day.  My recommendation is on the beach to arrive early in the morning or late afternoon.  Sunbeds and umbrellas are generally not free, and on the beach there is no cold.  It is best to come by car, swim, take photos, and continue on to Assos or Fiskardo.

reviews.title: Unforgettable
reviews.text: This beach is really stunning, especially the view from the top. It really takes your breath away. In fact, the whole road to the beach is magnificent landscape. The beach itself is a mix between sand and pebble beach. The the water is so blue, that it is difficult to be described. So, you really have to visit it.

reviews.title: Saw from the coastal road
reviews.text: Didn’t stop but saw beach on way to assos. We were warned it’s not great for children as the sea is rough and bad undercurrents so be careful. It did look stunning from above. The coastal road is incredible but a little unnerving to say the least!!

reviews.title: Amazing views - Choppy seas
reviews.text: Visited June 2018.Amazing beach and one of the best photos I have ever taken from the coast road, however on the day we visited the sea was very rough and for a weak swimmer like me a little intimidating. Seems like when you get into the water the ground drops off quite steeply but that might just be the way I felt as per above. Saying that, it is very beautiful and a must see if you are on Kefalonia. When we visited there were no sun beds or life guards and the toilet facilities were portoloos but as said, amazing place to visit and the drive down to the beach pretty spectacular.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: The position and the view of the beach from high is perfect. The color of water is very beautiful. It has sunbeds but there is enough space if you want to seat down with your own umbrella and enjoy the sea.

reviews.title: Stunning panoramic view from top
reviews.text: One of the most stunning beaches when you view it from above. The white pebbles against the turquoise see is breathtaking. However, you will need to park quite a way up the hill as it is very popular. Very few sun beds and parasols available so make sure you bring your own. Lying on huge pebbles is Not comfortable. The sea is quite cold here and getting in and out of the sea tricky due to the pebbles. Definit

reviews.title: Top 20 beach in the world, really?!!
reviews.text: The overwhelming consensus was, no. Don’t get me wrong it’s very picturesque, providing you ignore the car park and the winding snake of cars disappearing  up the hill. 2 Sun beds with a brolly will set you back €10, which is a little higher than what we’ve experienced elsewhere. There is somewhere to change which was clean and tidy. We didn’t use the toilets, so unfortunately I can’t give you any insight there. There are also showers to wash the salt off after a dip. The sea is cold, much colder than at Antisamos. Also the waves are much more significant, so not really suitable for young children. The drive there, as with many roads on the island will keep you on your toes. I’m sure the views are amazing from the road but my focus was 100% on the thin strip of tarmac. There is one bar at the beach, we didn’t use but was very busy.After having had a super swim we left after 2 hours. There isn’t anything else to do. Oh, don’t forget your swim shoes, the beach is pebbly and you’ll regret not having them. In summary, nice to visit, I’d get there early as parking can be a challenge (especially if you are unfortunate enough to need to park on the hill). Glad we went, but are we going back? No, we prefer Antisamos.

reviews.title: Wasps and strong undercurrents...
reviews.text: I have visited Myrtos Beach many times and it's one of my favourite beaches in the entire world but this year there have been many unfortunate incidents on the beach and in the sea. There are wasp warnings, so if you're allergic, be sure to have your meds with you. There are no life guards on the beach this year, no first aid kits, nothing! In June, a woman died on the beach after being stung. The sea is also really dangerous, as there are very strong undercurrents that pull you under, so don't let your small kids swim alone. There have been a few reports of people almost drowning this year. So, if I were you, take photos of this stunning beach but avoid spending time on it. There are so many other beautiful beaches on the island that are exquisite and safe to swim at.

reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: Wow what can I say excellent beach pebbles don't drive its a nightmare to park but if you seen the film captains corrili manderin your no why this beach has been voted the best on the island it's a must see

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We visited Myrtos beach on the same day as Melissani Cave and I recommend both! Crystal clear water and a very large beach with a lot of room

reviews.title: Beautiful but way too crowded
reviews.text: The Myrtos Beach is a genuine beauty, which became way too touristy, which kills its magic. After 12:00 it is absolutely impossible to park. The cars are abandoned along already narrow and treaky road, which makes the trip simply stressful and dangerous.

reviews.title: Great beach, a must visit
reviews.text: Fantastic beach with clear turquoise water and white pebbles. Umbrella / beach bed rentals available and a small café. Don't forget to swim through the small cave and jump from the big rock at the far left of the beach (if you are facing the ocean). Enjoy!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: The road is steep and narrow to the beach, however it is worth the effort. We arrived around 6pm on a warm June day and it was beautiful and reasonably quite.We did not want to leave.

reviews.title: A real eye cather
reviews.text: It’s lovely to see such treasure but almost impossible to swim when the waves are present which happens quite often because of the wind.

reviews.title: Amazing setting
reviews.text: This beach is worth a visit,  it is set against huge dramatic cliffs and the water is turquoise clear, but this place doesn’t have good facilities “ time for a make over” the beach it self is made from white pebbles which are very painful to walk on when leaving the water 😫 I recommend beach shoes to mitigate the pain and getting in the water is quite difficult as the waves roll in... moan over, it’s worth a visit.

reviews.title: Outstanding beauty
reviews.text: Got to be of the most beautiful places I’ve ever seen, crystal clear water and breath taking views. It’s such a pity that to get there was so frustrating. My only fault on the trip was the road down to was manic with cars and buses trying to get up and down, nowhere to park once you start your descend down only to drive back up frustrated. Advice is to park at top of hill and walk down but prepare for the half mile gruelling walk back up.

reviews.title: Tips for parking - and don’t be duped by fake parking attendants
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is lovely and if you are on Kefalonia, it is worth the effort to spend half a day there - best early morning. With parking, the best advice is to go early - before 10am. Parking signage is minimal and possibly confusing when you first arrive. After the last hairpin bend, not far above the sand, you come to the apex of a triangle which has a small bus shelter - you need to go straight ahead / slightly angled to the right - as this takes you onto the triangle which is effectively a one-way street, and allows cars to go in an anti clockwise direction around the triangle, back up to the bus shelter, and out of the beach. If you arrive after 10am you are probably going to have to park up on the hairpin bends. You generally have to drive all the way down to the sand, around the triangle, and then back up to park in the next available spot up the hairpins. You have to park on the right side of the road as you go up. Whatever you do, don’t be duped be duped by fake parking attendants - these will encourage you to park in the wrong spot, ask you for money, and you will generally be in for a disagreeable time. (We saw this exact thing happen to 3 unsuspecting tourists, who were just trying to do the right thing). Be warned.

reviews.title: Photo opportunity
reviews.text: Just did this as a photo opportunity from above as part of my day trip. It did look attractive and given more time would have liked to have gone down.

reviews.title: Worth to visit!
reviews.text: Go there by 9am and choose your spot.2 sun beds +umbrella 10euro.Most of the things at the bar coast 3euro ,bar opens by 11am.Free showers,WC and parking.Crystal clear water. Great place to be!

reviews.title: The most Famous Beach
reviews.text: Breathtaking view from up to the beach. Beach has white stones and sand , has sunbeds and beach bar. Water is blue but not very clear, not good for snorgeling, going deep imidietly. Amazing to watch  sunset there.

reviews.title: Park on the beach
reviews.text: Back in 2015 my late husband & I took a shipment of goats from the UK to Greece. Some went to the mainland and the rest went to Kefalonia. We went by ferry from the mainland with our livestock trailer. After delivery we were free to explore. Having seen Myrtos Beach in the famous "Captain Corelli's Mandolin" film we set off to find it. What a stunning location. You can drive down a steep track all the way to the lovely beach. My husband had his last swim in the sea there so it is a very special place for me.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Breathtaking view  when driving down to beach.  Colours of the water fantastic.  Sand and pebbles strongish current and very very  hot down there   bar and toilets at back of beach

reviews.title: Magical Myrtos
reviews.text: Famous for 'that' film but this beach has more to offer than that. Beautifully blue waters and a long white pebble beach. A great place to sit back, relax and enjoy listening to the waves crashing into the beach. Parking can be chaotic so get there early or late on and walk further down the beach towards the cliff to escape the crowds. Oh, and don't forget to get a picture at the top of the cliffs on the way to or from the beach.

reviews.title: Wow wow wow
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is in Pylaros and  is surrounded by tall and green cliffs. The color of the sea changes from dark blue to electric blue and turquoise. Its  stunning at every moment of the day.You cant help but be captivated by this location. It just draws you in. This is not a beach to go swimming in. The current is extremely dangerous. I have never seen such huge waves. The day I visited no one was swimming, instead all were at the edge running into and quickly away from the waves crashing around. Definitely keep an eagle eye on young children. To rent a chaise longe for the day is 20 euros. We had good cocktails and very friendly service from the staff at the only bar there. The beach toilets were clean.A must for anyone in the area.

reviews.title: Beautiful to look at .... great water temp... take shoes.
reviews.text: Myrtos is a MUST SEE if you're in the area. You really can't be close and NOT go. Be aware of sitting in the natural shade provided by the 'mountain' as the rockfall is pretty hectic. If windy don't put up umbrella. The water is lovely - the pebble beach can be pretty rough on your feet so if you have water shoes take them. It's a beautiful beach to look at and apparently is open to topless bathing and on the right-hand-side apparently nudity... I saw 3 women topless and no nudity. Very kid friendly and family friendly. Go early to avoid the crowd and also it gets SUPER hot after 2 so the earlier the better. Enjoy

reviews.title: Turquoise Blue
reviews.text: A beautiful beach- the colour of the water is breathtaking(we were told the amazing colour of the water is due to limestone).A strong current &  waves strong enough to knock you over the day we went.Quite a journey around & down by car (we took a taxi!)On the rocky beaches I would recommend the swim shoes you see for sale around the place (around €10 Euros).

reviews.title: Just do this all day
reviews.text: One of if not the most beautiful beaches I have been to. Limited bathroom/changing stations so come in your bathing suits. Additionally there is no restaurants or snack stands so bring lunch or snack with you. Wide open beach with no shade bring umbrella  if you so desire. Plan to spend all day at the beach. Can taxi back and forth from the port.

reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: Drove to this beach on moped, stunning views from above, white pebble beach with Crystal clear water, a must to see when in Kefalonia

reviews.title: Not as good from beach level as from above
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning when viewing from above, so picturesque. Given its beauty it attracts lots of visitors. Beach was very busy and dirty. Couldn't relax as you're likely to get a wind glider land on you as they use this beach to land on after jumping from cliffs above. The sea was rough when we visited and got deep quickly. Much better beaches around.

reviews.title: Amazing beach, beautiful setting, great view and journey to there.
reviews.text: Yes, this is the most famous beach and for good reason. The journey to there is incredible and the view is stunning but you need to be a confident driver and not have fear of height (like everywhere  else in kafelonia). We personally prefer anti Samos near sami but still very good, get water shoes or crocs, the pebble beach will be hard on your feet

reviews.title: Dramatic beach landscape
reviews.text: Turquoise waters, small white pebbles underfoot. Gets deep very quickly. Take a parasol (or hire a lounger) as there's no natural shade from the punishing Greek sun. We had 2 dips and got out before we fried to death.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We were told its a very photographic place and indeed it is.  The small white pebbles that make up the beach glisten and glow in the sun.  Views from the top are simply amazing.  You do not have to be a photographer to obtain good pictures.  Well worth seeing and definately on a list for those wanting scenic views.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach is what you need to see
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is what you need to see .We have seen it and it is true . We believe it may be one of the most beautiful beaches in Europe . The colors are unbelievable !

reviews.title: Ignore the Hype
reviews.text: Despite numerous positive reviews this is not the idyllic beach it’s made out to be. While pretty enough from a distance, it’s a pebbly beach so not comfortable to sit on or walk to and from the sea.Probably worth visiting just so you can say that you’ve been there but please take suitable footwear if you plan to go into the sea and a very thick towel if you want to sit on the beach.

reviews.title: My favorite beach
reviews.text: I liked Myrtos because it is a stunning location with picturesque white rock beach and a great cave to explore on the south side. We set up our beach towels against the cliffside so we could be shaded from the sun and swam in the clear blue waters. The temp is perfect and like the rest of the waters around kefalonia I never needed to buy goggles because I could see just fine with my eyes open in the clear waters.

reviews.title: Be aware of the falling rocks!
reviews.text: Looking for a shade I spent the most of the day on the very left side of the beach (sea wiev left side). I was lucky not to get injured by a heavy rock falling from above. The stones are falling the whole day long and there is no sign. If you want to be in shade, move deeper into a cave

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Absolutely awesome setting one of the nicest beaches we have seen on our holiday so far beautiful sand crystal clear azure blue water parking is limited a couple of tavernas and toilets showers too

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Didn't actually go down to the beach as we were on a coach, but stopped at viewing point looking down, what a stunning view!

reviews.title: nice beach but very busy
reviews.text: we wanted to see this famous beach so popped over to it from assos one morning , the road down to it is very steep and winding and the carpark at the bottom was full so go early , parking is free there is a small taverna and toilets the beach does look amazing when you are there but we found it far too busy , we were told it is not very good for snorkelling  but there were plenty of sun loungers for hire

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: We were stunned to see this beach from the road above, it really is so bright, the water and the pebbles. The road down was pretty scary and the parking at the beach haphazard. We would have spent longer at the beach if we had been happier with where we had parked our hire car!Glad we went though, it is beautiful.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach you need a car and when we got there it was very busy one of the best beaches on the island well worth a visit

reviews.title: Fabulous crescent shaped beach
reviews.text: Saturday 29th June 2019. Family of 4 (ages 21 to 64). It's a winding drive down to the two large parking areas. The beach is mainly pebbles, but fine to walk on. It's very large indeed, so although this was the weekend (we arrived at about 11am) it did not feel even remotely crowded. There is a snack shop and a large area given over to regimented rows of sun chairs and umbrellas which you can hire. We didn't as our visit was just to have a dip in the (quite cold!) sea and a walk along the shoreline. There are 2 watchtowers, but they were not manned when we were there so it would be wise to keep an eye on children at all times here. At one end there is a cool cave where people go to take photos inside the cave with the waves in the background. A couple was also sitting there...wouldn't be much room for many more people. In terms of shade, and if you're here for a while, then either bring a beach umbrella or hire one here because the sun is pretty intense. It was quite windy when we were here, and some umbrellas were getting blown away. It's a lovely beach and well worth a visit. It would probably be best to get here early - say around 9am when there is sufficient heat in the sun, but you are before the coaches (which do come here - but as I say it's a huge beach so I doubt you'd ever be pushed for space).

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: A fantastic beach with plenty of parking available. A bit boring for snorkelling as it’s just a sand bottom with a few rocks but the water is so clear! A lovely “secret” cave at the end of the beach!

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but full of Towie look a likes posing and pouting.  Beach cafe limited food so went to restaurant on the way back

reviews.title: What a heavenly place ..
reviews.text: This was on our bucket list after viewing the bay from above last year. We were travelling with Tui and our local rep was very negative when we enquired about visiting. “Almost impossible by public transport, no facilities or shade when you get there, no other tours available”We hired a car for the day, and found the complete opposite, beds and shade €10/day, small self service cafe, WCs and changing facilities! Interestingly, tour buses too. Seems there is a tour from Argostoli for €25 for a 2hr beach stop - geared up for the cruise ships which are now a feature in Argostoli. Parking is very limited and the road down winding, steep and narrow. We can see it’s a dilemma for the local tourist industry as the last thing you would want is to spoil such an idyllic spot, but we feel slightly frustrated at Tui’s spin on visiting. Well worth a visit though but get there early.

reviews.title: What a beach!
reviews.text: This beach is incredible, you will never see such clear blue water. the drive down to it is abit scary, but once your down there its amazing!!

reviews.title: Nice view from afar
reviews.text: We stopped off at the viewing point to look at this beautiful beach and the view was glorious. However we didnt bother driving down to it given that it is unsafe for swimming due to strong currents. Think that was the best decision! We discovered Mounda Beach near Skala  which is very sandy and shallow so perfect for little ones if you're looking for a bathing beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful little beach
reviews.text: This is a stunner of a beach. Beautiful clear water, beautiful pebble stones along with sand. Amazing views. It really is worth a visit. My only caution... the waves can get quite high and rough quite quick so if you’re with tiny ones just be careful. Also take your own sandwiches or have a late lunch, I really wouldn’t bother eating at the local taverna on the beach - the baguettes were awful - had barely any filling and no butter or mayo/ketchup inside so it was like trying to chew 15 dry crackers!?

reviews.title: A long Drive down to the beach
reviews.text: From the main road it is a long drive down the the beach along narrow twisty roads so be aware of coaches either way . Once you get down the the beach it’s just as good as the view from the top road. Great sun trap so beware you will brown very quick with the sun and breeze combined.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in the World and you can see why. Located in a cove surrounded by sheer cliffs it is one of the big attractions on Kefalonia. The view looking down to the beach is iconic.There is a large parking area at the side of the road which can get busy.To drive to the beach the road has a number of hairpin bends to negotiate.

reviews.title: love this beach!
reviews.text: this is one of the must see beaches, really pretty turquoise water, white shingle beach.in my opinion you need water shoes on the shingle, and not suitable for young children as it gets deep very quickly.there are umbrellas and beds, and a caféfairly steep drive down, but room to park when you get there.

reviews.title: Stay at the top and look down at the beach
reviews.text: Went to Myrtos beach today for the third time as I wanted to see if it had changed from my other visits in 2012 and 2014. If you park at the top and look down this beach looks amazing, clear blue sea that meets a clear blue sky and green trees on the sides of the cliffs that surrounds the most loveliest looking white sand. But wait that’s not sand that’s stones  that range from large to small and hurt when walked on and I have never see the water calm as the stones slope steeply in the water sometimes making the waves knock you off your feet. Although today it was the calmest I have see it. I really don’t know how this could be considered one of the best beaches in Greece. The drive to the beach isn’t that bad it’s the drive up that’s worse and the parking is terrible for a beach that is one of Greece’s finest. But all in all you have to go and experience the beach yourself so you can say you have been there I would advise that you take a parasol, drinks and beach shoes so those stones don’t hurt.

reviews.title: Beautiful but take a parasol
reviews.text: the drive down is stunning and the beach and sea themselves are next to none. due to the mountains either side there is limited breeze so it gets extremely hot and we both burnt. definitely take a parasol!

reviews.title: Great if you can cope with the drive
reviews.text: Challenging road down. Some toilets but not well maintained, Beach bar just setting up in early June. Shelving beach so care needed when swimming

reviews.title: Beautiful view - worth climbing down to ??
reviews.text: We visited Myrtos and took some photos from the cliff above. It looks like beautiful sand, but actually shingle. And it has loads of wasps. Nice photo opp. But we didn’t bother staying.

reviews.title: NO FACILITIES
reviews.text: Very difficult drive down a narrow track. Very poor toilets. No facilities. Take everything you'll need for the day. TIP: On arrival, do not follow the arrow to car parking - keep left instead.

reviews.title: Not enough facilities
reviews.text: We drove down all the way to the beach with high expectations, supposedly the most beautiful beach of the island. Even in the pre season we found all facilities occupied although overall there were not even that many people. So we left and drove to another beach nearby with free beds and umbrella’s. The many small bays and beaches offer a much better alternative.

reviews.title: Beautiful hot beach
reviews.text: One of the highlights of Kefalonia. Personally i prefer Petani Beach or the Sandy beaches around Argostoli. Quite hot here as there is almost no wind. Sea is not as clear and clean as other beaches in Kefalonia but still worth a visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This little beach is truly stunning!!  The colours are just so.....blue, green, turquoise!! Amazing little place!! Yes, it is a pebbled beach, but you can walk on it easily.  There was a little cafe when we went end of May 2019. Take your own beach kit.

reviews.title: Worth a Visit
reviews.text: Nice spot but you’ll need ur beach shoes as it’s all pebbles. The sea is a wonderful blue azure colour but everyone comes here. Try some of the other less well known Kiriakis and Vouti. .

reviews.title: Lego Beach
reviews.text: Really nice to look at but not so nice to walk on.... this beach is the equivalent to walking on Lego.......lots and lots of Lego

reviews.title: Myrtos
reviews.text: One of the best beaches of the Ionian islands. Extremely blue waters, awesome landscape! It’s a “must” for Kefalonia!

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Amazing beach a real gem to the island of kefalonia, weather your on the beach or up on the mountain above the views are amazing a must go if on the island

reviews.title: Very Beautiful.
reviews.text: This Beach is lovely very windy to get to and dont forget your sun cream as there are no shops, cafes down there, it is totally unspoilt. The colour of the sea is stunning.

reviews.title: Worth a look
reviews.text: Have just returned from Kefalonia and one of my 'must see' visits was Myrtos Beach.I wasn't disappointed. lovely white beach made up mainly of pebbles and a very steep drive down to get to it. The cave at the end is worth a look also. Only downside was that the toilets were locked up presumably until the season begins and there was nowhere to buy a drink so if you want to spend some time there take your own drinks. The view from the top is to die for also and there is a 'pull in' observation point for cars and buses.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Absolutely breathtaking location and even better in May when almost deserted even on a sunny day - don't forget your camera

reviews.title: Worth a selfie!
reviews.text: You could mistake for being in Thailand it's that stunning with the turquoise waters and islands beyond!Beach hut just being built ready for summer season so definitley worth a visit..

reviews.title: Simply Beautiful
reviews.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches I have come across in Greece and there are many!  Seen from the road above, the turquoise colour of the water is so stunningly vibrant that you realize right away you absolutely have to find your way to the white-pebble beach to experience it firsthand. Swimming or snorkeling in these crystal clear water is a treat you won’t want to miss.  If you can arrange to approach the beach by kayak, that is even better!

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: A steep windy road which opens into a stunning beach. Both times I’ve visited the beach has been relatively empty and it’s so wide you feel you have the place to yourself.We hired a car, apparently the coach trips stop at the top and ask if you want to walk down to the beach, walk down!Lovely cafe Alexander is a good spot to stop on the way back. Great cake and coffee and clean toilets.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Deserted when we visited in May however I would imagine an absolute tourist overload in high season. Stunning bay no bars, untouched paradise. Stay away from rocks as rock falls from goats

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stopped here for a few hours whilst we had the hire car. The beach was quiet (very early morning) and the sea so inviting, had a lovely quiet time here. Such a beautiful beach.

reviews.title: MYRTOS BEACH
reviews.text: A stunningly beautiful beach with a cave at the side. White Pebble beach with a multi coloured bay of sea. Crystal clear. Extremely dangerous under current so be careful if swimming there. Well worth a visit

reviews.title: Beautiful locstion
reviews.text: Secluded in early season. Worth the journey, fantastic view. Limited parking. 😉 Roads  /access a challenge, but the vista superb.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is always stunning, even in the rain. This is a place we always visit when we come to Kefalonia. Please take a look for yourselves.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, definitely a favourite of mine. Has a beautiful hidden gem of a little cave there too which is a must see. Has beautiful waters reminds me of the Caribbean. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Nice not nothing special
reviews.text: Definitely better seeing from above then actually being on the beach. Quite stoney and shingle. Lovely smooth white pebbles and waves. Obviously made famous by the film so guess must see

reviews.title: Breathtaking view
reviews.text: From upstairs looks amazing.Sandy beach,turquoise water turning to purple blue 100 meters from the beach.But it’s very rare absolute clear waters because of the transported slopes of passing vessels.The dangerous waves sometimes makes difficult to swim out and tho local authorities don’t take any measures against.

reviews.title: Enjoy
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful beach. Has a mix of larger and fine stone, the finer sand is so soft, not sticky and a beautiful white. Has an incredible back drop of the cliff front through the winding road to the hidden, perfectly clear blue sea. I think the clearest I’ve ever seen!

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach 2018
reviews.text: What a stunning beach ! The waters are crystal clear and the views from above are stunning ! It's well worth a visit as part of your Island discovery 😉

reviews.title: ONE OF THE BEST BEACHES
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos Beach twice, 2014 and 2018.  1st visit in 2014, there was big waves and look extremely dangerous, so we only went in to our waist.  (i've heard that there has been many drownings here, so we were extra careful.  2nd trip in 2018, it was like magic, very, very mild waves (almost flat), we had the best swim of our trip, we went a couple hundred meters out (two children, two adults) and not a hint of danger at all.  We just happen to catch this beach on a good day on our second trip.  A big highlight of our trip.  While on Cephalonia, make sure you visit 'Makris Yialos' also a great beach with bar/food and plenty of hire umbrellas and banana chairs.

reviews.title: Better appreciated from above
reviews.text: There is no denying that Myrtos beach is beautiful the sea is so blue but it looks so much better looking down from above than when you are actually on the beach which is over crowded and difficult to park. It also has the worst toilet facilities I have ever been too. I have been to many places in the world and been to some pretty dubious toilets, I am not fussy at all I will go any where, but this place was covered floor to ceiling in poo which was a bit much even for me.

reviews.title: So pretty it looks like candy from the cliff above!
reviews.text: The drive down to parking lot might be bit treacherous but once there you park right next to the beach.It has warm turquoise water and you can float/swim all day.When I was there there was no vending of any kind so bring your food and drink.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: By far one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The only downside is that its a pebble beach.

reviews.title: just falling in love with the views and colour of sea
reviews.text: what a stunning beach, the view from the top just not give Myrtos justice. As when swimming in the beautiful, blue waters of this beach:)

reviews.title: Everything and more
reviews.text: Honestly the most beautiful beach I have ever been too. Difficult drive to get to it but well worth it. It's just like the pictures. Would be nice if there was shops / taverna nearby so that you could make a day of the beach, but that might spoil it's natural beauty.

reviews.title: Most amazing beach
reviews.text: Best beach in KefaloniaWe had a very hairy drive to get here but it was worth itViews are incredible

reviews.title: Stunning beach but...
reviews.text: Beach is absolutley stunning, plentyof room even in mis August.  Couple of negatives are that unless you get theer very early there aer no sunbeds so bring your own shad and something to lie on as the beach gets hot.  Also parking..... if you dont manage to get there early you could be parking over a kilometre away on the road.  which then makes it fun to try and leave as then the road down becomes a single road with minimal passing spaces.... took me and my daughter about 40 minutes to get to the main road at the top (should take about 5 minutes)  so if you dont like hill starts in your car dont do it! :-)

reviews.title: Fabulous - came up to expectations
reviews.text: We visited 3 times in our short stay on Kefalonia. The sea colour is absolutely wonderful  - just like the pictures but probably better. We were fortunate to experience one day with high wind and the waves  and spectacle were fantastic. A must see loaction

reviews.title: Lovely beach but hire a car
reviews.text: This is a great beach, probably the most beautiful one in kefalonia- but it can be difficult to get to. I would definitely recommend hiring a car as there is a very long, steep road down to the beach which would not be fun to walk back up in the heat. Great beach overall with toilets and ice cream shop 🏖

reviews.title: Ok beach.
reviews.text: I know that this supposed to be the best beach on the island, but I was there only once.. I think you will have quite a few beaches like that on the island.

reviews.title: great place to see
reviews.text: Fiskardo a picturesque port lined with pastel coloured houses that rings the small harbor with heaps of relaxing cafés and shops to explore. This village is the only one on the whole island to emerge unscathed from the great quake in 1953. You could spend many hours here. Myrtos bay stunning waters with neon blue and the veiws are truely amazing.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: One of our road trips while staying in Kefalonia.  The ride into Myrtos Beach was breathtaking! Truly a beautiful beach although youll need beach shoes cause this beach has tiny rocks.  Water was incredible and theres a cave to explore and take pictures!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: My favourite place by far.Amazing crystal clear waters that you refuse to stop swimming in .Must visit.Advise,have some shoes with you since the beach is full of stones.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful places on this planet
reviews.text: I was in Cephalonia just a few weeks ago, travelling in Greek sunshine and warmth. We pretty well covered the whole of Cephalonia during our all too short stay, the first time my wife and I had been there in some 27 years. The last time was the year before the demise of the drachma and the rise of the dreaded Euro. Needless to say, a stop at Myrtos is a must while on this beautiful island. If I could only convince my wife, I would sell up and move myself lock, stock and barrel to this heaven on earth. We travelled all over the island and I will write about different places we visited, but this is one incredibly gorgeous beach which deserves its own mention

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: A must see when you are in kefalonia. A really beautiful beach. You will need beach shoes here,the water is crystal clear.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach - unfortunatelly neglected
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in Greece - period!Every day 100s or maybe 1000s of tourists enjoy the cristal blue waters (watch out for strong flow of water - dangerous for small children). It seems that the municipality has other things to do than hiring a lifequard and so the beach lost it´s "blue flag". Aditionally there was no place where you could buy a bottle of water - that´s a shame. You should bring beach foot wear because of the stones and get there early on high season (until 10:00) or else you will have to park high up the cliff.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: What a view. We visited whilst on a day trip to Kefalonia and we are so glad we did. The beach is beautiful. If you have the opportunity then visit. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: A Must Visit
reviews.text: If you're on Kefalonia, you simply must visit Myrtos Beach. As soon as you come around the corner to see it for the first time it will simply take your breath away.One piece of advice though, bring beach shoes as, from a distance it may look like white sand, it is actually small pebbles, so a bit sore on bare feet. Snorkelling here is great as the visibility is unbelievable and there are plenty of fish to see.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach - Worth a Visit
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos Beach whilst travelling around the island.This beach is featured in the film 'Captain Corelli's Mandolin'.There is a very narrow windy lane down to the beach (not for the faint hearted) but worth it in the end.The water was crystal clear and the long white sandy beach was amazing.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Drove here one of the most breathtaking views in Kefalonia.  If you hire a car you must go and visit this beach if only for the photo's.

reviews.title: Stunning beautiful location
reviews.text: Stunning beautiful location with quite a long twisting road down to beach.Best viewed from the high cliffs above- which are about 300 -400 foot  high at this point. This just emphasises the perfect golden crescent of sand and shingle set in an azure and light blue sea. There are some organised franchise sunbeds and umbrellas, but this is restricted to one small area only. Myrtos beach is the film location for the beach scenes including "exploding a naval mine" from "Captain Corolli's mandolin".Lovely places to visit - even if it is by the rather complicated bus schedules.

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: best Beach in Kefalonia! The view from the top is just breathtaking! And the beach itself is beautiful. Amazing shades of blue! Perfect place for a sunset!

reviews.title: What a sublime view.
reviews.text: This must be one of the most photographed beaches anywhere in Greece. It combination of white pebbles against an azure blue sea is truly a must-see, but take care if you bathe there, as the beach falls sharply as you enter the sea, and there are sharp undercurrents ready to rip you off your feet. You can see from the photo next to this review how long and tortuous the road twists and turns down off the main road. This photo was taken from a viewpoint further along the road to Assos and Fiscardo, which has ample safe parking.

reviews.title: Takes Your Breath Away
reviews.text: This is a breathtaking beach.  The white beach and turquoise waters cannot be matched.Heads up, parking is minimal, beach has lots of round rocks and is hard on your bare feet.  So, get there early and wear water shoes.

reviews.title: Greece, land of blue.
reviews.text: When you have been descending the winding road down to the beach you will find a place for your car most of the times. Pebble beach with amazing blue water. The pebbles will hurt you feet. Use watershoes for comfort. The cave at the left is attractive, be ware of falling stones from the hill however. Great beach for a swim. We spotted a muray eal!

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Sand and pebbles but very nice. Not so easy without a car though. Would be a nice place to drop anchor.

reviews.title: Beautiful but be careful in the surf.
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is certainly beautiful. Get there early, there are many spots but they do fill up quickly. We had a great day but did notice many people having difficulty in the dumping waves. As an Australian who is used to changeable surf conditions, based on what I saw the day we were there, this beach is absolutely beautiful but not safe for unsupervised kids.Enjoy this beach but look out for each other. Stay safe.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Great beech with white sand and small pebbles. You'll need your sea shoes for this one. But wow! turquoise water, waves crashing onto the shore, sun loungers, parking on the beech front. The road down and up to the beech is typically Greece. Very scary and not for the faint hearted but it's well worth the visit so don't be put off.

reviews.title: Ok but not all that
reviews.text: Went to Myrtos beach as a swim stop on way back from Fiscardo. Agreed it was empty and water was clear but the beach is only worth the 20 minutes we were there. In summary it’s ok as part of something else but not worth going as your only destination

reviews.title: Dramatic beach
reviews.text: Dramatic setting and you can park right at the beach . I prefer more rustic place with old fashioned tavernas with wilder beaches so this was not for me . However there is no denying its beauty , it’s very exposed with little shelter but great for swimming .

reviews.title: Magnificent Myrtos
reviews.text: The local tourist industry describe this as an organised beach, which means it has sun loungers for hire and has some services. It is possible to find spots for sunbathing without loungers. It is in a dramatic location with huge cliffs on three sides. There is a good road going down, with multiple hairpin bends, quite a number of road safety barriers but not everywhere so travel with the customary caution that Kefalonian roads demand. One of the spectacles of this location is the amazing colour of the sea with pools of turquoise and ultramarine alternating across the bay. Unmissable really.

reviews.title: amazing views on the way, basic beach, great for swimming
reviews.text: the view from above (on the way) is priceless, the beach itself has just basic amenities (sunbeds, simple kiosk), no real escape from the sun, but the water is amazingly clear and great for swimming. a must visit in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: a must see,we walked on the beach to the cave,but did not swim.The view from the top is amazing a beautiful spot

reviews.title: Stunning.
reviews.text: A really superb spot. The drive down is a little steep (not shocking for Kef), but there are good amenities and a really special spot in general.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: There are many beaches to see in Kefalonia and this is one of the ones that is a must. Many go because of the link to the film and once you see it you understand why they chose this location. Stunning.

reviews.title: Breath taking views
reviews.text: Busy beach but worth the trip down the steep access road to car park!Park anywhere you can at the bottom.........

reviews.title: Stunning scenery but basic beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach and setting but nowhere to escape from the sun.  There was only a kiosk selling drinks and one type of sandwich.

reviews.title: Stunningly beautiful
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is idyllic ! From above the colour of the sea is true blue and the beach is a mix of shingle and sand. There are WCs and a bar serving drinks and snacks, However and a big warning there is a very strong undercurrent here and lots of people were getting pulled back in trying to get out of the sea. It’s a strong surf which can be deceiving until you go in.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: Large beach in a dramatic setting. Gorgeous blue colours in the water. Quite famous and as a result, very popular. Parking can be a tad difficult, but the beach itself is big enough not to feel overcrowded. It does have facilities and a beach bar, but these are very basic. We were warned about strong under currents here, but thankfully on the day we visited it was calm and swimming was delightful.

reviews.title: Over-hyped and busy!
reviews.text: Perhaps this place is just not for me.  I like quiet and secluded - pretty Greek beaches, surrounded by olive trees, and with perhaps an old Taverna at the back!Myrtos beach is none of those things, apart from having a Taverna - doing burgers and chips however!The beach is large.  It is barren and devoid of any character.  It gets very busy and so do not rely on being able to rent a bed and umbrella ... take your own.On a positive side - it is a nice place to swim ... however - if there is a wind from the west of more than 5 or 6 kmh ... you may want to avoid it.  This is a wide beach that gets very choppy when it is windy.

reviews.title: Not that special!
reviews.text: We didn’t quite understand the rave reviews about this beach! Admittedly the high cliffs around you were impressive but the big white rocks instead of lovely sand do not make the walk to the sea pleasant! Facilities poor! Beach bar just serves drinks from fridges & crisps that’s about it!  Experienced much nicer beach at Lassi where drinks served to you & lovely sun beds! Still worth A short visit!

reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: One of the top beaches. Try to arrive early to avoid the crowds and find easy parking.Crystal clear waters.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: Visited this beach, the beach is ok with loungers and umbrellas, however the taverna at the beach is not very good, suggest if you do visit this beach you take food with you.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Wow, just beautiful,  Crystal clear, turquoise water. Stunning location. Fantastic panoramic views. Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Fabulous views
reviews.text: Didnt have time or patience to find a parking space and have a swim but this is certainly one popular beach, and for good reason.  Book ended by 2 headlands which provide for a protected beach, the water is a beautiful turquoise colour.  Umbrellas and sun beds can be purchased here.  Strongly suggest an early or late visit to beat the crowds.  Otherwise you will just have to satisfy yourself with brilliant views and photos of this iconic beach.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Greece
reviews.text: Amazing colors but get here the right day. Some days the beach gets crowded with touristbus people. To swim in the blue gives another meaning here...

reviews.title: Lovely - must see
reviews.text: We booked a tour which included a visit to the beach. We got to stay on the beach for an hour and it is so beautiful. You must visit this beach whilst staying in kefalonia!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: This beach is breathtaking. It's paradise and one of the most amazing beaches I have been to. Wonderful blue sea, white sands (with pebbles) and just a stunning surrounding.An absolute must if you are in Kefalonia

reviews.title: Beach paradise...almost perfect
reviews.text: I totally get why this beach gets listed among the top 10 in the world. The views as you descend the hills above are truly breathtaking. Very few locations can claim such picture postcard beauty. The clear turquoise water is typical of the Ionian Islands, especially those beaches which face west. The only beach that rivals this is Porto Katsiki in Lefkada, the next island up. The beach itself is a mix of white sand and pebbles. Getting in and out of the sea comfortably requires leaving your flipflops right at the edge. It is quite a steep shelf so not ideal for non swimmers. The beach bar serves drinks and ice creams but has a very limited food offer. Everything seems to be €3.00 for some reason. One exception: an umbrella with two sunbeds is €10.00 per day.  My advice: come in September. It's lovely and quiet, you get to park right on the edge of the beach and there's loads of space. I can't imagine it's this good in August.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach. White sand and crystal clear waters. Well worth a visit if you are in kefalonia.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: A brilliant beach with the bluest seas and lovely sand. Worth a trip to this beach. It's quite far from anything else though and quite a scary ride over the mountains to get there!

reviews.title: Best Beach in Kefalonia
reviews.text: This is a must see beach, not just because of the film, the views down to it are stunning, the water is just amazing, the colours in the sea will mezmarize you. Beach is massively pebbly so you will need reef shoes and you will have no problem walking the beach and entering the sea, I hobbled about in flip flops and stubbed my toes going in the sea and quite frankly struggled getting out again lol, but wear wet suit or reef/gel shoes and you’re sorted, if you come to Kefalonia you MUST see this beach, a bus will take you there and it’s a 10 min walk down to it or you can hire a car or quad bike, we hired a car and parked on the beach, much easier. Enjoy 😊

reviews.title: Picturesque from above.
reviews.text: I have visited this beach every year for the past 9 years and seen from above it is quite spectacular. This year it was even more  crowded than usual but an organised one way parking system was in force which made getting out from the parking area much easier. However i would advise going early to park by the beach.  With 2 sunbeds and an umbrella now costing 10 euros it wont be on my itinerary next year. The beach is very pebbly so fitted beach shoes are advisable especially when entering the sea which can be  rough. There are toilets and a cafe for snacks, drinks, ice creams etc. Watch out for the paragliders coming down from the cliffs behind.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Visited the beach on a day trip the beach was outstandingly beautiful. We have seen many beaches over the years but this will take some beating

reviews.title: Great beach, just too crowded
reviews.text: Arrived about 11 and found parking easy (free) which was next to the beach.Two lounge chairs and umbrella for 10euros.Desk chairs are close to each other and the sun come from behind as the chairs are facing the sea.A pebbled beach which requires flip flops till the sea. Then you have to put up with 4-5 steps on the stone till you start swimming. There is a toilet which was reasonably clean and a cafe which had drinks, toasties and beers. They played loud music at times which spoilt the ambience, there were also some people playing their music and talking loudly.

reviews.title: Day visit
reviews.text: This area is very nice but the beach is very small pebbles and the sea washes the pebbles from under your feet which makes standing a very difficult thing to doPicturesque but much better beaches on Kefalonia .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: There isn’t much here, not even a cafe or toilets but the beach is so beautiful and quiet that it’s worth a visit. It’s pebbly so make sure you bring flip flops for going into the sea!

reviews.title: Real nich beAch
reviews.text: Crystal blu ater wilde environment I was real appreciate this beach with free place for visitors!! Must go there!!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos beach today, lovely crystal clear warm waters, white pebble beach, what a lovely place to visit *****

reviews.title: Could Rival Any Caribbean Beach....
reviews.text: From the winding road coming down from Fiscardo this beach looks stunning so much so it could rival any carribean beach, there are viewpoints along the road and it does get fairly busy with people taking photographs hence why it is the most photographed beach in the whole of Greece.Also famous for its location for the film Captain Corelli's Mandolin used as the mine explosion episode, it has also been voted the best beach in Greece so really is a tourist spot and a photographers delight.Once down at the beach you can park right on it, it is a very winding drive down not for the faint hearted just like most of the roads in the North.A  pure white tiny stones beach leads to an unbelievable turquoise azure blue sea, there is quite a drop a little out and the wave energy here is very high, i certainly wouldn't leave children unattended, especially on a windy day as it was on our visit .An absolute must no matter which area you are staying in on Cephalonia.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Well worth the trip to Myrtos beach - it is absolutely incredible. Pictures don't do the sea colour justice! lots of room, and places to place a towel or you can also hire sun loungers.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A white stone beach with the limestone eroding into the ocean makes the colours just amazing.It's one of the wavy beaches of Kefalonia and the feelings of being shaken by the waves follow you even after you left.Be mindful of bringing some sort of protection for your feet since the waves are powerful and the stones may be sharp.Little secret: on the east of that beach there's an amazing cave from where the ocean penetrates powerfully (be careful not to go on high tide as the waves can be a bit scary)

reviews.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful
reviews.text: I cannot say enough wonderful things about Myrtos Beach. We stopped here for a short 45 minutes while on a tour to Messilani Lake, I wish we could have spent the entire day here. It’s is absolutely the most beautiful beach I have ever been to. The water is a color I didn’t know existed in real life, such a bright turquoise color that isn’t like anywhere else in the world. An absolute must if you are on Kefalonia Island. One thing I would suggest is make sure you have good sandals or water shoes. The beach is very rocky, not much sand so be prepared to walk on the rocks to get into the water.

reviews.title: Beautiful views -rough sea
reviews.text: Lovely beach- is pebbly but we prefer that and we buy the beach shoes with a tough flexible sole. The colour of the sea was a beautiful turquoise and there are sun beds.It was difficult to swim as the sea was very rough which is tough when it is boiling hot. Lovely view from the beach but the best view is from the very top before you go down the winding roads to get to it- it is so high and the scenery is magnificent.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous and breathtaking! The white marble stones and pebbles are beautiful, have not seen this before. The white stones pebbles against the lovely blue sea is beautiful. Sea a bit rough in the day we were there so we did not get a chance to snorkel. Beautiful beach to relax at.

reviews.title: Beautiful but the sea very rough
reviews.text: A beautiful beach and quite busy but hard to get into the sea as very wild and rough waves also take swim shoes to walk on pebbles

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach! The contrast of colours here was beautiful, from white pebble stones (swim shoes could be handy), bright turquoise water. The best way to get here is by car! Would recommend making a day out of it and bringing some snack along for the ride!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Awesome beach, huge stretch of small to medium sized pebble beach, with beautiful blue water and sheltered cove. There are sunbeds and umbrellas you can rent but we bought a cheap umbrella for 8 EUR in the supermarket and set up on a more secluded part of the beach. There's also a little bar where you can get drinks and a public restroom.

reviews.title: Amazing water
reviews.text: Lovey beach, such blue water! Got to the beach around 11am and got two sun loungers for 10 euros, recommend you don’t get to the beach much later as they were all taken by midday. Managed to park all fine and our little hire car managed the track down just fine. Beach is pebbly but didn’t cause us any problems. Def recommend!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This a stunning beach.  Pebbled so wear beach shoes.  There is a winding road down but passable for two cars.  The beach is large but car parking can be limited at peak times.  There is a small beach cafe, toilets & shower.  There is a great Cave to the left where you can swim in.  There are some beach umbrellas & sun-loungers for hire, but not loads.  Without a doubt go around 6pm when the crowds have gone & watch the sun set it is incredible.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach if you get a calm day
reviews.text: We were lucky the day we came it was very calm water and safe for swimming, but easy to see how it could be dangerous on a rough day. It’s worth exploring the cave down to the left of the beach, just make sure you wear shoes for the rocks!

reviews.title: On the Beach
reviews.text: One of the tourist hot spots looks great from above and the drive down the very narrow steep road with large tourist couches coming the other way is very entertaining or scarey, parking at the bottom is a challenge unless you go early or late in the day.The beach is stoney and shelves away into the sea very quickly so not suitable for young children, the cave at the end of the beach is interesting and you can swim thru it . In summary difficult to get to its not suitable for kids but is dramatic location it’s worth the effort

reviews.title: Beautiful from the top - not so good when you get to the beach
reviews.text: Not too sure what is so good about this place - when we visited, parking was non-existent, so returned on another day - but later in the day - but were quite underwhelmed and wouldn't recommend a beach visit here.  The pebbles in places are quite large, so uncomfortable under foot - advisable to wear aqua shoes in all honesty - however the sea here can be a little formidable and wipe you out.There are nicer beaches to visit on the island - but for sheer beauty from the photographic point up on the mountain roadside - it is spectacular.

reviews.title: The best beach in Greece but no sand
reviews.text: We have had photographs at the top some 15 years ago and we finally revisited last week and again had photos but this time drove down to the beach. We had hired a jeep this time and was not part of a coach trip. From above its one of the most photographed beaches and the colours are as you see on the photos , no filters .We passed by early on route to Assos but returned in the afternoon. By the time t was in full swing and busy. The beach its self is actually white pebbles and not sand as it appears from above. The sea was warm with lots of waves and gets deep quickly. For not so strong swimmers it can be dangerous if it gets really choppy and it does pull you in. So for kids please ensure your watching them. I have heard that if its to bad they do actually stop you swimming.You do have a wc and a small beach bar for drinks and snacks. You also have sunbeds which can be rented and also have to advise not much shade so either take some or rent some as it gets hot down there. Its fantastic for phot opportunities and well worth a visit. But I would go early if you want to park  there as it does get very busy.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach,get there early
reviews.text: Stunning to look at, pebbly underfoot and make sure you get there early to hire an umbrella or take your own. It's very exposed and got very hot. Lovely waters which were calm when went and great for all the family to swim in. Basic snack bar which does ice creams and drinks. If you want more make sure you bring your own.

reviews.title: Stunning beach but no facilities
reviews.text: I am rating the beach 5***** just because of its beauty. However, it is very difficult to access, even more difficult to find an unoccupied seat (we did not find any on our trip here), so bring your own umbrella if you can. Also no restaurant or bar here, just a tiny shop where you can buy drinks and ice-creams but the queue is huge, so not pleasant. However the beauty of the place still makes it worth visiting if only for a couple of hours.

reviews.title: Stunning sea
reviews.text: Took a drive down here today, it was very busy. The sea is stunning. Lovely white stony beach, sharp underfoot!

reviews.title: An amazing experience beach with round pebbles
reviews.text: We loved this beach, for the experience. What an amazing beach with perfectly rounded white pebbles. Definitely bring swim shoes as walking on these pebbles is not easy on the feet. It’s a beach like nothing you’ve seen before. The sea deepens quite quickly here. Wasn’t overly crowded which also made it super comfortable.

reviews.title: Beautiful but so busy
reviews.text: No trip to Kefelonia is complete without a visit to this wonderful Beach, with the stunning views when approaching it, amazing views to look down on. When approaching Myrtos, there is a viewing point along the road side, worth a stop here for photo opportunity.We made the journey to visit here from our accommodation in Lourdas/ Vlachata on Sunday  26th August. We took the scenic route through Agrostoli past the Lagoon and along up the Bay. We drove through Farsa and across through Agon then on to Myrtos, much more scenic that taking the inland route.When we visited here it was so busy, the parking was absolutely chaotic and finding a place to park was difficult, eventually we parked up and headed for the beach.There were sunbeds and umbrellas available, they were a new addition this year. There was still room to spread out the beach mats and towels, not much avaiable when we visited. We stayed for a few hours and decided to head for Mounda Beach (reviewed separately) much quieter.The good news is there is a Taverna at Myrtos again, last year the authorities did not permit one. It is situated a bit off the beach and not on it like the old one.Would recommend possibly visiting here during the week and not at the weekend, might be slightly quieter, but don't it.Not sure, maybe my imagination but the beach seemed different this year, it appeared to have been flattened, maybe naturally or by machine, not sure, it felt a bit unreal if that makes sense.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: I was a little nervous of the road but it was fine. Full of bends but not too difficult. The views from the top are breathtaking. I have read a lot of negative reviews about the beach. It is mainly stones as are a lot of other beaches. The stones here however are brilliant white. Also there are stretches of white sand.The water was gorgeous. Loved it.

reviews.title: Stunning but strong “dumper” waves
reviews.text: We visited twice during our holiday. Just simply stunning! Absolutely necessary to go early during the peak season as it gets busy quickly. We struggled to get in and out of the sea on our second visit due to the power of the waves, I wouldn’t recommend for children or weaker swimmers on windy days. The waves will pound you into the pebbles and it hurts! Beautiful to see and experience but beware of the strong tow. We didn’t use the facilities but there are sun beds/umbrellas and a small snack bar available in the peak season. Basic toilet and changing facilities available, parking on the beach if you arrive before 9:30am, slightly hairy drive down to the beach but worth it.

reviews.title: Beautiful but no amenities
reviews.text: The beach is stunning. However the drive down is pretty hairy winding hairpin bends what seems to go on forever. You have to parallel park on these hairpin bends, which could prove difficult for some.There is nowhere to buy a drink so make sure that you bring enough water. Shaded places are limited- bear this in mind if you have small children. The beach is beautiful, though.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: The view from above is perfect. The waters are clear and light blue. You have to visit the beach when there isn't any wind so there will be no waves. Must see.  Go early around 10 so you can find a parking slot and a nice seat on the beach.

reviews.title: Scary trip down to the beach in a coach
reviews.text: Visited as part of a coach trip,how coaches get down that road safely.Beach is beautiful but mostly pebbles,very painful to walk on,so wear flip flops,the sea shelves off very quickly & strong currents,so can be quite dangerous,but still worth a visit.

reviews.title: Great afternoon in the surf
reviews.text: This was a bit of a surprise given some mixed reviews. It is a pebble beach so not ideal for only sunbathing as it’s not that comfortable but the waves were fantastic. We all loved being in the breaking surf from 7 years old to 47. A really fun afternoon in the waves, some 6 feet or more high. A welcome contrast to the calmer beaches. Road down fine and in the mid afternoon finding a parking space was no problem. A holiday highlight for us!

reviews.title: Captain Corelli;)
reviews.text: Corelli .... who does not know. Not only because you should visit the Myrthos beach. The beach is beautiful not only from the top but also on the beach. Clean water, hot sand, what more could you want :)

reviews.title: Best Beach!
reviews.text: The beach is well maintained and is easy to reach. It has guards who keep an eye on the people in the water, which is good because it can have some waves if the wind is right. This is a must visit beach on Kefalonia!

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: Best of Kefalonia. The road is winding, but manageable, nothing too tricky. We got there by 11.30 and got the last parking spaces at the end of the alley. One Panda that tried to enter after us got stuck in the sand. White pebbles, shoes are a must. It is very large and very long, so it was not crowded. Few sunbeds, so best to have an umbrella, or else it gets too hot. Only one tavern/kiosk, didn’t ckeck it. So it was very peaceful, and quiet, and relaxing. The scenery is magnificent and indeed the colour of the water is unbeatable.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: This may be the best beach in cefalonia. You need to go early if you want to find a parking lot. There are some beds&umbrellas, but all of them were sold around 12.30. Its not possible to sit under the sun when its too hot. The sea is magnificent, the  color is amazing. For me much better than antisamos, i would prefer shooting the movie in this beach

reviews.title: Nice beach.
reviews.text: It is one the most beautiful beach in Kefalonia perhaps it is the most famous. The sea and beach were beautiful. It was also nice to have a facility selling drinks on the beach and changing cabin. The prices were reasonable.

reviews.title: Stunning beach with views to die for!
reviews.text: Beautiful turquoise waters and slightly pebbly. Get there early to park on the beach, it's well worth it.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: As the photos show, this is an amazing place and one to tick off the bucket list.Bring a parasol if you don't want to pay to hire.

reviews.title: What a view!
reviews.text: A stunning view and a colour of sea that is beautiful. Pebbles, yes. Parking a real issue unless you get there early, yes. Quite a windy road down, yes. Not much shade, no. Loos “ok”. Cafe limited but perfectly ok. If you’re looking for the perfect beach with everything wonderful, it’s not it. But, for Kefalonia, it’s a fabulous beach on a fabulous island.

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: It is a must see on Kefalonia. Unfortunately - No sand. But still - beautiful. The most amazing is the view from the viewpoint. Parking place - awful!!

reviews.title: Great place to see the sunset
reviews.text: We had a car so went to this beach about 3 o'clock. We found plenty of car parking spaces as it was later on in the day and we wanted to watch the sunset. Very stoned beach and would advise to wear shoes into the sea. This beach is stunning and the sunseet didn't disappoint us at all. Lovely to see the paragliders landed on the beach. I would highly recommend this beach as it was clean but I should imagine the parking would be a little annoying in the busy season

reviews.title: Lovely to look at, pebbly beach.
reviews.text: We drove past on the way to and back from Fiscardo.  The views are fabulous.  We went to the beach mid afternoon and got parking easily, they have a good one way system.  There is very little natural shade on the beach and it's very pebbly so hard on the feet to get in and out.  Once in the waves are quite rough so it wasn't the calmest or most fun beach we have been on.  We left after 30 minutes.Beautiful to look at, not our sort of beach.

reviews.title: excellent beach, awful parking place
reviews.text: The beach is awesome, there is a lot of place where you can place your towel and umbrella, but the parking is extremely small. You can find a beach bar, showers and toilets.

reviews.title: Awesome views!!! Wow!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: This is the most amazing beach on the island and most of Greece for views. Its much more quiet than the commercialized beaches. Bring some kind of shoes to wear because its mostly a pebbles and rocks beach. It has some amenities but it does not have the most amenities. If you want the most amenities, go to Makris Gialos beach or Antisamos beach or Skala beach.

reviews.title: Dissapointed
reviews.text: Been looking forward to visiting the beautiful beach featured in the film “Cpt Corelli‘s Mandolin” Very disappointed, as beach was very overcrowded, sun beds and umbrellas, and very congested with traffic trying to find parking spaces (which are very limited)Access is down a very steep and narrow hill. We arrived on an organised tour, which I would definitely recommend, as a parking space next to the beach was reserved for us .There is a small cafe on the beach and toilets, however we were warned by our tour guide not to use the toilets !!The beach has very sharp shingle/ pebbles, so beach shoes are a must! Also we were warned about the very strong currents and steep shelving beach, so be aware when swimming.Be very careful near the cliffs , especially near the cave, as there was a rock fall while we were there!!Best way to see this beach, is from the pull in view point on the road above the beach.Definitely recommend taking your photographs from here Beautiful!

reviews.title: Stunning beach but
reviews.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches on the island of Kefalonia...It is a pebble beach so bring beach shoes or have a painful stay.The BUT....you Must get there 9:30 latest or the chances of parking your car are almost nil.Now look at Google earth...if you can not park there the walk up hill is horrendous.One taverna sells toasties and coffee €3 cold drinks and crisps.👍There are toilets.Its a great day out.Leave by 4pm before the exodus.Sprogg

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Lovely big beach. White Pebbles so tricky getting in and out of the sea. Take swimming shoes. Parking and sunloungers not plentiful so go early on otherwise u have to park up the hill and do the steep walk up and down and wait for a longer to become free. Free parking and loungers not too costly . Showers at the back of the beach.Def worth a visit. View amazing from the road above.
