reviews.title: Terrible Dangerous Road - Had to Turn Back
reviews.text: The road down to the beach was too dangerous to continue down to the beach.  Maybe outside of August there is less bedlam? My experience was that since there is little parking at the beach area - everyone was parking instead along the narrow road.  This is a treacherous winding road and the parked cars made the situation absolutely untenable.  A Serb chap parked to admire the view as I tried to do a 3 point turn on a bend to escape and laughed when I explained there were no barriers and the road was frightening - he told me this was 'Greek Land'!  Even if you reach the beach early in the day and manage to park at the bottom safely - you would still have the nightmare of leaving up a winding road, with no barriers and huge drops - with other reckless drivers.  Sadly I would give it a miss - since this road is an accident waiting to happen.

reviews.title: Lovely beach with rock jumping
reviews.text: We visit the south end of Myrtos beach which has won awards - rightly so. Small pebbles, some sand (but quick drop to depth - be careful if with young children). Our teenagers (13/15) enjoyed jumping from the rock near the small cave. Arrive before 10.30 to be able to park on or near beach. There is a refreshment stand and showers near the middle of the beach (chairs/umbrellas there too). There is a spectacular view of the beach at the lookout along the main road towards Assos. Tip: buy pies and fruits at the grocery up in the town next to the turning for the beach to enjoy them on the beach.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Crystal clear waters, amazing view down on it! Pebbles but able to get comfortable! Suitable shoes useful due to pebbles that you can wear in sea. Limited parking so get there early. Very popular but enough room so didn’t feel crowded. Saw few fish when snorkelling. Will definitely revisit!

reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.text: What a site!! Beautiful beach. Amazing sunsets. When someone visits Cephalonia it is a beach that he has to go!!

reviews.title: Best for a great photo
reviews.text: Beach is lovely and white as the photos suggest and not too stoney either. Parking can be tricky so either get there early or you will have to park up the hill. We stayed here for a couple of hours before moving on to see other beaches.

reviews.title: Lovely to drive to see but we didn't stay
reviews.text: A good drive from where we were in Lourdas but worth it to see this famous beach. The congestion with vehicles trying to park was bonkers - it was just too popular! We parked and went for a walk on the beach but didn't stay. It is an unspoilt beach and, as such, has no cafe/bar/shop/toilet etc and only a small collection of sunbeds and shades. We didn't have our own shade and it was too hot to stay without even natural shade so we moved on but our photos are amazing! The drive on was also lovely. I suspect those in the know we're aware that it gets crazy busy and were there very early to secure a spot. It's worth a visit, absolutely.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Just gorgeousThere is a car park but when full people park along the long winding road which isn’t as scary as we were led to believe although the walk is challenging because of the heat and lengthBeach is shingle and there are toilets and refreshmentsThe sea a few steps in is deep but totally gorgeous

reviews.title: Everytime we go to Cephalonia...this is the beach we spend the most time at
reviews.text: The services are adequate and the people friendly.  But the beach"s natural beauty is the reason you go.  The steep cliffs above you and that incredible Ocean colour.  I have died and gone to heavan!

reviews.title: Picture perfect beach but nightmare road down.....
reviews.text: You have probably already seen images of the picture perfect Myrtos Beach without even realising it, as it's image is widely used to promote Greece as a whole. Be warned, if you are driving, the road down is extremely windey, and as parking at the beach itself fills up quickly, visitors start to fill up the roadside closest to the cliff wall. This makes the road only just wide enough for vehicles to pass. Bad enough on the way down in an unfamiliar hire car, but a nightmare on the way back when you will need to drive within feed of a sheer drop ! That said, it's worth a quick visit and park in some of the wider sections of road where you can take a picture looking down onto the beach...beautiful !

reviews.title: Lovely but crowded
reviews.text: Perhaps the most famous beach on Kefalonia so unsurprisingly full of tourists. If you want to park close by, get there early. If you prefer a quiet beach, don't go! But well worth a visit at off peak times...

reviews.title: Worth the effort
reviews.text: Everyone says this beach looks best from the cliff tops. True, it’s a pebbly beach, but it is stunning in and out of the water. Get there early (9-10am) to get a parking space.

reviews.title: Great beach - top tips
reviews.text: This beach is a God given gem. To fully enjoy it follow these simple tips.1. Leave a visit for the later part of holiday. The beach is white so you will be recieving sun rays from water and sand as well. Get some melanin on you.2. Bring your own sun umbrella and if you have folding chairs. 3. For more sensitive ones, bring rubber shoes 4. Go to the far left part so you will explore caves and rocks5. Come before 10am the car parking is crowdedHave a great fun day at the beach!

reviews.title: Spectacular beach
reviews.text: Roads are crazy on this island...  so many twists and turns and the drive down to this beach is nuts! To then discover no restaurants or snack bar!  Not sure why designated in top 30 beaches in the world ... yes fab but we were a little disappointed...

reviews.title: one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece
reviews.text: the beach is very warm. It is warmer than in other parts of Kefalonia even in May. I advise for a family holiday. Luckily there were no sunbeds on the beach. this creates the impression of a wild beach. people are relatively many. the water is blue and clean. but for diving with a mask does not fit

reviews.title: Very crowded place in August
reviews.text: As you probably discovered already this is one of this places that looks perfect in the pictures, or from above but it’s not a beach to spend your day on. It is so popular!!!

reviews.title: Amazing road along the sea and mountains
reviews.text: We did not visit the beach itself because it looked to crowded. We saw it from above while driving on one of the most beautiful roads I've ever seen. The views over the ocean and mountains are perfect, I would place it on the same spot as Chapman's Peak in Cape Town!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Words cannot describe the stunning beautiful features of Myrtos Beach. The view from the clifftop is amazing and once you get down there for a swim the crystal clear water is both invigorating and essential in peak of a Greek summer.Be early if you want an umbrella or bring your own as there are limited umbrellas

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach I have ever seen!
reviews.text: Took a car round the island today with the family. Stopped here twice. First we went to the photo point on the road where the view of the beach was so stunning and picturesque. I’ve never seen anything so beautiful. Later we went down to the beach for a dip and a sunbathe. Despite the beach being a bit rocky, the sea is so clear and blue and the pebbles are amazingly white. You can park along the road at the foot of the hill and I would definitely recommend this as one of the best places to visit if you are staying in Kefalonia. Simply blissful.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: This was one of my highlights and i wish i had spent a full day there as the sunset would be awesome! The water and beach are SO clean! I spent my entire time in the water which is DEEP but safe. The clarity of the water is stunning. I just loved it! Note, shade is hard to come by so be warned. You can get a bit at the back of the beach but i am sure it would go later in the day so best to take your own. It does get busy but the beach is so huge it isn't really a problem.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: What a beautiful place absolutely stunning, a real suntrap, a got to visit beach even as the sun goes down sunset stunning.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Everyone already said it all, its breathtaking! I was there for few hours only, but don't really get people who are unsatissfed with fascilites, have you seen other beaches how they look like with all the umbrellas and sunbeds? Can you see the beach out of them? This is exeptional natural beauty, enjoy it!

reviews.title: A spectacle but not 100% pleasant
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is a spectacle that visitors to Kefalonia should see once, but the number of cars and the large hard pebbles require an element of endurance. Rock shoes or flip flops are a must at all times and a sun bed or chair is advisable unless you can cope with lying on a bed of boulders. Yes the water is exceptionally clear, yes your photos of the beach from above will look photoshopped when in fact they are #nofilter, but there are prettier beaches that are more comfortable in my opinion. In many respects it is a wonder of nature, but a little inhospitable.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: We were left dumbfounded when we came across the sight of Myrtos beach, it is simply breathtaking!! The beach itself has white sand and pebbles, take your beach shoes if you’re swimming. If you will be staying a while take a parasol as there are none for hire. There are a couple of loos. Worth not having facilities for the spectacle that is Myrtos beach!

reviews.title: The views are better
reviews.text: The views of Myrtos Beach are undeniably stunning and worth taking many photos of. However, although the beach itself is fine, it is not as relaxing as the smaller beaches in Kefalonia. It is big, so you should get space, but it is obviously more crowded and the toilets were vile! If you like a busier and more organised beach, this is fine and much nicer than Antisamos Beach. If you prefer quieter and smaller beaches, take your photos and drive on!

reviews.title: Good beach, could be better
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is the most famous beach on Kefalonia. Water is pretty clean and clear and has very nice coulour. However, there are some things that does not make it perfect. Aside from being too crowded, there is a serious problem with parking spaces, especially having in mind that there is a large part of the beach that is being underused and could be improved and turned into parking. The other problem is that there is very small number of sunbeds and umbrellas for visitors who do not bring their own. In the end, there is only one small coffee shop with very high prices. Therefore, you have to wait for someone to leave the beach and then race with other visitors for the spot. All in all, I have to say that although I prefer sandy beaches, this one is very good, apart of these few problems.

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: Got here late after travelling somewhere else first.Was too busy to park but looked really nice. Recommend arriving early.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The most wonderful sandy beach, not overpopulated so there is plenty of space. The view are spectacular and well worth the tricky route down. There is also a lovely taverna serving food and drinks. You won't want to leave

reviews.title: Very crowded
reviews.text: Beautiful but very crowded beach. If you search a peaceful place is not the place to go! Not enough parking lots.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: All our mates and websites told us to go to this beach. The drive there was way better than the destination.The beach is pebbly and there’s nothing there. Granted the view from the top looking down onto the beach is awesome but the beach itself was awful. Maybe coming from South Africa we are seriously blessed with golden sandy beaches perfect for some beach cricket, touch rugby or football but this is not that type of beach.It’s full of irritating people who can’t swim and would rather just sit and drink all day. The beach was also filthy, full of cigarette butts, although they do soften the pebbles.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous but very very busy. There are some of sunbeds and sun shades- 8€. A small cabin with a very limited choice of snacks- take your own lunch. There are toilets and a place to change. Limited parking unless you are early

reviews.title: Superb beach
reviews.text: Superb stunning beach and definitely a must visit place when you go to Kefalonia. A place to go for a lovely relaxing chilling day

reviews.title: Beautiful day!!
reviews.text: This beach is undeniably beautiful. We came at around Midday during the week and it was very very busy so we decided to leave it for another day. Get there for 10.30am latest to park and access sun beds. We did this and spent the day here, it was amazing. The water is crystal clear and the most amazing shades of blue/turquoise, the surroundings are breathtaking. As others have said there are toilet facilities, however these get pretty grim (take tissue!), showers, and a small cafe selling drinks/snacks. There is a cave to explore, and the sea is just beautiful!

reviews.title: Breath Taking
reviews.text: The view from the top is out of this world and have never seen anything so beautiful like it.When we went down to the beach and parked up the sea waves where rough on this particular day but still managed to dip my feet in as I could not resist.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The journey is well worth it. The colour of the water is unbelievable and the cleanliness of the beach is superb

reviews.title: Nice location pebble beach
reviews.text: Very spectacular view to get to the beach and the location is gorgeous. If you dont mind pebble beaches then this will be good beach. I personally liked kiriaki beach more which is close by. Parking is a bit tricky and gets really busy by 12 so get there before then

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: This is just the most amazing view from the road I’ve ever seen.  Absolutely stunning. A must stop for great photos when visiting the island.  Just beautiful.

reviews.title: It’s true what they say - one of the very best
reviews.text: The trip down to the beach is a typical nightmare but well worth it. Take your own food and drinks because you cannot get anything down there. There are good beds and umbrellas for hire for 7 or 8 Euros a set. The water is beyond description as is the view back up the mountains from the beach Swimmers will rejoice doing a lap or two across the bay in which the beach rests. For the brave or reckless you can do tandem hangliding from the top of the mountain landing on the beach.

reviews.title: Wow, about the most beautiful thing I've ever seen
reviews.text: This is a must see when on the island.  I have never see so many shades of blue.   It is spectacular.  Pictures cannot capture how beautiful this is.I didn't go down to the beach, just saw it from the road half way up the mountain.There are pull outs on both sides of the beach.  It is good to check them both out.  Depending on the time of day, one might be better than the other.  We saw it at mid-day in the summer and it was fantastic.

reviews.title: Blue Blue Blue
reviews.text: This beach is stunning. I have never seen anything like this. Me and my husband travel all the time and this beach took our breath away.

reviews.title: Natural beauty
reviews.text: Is the most beautiful and one of the most popular beaches. A natural beauty with an unbelievable view that will give you the opportunity to take great pictures. The negative is that most of the time there is waves and air. It has a beach bar that you can take snacks or coffee, but do not go to its toilets are unacceptable and very dirty !!

reviews.title: Blue definitely is the colour
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach, when you see it from the vantage points up top, the colour is stunning and even better once you have made the journey down the winding road to it.  Yes it is pebble and large ones at that, so beach shoes required if you intend to swim.  The only reason I did not give it a 5 star rating is as previous reviewers have said, the lack of facilities.  There was nowhere to get a drink or food when we visited in July and the toilets could definitely do with an update.  For such an iconic tourist attraction as Myrtos, with all the visitors it gets each year, I am really surprised that the Council (or whoever is in charge of local government) does not employ someone to at least keep the toilets clean and empty the overflowing "paper" bins.  Also, there used to be a beach bar cafe, so not sure what happened to it but the beach is crying out for one.  If anyone from the council or tourist board has any info please could they let us know.  Beautiful beach but facilities need updating.

reviews.title: Out of this world
reviews.text: What can I say this place has to be seen to be believed.  Only downside there are no beach bars for you to buy a drink or get something to eat.  Get there early to get your self a brolly/beds or ensure you take your own

reviews.title: Nice but.........
reviews.text: This is a great looking beach from the viewing  point and where all the publicity photos are taken. Once on the beach it is made up of various sized white pebbles. Beach shoes are recommended and be aware the beach shelves off very quickly so you are out of your depth in a few meters. No problem if you are a confident swimmer but those who aren't or child should be aware. The water is very clear and stunning. Having read some reviews they stated there were no amenities on the beach. On 31 July there was a shower point and toilet. We were informed   as of 1 August a small cafe will be opening to provide refreshments. If you want to go in the car then you need you need to  go early. Any later than 10.00hrs in the peak season and you have no chance. The beach is at the end of a narrow track  with hairpin bends. Parking gets crazy the later you leave it. There is no effective monitoring of the number of vehicles entering hence the potential for total grid lock. There is a small local bus which runs  from the small kiosk ( pictured)  down to the beach  regularly throughout the day.The toilets are a good addition although I warn you they require some refinement. The Gents toilet had a normal size dust bin with no lid. In Greece all paper is required to be put in the bin rather than flushed down the toilet. By 1000hrs this resembled  something  akin to an open sewer. This was not too dissimilar to the smell of open medieval sewers experienced when visiting the Jorvick Viking centre in York.

reviews.title: No food or beverages offered in the beach bar
reviews.text: As others have already mentioned the beach is amazing and specious. However parking is not easy to find and the beach bar only offers coffee and water.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: It is lovely, tidy, clean.There is a tiny cave.Nothing other than sun, pebbles and sand and obviously a clear blue sea.Surroundings are beautiful.Nice.

reviews.title: Wow what a Blue
reviews.text: This beach looks amazing from above , stunning Blue and calm.We hired a car and went down onto the beach from above looks can be deceiving, the beach is pebbles and the current very strong so beware. Well worth a visit though you will not be disappointed

reviews.title: Absolutely stunning
reviews.text: Unfortunately it clouded over when we went to see the beach but it was still gorgeous and we had some lovely photos. Worth seeing!

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach- Definitely One for the Bucket List
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is absolutely AMAZING!!! Viewing it from the road above is just spectacular! It is just breathtaking to look down at it in all its glorious grandeur -the incredibly blue water & the softest looking white sand!! You can make your down to the beach via a rather long, narrow one way path by car or by foot.  Parking is somewhat limited.  Once on the beach, there are facilities for changing and showering.  Additionally, there are a limited number of sun beds with umbrellas  available.  In any case, pack yourself a cooler with refreshments & snacks, a towel (and maybe your own chair & tube/raft), and for sure, don’t forget the sun block!!! Spend the day idly basking in the sun, splashing around in the aquamarine water while you soak up one of nature’s most magnificent creations!  Myrtos Beach- definitely one for the Bucket List!!!

reviews.title: Amazing beach, well worth the drive!
reviews.text: Visited this beach twice in two weeks. The water can be a bit chilly at times for an Australian, but the view driving down is fantastic.  Tip: bring some decent footwear as the pebbles can be a bit annoying walking back and forth on the pebbles and sand. The cave down the far end is great to witness. One can easily swim in and out and around the cave. Be careful of the sharp rocks though, best the visit this place when it's a really hot day!Parking is a breeze, we never had trouble parking there both times so plenty of space is available.Nothing available in terms of food and drinks at the beach, so best to pack something before you leave. However, at the top of the hill, there are a few restaurants and places to buy drinks.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Stunning turquoise water, nice view from the view point. If you miss the bus, there is a long road to walk. Try to rent a car or hitchike.You should bring your own umbrella, because there is no shadow.

reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: We decided to drive early to Myrtos to beat the crowds and I’m so glad we did! Whilst the road was windy and steep, the views driving down were spectacular. The beach itself was a mix of sand and white pebble, and whilst there were umbrellas, it certainly wasn’t  organised like some. It was also large enough that even when busy, there still felt like space! I would fully recommend a day spent on Myrtos

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: The best views are from the road above. Truly breathtaking. The beach itself is large white pebbles and it shelves away very quickly from waters edge and the current is quite strong. Wouldn’t recommend for young children or poor swimmers. That aside one of the nicest beaches I have ever been too and definitely worth a drive to.

reviews.title: Amazing beach with a few of cons
reviews.text: Would recommend but you'll have to endure a hassle to experience what is indeed an amazing beach. As usual, beautiful things attract big crowds. The municipality in Kefalonia needs to do a much better job organizing access/parking and amenities (overall, the worst experiences we had in the wonderful island of Kefalonia were due to the local authorities not doing or being terrible in doing things that elsewhere would be taken for granted - reinforced my belief that if you want to destroy something beautiful, give it to incompetent/indifferent public servants, especially at the local level).

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: I wouldn't say this is the best beach on Kafelonia but the colours of the waters and the scenery even on a cloudy day are exceptional. Swimming is a no go as the sea current is strong but you're simply there to take in the ambience and the experience of visiting a glorious natural beach which doesn't require any kind of commercialism or ammenties.

reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: This is truly an amazing beach, beautiful turquoise color and very clean  surroundings. if you have children it s not so great as there are no basic amenities. We were lucky as the day we visited they put some umbrellas so there was some shade however there are no toilets and you have to go all the way to the village .I know the beauty of this place  remains in the unspoiled nature  so maybe toilets are not the best idea however something must be done.

reviews.title: Amazing water
reviews.text: The best looking water I saw on the island worth the drive and hassle for a parking spot. If you are driving by car get in early or prepare to walk 10minutes down the road and walk. There isn’t much at the beach other than toilets & a man offering hang gliding for 60€ plus 20€ if you want the video. Worth a visit if your a beach fan or want some amazing selfies

reviews.title: Stunning location but does not fully deliver
reviews.text: So this Beach was on the "Must do" list after all the hype and Captain Corelli's mandolin.... This is a stunning beach to view from above, look for some of the viewpoints on the mountain road above and it will take your breath away. But as a beach for swimming, especially with a young family then please beware. The beach is a "natural" beach, there are no real facilities. The stones, although rounded, are very hard on your feet, you do need foot protection and the waters are very strong. The water drops off very deep in only a few metres and on the day we visited the normally crystal clear Kefalonia waters were very "milky", snorkelling was a waste of time. I am not sure younger ones would really enjoy this beach, they would need very close monitoring if swimming, cannot build sandcastles and have limited access to toilet facilities. Overall it is a must visit location but if staying a long time take something comfortable to lay on !

reviews.title: Just stunning
reviews.text: If you go to Kefalonia then make sure you visit Myrtos beach.  There’s a narrowish winding road down to the beach.  There is limited parking at the bottom.  I’m sure during the day it’s hellish busy with vehicles.  We went just before sunset to watch it setting and it was fairly empty, just about 2 dozen people on the beach doing the same as us.  The sea is a magnificent blue colour that’s makes for fantastic photos.  Waves can be high and there is a drop off about 3 meters out in the water.  The pebbled beach is stunning and surrounded by high cliffs.  Great place to chill and watch the sun set.

reviews.title: Beautiful!!!
reviews.text: Deep blue waters in a remote location. On a windy day the waves can go really nasty. Definitely a place to see in Kefalonia

reviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful
reviews.text: When you come over the ridge and see that water for the first time you will add this to your list of favorite places on earth.  I am not a huge beach person, but I could not wait to get into that water.  No one photograph can actually capture the real color of that water.  Breathtaking and refreshing.  If you are on Cephalonia, you must visit here.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but not organised
reviews.text: Breathtaking views and clear blue waters. The pebbles make it difficult to get in and out of water. It also deepens in 3 m and the fact that it is not organised makes it difficult for families with small children.

reviews.title: Spectacular beach - though better for photos than sitting on!
reviews.text: Myrtos really is a stunning looking beach with the colour of the water taking your breath away.  The views from the coastal road are amazing.  We drove down the windy road to the beach one day during our stay in early June and it still looks amazing close up with beautiful blue water, however there are no sunbeds and the stones are a bit tricky to negotiate in and out of the water.  I am not a great fan of lines of sunbeds on a beach, however it is a little strange that the most iconic beach on the island has so few facilities. There is a blue building in the middle of the beach but no sign of it being a taverna or providing toilet facilities or sunbeds.  If it is not in use then it does detract from the overall beauty of the place.  Maybe we were a little early in the year and these are provided in high season only.  In any case it remains a must visit beach!

reviews.title: The Most Beautiful Beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach.  the water is very rough for swimming.  You will need shoes for the rocks in the water,

reviews.title: Simply amazing
reviews.text: This large beach and its beautiful blue waters was in my opinion the best place in Kefalonia. Although the water is quite wavy at times, one can enjoy the beach pretty well. Also, the sights from above are spectacular.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: This is the most famous beach in Kefalonia. It features in all the advertising for the island. It is truly stunning. However, there is a downside to this beach. At times it does have a dangerous rip tide/current that can sweep you out to sea. Swimmers be careful. If unsure, get advice before heading to this beach to ensure you can enjoy it to its best.

reviews.title: myrtos beach
reviews.text: Super view! Very clear beach.One of the best in Europe.You must visit if you are in kefalonia!  Be careful the waves!

reviews.title: Disapointing
reviews.text: My family and I visited the beach today. We were so excited to go there since all the reviews we read say it’s worth it.When we arrived there we were very disappointed. The water was blue but dirty, no sun beds or bars.That was ok i mean every beach is dirty once in a while. The most disturbing thing i saw was some drunk persons behaving very irresponsible.Over all, i can say that the beach is beautiful only from far away, since the close up is disappointing.

reviews.title: Beautiful clean water - worth the drive down
reviews.text: We were stating close to Myrtos beach so had to visit. We had seen it on our way to our villa from the coastal road and from this height you can see the clear turquoise water really clearly. The road down to the beach is a bit hairy, very steep and twisty with blind bends and a real drop in height from the top but I managed it. There's no cover on the beach, parasols or sunbeds, not sure why and it's pebbly so difficult to walk on but the water is so clear and refreshing (and deep). I imagine if you were there early or late and had it to yourself it would be magical. Everyone talks about seeing the sunset at Myrtos which I imagine is spectacular, but I wasn't going to wait for dark to make the return trip back up that road!

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: From above looks amazing,when u go down is even better..the deep blue and the amazing water is something unique.lovely

reviews.title: The most turquoise water to be found on the island
reviews.text: Myself and my partner visited after hiring a car, as we had been told by reps and other people its the best beach on the island. When we drove the views were breathtaking, even on a slightly cloudy day. However, I couldn't agree more that its nicer to look at than be on. I found no problem parking but the beach is pebbly and quite littered to be honest. Such a shame people cant look after it as there are huge bins provided by the car park. I stayed here for an hour or two then moved on. Although a stunning beach I spent my afternoons on far nicer beaches which were more quaint and unspoiled.

reviews.title: Best viewed from above
reviews.text: This is one of the most beautiful beaches I’ve ever seen. From above. We descended the windy road to take us down and were waved on by a parking attendant even though we’d found a free spot behind some other cars not far from the bottom. We then sat in a queue for 10 minutes while people struggled to get in and out of 2 car parks.Once we finally found our way through and into a space we headed towards the water. What looks like white sand is actually tiny white pebbles, something like you might find in a builders yard. They get in your shoes and in between your toes and hurt your feet. We put our towels down as there are no sun beds available, and walked towards the water over big white pebbles.Getting in wasn’t easy. It was painful walking over stones of different sizes. One we got in, the water was lovely. Not clear, but warm and refreshing, but it got deep very quickly.Getting out was even harder. We worked our way to the shore on our bellies and made a few attempts at climbing out without being pulled back in, then over the hurty stones and pebbles and back to our towels. We only went in twice and we won’t be going back again.  This beach is definitely best viewed from above!As it’s so famous in Kefalonia and all the guidebooks recommend a visit, there really ought to be more facilities. There are no beds/umbrellas, no toilets and nowhere to buy food. And the parking needs organising. But it you like things unspoilt, you’ll love this!

reviews.title: Nice swim
reviews.text: Visited today. We arrived at 8:30 and we had the place to ourselves. The beach is pebbly as is the entry / exit to the sea so it is quite hard and difficult to walk on in bare feet. Sea shoes are a must. The water was lovely and warm and we really enjoyed swimming here. Very limited facilities. We left at 9:30 as we just stopped for a quick visit and it was starting to get really busy

reviews.title: Clear waters and nice surroundings
reviews.text: Visted Myrthos beach yesterday,a beach that you cannot miss if your in kefalonia. Waves are a little bit stronge, so families with small kids should keep eye on them.The surrounding cliffs that surround the beach and the Crystal clear sea are awesome. One thing I didn't like was the huge amount of cars rushing down to find a parking and not giving chance others to drive out, so at some point you can be stuck with moving. Still is worth visiting.

reviews.title: Take supplies!!
reviews.text: Came to myrtos beach this morning...such a beautiful spot and the views are spectacular. However there are no sun loungers to hire and no beach bar,other than in the bars up the hill.Toilet facilities not great either..So make sure you're prepared!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The beach and the adjoining cliff are beautiful. Must visit for a sunset or sunrise. But the waves are harsh so experienced swimmers only. The color of the water is immersive and there is a small cave hidden towards one end of the beach, needs caution due to the waves. No restaurants or umbrellas though, get your own stuff

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Wonderful long beach, unfortunately the sea was rough so we couldn't swim and my son lost his face mask, so be careful, the waves are stronger than you think. Pebbles no sand so it's good to have the rock shoes. There is no place to buy water so make sure you have it!

reviews.title: Wednesday on the Beach
reviews.text: We were advised that this was a must do trip ! Hired a car and went for the day One of the most beautiful beaches and sea to swim in ! You need an umbrella as it was baking hotAlso although lots of parking it looked liked madness after about 1130 ! And you need a cool box with drinks and sandwiches as nothing on the beach itself but tavernas up in the village

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: This is the best beach on the island. A big beach with soft little pebbles. The water is amazing. It’s turquoise and very warm

reviews.title: Viewed from road above
reviews.text: We only view this beach from the road above as we were on a coach trip and coaches can’t get down.  It looked spectacular and our tour guides told us the beach is made up of very fine stone, almost as fine as sand, but the sea gets deep very quickly

reviews.title: Beautiful but blustery
reviews.text: What a view, what a beautiful setting, I’ll even allow the stones. With a few patches of sand here and there, it would’ve been perfect. The sea was amazing, so clear, so blue and the windy conditions made it a lot of fun for our little boy who thoroughly enjoyed being swept out by the huge waves.

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: Breath taking place. So beautiful. The views from the top are stunning and once down the beach is gorgeous. Sandy and white pebbles and the bluest sea. There is a small cafe and changing area.

reviews.title: Well worth a visit , stunning blue waters
reviews.text: We visited Myrtis beach today and thought it was stunning. The setting is awesome. The kids had great time with the big waves which were crashing in. Couple of suggestions if you plan to visit :1. The drive down is pretty steep and can be very tight especially when it’s busy, worth being early to avoid any hassle. We arrived at 1pm and it was chaotic at the bottom where cars were parked and others trying to leave.2. There are no Tavernas or bars down there so make sure you have water / lunch with you. We didn’t and ended up heading back up to one of the Tavernas at the top of the road ( at the junction ).3. There are some sandy parts to the beach but it’s pebbles when you try to get into the water. If you don’t have the swim shoes , you can look like a bit of an idiot ( as I have ) trying to walk on the pebbles. It is uncomfortable, I plan to spend the 9 euros on a pair of these things tomorrow.

reviews.title: Bit exposed and choppy, but impressive
reviews.text: Aesthetic surroundings , but you need to choose your day if you enjoy swimming in crystal clear calm seas. The day we went had quite impressive waves crashing on the shore which is good fun for adults and strong swimmers, but limited fun for sub-teenagers who may object to being tossed about onto the stones by the forces of nature.Watch out for paragliders landing on the beach. No immediate facilities for refreshments or loungers. Don't fancy being here during next earthquake!

reviews.title: Not as nice as it looks
reviews.text: From the viewing points, you are like WOW!!! It looks so beautiful and bright blue. Everyone is taking photos outside of their cars. But you get down there, there's hardly any car park spaces but we found one in the end. It's a stone beach which is fine as the lovely beach in Sami is the same and we loved that. But this beach doesn't look as clean as the one in Sami. There's no sunbeds so you need to pay on the towel on the big stones which dig in your back and isn't nice when your pregnant. Then the waves!! They are so big and aggressive that my husband went in and got pushed all over the place and big rocks under the sea rolling over and hitting his legs. He cut both of his ankles and he was even wearing his swimming shoes. It wasn't safe for me to get in so we left after an hour so did loads of other people.

reviews.title: Turquoise sea
reviews.text: You will need a car to visit. Take some provisions with you as when we went in June there was no beach bar open. The sea was rough when when we went but great fun.It is the most turquoise sea you will ever see especially when viewed from the mountain road above.

reviews.title: What a sight
reviews.text: We want to see this beach because of the film.We weren't intending to drive down as thought we would just view from above ? We were glad we took wrong road and ended up on the beach . Lovely to walk along not a lot of people there the time we went ? And a nice paddle in the water ,so we could say we'ed done it.Didn't try the toilets though as had read awfull reports about them ?

reviews.title: Blown away by the beauty of this beach
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos Beach today for the first time and was absolutely blown away. Such a beautiful place.The drive down to the beach is very windy (probably and understatement!) there are areas that you can pull over and stop to take pictures.The beach itself is white pebbles and the sea is different shades of turquoise and so warm.If you plan on staying a whole day take supplies with you - ice box, food, drinks, umbrella.Can't wait to spend time here again - outstanding.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful. Amazing colour of the water and not too crowded! It is recommended to go there by car since it is quite a hike to walk back up after the swim.

reviews.title: Fantastic Wild Nice Beach !
reviews.text: I can not describe here in my short review all my  emotions when I saw Myrtos Beach.I have never seen in my life so Beautyful places like that one. It was really Fantastic.Myrthos always will be in my heart. It was unforgettable time in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Beautiful waters
reviews.text: The colour and feel of the water are both beautiful. The temperature of the water is nice. The beach is picturesque. It is a pebble beach so if bare foot it hurts. Plan on visiting for an hour or two. It is too bare to remain all day. Bring a sun umbrella as there is absolutely no shade.Recommend going for a swim and then heading for lunch in the nearby town. A touch and go kind of stop.

reviews.title: Greece in one picture
reviews.text: A real must to actually see the scene that makes Kefalonia stand out from the rest then you have to do this one. The road has now been rebuilt above this idyllic view and in the process they have put in a viewing point above Myrtos Beach to allow you to take the picture that you will see on many brochures. Then make your way down the twists and turns to the beautiful white stone beach and have a sunbathe. Be careful though as the heat can become excessive as you are within a sheltered bay and a parasol is advisable if you plan to stay any length of time. A real must and have visited this location many times over the years.

reviews.title: Picture postcard
reviews.text: looks amazing from the view point, a must stop if driving to Asso or Fiskardo. We didn't drive down but you ca npark near the beach but it gets busy.

reviews.title: Stunning and isolated
reviews.text: Absolutely lovely beach with spectacular views from the high approach, be advised quite a away from anything else so take everything you need if at all possible. I mean food, drinks and Sun protection including a sun umbrella if possible. I am not sure I would take children to this beach as it is a steep path down and no other attractions other than sand, beautiful clear water and the views. If you go you want to make it worth it - so I would allow more than three hours if not all day. No photos included in review it's one of those places you have to see for your self!!

reviews.title: Nice views, but beach not well looked after
reviews.text: We'd read that this was amongst the best beaches in Greece, but I'd have to disagree. The best part were the really amazing views of the beach and bay for the hills above. No doubt that they were amongst the finest in the land. But the beach itself was poor, chaotic and small parking area, few facilities on the beach, so nowhere to get a drink etc. There seemed to have been something there in the past, as there were unsightly ruins of earlier shacks, or that is what it looked like. Pity, it could have been so nice. Anyway, if you like a white pebble beach in a scenic cove, and you bring your on food and drink and anything else you need, then it's fine. I just think there are better beaches around.

reviews.title: Stunning water - pebbly beach
reviews.text: We used a car to get here. We got lucky with parking. We arrived at 1pm, the beach was busy but never crammed. Unless you have leather feet you need to get some aqua shoes as the pebbles are excruciating. I had mine with me but thought I would give it a go as I spend most of my time (when not at work with no shoes on) alas it was hell and on went the aqua shoes. The beach drops away quickly so it only takes a few metres and you can’t touch the bottom. I’m 1.76m so definitely not short. Water was beautiful, clear and very warm towards the surface. Very insta-worthy. There are toilets and open beach showers to rinse off but that is it. BYO everything. Saying that, and being an Aussie. I still prefer the soft sand and equally clear water at Lourdata.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: All due respect,,,,total waste of time,,,,it's poor,,,,,might of been in a movie but realy isn't worth the trip,,,,Kefalonia has much better beaches than that,,,,go there and tell me I'm wrong

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is a beautiful pebbled beach with clear blue waters. I would recommend beach shoes if you plan to go in to the water and sun cream as the beach is a real sun trap. You definitely need a car to visit and parking is limited on busy days.There are no beach side bars or restaurants so taking your own drinks and food is advisable.The view is amazing as you come down the mountain towards the beach and the beach is pure heaven! Enjoy :-)

reviews.title: Island tour
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful colours, what an amazing beach a must see for anyone visiting Kefalonia, only go into water if you are a very strong swimmer

reviews.title: toilets fit for animals so dirty they are
reviews.text: beautiful beach with no toilet facilities at all. two loos so dirty that I don't see how people can use that beack

reviews.title: Love it - but take shade!!
reviews.text: Its not yet commercialised so nowhere to change, eat or have a pee, no sunbeds, no shade - but if you just want turquoise warm seas and a lovely picturesque beach - its Myrtos.  We LOVED it!

reviews.title: Tourists Must
reviews.text: Had to see this beach as it is very much spoken of.  Especially, since the film Captain Corelli's Mandolin.The view from the viewing points at the top are spectacular and it was a compulsion for me to take the ride down to the bottom and walk or paddle on this beach.  When I arrived at the beach instead of beautiful sands it was intact very fine shingle.Getting into the water was fine but when I tried to get out my feet sunk into the shingle and trapped my foot which made it difficult to get out without resorting to a very undignified crawl on all fours. The water seemed not  to want me to leave.All in all the illusion I saw from reviewing point at the top was disappointing on the ground so to speak.Better to see from above and enjoy the view.

reviews.title: Stunning Views
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is a must see when visiting Kefalonia. We were lucky to spend the day on a private 4x4 tour island tour and stopped at both sides of the beach to capture the views. It’s just stunning. We drove down the road to have a walk on the beach. The beach is not sandy, it’s small pebbles so it can be quite uncomfortable on your feet. Only problem for us is that there is no shade, you have to take your own beach brolley and if you are visiting for the day, you would have to purchase one. The only facilities are toilets however there are a number of tavernas and shops at the top of the hill. Again, another must see if you are visiting the island.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach & gorgeous clear water
reviews.text: One of the top 10 beaches. Amazing beach and clear water... the view from above and in the water looking back to the beach is fantastic. In June we had to take our own umbrellas.

reviews.title: NICE BEACH but not spectacular
reviews.text: A ''postcard'' vista greets you when you first turn up and after a long-ish drop down the hairpins you arrive at the Car Park which was ok for when we were there but I'd guess gets full up peak season.Mostly Limestone coarse sand / shingle / stones there's a cave worth looking at to the southern end which you can walk  /swim under.NO facilities to eat [ they are back up the beach access road about 3/4 mile climb away ] but there are Loo's in a block on the beach itself.No loungers or Umbrellas etc. Its simply a beach and the 'drop off' means the 'tots' might need a close eye on.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: W didn't go down onto the beach but it is well worth going to the two viewpoints and looking at it from above. The colour of the sea against the beach is spectacular!

reviews.title: Fantastic view but in reality - shocking!
reviews.text: The views of this beach are spectacular but after going all the way down to the actual beach we were disgusted. There are no facilities to buy anything (water, snacks etc) but the main fault for us was the disgusting toilets that clearly had not been cleaned for some time. Needless to say after travelling for over an hour tosee this place and leave after a couple of minutes we were extremely disappointed.  CLEAN THE PLACE UP!!!

reviews.title: Absolutely breathtaking!
reviews.text: Be sure to see Myrtos Beach!Whether from high above the cliffs or down to the beach itself you'll be enchanted!It's got this 'wild' and 'raw' beauty to it!It comes as no surprise that just a few years ago it  gained the gold award as the most beautiful beach in Europe and in another worldwide contest it came third!The road down to the beach is unfortunately not that ideal...there are so many curves and turnings and the cliffs above do give you the 'chills' when your mind goes to slidings of rocks and so on which is quite frequent at the sides of the beach...On the other hand if you intend to swim there and you have small children I'd say don't let them go deep especially if there are waves.Maybe at the edge the waters are shallow but from one moment to the other you could find yourself in sudden depth.The white sand which is full of pebbles adds this uniqueness to the whole picturesque scenery!

reviews.title: Looked nice from up above
reviews.text: We stopped here for photos as part of a tour of the island.  The view from high up was pretty amazing, lovely colours reflected in the sea and it looked idyllic.

reviews.title: It's a beach......
reviews.text: Pleasant beach with clear waters. Safe for bathing. Good views from above on the map road. Good sunset snaps.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: We visited Myrtis beach. Beautiful sea but white stones not sand. Popular area to visit . Either go by tour or by hiring a car which we did. Not easy to walk if disabled. But a beautiful view from the road.

reviews.title: A beautiful part of Kefalonia
reviews.text: I agree with other reviews that the view from above Myrtos beach is the most stunning, however there is nothing like actually walking on one of the most beautiful places in Kefalonia.Our visit was at the end of the day as the sun was sinking over the sea. There was still some warmth in the sun and the colour of the azure sea against the white pebbles/ stones was beautiful.It was quiet and we parked on the back of the beach. Reading some of the reviews regarding the toilets takes away the main reason for visiting this beach. It’s beauty.It is humans that create the dirty toilets and nature that creates Myrtos beach. We spent a few minutes on the way back to our car picking up litter and mess left by other visitors to help keep this area clean.Don’t worry about toilets and score the area one star. Sit on one of the large white rocks, look up and down the beach then stare out to sea and thank god that you are still alive to enjoy it.

reviews.title: Toilets a disgrace 2
reviews.text: This beach looks like paradise. We just wanted to change but the toilets were disgusting, truly horrible. We left . Don't go, just look at it from above and enjoy the beauty.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world!
reviews.text: Myrtos beach has an amazing view! It's the most famous sight of Kefalonia, one of the best beaches in the world and you must take a swim there! Be careful because it can be too wavy and even dangerous deep when it's very windy!!

reviews.title: Doesn't disappoint
reviews.text: Just like the photos it is a spectacular place to visit, ensure that you get photos from the top before going down to the beach itself.

reviews.title: Toilets a disgrace
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and views on walk down to it but toilet facilities not acceptable and spoiled what could have been a good experience.  Cave was worth a visit, easy to access and room to stand up in. Lovely white pebbles and sand and someone had made some interesting sculptures from the pebbles which were really cool.

reviews.title: Idyllic
reviews.text: The pictures of this beach don't lie. The view from the road above highlights the contrast between aquamarine blue sea and brilliant white beach which is pebbly rather than sandy. Free Car parking is available at beach level but take your own sunshades and drinks. Be warned the sea can be quite rough but even on calm days there can be an strong undertow and there is a shelf with a step drop that goes from knee deep to overhead quite quickly.Lifeguards we're on duty. That said, it's one of those picture postcard sites you must visit.

reviews.title: Peace Haven
reviews.text: The view from the mountain road is amazing and a fabulous photo opportunity. Lovely white part sandy/pebbly beach with turquoise water. Very quiet but we did visit on a Friday in June. Will probably be busier at weekends and height of season. There is nowhere to eat/drink so take your own provisions but there are toilets and parking available.

reviews.title: Beautiful from afar, not so nice up close!
reviews.text: Like other reviews on here, the view of this beach from the mountain road is undoubtedly stunning. However, when we went down there later in the day, I was pretty disappointed! Yes the sea is wonderfully blue, but I have to say rather murky (definitely not for snorkelling) with some litter floating in it! And there are zero facilities except some rather overused toilets. To me, it also felt like a gravelly quarry when we were down there. I would say definitely worth a drive over to view it from the top, but if you do decide to venture down, make sure you have plenty of food, drinks (it’s especially hot due to the heat reflecting off the stone), a parasol (there are no naturally shaded areas), towels, flip flops (the stones are painful!), and a strong bladder.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: If there was a paradise it sure would be Myrto beach in kephalonia! Breathtaking view with tuirquose water ,like being at the edge of the earth! Simply amazing'

reviews.title: Well deserved ‘must see’ beach
reviews.text: No visit to Kefalonia would be complete without checking out Myrtos Beach. Brilliant white, rounded pebbles make for the most amazing azure sea. Steep descent so perhaps not for nervous drivers but safe enough if you take your time and don’t be distracted by the view!  Basic and disgusting toilet facility at back of beach but this is intended to be an unspoilt, uncommercialised, Captain Correlli beach. Changing facility in middle of beach - if this includes decent toilets I stand corrected!Lasting memories if you swim here believe me.

reviews.title: Beautiful for sure
reviews.text: The beach is gorgeous no doubt. On the road to the beach there's a view point that has stunning views of the beach below. The down side is that the sea is very choppy /rough, and it seems its like this all around the year. No showers, no sun beds and on top of that it's a pebble beach so it's not the most comfortable.

reviews.title: Pretty but no facilities.
reviews.text: Beautiful from the road above, a bit of a let down when you get down there unless you like lying in a gravel pit. Hate to think what the loos were like.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Had a photo stop on the Tui premium island tour. Boy its breathtakinging beautiful... Captain Corellis beach. The sea is so many shades of torquoise. It would be accesible by car down a steepish winding road. No beds umbrellas or cafes, very few people. Just a stunning get away from it all place. From our photo stop point the smell of the sea and wild thyme completed the picture for me

reviews.title: Romance with Captain Corelli
reviews.text: We hired a car and drove to Mythos Beach. Not disappointed. The water was warm and inviting. The drive down to the beach not for the faint hearted. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach used in captain Corelli mandolin film. Crystal clear seas and lovely blue tones, looks like the Caribbean, Lovely spot to visit

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: Excelent beach, do not expect that you can use the toilets. I don’t why they don’t put a tax for toiletes in order to be clean..

reviews.title: OMG Stunning... white beach and crystel clear blue waters
reviews.text: after popping into Assos we came here... oh my... I really cant put into words how utterly beautiful this beach is... no beds or bars etc, so take a cool bag drinks and get an umbrella from the local shop... this way you can stay longer and enjoy the stunning beach

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Wonderful beach. We love it. Waters crystal clear. Pity there are no facilities. Would be great to have a small taverna for water and snacks.

reviews.title: breathtaking but can be dangerous
reviews.text: The most photographed beach of Kefalonia! And it is stunning with the turquoise water, steep cliffs and white beach. If you are driving around the island, make sure you stop above the beach to take photos. For swimming its not the best beach though, it can get rather dangerous with high waves and strong currents. What from above looks like sand is actually white pebbles which makes it hard to get out of the water. Good to know: Winding roads down to the beach Be careful! Myrtos is very affected by weather and wind - don't swim if the flag is red! Definitely not ideal for small kids.Facilities are limited (depends of the season). In the high season the beach struggles with wasps. Can be difficult to find a parking.The perfect time to go to Myrtos would be a windless day in the end of the season when the water is warm and the most people and cars are gone (and hopefully the wasps).

reviews.title: Mighty myrtos not for the bare footed
reviews.text: Awesome location,sandwiched between two mountains ,from above it looks crystal clear with fine white sand ,but in reality it's a stone filled beach ,with stones all the way too the breakwater ,kids wouldn't be safe swimming as the waves are huge ,some as big as four feet and crash onto the beach at very quick intervals ,I am a strong swimmer but found myself unable to get out to calmer water ,although a few hardy people did ,all in all I'd say visit some of the easier beaches particularly near Sami as they were all sand and easy to swim in ,

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Stunning beach, great swim! But take food and drink as there's no bar or restaurants. Especially if you're travelling by bus as the walk to the nearest village is a long one up the mountain, so you are pretty much stuck there until your bus collects you. Also, take beach shoes as the pebbles going into the sea hurt your feet!

reviews.title: Stunning beach, amazing clear water and very few tourists
reviews.text: Had a great day on myrtos beach. Was able to drive down to and park really close to the beach. Bring your own umbrella though as there is very little shade available.

reviews.title: You MUST GO
reviews.text: You must go there for sure! Just choose a day with out a wind otherwise is dangerous! The waves will not let you go out.

reviews.title: Supposedly the best in the island
reviews.text: A very big beach but very stony so not good for us. Petani is better. There is parking nearby. Not much in the way if refreshments by the beach.

reviews.title: Awestruck
reviews.text: Truley a wonder of the natural world. One of the most beautiful beaches in the world . Crystal turquoise waters white sand amazing x

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: We stopped here for a quick swim as we passed. What an amazing place. Wonderful clear warm sea.Quite pebbly underfoot, but the views and sea make up for that

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Sadly nothing really exists there anymore for such a stunning location. You would think the locals would of capitalised after the filming of “Captain Corelli’s Mandolin” In the short period we were there loads of tourists came down but soon left

reviews.title: World class
reviews.text: View from the top is amazing 😉 , and the drive down is spectacular, beautiful beach 🏖 we got there early so it was quiet 🤫 you would enjoy it better if you take water shoes it’s a pebble beach albeit small pebbles , take a parasol there is no natural shade . Worth a visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful Location
reviews.text: Driving in a hire car, we eventually found the turn off to Myrtos Beach but our mistakes gave us beautiful views over it first. The steep road down was a bit hair raising, but we made it!!  No shade on the beach so only stayed 2 hours but worth the trip.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach probably best viewed from afar. There is a very good viewing area on the main road to the north of the beach. Waters are turquoise set off beautifully by white shore and not spoilt by rows of sun beds (at least in May). If you do decide to venture down tempted by the turquoise water as we were, you will be faced with a fairly narrow road with hairpins (well this is Kefalonia!). Once there there was a small area for parking. Beach actually consists of small pebbles and is quite uncomfortable to walk on. However, for somewhere so attractive, it was not crowded. Sea was calm and nice temperature to swim.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: To start the drive down was nerve racking, except for me driving, the cliff roads towards the beach were on the edge and then down towards the beach were steep.However it was worth it for an amazing beachThe sea was lovely and not too wavy.It was crystal clear turquoise and a great swim.The beach was white and simple. No beach bars here. Worth a visit.Some fantastic photos, from the top and from the beach.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: Stopped here for a photo opportunity whilst on a tour of the island. The views are absolutely stunning really Beautiful, it's a must visit of you're in kefalonia.

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: What can I say absolutely fantastic beach. We were on an island tour with TUI and the view down into the beach is fantastic.

reviews.title: Breathtaking Views
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos beach during a family holiday in May you will need a car to get to the beach, the drive down to the beach itself is pretty spectacular and you have to stop to take photos.  The beach itself is small stones so would take beach shoes to avoid painful feet.  I don't think the beach would be suitable for young children as the waves were dumping on the beach quite strongly during our visit and there were no sunbed or facilities but this could have been due to the fact it was early in the season.Well worth a visit for the views.

reviews.title: What a view
reviews.text: My wife and I went on an island tour and this beach is a must.  If you visit Kefalonia put this on your list.  The beach is stunning and the different shades of blue in the sea is amazing

reviews.title: A must see beach apparently!
reviews.text: We drove from the North up to Myrtos and Assos. A fantastic drive. Lots of hair-pin bends so drive carefully. And watch out for rocks on the road.Pull over safely at the top before descending and see the best views of the beach. Blue Sea against a white pebble beach looks amazing.Drive down for limited parking. There is no shade apart from the cave at the end. But be careful as rocks fall down all the time near the cave, great views inside and water in there too.Cool clear water and nice for swimming. A Stony beach so not comfortable. But OK. We went in the morning at 11am.. Not busy in May! So parked easily. Not sure where cars park in Peak season once full!We headed to Assos after here, which is amazing. More scary driving, but take it slowly and you'll be fine.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: It looks better from above. Nice beach but preferred petani beach.worth a visit but there are better beaches to see.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: the view of the beach is breathe taking and well worth the visit to swim in the crystal clear waters is lovely there are no toilets or shop there

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and clearblue water!You can see the beach from a hill and then you can go down to the beach.Good road so it’s No problems with drivning down.It’s a must see place on Kefalonia!

reviews.title: Wow wow and wow
reviews.text: The trip down to the beach is hazardous but well worth it but a word of warning not good for children or adults that can't swim very deep water straight away as one walks in

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Everything you've read, heard seen on the television does not do justice to this breathtaking view. Its certainly worth a visit and make sure you take your camera.

reviews.title: Beautiful from a height.
reviews.text: We stopped here to look over this amazing looking beach but did not bother with going down as it is a pebble beach and it can get very busy. The water is a stunning colour and looks inviting but is a little tricky to get down to as there is only one road you can use t get on to the beach.

reviews.title: Don't bother!
reviews.text: Went to this on the strength of the recommendation in the guide book, but driving down the hill, all we could see was wall to wall people. On getting down, we had a drink of water, and left, stopping to take a couple of photos from the viewing point.

reviews.title: OMG, the sea here beats even the Maldives!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, well worth the near motion sickness getting to it!!My only complaint.. there are not that many fishes in the sea!! Honestly though, can’t fault itPs beware: no shade or shelter, or places to buy water on the beach so bring your own!

reviews.title: Stunning but busy
reviews.text: Amazingly beautiful beach where the white gravel - wouldn't call it sand, creates the most azure blue sea. This is the problem! It gets so busy on the beach that it is not relaxing at all. We lasted ½ hour then left for a quieter beach. A must see mind.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: We didn't go onto the actual beach as the coach could not get down there but we stopped for a photostop and it is beautiful!It is defiantly worth a stop there to just see it for yourself!

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: A must-see when in Kephalonia! The turquoise and blue water against the white stones is so beautiful, even on a cloudy day. There is a place to park and take some photos up top off the main road. The drive down was much easier than I expected from the other reviews. Don't try to go barefoot or you will have very sore feet.

reviews.title: Famous For It’s Beauty
reviews.text: Myrtle beach is always featured in travel brochures and this is because it is so beautiful when viewed from above. One day we decided to go to the beach to see it properly. The sand was clean  and it was a lovely beach for families because the sea was not deep at the edge of the beach. The road down to the beach was steep and the cars were parking at the bottom of the hill actually on the beach. It would be nicer to have a carpark specifically for the beach without intruding on to the sand in cars

reviews.title: WOW!!
reviews.text: This just took our breath away! Approaching it from the main road we pulled over and looked down onto the beach below and just knew we had to go down to walk on the beautiful white sand. The sea was a bright turquoise colour and just as in the pictures we had seen advertising Kefalonia. The road down is very winding with some very acute bends but worth every minute. We walked along the sands and everyone we spoke to was just as in awe of the scenery as we were...in particular a guy from Panama!Highly recommend a trip here ...you will not be disappointed!

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: We had a fantastic drive along the coast road to get here with breathtaking views. The road down from the village to the beach is steep but take care and it's fine. You will realise when you go down why coaches can't get there but this makes the place more special as there isn't coach loads of people. The beach is mainly pebbles and shingle and the sea gets deep quite quickly.Well worth the visit.

reviews.title: WOW Stunning Beach
reviews.text: We walked from Agia Efimia (crazy idea but we managed!) the views from the top are amazing, the colour of the sea is unbelievable. We walked down to the beach and had not brought swim shoes! As we were travelling light! Big mistake! The pebbles absolutely kill your feet and they shift when you walk on them so it’s hard to get out. Be careful the waves are so strong and the undertow could feel a little scary Well worth visiting the locals pride and joy! They often ask if you’ve been.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Visited Myrtos beach and the drive down to the parking was breath taking. Views of the beach are amazing especially how the colours are so indistinctive, was truly worth the visit.If staying in Skala it is about one hour drive and is totally recommended for visit. The beach was clean and nice, able to swim.The only let down to the beach is the fact that the toilet and changing facility have not been maintained - hence why the 3* and not 5*. The beach itself is definitely worth the 5* but the experience that me and a friend had visiting the WC facility was horrific. The toilets were all closed(locked) so unable to gain any access to them. The only one that was open was awful and sickening to see. The changing area also smelt and seemed like it was used as an excretion area instead of the closed toilets.Would recommend going to a WC before attending the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Just amazing. Would suggest to have swim shoes to spare your feet especially if you are not use to walking barefoot, with you as the beach is sandy and full of pebbles. Most beautiful white pebbles. Also be careful it  starts shallow and then sudden deap drop into the ocean. But worth the visit.

reviews.title: I'm sure it's all been said before
reviews.text: The best beach I have ever seen the view from above is amazing if your in a car do drive down the dodgy windy road to have a walk along it the sea is the craziest colour I've ever seen truly beautiful

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Just back from the fabulous island of kefelonia and will return , myrtos beach is an absolute must one of the best of many beautiful beeches on the island.

reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Large, famous beach that has beautiful pebbles, unfortunately no sand so beach/sea shoes strongly recommended. Very pretty small cave area at southern end of the beach for special photos. Virtually empty on a sunny warm day early April. Wierd seeing mountain goats coming down onto the beach area!

reviews.title: What a shame
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach - one of the most famous beaches in Greece! Even the World! So come on Greek authorities let's see this beach at its best.  It was so much better when there were toilet facilities, umberellas and a canteen. The council must be losing so much money by not providing these facilities any longer. Not everyone is able to sit on stony beaches and you dare not go there without shade and water.  So anyone who used to spend a few hours there I would advise only 1 hour without the above facilities

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Un po’ difficile da raggiungere, ma quando ci arrivi sembra un posto fuori dal nulla, acque limpidissime ed onde mozzafiato, ci ritorneremo sicuramente.A bit 'difficult to reach, but when you get there seems a place out of nowhere, crystal clear waters and breathtaking waves, we will definitely return

reviews.title: Worth the drive
reviews.text: We went to this beach just to take photos and it did not disappoint. It is beautiful and the drive down is lovely. Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but be aware of rip tides
reviews.text: Was there a few years back and the sea although not rough the waves were quite big due to the steep angle of the beach going in to the sea, I got caught out by a rip tide and luckily didn't panic 'too much' and waited until the sea "let me go" about 100 metres out, didn't bother going back in, not something ill forget in a hurry. Stunning place to visit, yes the approach road is a bit dicey, but take your time and it will be fine. Stay in your depth if the waves are misbehaving!

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach...Wild and Beautiful
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is a prized beach and one of the earthly paradises!!!In one contest it came first in Europe and in another 3rd worldwide.The scenery is incredible whether you take photos from the top or drive down to the beach.However if you decide to drive down have in mind that you'll have to extra careful of the road-it's not in the best condition.You'll also find that a lot of fences have been put up in places to keep rocks from falling-which happens every time there's an earthquake.No surprise there.But the beach itself compensates you!White sand and pebbles all along the beach and crystal clear waters.Restrict yourselves to the middle of the beach and avoid the sides at the far end due to small avalanches.It would be wise not going very deep.The waters may be shallow at first but they suddenly get  a bit steep especially if it's a windy day .If you have small children,just keep them restricted to the shallow part.In any case,it's an experience not to be missed.Photos of Myrtos do not do it justice-it's far more beautiful in real life!!!It's also one of the areas where the filming took place of Captain Koreli's Mandolin starring Nicholas Cage and Penelope Cruise.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is without doubt the most beautiful beach in Greece and one of the most dramatic. Before heading to Myrtos beach try to drive to the panorama viewpoint seen on the way to Assos, i.e. after passing Divarata. The breathtaking view daytime is stunning. The sunset from the same viewpoint attracts people from all around the Island. The beach is crowded daytime,  but very peaceful after 18 p.m for those who want to enjoy the ambience in harmony with nature and the surrounding mountains. The Myrtos Bay is backed by steep limestone cliffs. Dedicate at least one day for Myrtos Beach and its surroundings.

reviews.title: Stunning beach!!
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is absolutely beautiful! The bluest and cleanest water! Best to pack a picnic lunch and plenty of water as there isn't much around at all. Another idea would be to bring a beach tent/umbrella. I didn't spend much time at this beach so I didn't need any of the above..

reviews.title: beautiful view
reviews.text: It was beautiful - but it is stone and not sand so it made itDifficult to walk on. It was very busy and the sea was clear and blue.

reviews.title: Unbelievably beautiful
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach! But come prepared with sun shades, chairs/sunbeds, towels, water, food etc because there is nothing else there!

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: Maybe one the nicest beaches in Kefalonia. For this reason it's usually overcrowded and it's difficult to park. As a preference you should go on the righthand side of the beach. All in all it's worth visiting at least once in a lifetime.

reviews.title: Pure beauty
reviews.text: This place did not have much amenities and had pebbles but the place the water and the feeling you get at this beach is just indescribable MUST GO AND HAVE EVERYTHING water and food .... it’s just sad it’s under developed

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Myrtos Beach is beautiful and worth a visit but don't expect to stay very long. The views are stunning but when we visited at the end of May there was no sunbeds or umbrellas making it impossible to sunbath unless you took your own. There is no taverner or shop on the beach so make sure you stock up on supplies before driving down the long, steep winding road!There is a beautiful view point from the road at the top looking down onto the beach if you don't fancy the drive down.

reviews.title: Better from above...
reviews.text: It's the backdrop that makes this a stunning view. It's a long way down, and in my opinion, not worth the trip.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach!
reviews.text: A gorgeous beach with white gravel like marble, the water is very deep at the shore, but since it is ff salty it's not a problem! The problem is that you do not find a parking space, you have to bring your sun umbrella becouse sun is hot and so do not miss the drinks because there are no shops or restaurants!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: A beautiful beach worth the steep winding decent. Not the biggest beach I. Imagine it's busy in the summer.  I went in April before the tourist season so it was almost deserted, but still just about warm enough to swim. I highly recommend paragliding for more amazing views!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: The view from above as you drive down to tis beach is stunning.  It is a small narrow twisty road with many switchbacks, not easy to do up or down but undoubtedly worth the effort.  There are many facilities on the beach so if you can bring food and drink with you.The sea is a stunning blue, it is not a sandy beach but tiny white gritty stuff.make the effort for the day and get out to this stunning beach

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and setting, could be better cleanliness and water clarity
reviews.text: Lovely setting and easy to get to.Beach itself is mixture of sand and pebbles.The shop/cafe was shut when we went and facilities close except for 1 which had been broken open plus had no water so was not at all pleasant.There was some litter left in the beach and the water was murky with white dust so was good to swim but not snorkel.

reviews.title: Great scenery but not for swimming
reviews.text: Visited on a windy day in October. The scenery was spectacular and the pebbly beach attractive but the waves and pebbly beach made it dangerous and painful to get in and out of the sea. Only four lads went in while we were there and one had difficulty getting out. At the end of October all facilities except one WC were closed.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: We recently visited this beach and unfortunately we were disappointed . There is no doubt that the view from above is stunning and the colour of the sea is turquoise blue . However as you descend to the beach it loses its charm . It's still a nice beach but by no means fabulous . We found another beach near Sami which was beautiful  and that we much preferred ( antisamos beach)

reviews.title: Amazing deep blue sea like in a dream
reviews.text: First you need to catch the view from the top. It's just amazing and incredible how blue and pure it is.. Then go down on the beach. Can be wavy, but so nice !

reviews.title: Beautiful but paddling is painful
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach, turquoise waters leading to deep blue water. Beach is very pebbley which is painful underfoot. Taverna and toilets in summer, nothing in Winter.  Easy to park in winter. Lots of photo opportunities on main road.

reviews.title: Stunning Colours
reviews.text: We had heard about this beach as being one of the top 10 in the world, so we HAD to see it for ourselves. We drove the coast road up from Agostoli. To say it was an experience is an understatement. We are both not the best with heights and not realising that this coast road was so high, it was quite an unnerving drive. Rock falls, missing barriers, coach drivers coming towards you with one hand on the wheel and the other holding a mobile phone!!!! It was a relief to get there. It's a steep road down with plenty of hairpin bends and there is a small car park at the bottom. Ok in October but in July/August must be a nightmare. The colour of the water is fantastic.
