I've never seen sea like it. Every hue of blue imaginable - absolutely gorgeous. Be warned though it is a pebbly beach and the surf is strong enough to knock you off your feet.(Some kind of footwear is advisable). Once past the break though it's relatively calm. There are shops just off the coast rode just before you get to the beach, that sell beach equipment and toys. Overall though the beach is definitely worth a visit if just for the stunning views, but one of the worlds top 10 hmmm not so sure. PS we found out afterward that there is a cross country road that we could have used. DOH!

reviews.title: Very impressive, even if only seen from the Main Road
reviews.text: We went on an island tour and has a look at this famous beach from the main road at each side and it is easy to see how it became a feature location of the film Captian Corelli's Mandolin... The drive down is impressive enough by the look of it also

reviews.title: Stay up and take a photo.
reviews.text: It's a very pebbly beach with strong waves - pretty from above but for a visit you're better off driving elsewhere!

reviews.title: Second best beach in Greece!
reviews.text: There are two greatest beaches in Greece: Egremnoi and Myrtos. I was very lucky to swim on the first one before the earthquake of 2015/11/17 destroyed it forever and I had a chance to have a glimpse of Myrtos from the viewpoint during my one day’s trip to Kefalonia  from Zakynthos. As compared to Egremnoi, Myrtos seems to be a shorter, but wider. And it has pebbles in a jumble with sand whereas Egremnoi had small white pebbles only – so soft and pleasant for your feet...The water in both places is just stunning: Nice is nervously smoking on the sidelines - for sure! :) :) :)

reviews.title: holiday october 2017
reviews.text: beautiful beach, amazing views from the top of the cliffs. very clean, crystal clear water, the road in is  very steep and twisting......nit for the faint hearted

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Just look at it!Went for a short visit a couple of days ago, nice and quiet this time of year but still beautiful - didn’t have any problems parking right on the beach

reviews.title: Much more scenic from the cliff
reviews.text: No doubt about it this beach is a photographer idea of heaven!  Although it looks tricky to get to it wasn't that bad - a steep winding road but wide enough for two cars to pass comfortably!  We had no problem parking but I imagine it gets very busy in the main holiday season.  The beach is actually rather rocky and pebbly when you get onto it - but it does look lovely.  It has tavernas and facilities with beds and parasols.  The waves were very rough and as I'm not a strong swimmer I only paddled.  I noticed that getting in was much easier than getting out - many people struggled with the powerful waves knocking them over onto the rough pebbles.  I was pleased that I visited but I think I would just stop at the top to look next time!

reviews.title: Breathtakingly beautiful Myrthos Beach
reviews.text: Myrthos Beach is absolutely beautiful. The colours of the sea are simply stunning! The beach has small pebbles so do protect your feet!

reviews.title: Stunning location.
reviews.text: Amazing beach with wow factor location. Azure blue sea and golden beach. Stony with sand. Steep gradient once in water so quickly out if your depth. Appears sheltered from the tide on day of visit. Sunbeds and umbrellas available for a fee. Showers and toilets/changing cubicles FOC on beach. Small kiosk for food and drink about 5 min uphill walk from beach. A definite must if anywhere near.

reviews.title: Beautiful but not the best for swimming.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach after a very steep descent which I wouldn't like to do in high season! Amazing panoramic views from up top. Beautiful clear water and lovely white pebbles. No taverna, but toilets and changing rooms are there. Sunbeds if you want them. Not much parking so not sure how it would be in august. Steep shelf into  the water with Quite strong currents and a strong undertow , not for a weak swimmer or someone unsteady on their feet.

reviews.title: Fabulous but not the best
reviews.text: Fabulous view from above but the beach itself isn't as good as say Petani or Antisamos with very large pebbles and a steep drop into the water.Be warned, it's very easy to miss the turning especially coming from the north as the sign is a couple of yards back from the main road.

reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.text: Myrtos beach is breathtaking! Both from looking at the turquoise see from above and being on the beach itself! You need swimming shoes as the see it pebbly and be aware to dips quickly.

reviews.title: Turquoise heaven
reviews.text: For a very long time Myrtos seemed almost mythical to me. Here I was in rainy London and there was this place, miles away, with this impossibly turquoise blue sea and stunning backdrop. I was longing to get there and when I finally did, I thought I was in heaven. You see, I'm a proper beach bum (are you allowed to say 'bum' on TripAdvisor? ) and I do love when sea is perfectly blue. It is a beautiful, stunning, gorgeous, incredible place and no wonder it is often mentioned in the best beaches category. I was lucky to visit Myrtos beach twice during my past holiday. From what I hear, I was also lucky to be able to swim there (day one only). The waves were way too big the next day. Having said that, the beach still looked beautiful and I did some paragliding with 'No Borders' team who were there that day (big shout out to them, they were fantastic!).From the more practical point of view, the beach was easy to find, the road leading to it not scary at all and there was no problem with parking space (mid August). No umbrellas/sun loungers so bring your own. There are 2 viewpoints up the hill, one of each side and they are a must stop for the one last photo of this stunning beach.

reviews.title: superb visa
reviews.text: The visa from the top of the hill overlooking the bay is wonderful. The clear water shows a sandy shelving beach clear of rocks except for the edges. The road down to the beach may be a no-no for nervous drivers. When down on the beach one may be disappointed how commercialised it is with taverna and beach umbrellas but I guess that's what one has to expect.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches i have seen.On windy days it is quite dangerous as the waves could reach the hight if 2-3m.A must see place . You need to know swimming to use the water as it deeps down dramatically a couple of meter away from beach

reviews.title: Breathtaking Location
reviews.text: The most fantastic location with white pebbles and turquoise sea, fantastic views over the headlands.  There is parking at the beach.  Need shoes to get to the sea as very pebbly.  The sea dips quickly so there is surf to get through when swimming.  there is a small beach cafe, limited toilets and changing facilities.

reviews.title: Breathtaking view from above and below
reviews.text: The sun shining on the beach and sea when we pulled up off the road at a viewing place above the beach, made us take a breath, it's a wow factor!   The road to the area and down to the beach is pretty scary at times and not for the faint hearted.  We were lucky that it was quiet when we visited and fairly easy to drive there without meeting anyone coming the other way!  It's definitely worth the drive though and once down on the beach we were surprised how big the waves are and how dramatic it is.  The sea is not good for swimming unless you are a strong swimmer as the waves are big and strong and there's a ledge which drops down when entering the sea.  The beach is pebbly/stony which explains the white nature of it.  There are facilities on site such as toilets and a café bar.  I saw a bus come down to the beach too so presumably there is a bus service though not sure how often this runs.  The car parking was ok for us as it wasn't too busy but not sure what it will be like at the height of summer and popular times.  The parking is free of charge.  There is no shelter from the sun either so be prepared.  It was one of the nicest beaches however on the island and should not be missed - even if you just view from above.

reviews.title: Beautiful Myrtos Beach
reviews.text: A must visit Beach on this gorgeous island of Kafelonia ! Clear blue sea , with white sand. Plenty of sun beds and umbrellas to hire ! Safe for swimming with a majestic landscape as a back drop. Lots of great restaurants nearby for fantastic Greek food to enjoy when you leave the beach !

reviews.title: Must see !
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places to see on the island! Crystal clear water and breath taking views on the way to the beach

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach / Pylaros
reviews.text: A beach like a super postcard or for never-ending holidays; rocks and high cliffs, deep blue sea; there are sunbeds to rent; is a sandy with pebble beach.

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: Travelling up to fiscardo we decided to pull over and take pictures from above of Myrtos beach which looked absolutely amazing, but little did we know that we could drive down to the beach AND there was free parking too.Beach was gorgeous and wasnt packed at all, and the sea was piercing blue.Spent a couple of hours here, pure bliss.

reviews.title: Posers Paradise
reviews.text: It's only wonderful from the high cliff tops. Once down on the beach it is full of posing "beach professionals". It's mostly pebbly and what sand there is, is sharp and uncomfortable to walk on. There are plenty of better options that are quieter and with fewer "pouches" on display.

reviews.title: The more times You come the more MAGICAL it gets!
reviews.text: This is a chameleon beach! No wonder it is one of the most beautiful beaches on planet earth!At first I wasn't impressed much...yes, the color of the sea is turquoise/marine blue combination - beautiful when seen from one of the 2 spots on the main road above the beach...but than you reach the beach and think to yourself "oh, well, these pebbles hurt my legs" and although there is sand in the middle of the beach You still have to walk the pebbles to reach the water. Some good water snickers made this no longer a problem! We bought ours for 10euros pair and that was great because we used them on other beaches too! (most beaches in Kefalonia have pebbles, especially those on the north and west side)And than, because we were situated in the village just above Myrthos, we were passing by every day, we started seeing the colors change, in the morning and during sunset, when it was windy and wavy and when the sea was calm and actually it looked its best when there were high waves and it was sunny, the colors looked like if a painter was drawing his painting! Absolutely magical!The beach is highly acoustical so the sound of the waves is miraculous!For the bathing part, it is a bit tricky if You are not a good swimmer and it is not that suitable for little kids as the water gets deep fast. The water was good temperature in September, not cold while the sea was calm and pretty warm when there were waves.There are sun beds in the middle of the beach, but we didn't use them, with a small restaurant/cafe, we didn't try it either. There is no natural shade on the beach from 11-14 so either bring a parasol or hide in the little cave on the left side of the beach.

reviews.title: We were but passing by
reviews.text: We had a limited time in transit from Sami to Kefalonia Airport and had taxi take us via Myrtos lookout and Assos. Though it was a dull day, the view down to the beach and across to the brilliant white cliffs of Cape Aghianiou were sensational.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL!
reviews.text: This beach is just spectacular!  The water is an incredible blue, to rival any I have seen in Mauritius and the Maldives.  Take your beach shoes though as there are some pebbles.

reviews.title: Magical Ionian Sea!
reviews.text: The best beach in the anyway magical colors of the Ionian Sea! Placed at the island of Cephalonia with a very easy Access,by Car or moto.

reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.text: What amazing views. Definitely take water shoes as suggested in other reviews very pebbly beach. Take lunch and drinks and just enjoy the day there swimming in turquoise waters. Well worth a day out.

reviews.title: One of my top 5!!!
reviews.text: We arrived in Kefalonia to high waves and choppy waters for 4 days down in the south of the island. We spent those days searching out little coves with calm waters. Finally, the weather changed and it was time to visit Myrtos Beach, a "must see" on my list when planning this trip. As you drive down the twisting roads with hairpin turns, you catch a glimpse of the brilliant blue waters, white shore and high cliffs. Stunning. Breathtaking!In September there were plenty of places to park, no problem. The beach consists of pure white pebbles which is hard to walk on barefoot, but most people use water shoes or leave their flip flops near the water when they swim. The water is CRYSTAL clear and warm. We loved this beach so much we came back the next day!I've been to many beaches in my life, in all different parts of the world,  and Myrtos Beach is definitely up there in my all time top 5 favorites. Wish I was there now!

reviews.title: nice but no sun
reviews.text: we hired a car and went to Myrtos beach, no where to park and no sun at all , stayed for about 3 minutes then went to Ag Efima which is lovely

reviews.title: Best view on beach, take parashute
reviews.text: Very nice view on the beach from top, small white stones not sandy, beautiful most torquize blue water you ever saw, must do is a parashute from top of the hill to the beach. Take camera and just enjoy.

reviews.title: Breathtaking beach
reviews.text: Having viewed the beach from above we decided to venture down the narrow road to the beach itself, looks a worse drive than it is and well worth it, get there early as parking becomes crowded and enjoy!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: We were very disappointed with this beach. Looking down at it from the road but once down there it's really not a very nice beach. It is a mainly pebble beach, but it resembles a builders yard. There are toilets. No food or drink facilities.

reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.text: As we drove down the mountain to the beach, the view takes your breath away! It is definitely worth going to. Take water and snacks with you as there is no restaurants on the beach but that adds to the charm . Beach shoes help walk on the pebbles! You can even go paragliding of the cliff, which of course I had to try and loved it!

reviews.title: Looks spectacular from above
reviews.text: Looks spectacular from above at road level with white sand and crystal clear blue and turquoise water. Beach is white but very stoney so you need suitable footwear to walk on it.at the time we visited the refreshment area was being refurbished so had to leave early but lovely location.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We went as part of a tour of the island with Avgerinos travel experience based in SamiWell worth going on as we got to see this wonderful beach would definitely recommend seeing

reviews.title: Awesome!!!
reviews.text: My wife and I visited Myrtos Beach on 2 occasions and had the time of our lives!! the sea andcolours were incredulous, hardly anything compares, it was joyous for us

reviews.title: Call that a beach?
reviews.text: The best beach on the island, so they say. It is a pretty little crescent shaped beach, with a few rows of sunbeds and straw umbrellas. It also has great views but on the grand scale of magnificent beaches, it falls well short.

reviews.title: Absolutely Stunning Beach with a spectacular sunset!!
reviews.text: A visit to Myrtos beach is a must while you are in Kefalonia island! There is plenty of car park space free of charge. The beach is stunning with tirquase crystal clear waters!! The only drawback is that there is no restaurant, no sunbeds or umbrellas but as we told from locals they plan to make Myrtos beach an organised beach.  We were lucky that we saw an incredable sunset.  We visited the cave that was situated at the very end of beach which was pretty amazing!! Love this beach!!

reviews.title: What a beautiful beach!
reviews.text: An incredible place!  Unlike Petani bay, there are no restaurants, chairs/umbrellas.  You still need you water shoes, this is not a sandy beach!

reviews.title: A very disappointing visit this year...
reviews.text: Unfortunately, this year, there is NO BEACH BAR at all, so when you go to Myrtos, take your own drinks and snacks. Additionally, there is a minimal amount of sunbeds and umbrellas available for rent this year, maybe half of what there normally is. We got to the beach at 11.30am and there were no beds or umbrellas available, so we had a swim, sweltered in the sun for an hour and left. And, if you have sensitive feet, you MUST wear beach shoes, as the pebbles are really tough on your feet.

reviews.title: Myrtos beach
reviews.text: Visited this beach 12 years ago  it was stunning, very few people and sun beds. I was so disappointed this time roun. It is now completely in a state of disrepair. What looked like a bar is been dismantled, just half of it, there are still WC facilities, but looks very dirty overall. The view from  above is still breathtaking so at least you have a wonderful photo.I do hope that can the restored to its former and natural beauty.

reviews.title: Lovely to look at but beware
reviews.text: Lovely to look at but a nightmare to walk on, make sure you take the Jelly Shoes that you can wear on the stony beach and into the water. Nearly crippled me walking down to the sea

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Describing Myrtos beach as "paradise on earth" these are the right words for this lovely and wonderful beach in KefaloniaThe water is clear, diferent blue color tonality, super clean with wonderful sunset.Not to be missed.

reviews.title: Stunning, the sea is an unbelievable colour
reviews.text: This beach is a must to visit, the scenery and views are outstanding, the only downside is the stones are sharp under foot making access to the sea ouchie with out decent foot wear. The sea was warm but can be rough with a strong current.

reviews.title: Best beach we've visited
reviews.text: After a stunning drive down to the beach itself,we found quite a lot of cars parked but the beach size still makes it feel quiet! The colours of the sea will stay with the wife and I for a long time! A must visit for all who come to kefalonia!!

reviews.title: Myrtos beach
reviews.text: A beautiful place.Dont be fooled by the white beach It is pebbles and boulders. But even that said it is a fabulous place to visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but slightly scary drive down the hairpin bends. As with everywhere on Kephalonia the parking is free. Also great views of it from the main road at the top if you didn't fancy the drive down.

reviews.title: Iconic beach but be careful
reviews.text: from the hillside the beach looks fantastic and the colour of the water is amazing. the beach is shingle so can be hard on your feet if not wearing water shoes. When we visited the water was quite rough and was breaking on the shore with 4 foot waves which made getting into and out of the water tricky. we didn't see any warning flags or life guards, there is no cafe or bar although there was some toilets that you could use if you could hold your breathe long enough as they did smell quite badly.

reviews.title: A stunning beach
reviews.text: Probably the most photographed beach in Greece, and described as one of the most dramatic, Myrtos's mile-and-a-half long arc of dazzling white pebbles is an assault on the senses.Whilst it's stunningly beautiful the combination of pebbles, shelving and strong currents mean you have to take real care - especially with the children.It's very exposed – although umbrellas are available for hire.A beach bar and toilet provides everything a sun-worshipper should need.During September it was fairly busy, I can imagine that in high season it's rammed.If you want to take the easy photographic option park up in the lay-by on the main road and shoot away.It really is a visually stunning beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach - Cristal clear water
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach with Cristal clear water. Nicest beach in Kefalonia.Free parking space.Little wite stones on the beach No bar or restaurant at the beach.

reviews.title: Most breathtaking beach in Europe
reviews.text: Amazing beach, big peoples and steep slopes but the drive down to it off the mountain will take your breath away x

reviews.title: Visually stunning!
reviews.text: We rented a scooter to travel around Cephalonia.  The steep road down to the beach suddenly reveals on precipitous lay-bys  the turquoise & azure waves breaking on the beach far below. The sheer size & area of the turquoise surf is startling. There was a strong onshore wind which meant the waves were vertically dumping their full force on the pebbles & there was a undertow, so no one was in the water. This was disappointing, but nothing could detract from the amazingly beautiful turquoise colour.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach view overlook ever
reviews.text: It was a chilly day in October when we visited, so we didn't want to spend any time on a beach, but the view from above was amazing.  There's an overlook where you can stop to get a photo that includes all the vivid blues you can imagine in the water, along with mountains, clouds, outlying islands - it's just a gorgeous view.  If you watch the movie Captain Corelli's Mandolin with Nicholas Cage and Penelope Cruz (and pretty much the only reason to watch it is if you're planning a visit) you'll have fallen in love with this view long before you get there.

reviews.title: Great view, but that's about it..
reviews.text: The views of this iconic beach are amazing! You will need a car to get down to it or a pair of pretty good trainers/hiking boots! And watch out for the goats along the way!This beach has supreme views and is a must for a photo happy tourist! From above, what looks like sand is actually fairly white pebbles. Looks can and usually are deceiving! The water is an amazing color but I unfortunately didn't get a chance to go in do to the amazing lack of parking! This is a photographers friend but there are much better beaches to go to should you wish to enjoy your day and bath in the ocean.Worth a look for Instagram's sake but wouldn't spend the day. Best to do it when near to the area and combine this with other activities.

reviews.title: A beautiful beach with the whitest pebbles and an amazing view from above
reviews.text: First saw this heavenly place from the road above on our way to the hotel and decided to stop to take pictures which decision I'm very grateful for (photos attached). The view and the beach itself is very identical to the famous Navagio (Shipwreck) beach in Zakynthos. However we went there at around 5 in the afternoon and it was so wavy that I didn't even fully get in the water though it was a great picture material for the photography/Instagram lovers. I would recommend putting swimming shoes on as the beach is stony (the pebbles were so white and beautiful that I took some home to remind of that place) and you might hurt your feet. The beach is accessible by car, bus, bike, waking and I hear a public bus stops right there. Disadvantage is that I didn't see any bars, restaurants or bathrooms and I'm not a fan of peeing in the see.

reviews.title: Impressive view
reviews.text: Impressive work of nature. The view from the main road is breath taking.The send is so fine, so soft, fondle the feet. The water is deep with waves usually so you cannot let you toddler or a small child to play in a shallow. My advice is to get up early if you want to enjoy this beach given the fact that you can find shade only in the morning hours and early after noon. There is limited number of sunbeds and umbrellas, also you can always carry on your own and enjoy all day in the beach. Also, there are no organised parking space so you have to park on the/next to the road and that can be very high and include a lot of walking. Beach offers a kite surfing.To be honest, I've enjoyed more in a view and scenery than in a swimming.

reviews.title: Great View from the Lookout Point above the beach
reviews.text: There is a fantastic view of the beach and colourful sea from a lookout point on the road above Myrtos Beach. You can also see the old Venetian fortress of Assos in the distance. It's worth stopping for a photo or two.

reviews.title: Good but not quite up to first impressions
reviews.text: You first see the beach from the top of the cliffs and it looks stunning. After you drive down a slightly twisty but perfectly safe road you reach the beach. Parking is limited so get there early. One end has sun chairs and umbrellas. There is a kiosk. And the beach is white pebbles, although it's quite comfortable if you have a towel.  There is quite a steep drop off into sea and day we went sea was cloudy so couldn't see bottom.  Quite choppy so be carefully.  Worth a visit though

reviews.title: Stunning scenery
reviews.text: Parked up, walked down and the beach is every bit as stunning as the top but , be aware you do need sensible shoes to walk on this beach as it is very stoney, and the sea is no different. I do not swim and it was not pleasent to sit in as the waves crashing against you are also bringing in the stones.There are limited sun beds available at what cost I do not know. There is a kiosk to get snacks , drinks reasonably priced. There are toilets and changing facilities too. Best advice is get there early therefore no hiking back up hill to car.!!

reviews.title: THE place to go
reviews.text: Everyone says this is one of the most beautiful beaches in the Medditerranean, and with good reason. The view from the hilltop leaves you speechless! The color of the water is amazing, completely surreal!A recommendation to come early, or you will have to park all the way up the hill, and the climb is quite steep :)

reviews.title: Amazing beach but not much else there
reviews.text: Warning to all who travel make sure you take food and drinks because although the beach does have a snack bar for some unknown reason it was closed and you could only order things you wanted and then you would have to wait one hour to get it. Crazy but true, so make sure you take provisions because it is well worth it. The beach has limited sun beds and umbrellas. On the day we went we were told that they were free for some unknown reason. The beach is absolutely spectacular in colour and you will have never seem the sea such a brilliant, almost unbelievable effervescent aqua blue. It is truly amazing and you must visit this beach. It has pebbles and waves so you need to be a good swimmer. Also water shoes are required if you have sensitive feet..

reviews.title: Speechless
reviews.text: Maybe we was at the right time and season but the real colours of rhe water it s ten times more beautiful than the pictures..amazing beach!!Buy your beach shoes for stoney beach if you are foot sensitive😀The bar was close at the time we was there so bring your cooler with you!Sunbed was available but better on the towel...it s to beautiful to have ,,neighbours"

reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.text: We visited here many years ago, so didn't feel that we needed to venture down the winding road to the beach on this occasion. The spectacular colour of the beach and the sea is something to behold. So from the top or the bottom it is just glorious. A must see.

reviews.title: Myrtos Beach, Kefalonia, Greece
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, one of the prettiest I've seen. It is fabulous to see but is rocky and there is a dangerous undertow. For swimming there are other much more suitable (and beautiful) beaches in Kefalonia.

reviews.title: Great beach!
reviews.text: Love this one as it makes a change from the quiet little coves without waves (although we adore those too!!!) huge breakers to jump through and a tiny bit of sandy shingle rather than all pebbles. Get there early though as parking is limited! Clean, and unusually for kefalonia there was a couple of guys selling snacks from coolboxes. Not much shade so take a brolly 😊

reviews.title: Worth the trip
reviews.text: Breathe taking beach well worth the hairy trip up and down the windy hill. A must if you're on the island but dont go by coach.. :)

reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.text: This is a very nice beach. Can be difficult to find parking in the summer months but if you manage to get there it's worth it.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: It's a very nice beach of course, but it also very busy in the high season. It is a must see beach, but other beaches are as beautiful.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: Nice clean pebbly beach, best to get there pre 10am as it's a hike to get there and it does get fairly busy, €7 for 2 sun beds and an Umbrella, there is a small cafe service sarnies, drinks and ice Lollies etc, has toilets and a changing area that is fairly clean.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Actually visited the beach some time ago and only had a brief stopover at a viewing point this time round. If you can get down, it's worth noting that the beach is not what it seems and perhaps not the best place to bathe

reviews.title: stunning
reviews.text: a stunning beech pebbles and sand their is a view point on the way down to the beech do stop and be thrilled with the view very narrow road down also steep. bendy. go early as it gets busy and i mean early on the beech are cold drinks snacks toilets .the toilets are very busy and in need of upgrading there is a life guard and if it is rough he will stop you swimming be aware it is a sun trap

reviews.title: Exquisite
reviews.text: This beach is a must if you are visiting Kefalonia. One of the top 10 most beautiful beaches in the world. The sea is a gorgeous turquoise and crystal clear. Its a stone beach so wear water shoes. There are beach beds and umbrellas to hire but go early to book one. Its a very steep decline to the beach with hairpin bends ..scary to navigate but worth the ride down. There is a beach taverna for drinks and snacks which is very handy because of the long trip back to shops. A nice add on to visiting this beach are the fresh water showers to rinse the salf off after a swim. Highly recommend a visit to Myrtos beach.

reviews.title: Beach with a view driving down to it.
reviews.text: Pebbley  beach with a drive down to it you will never forget famous for its clear water. But a pair of those rubber shoes a necessity to negotiate your way to the waters edge you need to spend at least half a day there to appreciate it.

reviews.title: Stunning views - not to be missed!
reviews.text: I think the views are even better than what you can see on the pictures - just stunning! Pack food and get prepared to spend some time on a wonderful beach. Bring your shoes as it is rocky!

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Nice looking beach from a distance but in reality nothing special.  No shade, no sunbeds for hire.  Busy when we were there.

reviews.title: It is like a fairy tale
reviews.text: This beach is a must see in whole greece island series. Free areas for publicmto settle down with their own stuff, paid umbrella and sunbeds nearby, free shower and changing rooms. Amazing water color. Deep sea. Warning rapidly increasing depth. Beginner swimmers must be careful.

reviews.title: Looks wonderful from a distance
reviews.text: Looking at this beach from above it seems so idyllic but down there we found it to be potentially quite dangerous. Very stony so sea shoes are almost essential because trying to exit the rough breakers can be difficult. Water does get deep quickly and with the big waves I would not risk letting a child into the sea without some kind of safety device. Maybe it was a rough day but with no wind or significant waves anywhere else we visited on the day think this may be the norm. Nice for sunbathing though

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Very nice beach with unbelievable blue waters. The climb down and up (if you have to park your car further away) is quite hard with the heat, but it is alright.

reviews.title: Well worth the visit
reviews.text: Recently toured around the island and were recommended this beach as a must see... after stopping off in Asos we made our way over to the famous kefalonia beach to spend the afternoon there. The parking was pretty easy as we managed to park up on the beach at around 1 pm no problem but we're lucky as someone was just leaving. The beach is shingle then pebbles and shelves quickly once you get into the sea but the sea is well worth it it's beautiful turquoise and warm and regardless of the red flag flying was safe enough to swim in on our visit... however there were no lifeguards present! The care was open fir drinks and icecreams and I think toastie sandwiches... maybe only in august? We had beach mats and sea shoes so we're well equipped . Unfortunately the weather clouded over and we even had a few drops of rain so after a stroll to the cave and a brief swim we left but felt our visit had been worthwhile.

reviews.title: Looks better from a distance
reviews.text: Beautiful when viewed from above.  But it's just a beach.  Not great for kids - it shelves away quickly and is deep. Stony on the edge of the shore. 7 euros for a bed and a brolly. Recommend view from above and move on.

reviews.title: The view from above is magnificent. If you are lucky you can also swim
reviews.text: This beach is the most famous of the island and for good reason. Amazing view and magnificent beach if you are lucky and it is not windy. Otherwise just play with the waves. The parking is problematic during rush hours so go there either early or late in the afternoon.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and breathtaking.  Very easy to park, sea was rough when we visited, but great fun.  Would recommend a visit.

reviews.title: I didn't like it!
reviews.text: It is, as many on here have said, very beautiful...but, this makes it difficult to get to as parking is restricted, crowded (I counted 12 people in a queue for the only one of three showers that was working) of expensive (4 euros for a bottle of water!!).  Go there, take pictures from up high on the mountains, and then go and find another beach to sit on, there are nicer ones!

reviews.title: Landmark
reviews.text: Well it probably should be a must-see. Staff were preventing any cars from parking anywhere on the beach on the Friday we visited, which was unlike previously. But the attraction is from above and clear turquoise waters give amazing photography.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We went to the view point for Myrtos beach on a day tour of the island. It's as breathtaking as all the photos you see. The sea looks all different shades of blue, beautiful. It's definitely worth a look.

reviews.title: Indescribable beauty
reviews.text: I have never seen water so pure turquoise in colour-It looks like its been photoshopped! Not enough loungers and umbrellas but apparently that's because they didn't pay their required dues-naughty naughty! the rocks made it difficult to get into the sea but once in it is wonderful!

reviews.title: Marvellous Myrtos
reviews.text: Arrive early - 10 am latest! That has to be my top tip because after that the road to the beach gets really, really busy.  But it is a wonderfully dramatic beach - blue sea contrasting with white cliffs. There are some sunbeds to hire but no other watersports so not necessarily somewhere to spend the whole day. Take care with younger children as the beach does shelve steeply and the waves and undertow were strong even in August. If you arrive by car from the south, there is a layby on the left (before Myrtos village) that overlooks the beach, where you can get a good photo.

reviews.title: Myrtos
reviews.text: Our day trip to Myrtos Beach was amazing.  We were mesmerized by the water from a distance while traveling to the beach.  Absolutely breathtaking!

reviews.title: Day trip
reviews.text: We visited the beach by bus,limited buses but well worth a trip, beautiful stunning bay turquoise water, however you do need to be careful of the wind causing strong waves which can knock you off your feet!! Not safe for children to swim on those days. Dry steep road down,bus is only 2 euros well worth it.Don't forget your umbrella if you can't stand the sun all day, only a small cafe on the beach selling drinks, icecream and a few snacks.Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Breath-taking view!
reviews.text: Words cannot describe the views at Myrtos. You simply have to see it.Be careful as the beach is not sandy! Sea boots come in handy.Parking can be crowded, it then requires to park on the roadside and walk down the hill.

reviews.title: The perfect beach if the weather is perfect!
reviews.text: It is one of the perfectly preserved beaches looking west that combine exceptionally view with one of a kind clean coloured waters. It is almost not organised with few umbrellas and a very small bar so you have to carry your umbrella and towels. the view both from above and below is breathtaking, especially during sunset. Make sure you hit the beach with calm seas to get the max!

reviews.title: Just Ok if you want to lounge about
reviews.text: Whilst I agree with many of the comments about the view from the hillside above (it is spectacular), you need to be forewarned as to some of the shortcomings of the location.1. Parking is limited, especially at peak times, arrive around 3pm and many people are leaving.2. don't bother with your snorkels, the combination of white sand and waves result in poor visibility.3. Bar only takes cash, no credit cards.That said, if you want to soak up the sun in delightful surroundings, paddle a little, then you'll enjoy your time here.

reviews.title: Literally ... the Best Beach!
reviews.text: I have visited over 25 Greek islands and I can confidently say that Myrtos is the best beach. White sandy beach, crystal clear blue water, stunning natural environment, all set far away from the road, the noise, the chaos of contemporary life. Myrtos is reason enough to visit Kefalonia. It's magnificent!

reviews.title: Looks much better from above
reviews.text: The beach itself is pretty, but it's terribly crowded. It would be a great beach if there was less people there.. A LOT less.

reviews.title: A must see beach
reviews.text: This was a fabulous beach, with an authentic feel and gorgeous pale sand.  The sea was warm and great to swim in, but there is a need for shoes, as the shoreline  is full of pebbles.  However, it was difficult to park, so I would suggest arriving early to beat the crowds.  There is a need for more sun beds and shades for the amount of people it accomodates and another cafe/restaurant would be benificial.  If you want breathtaking scenery, then have a drive out to this beach.

reviews.title: Better to look at it from the hill...
reviews.text: Nice view from the hill...BUT: is a pebbles beach (take shoes!!), gets VERY crowded (and parking gets impossible), has many cold water submarine springs. Reccomended for one visit only (get there quite early in the morning...)

reviews.title: The Most Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: This was the prettiest beach we visited in Kefalonia! It's a very windy road down to the beach which gets full of parked cars arrive early or later on if you want to park close to the beach. There's a bar selling snacks and drinks not brilliant but better than nothing. There's not many sun beds on the beach so be sure to take an umbrella with you if you want to be out of the sun.

reviews.title: Wouldn't miss this beach
reviews.text: Large pebbly beach without sun beads or umbrellas. The waves were fairly big (however it was quite windy). Warm and clear water. Handy shower and changing huts. Cafe on beach. Very famous Kefalonian beach, wouldn't miss.

reviews.title: Nightmare drive and parking
reviews.text: Looks stunningly beautiful   bluest sea ever but the drive and trying to park amongst frankly aggressive Greeks _  in a car they change_   was a nightmare    also the swimming was quite hard work with waves knocking you over  not for kids   and large pebbles  and the sea is actually cloudy with sand   so looks great but disapoints

reviews.title: Great photo opportunity
reviews.text: Plenty of parking places on the roads to Myrtos Beach. Stunning views and the Blue colours of the sea are amazing. The drive around the mountains are not for the faint hearted though, but well worth it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and cave
reviews.text: What a beautiful peeble beach. There is no shade, unless you go in the cave, so you may want to bring an umbrella and chairs. Also pack food and drinks because there is not beach bar. We enjoyed it and the kids like swimming in the cave. However we didn't come prepared with chairs and umbrella so we didn't stay for too long.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: The view from the top is absolutely breathaking, but the beach itself is i think overrated. It is a pebblebeach, it has no natural shade, there is no taverne or anything. But the sea is nice, although not different then on other parts of the island. It can be a bit dangerous at times with little kids or inexperienced swimmers.Take a sunumbrella, a mat and come before 11 otherwise you will have trouble parking.

reviews.title: A much- photographed beautiful beach
reviews.text: My wife and I visited this beach as part of an excursion. From a distance it looks like the most idyllic beach you could imagine with pure white sand. However, the beach itself is made up of very fine white shingle which reflects the suns rays to make this beach very much a Sun trap. If you are looking for banana boats, net skis and the like then don't come here. This is a remote, beautiful beach which is quite difficult to access but beautiful nonetheless

reviews.title: An imperative update
reviews.text: When I visited this beach again in this season, I felt that I had to update my review dated Sept.28, 2015. This time I observed that the umbrellas have gone. There was not even a small buffet selling water and beverage. I couldn't see any lifeguard on duty in such a beach open to the high afternoon vawes. According to the locals, no one applied for a new contract for services and activities in this beach due to high taxing policy of the administration.So, If you want to visit this beach, don't forget to bring your umbrella, portable chairs, food and beverages with you and keep an eye on your children swimming in shallow water which could be dangerous for them by a sudden strong vawe.

reviews.title: Beautiful and breathtaking!
reviews.text: The most amazing clear, blue water! The scenery and pictures coming down the windy road is so beautiful and leaves you speechless. Definitely take a camera and stop on your way down and enjoy the view.MUST: Bring swim shoes as the rocks are big and hurt a lot. There is no shade so if you do not enjoy being in the sun the whole day, a sun umbrella is required. There is a cave on the left hand side where you can go to take a break and catch the shade but it is usually occupied. When we went in July there was no bar/cafe where you can purchase snacks or water, so bring what you need for the day. Apparently, the locals said there is a bar/cafe open in August but I cannot guarantee that is true. There are lots of restaurants once you head up and go up the windy road but nothing close to the beach. There are no water sports or water activities in this area so bring your own entertainment. We brought a volleyball and paddle boards to keep us entertained. Bathrooms are available and a shower as well but no soap allowed in the shower area.Beaches like this one are hard to find so when you arrive, enjoy the views, enjoy the colors, the salty sea and take lots of pictures!! You will not regret it!

reviews.title: Gorgeous but not the best place for a swim
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever seen, but definitely not good for a swim. The waves were very strong, and the pebbles painful. Definitely worth a visit though!

reviews.title: Myrtos
reviews.text: Beautiful beach .Exciting drive down a very steep hill.Car park at the bottom.Small cafe on the beach.Beware the strong undercurrents,they will knock you over

reviews.title: Beautyful
reviews.text: The view is just amazing! Crystal clear water ,really worth to go there! The only problem is that there is no shadows anywhere so you may need an umbrella and not restaurants at all. Only a "snack bar" that offers sendwiches,soft drinks,beers and coffee.

reviews.title: Breath taking scenery
reviews.text: Wow, Myrtos is so stunning, it takes your breath away. One of the most beautiful beaches I ever been to. The waters, are beautifully blue. Beware, there were NO amenities down there, when we went in July 2017. So pack a lunch and umbrellas. There is some shade, early in the day but after midday, the best part of the beach is unshaded. Though, you can hide in the cave. It was the coolest place, like a natural air conditioner! Of course, nothing is perfect. The stunning views come with a price, I found the pebbles to be super painful to walk in. Do invest, in waterproof shoes – it will be worth it, as the majority of the beaches are pebbles anyway.A must see. I also HIGHLY recommend, doing a para-glide flight with No Borders. Truly incredible experience, gentle as a feather.

reviews.title: Lovely views
reviews.text: The view of the beach as you descend the windy mountain road is quite breathtaking and it's no surprise that this beach is very popular with both locals and tourists.We were staying very close, so visited the beach 3 or 4 times.It is sandy in some places and pebbly in others, but very pebbly the nearer you get to the sea, so shoes you can enter the water in would be handy. The water itself is beautifully clear and as warm as bath water! Generally the sea is very very calm here, although on our final day there were bigger waves, although nothing dangerous, they just added to the enjoyment if anything.There are free to use toilets and showers, there is also free parking and a small cafe. There is very little natural shade in the beach, so taking a parasol is a must, although there did seem to be some for hire along with day beds.

reviews.title: Bar open. Not the best beach in Kefallonia.
reviews.text: We arrived at 2pm and although busy waited no time for someone to move on & release a parking space. Small bar/sheltered shack open for drinks/ice creams - no food. And chaise longues/shower.Best from above for spectacular colour - no intimacy or prettiness from ground level!
